***********************************************************************
  Introduction
***********************************************************************

RadioTherapy package based on PHITS (RT-PHITS) is a dose
reconstruction package to evaluate radiation dose in various types of
radiotherapy using PHITS simulation. RT-PHITS contains several modules
which are able to convert DICOM data into PHITS format so that PHITS
simulation can be performed using these data.

CT2PHITS is a module to convert CT number to material composition and
density referring to a conversion table specified by CT2PHITS input
file.  The file "HumanVoxelTable.data" contained in data
directory is such a table based on W. Schneider,
Phys. Med. Biol. 45(2000) 459-478.  CT2PHTIS creates PHITS geometry
input of the phantom image using the converted data. Information
needed to reconstruct the object such as pixel numbers, pixel size,
slice thickness etc. is automatically taken from the DICOM CT data.

PHITS2DICOM is a program to conert 3D dose distribution calculated by
PHITS to data in DICOM RT-dose format. RT-dose file is created by
modifying header information and voxel data of the sample RT-dose file
(sample.dcm) located in "data" directory. Necessary information is
extracted from PHITS outputs and RT-image data used in the calculation
and RT-dose file having the same "Frame of Reference UID" with
RT-image is created. Owing to this conversion, dose analysis of 3D
dose distribution by simultanous display with RT-image using general
DICOM viewer softwares such as "dicompyler
(http://www.dicompyler.com)".

PET2PHITS is a module to create radioisotope (RI) source distribution
inside patient body by convertting PET image data. By converting the
patient CT image together with CT2PHITS, the RI source distribution
can be defined on the patient body in PHITS.

IinputCreater4PHITS is a module to create PHITS input file by
combining source and geometry information converted from DICOM data by
other modules. It will create a complete set of the PHITS input
containing [parameters], [source], [surface], [cell], [material],
[t-3dshow], [t-deposit] sections and therefore you can check the
success of the conversion of data by running PHITS with this input.
This sample input could be a good starting point to produce more
practical PHITS inputs fitting your purpose.

SimpleSource is a module to create simple source input.

DICOMreader is a module to read DICOM binary file and display in text.

ROI2PHITS is a module to create region of interest (ROI) voxels by
loading ROI data from RT-structure file or mask image files in CT
format. The voxel dimensions are taken same as the voxel phantoms
adopting from "phantominfo.dat".

DVHcreater is a module to create Dose-Volume histogram (DVH) from
RT-dose files. Partial contributions to the DVH can be also
illustrated by the cumulative bar chart of the DVH by choosing the
partial RT-dose files.

PlanReader4PHITS is a module to read RT-plan DICOM binary file and
produce text intermediate files required for Plan2PHITS.

Plan2PHITS is a module to create beam devicegeometry include files
from intermediate files of PlanReader4PHITS.

PSFsplitter is a module to collect existing phase space files (PSF) and
re-distribute to match MPI parallelization numbers.

Voxel-ID Modifier is a module to modify the Voxel-ID in the voxel
phantoms created by CT2PHITS.

***********************************************************************
  System requirements
***********************************************************************

OS: Windows (XP or higher), Mac (OS X v10.5 or higher), Linux Unix
    etc.

***********************************************************************
  How to RUN RT-PHITS
***********************************************************************
RTphitsGUI.py is a python script for a GUI usage of RT-PHITS.
See details in HowToUseRTphitsGUI.pptx.

Followings are the instruction for CUI use.
-- Windows-------------------------------------------------------------
Drag input file for RT-PHITS (e.g. simplesource.inp, pet2phits.inp,
ct2phits.inp, inputcreater4phits.inp or phits2dicom.inp) and drop into
RTphits_win.bat

or

1. Open COMMAND PROMPT and change directory to RTphits directory

2. Run the programs by

   bin\simplesource_win.exe < simplesource.inp
   bin\pet2phits_win.exe < pet2phits.inp
   bin\ct2phits_win.exe < ct2phits.inp
   bin\inputcreater4phits_win.exe < inputcreater4phits.inp
   bin\phits2dicom_win.exe < phits2dicom.inp

-- Mac ----------------------------------------------------------------
1. Double click RTphits_mac.command in FINDER
   This will pop up TERMINAL and show the following message;
   "Input filename for RTphits ? - Type filename & ENTER -"

3. Type a input filename for RTphits
   (e.g. simplesource.inp, pet2phits.inp, ct2phits.inp,
   inputcreater4phits or phits2dicom.inp) and ENTER
   This will initiate each module

or

1. Open terminal and change directory to RTphits directory

2. Run the programs by

   ./bin/simplesource_mac.exe < simplesource.inp
   ./bin/pet2phits_mac.exe < pet2phits.inp
   ./bin/ct2phits_mac.exe < ct2phits.inp
   ./bin/inputcreater4phits_mac.exe < inputcreater4phits.inp
   ./bin/phits2dicom_mac.exe < phits2dicom.inp

For rare cases, the programs fail to execute showing a message that
the following files (RTphits_mac.command, pet2phits_mac.exe,
ct2phits_mac.exe, inputcreater4phits_mac.exe and phits2dicom_mac.exe)
do not have executable property. This situation can be fixed by adding
executable property to those two file by the following steps.

1. Open terminal
2. Change directory to RTphits directory
3. Type and execute the following line

chmod +x RTphits_mac.command bin/pet2phits_mac.exe \
bin/ct2phits_mac.exe bin/inputcreater4phits_mac.exe bin/phits2dicom_mac.exe

-- Linux --------------------------------------------------------------
1. Open terminal and change directory to RT-PHITS directory

2. Run the programs by

   ./bin/simplesource_lin.exe < simplesource.inp
   ./bin/pet2phits_lin.exe < pet2phits.inp
   ./bin/ct2phits_lin.exe < ct2phits.inp
   ./bin/inputcreater4phits_lin.exe < inputcreater4phits.inp
   ./bin/phits2dicom_lin.exe < phits2dicom.inp

***********************************************************************
  How to WRITE input file for CT2PHITS
  (See also ct2phits.inp which is a sample CT2PHITS input)
  (It may be better to quote characters string by double quotation ")
  (In a very rare case, full path may be required for directory & files)
***********************************************************************

Composed of 9 lines

1. Write in CT2PHITS input at the 1st line to show the file is for
   CT2PHITS

2. Filename of the conversion table. (e.g. "HumanVoxelTable.data")

3. Directory name (path) containing DICOM CT files. (e.g. "work/sample1/CT/")

   DICOM CT data files are automatically extracted from the specified
   directory and the data will be ordered by the slice location
   parameter given in the DICOM header.

4. Setting directory name for the creating intermediate files
   (e.g. "work/sample1/DATfiles/")

5. Specify minimum and maximum slice numbers to analyze

   The number should be specified by the slice number.

6. Setting minimum and maximum pixel numbers for x and y directions.

   This parameter is prepared since DICOM CT data normally contains
   marginal space where no object exists. By clipping out a region
   necessary for simulation from the original image, memory space and
   computational time of the PHITS simulation can be reduced. If you
   do not know the pixel size of your DICOM CT files, it is advisory
   to set small number to maximum pixel numbers and run CT2PHITS
   once. The CT2PHITS output shows the pixel size of your DICOM CT
   files, then you can reset the CT2PHITS input.

7. Setting coarse graining voxel numbers in x, y and z directions.

   If you want to faithfully conduct PHITS simulation with the
   original DICOM CT data resolution, set 1 for all these
   parameters. However, reduction of resolution may be required due to
   limitation of memory space or computational time. In this case, set
   integer number larger than 1 to these parameters. The CT data will
   be averaged over the specified number voxels in each direction
   before converting to PHITS materials. If the parameters are set 2 2
   2, two voxels for each direction is averaged and therefore eight
   voxels in total are averaged. If there is remainder data by
   quotient, remained data is just discarded.

8. Setting a option for the origin:

     0: Center of the converted voxel data is set to the origin
     1: Coordinate info is taken from the DICOM header
        (ImagePositionPatient & ImageOrientationPatient) and the system
        is transformed to this coordinate

***********************************************************************
  How to WRITE input file for PHITS2DICOM
  (See also phtis2dicom.inp which is a sample PHITS2DICOM input)
  (Different from CT2PHITS, should not use quote characters string
  by double quotation)
  (In a very rare case, full path may be required for directory & files)
***********************************************************************

Composed of 9 lines

1. Write in PHITS2DICOM input at the 1st line to show the file is for
   PHITS2DICOM

2. Write the name of sample RT-dose file with PATH
   (Normally data/sample.dcm)

3. Write the name of CT-image file with PATH
   (e.g. work/sample1/CT/60592375)

4. Write the name of 3D dose distribution file with PATH obtained by
   PHITS (e.g. work/sample1/PHITSinput/deposit.out)

5. Write the name of phits.out file with PATH obtained by PHITS
   (e.g. work/sample1/PHITSinput/phits.out)

7. Select option for dose normalization

     0: As it is
     1: Normalizaed into 1 for maximum value)
     2: By given factor multiplied
     3: Normalized at the position of next line by the value

The two lines below are active only when option 2 or 3 is selected at the
line 7.

8. (2 in line 7) Specify the normalization factor
   (3 in line 7) Specify the normalization point (x, y, z) in mm
   (e.g. 0.0 0.0 0.0)

9. (3 in line 7) Give the normalized value
   (e.g. 1.0)

***********************************************************************
  How to WRITE input file for PET2PHITS
  (See also pet2phits.inp which is a sample PET2PHITS input)
  (It may be better to quote characters string by double quotation ")
  (In a very rare case, full path may be required for directory & files)
***********************************************************************

Composed of 9 lines

1. Write in PET2PHITS input at the 1st line to show the file is for
   PET2PHITS

2. Write the name of RI list file name with PATH (Normally data/RIlist.dat)

3. Choose RI listed in RIlist.dat (eg. At-211)

4. On/Off of radiation types, all, photon, electron, positron, alpha;
   0:off, 1:on (e.g. 0 1 0 0 1)

5. Setting directory name for the intermediated files
   (e.g. "work/sample1/DATfiles/")

6. Option for skip reading PET files; 0:off, 1:on
   Option 1 required processed intermediate files

The three lines below are active only when option 1 is selected at the
line 6.

7. Directory name (path) containing DICOM PET files.
   (e.g. "work/sample1/PET/")

8. Specify minimum and maximum slice numbers to analyze

   The number should be specified by the slice number.

9. Setting minimum and maximum pixel numbers for x and y directions.

10. Write the biological decay constant.
    (if < 0: Fitting from PET data)

***********************************************************************
  How to WRITE input file for INPUTCREATER4PHITS
  (See also inputcreater4phits.inp which is a sample)
  (It may be better to quote characters string by double quotation ")
  (In a very rare case, full path may be required for directory & files)
***********************************************************************

Composed of 8 lines

1. Write in INPUTCREATER4PHITS input at the 1st line to show the file is for
   INPUTCREATER4PHITS

2. Setting directory name for the intermediated files
   (e.g. "work/sample1/DATfiles/")

3. Setting directory name for the creating PHITS inputs
   (e.g. "work/sample1/PHITSinput/")

4. Parameter option; 0:default (Only 0 is allowed currently)

6. Maxcas, Maxbch for PHITS simulation

7. Parallelization option; 0:off, 1:on

The line below are active only when option 1 is selected at the
line 7.

8. Number of OpenMP processes, Number of MPI processes

  How to WRITE input file for SimpleSource
  (See also simplesource.inp which is a sample of SimpleSource)

      files.  created during compilation.  You may use this command
      for cleanup previously compiled files.

compile the programs by typing

   ./compile_lin.sh

   This will create executable files in binary directory (bin/)

NOTE: ./clean_lin.sh will remove this executable file and other object
      files.  created during compilation.  You may use this command
      for cleanup previously compiled files.

--- SLIDE 20 ---
Notice for many materials with EGS
20
Preparation of cross-section data for EGS takes very long time if simulation geometry contains many materials (the data for all the materials will be prepared at the beginning of PHITS execution).
For repeated PHITS simulation, it is useful to keep the created cross-section data for EGS not to reconstruct the data at each time
1. Set ipegs=-1at the parameter section and execute PHITS
 => The cross-section data for EGS will be created without transport calculation
2. Set ipegs=2 at the parameter section and execute PHITS
 => Transport calculation will be conducted using the created data
For details, please refer to the parameter section for EGS in PHITS manual
How to
Many materials with EGS

2.. Create input file of PHITS2DICOM (phits2dicom.inp)
PHITS2DICOM HowTo
1. Compute 3D dose distribution by PHTIS
=> Run PHITS with phits.inp in work/PHITSinput by eliminating "OFF" at the last t-deposit
=> 3D dose distribution deposit.out will be created
=> RT-dose format file will be created (work/sample1/PHITSinput/deposit.dcm) dcm extension file
3. Execute PHITS2DICOM
   Windows: Drag phits2dicom.inp and drop into RTphits.bat
   Mac: Double click RTphits.command and type phits2dicom.inp + enter

--- SLIDE 28 ---
What is EQDX?
28
Features of TAT
Relatively low-dose rate
Non-uniform dose within tumor
RBE ≠ 1
Different therapeutic effect even in the same dose
EQuieffective Dose to X-ray therapy with fraction size X, EQDX, was proposed by ICRU*
S: Surviving fraction
*Bentzen et al. Radiother Oncol. (2012)
Example of EQDX

--- SLIDE 29 ---
29
EQDX can be calculated from α and β doses based on the stochastic microdosimetric kinetic (SMK) model*, using user-defined anatally function in PHITS
*T.Sato & Y.Furusawa, Radiat. Res. 178, 341-356 (2012)
Conversion from dose to EQDX
Recompile PHITS with usranatal.f included in phits/utility/usranatal/smk_tat/src
Edit phits.inp created by RT-PHITS by changing icntl = 0 to 17 to activate anatally mode
Copy [anatally] section written in phits/utility/usranatal/smk_tat/phits.inp to phits.inp
Run re-compiled PHITS with phits.inp

Convert EQDX.out to EQDX.dcm using PHITS2DICOM, if you want to visualize the calculated EQDX distribution by DICOM viewer
Please read phits/utility/usranatal/readme-en.docx in more detail
=> 3D EQDX distribution EQDX.out will be created
Conversion procedures

https://ejnmmiphys.springeropen.com/articles/10.1186/s40658-020-00350-7
Some differences between the current model and that described in this paper
Use SMK model instead of MK model
ROI function is not included because there is no fixed format for setting ROI

--- SLIDE 08 ---
PHITSインクルードファイル
PHITS形式の詳細は /phits/lecture/advanced/voxel/phits-lec-voxel-jp.ppt 「Voxelファントムの作り方」を参照
CT2PHITS output
8
$ Voxel phantom
$ Material universe
 infl:{CTuniverse.inp}
$ Voxel universe
 5000 0 -5000 lat=1 u=5000
     fill= 0:63 0:63 0:46
 infl:{CTvoxel.inp}
$ CT parameters
set: c81[   64]  $ number of x pixel
set: c82[   64]  $ number of y pixel
set: c83[   47]  $ number of z pixel
set: c84[     0.78125] $ unit voxel x
set: c85[     0.78125] $ unit voxel y
set: c86[     0.32700] $ unit voxel z
set: c87[-c81*c84/2] $ smallest x
set: c88[-c82*c85/2] $ smallest y
set: c89[-c83*c86/2] $ smallest z
...
$ Voxel phantom
$ Unit voxel at smallest x & y
 5000 rpp c87 c87+c84 c88 c88+c85...
$ Outer region
   99 so 500
$ Main Space
   97 rpp c87 c87+c81*c84 c88 c88+...
   98 500 rpp c87+c90 c87+c81*c84...
ボクセルファントムの中心がxyz座標の原点にくるように配置されている
ボクセルファントムのピクセル数や大きさはDICOMのヘッダーから自動的に設定

--- SLIDE 13 ---
回転と平行移動
[transform]
13
nは座標変換番号
x0, y0, z0は平行移動を表すX,Y,Z成分
Rz, Ry, RxはX, Y, Z, 方向の回転行列
Mで変換式を選択 (ここではM=2のみ扱う)
[ T r a n s f o r m ]
    Trn     x0   y0   z0   ->z   ->y   ->x   0   0  0   0   0  0   M
M=2のとき
[Transform]セクションを設定し、[cell], [source]セクション等においてtrcl=nとする。

--- SLIDE 17 ---
読込の高速化
17
PHITSでは一度インプットファイルを全てバイナリー化してから再読込
巨大なボクセルデータをあらかじめバイナリー化して読込時間短縮!
目的
手順
1 [Parameters]セクションのivoxelを有効にする(cを消す)
ivoxel = 2                 # LatticeのFill部分をバイナリー化としてfile(18)に出力させるオプション
file(18) = voxel.bin   # 出力するバイナリーファイルのファイル名
2 PHITSを実行する -> Binary file was successfully generated!!
3 ivoxel = 1に変更する
ivoxel = 1 # LatticeのFill部分をfile(18)から読み込むオプション
高速化!
Faster execution

--- SLIDE 20 ---
マテリアル数が多い場合の注意点
20
マテリアル数が多い場合にEGSを使用すると、EGS用断面積データを用意するのに非常に時間がかかる(PHITS実行の最初に全てのマテリアルについて用意)。
複数回PHITSを実行する場合には、PHITS実行時にEGS用断面積データを毎回準備するのではなく、一度作成した断面積データを使いまわすことができる。
1 ipegs=-1 をパラメータセクションで設定し、PHITSを実行
   => EGS用断面積データを生成し、輸送計算を実行せずに終了
2 ipegs=2 をパラメータセクションで設定し、PHITSを実行
   => 既存のEGS用断面積データを使用して、輸送計算を実行
詳しくはマニュアルのEGS5用パラメータの項目を参照
実行方法
Many materials with EGS
線源オプション=0 以外 negs=1: EGS使用有り

--- SLIDE 24 ---
まとめ
24
Summary
RT-PHITSを使用することで、DICOMイメージデータをPHITS形式のボクセルデータに変換
線源を状況に合わせて変更
PHITS2DICOMを使用することで、PHITS出力の三次元線量分布をRT-dose形式に変換
DICOM RTが読み込めるソフトウェアを用いて、CT値と線量値の同時表示や線量解析が可能

--- SLIDE 28 ---
生物学的線量EQDXとは?
28
*Bentzen et al. Radiother Oncol. (2012)
標的核医学治療の特徴
比較的低線量率の長時間1回照射
腫瘍内で線量が不均一
RBE ≠ 1(TATの場合)
全ての治療法を統一の指標で評価できる
EQDX(α/β)の例
同じ吸収線量でも効果が違う
同じ治療効果を得るために必要となる分割X線治療の吸収線量EQuieffective Dose for fraction size X, EQDX(α/β), がICRUより提案*
S:細胞生存率

--- SLIDE 29 ---
29
TATにおけるEQDXは、SMKモデル*に基づくユーザー定義anatallyを用いてα線とβ線による吸収線量から計算可能
*T.Sato & Y.Furusawa, Radiat. Res. 178, 341-356 (2012)
吸収線量からEQDXへの変換
phits/utility/usranatal/smk_tat/srcに含まれるusranatal.fを使ってPHITSを再コンパイル
RT-PHITSで作られたphits.inpのicntlを0から17 (anatallyモード)に変更
phits/utility/usranatal/smk_tat/phits.inpの[anatally]セクションを上記phits.inpにコピー
再コンパイルしたPHITSで上記修正を加えたphits.inpを実行

EQDX分布をDICOM viewerで確認したい場合は、PHITS2DICOMを使ってEQDX.outをEQDX.dcmに変換
詳細はphits/utility/usranatal/readme-jp.docxもご参照ください
=> EQDXの3次元分布 EQDX.out が出力される
変換手順

--- SLIDE 31 ---
生物学的線量EQDXとは?
31
*Bentzen et al. Radiother Oncol. (2012)
標的核医学治療の特徴
比較的低線量率の長時間1回照射
腫瘍内で線量が不均一
RBE ≠ 1(TATの場合)
全ての治療法を統一の指標で評価できる
EQDX(α/β)の例
同じ吸収線量でも効果が違う
同じ治療効果を得るために必要となる分割X線治療の吸収線量EQuieffective Dose for fraction size X, EQDX(α/β), がICRUより提案*
S:細胞生存率

--- SLIDE 32 ---
32
TATにおけるEQDXは、SMKモデル*に基づくユーザー定義anatallyを用いてα線とβ線による吸収線量から計算可能
*T.Sato & Y.Furusawa, Radiat. Res. 178, 341-356 (2012)
吸収線量からEQDXへの変換
phits/utility/usranatal/smk_tat/srcに含まれるusranatal.fを使ってPHITSを再コンパイル
RT-PHITSで作られたphits.inpのicntlを0から17 (anatallyモード)に変更
phits/utility/usranatal/smk_tat/phits.inpの[anatally]セクションを上記phits.inpにコピー
再コンパイルしたPHITSで上記修正を加えたphits.inpを実行

EQDX分布をDICOM viewerで確認したい場合は、PHITS2DICOMを使ってEQDX.outをEQDX.dcmに変換
詳細はphits/utility/usranatal/readme-jp.docxもご参照ください
=> EQDXの3次元分布 EQDX.out が出力される
変換手順

33
DICOM viewer
DICOMビューワーで確認

--- SLIDE 34 ---
参考文献
34
Reference
T.Sato, T. Furuta, Y. Liu, S. Naka, S. Nagamori, Y. Kanai, T. Watabe, Individual Dosimetry System for Targeted Alpha Therapy Based on PHITS Coupled with Microdosimetric Kinetic Model, EJNMMI Physics 8: 4 (2021).
https://ejnmmiphys.springeropen.com/articles/10.1186/s40658-020-00350-7
本手法と論文に書かれた手法は、以下の点で異なります
通常のMKモデルではなくSMKモデルを利用しています
ROIを設定する機能は、ROIのフォーマットが決まっていないため含まれていません
オープンアクセス!!

 <source> = 1.0
   s-type =  2             # rectangular (rectangle)
       x0 =  0.0           # minimum x coordinate (cm)
       x1 =  c84           # maximum x coordinate (cm)
       y0 =  0.0           # minimum y coordinate (cm)
       y1 =  c85           # maximum y coordinate (cm)
       z0 =  0.0           # minimum z coordinate (cm)
       z1 =  c86           # maximum y coordinate (cm)
      dir =  all           # direction cosine from z axis
   e-type =   28

  directory. No need to specify sample filename and numbering position in the
  filename. Adoptation of DICOM parameters has been modified again so that
  they are correctly treated.

  DICOM slice order is also adopted from DICOM header.

FILE: RTphits_mac.command
BEGIN_FILE
#!/bin/sh

cd `dirname $0`
echo "Input filename for RT-phits ? - Type filename & ENTER -"
read INPUT

for i in $(head -n 1 $INPUT)
do
    if [ $i = "CT2PHITS" ]; then
	./bin/ct2phits_mac.exe < $INPUT
    elif [ $i = "PHITS2DICOM" ]; then
	./bin/phits2dicom_mac.exe < $INPUT
    elif [ $i = "PET2PHITS" ]; then
	./bin/pet2phits_mac.exe < $INPUT
    elif [ $i = "INPUTCREATER4PHITS" ]; then
	./bin/inputcreater4phits_mac.exe < $INPUT
    elif [ $i = "SIMPLE" ]; then
	icount=0
	cat $INPUT | while read line1 line2
	do
	    icount=$(( icount+1 ))
	    if [ $icount = 2 ]; then
		filename=$line1'sourceinfo.dat'
		echo 0 > $filename
	    elif [ $icount -gt 2 ]; then
		echo $line1 $line2 >> $filename
	    fi
	done
	echo "**** SIMPLE SOURCE successfully finished ****"
    else
	echo "**** ERROR: File is not for RT-PHITS ****"
    fi
    exit
done

echo "- push ENTER key to end -"
read WAIT
exit
END_FILE

FILE: RTphits_win.bat
BEGIN_FILE
@echo off
setlocal EnableDelayedExpansion
set count=0
set signature=""

cd "%~dp0"

for /f "delims=/ " %%i in (%1) do call :check1st %%i

if /i %signature%==ct2phits (
echo **** CT2PHITS input file is loaded ****
"%~dp0"bin\ct2phits_win.exe < %1
) else if /i %signature%==phits2dicom (
echo **** PHITS2DICOM input file is loaded ****
"%~dp0"bin\phits2dicom_win.exe < %1
) else if /i %signature%==pet2phits (
echo **** PET2PHITS input file is loaded ****
"%~dp0"bin\pet2phits_win.exe < %1
) else if /i %signature%==inputcreater4phits (
echo **** INPUTCREATER4PHITS input file is loaded ****
"%~dp0"bin\inputcreater4phits_win.exe < %1
) else if /i %signature%==simple (
echo **** SIMPLE SOURCE input file is loaded ****
set count=0
for /f "tokens=1-2" %%i in (%1) do (
set /a count=!count!+1
if !count! ==2 (
set line=%%i
set filename=!line!sourceinfo.dat
echo 0 > !filename!
) else if !count! GTR 2 (
echo %%i %%j >> !filename!
)
)
echo **** SIMPLE SOURCE successfully finished ****
) else (
echo **** ERROR: This file is not compatible with RT-PHITS ****
)
pause
exit

:check1st
set /a count=%count%+1
if %count%==1 (
set signature=%1
)
exit /b
END_FILE

FILE: src/compile_lin.sh
BEGIN_FILE
#/bin/sh
echo -n "Compile CT2PHITS"
icx -c dicomlib.c utllib.c interface.c nonwinlib.c
ifx  -o ../bin/ct2phits_lin.exe dicomlib.o utllib.o interface.o nonwinlib.o \
	 stdmod.f readctmod.f tablemod.f createctmod.f ct2phits.f \
	 -static-intel
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
    echo "..............OK"
else
    echo "*** FAILED ***"
    exit
fi
echo -n "Compile PHITS2DICOM"
icx  -o ../bin/phits2dicom_lin.exe dicomlib.c phitslib.c utllib.c phits2dicom.c \
    -static-intel
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
    echo "...........OK"
else
    echo "*** FAILED ***"
    exit
fi
echo -n "Compile PET2PHITS"
ifx -O2 -o ../bin/pet2phits_lin.exe dicomlib.o utllib.o interface.o nonwinlib.o \
      stdmod.f readpetmod.f createpetmod.f fitbiomod.f pet2phits.f \
      -static-intel -qopenmp -qopenmp-link=static
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
    echo ".............OK"
else

FILE: src/createctmod.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
      module createct
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEctinp(Cinter,iorg,icolor,
     &     ixmin0,iymin0,izmin0,ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: iorg,icolor
      integer,intent(in) :: ixmin0,iymin0,izmin0,ixnum,iynum,iznum
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg
      real(8),intent(in) :: xsh(3),xvec(3),yvec(3),zvec(3)

      call CREATEusrparam(Cinter,iorg,
     &     ixmin0,iymin0,izmin0,ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh)
      call CREATEsurf(Cinter)
      call CREATEcell(Cinter,ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      call CREATEmat(Cinter,icolor)
      call CREATEtrans(Cinter,xvec,yvec,zvec)

      return
      end subroutine CREATEctinp

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEusrparam(Cinter,iorg,
     &     ixmin0,iymin0,izmin0,ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: iorg
      integer,intent(in) :: ixmin0,iymin0,izmin0,ixnum,iynum,iznum
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh(3)
      real(8) :: epsilon=1.0d-5
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: iend

      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'CTusrparam.dat',status='unknown')
      write(io,'(a)')'$ CT parameters'
      write(io,'(a,3i5,a)')'$ (xmin0,ymin0,zmin0)=(',
     &     ixmin0,iymin0,izmin0,')'
      write(io,5000)'set: c',81,'[',ixnum,']  $ number of x pixel'
      write(io,5000)'set: c',82,'[',iynum,']  $ number of y pixel'
      write(io,5000)'set: c',83,'[',iznum,']  $ number of z pixel'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',84,'[',xdel,'] $ unit voxel x'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',85,'[',ydel,'] $ unit voxel y'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',86,'[',zdel,'] $ unit voxel z'
      if(iorg.eq.0)then
        write(io,5001)'set: c',87,'[-c81*c84/2] $ smallest x'
        write(io,5001)'set: c',88,'[-c82*c85/2] $ smallest y'
        write(io,5001)'set: c',89,'[-c83*c86/2] $ smallest z'
      else
        write(io,5001)'set: c',87,'[',xorg,'] $ smallest x'
        write(io,5001)'set: c',88,'[',yorg,'] $ smallest y'
        write(io,5001)'set: c',89,'[',zorg,'] $ smallest z'
      endif
      write(io,5001)'set: c',90,'[',epsilon,'] $ small quota'
      if(iorg.eq.0)then
       write(io,5001)'set: c',91,'[',0.0,'] $ x shift'
       write(io,5001)'set: c',92,'[',0.0,'] $ y shift'
       write(io,5001)'set: c',93,'[',0.0,'] $ z shift'
      else
       write(io,5001)'set: c',91,'[',xsh(1),'] $ x shift'
       write(io,5001)'set: c',92,'[',xsh(2),'] $ y shift'
       write(io,5001)'set: c',93,'[',xsh(3),'] $ z shift'
      endif
 5000 format(a,i2,a,i5,a)
 5001 format(a,i2,a,f12.5,a)
      close(io)

      return
      end subroutine CREATEusrparam

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEsurf(Cinter)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: iend

      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'CTsurf.dat',status='unknown')
      write(io,'(a)') '$ Voxel phantom'
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Unit voxel at smallest x & y'
      write(io,5003)' ',5000,' rpp',
     &     ' c87 c87+c84 c88 c88+c85 c89 c89+c86'
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Outer region'
      write(io,5002)' ',99,' so 500'
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Main Space'
      write(io,5003)' ',97,' rpp',
     &     ' c87 c87+c81*c84 c88 c88+c82*c85',
     &     ' c89 c89+c83*c86'
      write(io,5003)' ',98,' 500 rpp',
     &     ' c87+c90 c87+c81*c84-c90 c88+c90 c88+c82*c85-c90',
     &     ' c89+c90 c89+c83*c86-c90'
 5002 format(a,i4,a)
 5003 format(a,i4,4a)
      close(io)

      return
      end subroutine CREATEsurf
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEcell(Cinter,ixnum,iynum,iznum)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use readtable, only:Nuniv,rho
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: iuniv
      integer :: iend

      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'CTuniverse.dat',
     &     status='unknown')
      do iuniv=1,Nuniv
        write(io,5000)' ',5000+iuniv,' ',5000+iuniv,
     &       ' ',rho(iuniv),' -99 u=',5000+iuniv
      enddo
 5000 format(2(a,i4),a,f12.5,a,i4)
      close(io)

      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'CTcell.dat',status='unknown')
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Voxel phantom'
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Material universe'
      write(io,'(a)')' infl:{CTuniverse.inp}'
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Voxel universe'
      write(io,'(a)')' 5000 0 -5000 lat=1 u=5000'
      write(io,5003)'fill= 0:',ixnum-1,' 0:',iynum-1,
     &     ' 0:',iznum-1
      write(io,'(a)')' infl:{CTvoxel.inp}'
 5003 format(5x,3(a,i0))
      close(io)

      return
      end subroutine CREATEcell
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEtrans(Cinter,xvec,yvec,zvec)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      real(8),intent(in) :: xvec(3),yvec(3),zvec(3)
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: i,iend
      character(5) :: TAB='     '

      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'CTtrans.dat',
     &     status='unknown')
      write(io,'(2a)')'$ ',
     &     'Transform system according to DICOM header'
      write(io,'(a)')'tr500 c91 c92 c93'
      do i=1,3
       write(io,'(a,3f10.5)')TAB,xvec(i),yvec(i),zvec(i)
      enddo
      write(io,'(2a)')TAB,'1'
      close(io)

      return
      end subroutine CREATEtrans
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEfill(Cinter,ixnum,iynum,iznum,mat)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      integer,intent(in) :: mat(ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: ix,iy,iz,i,ii,iend
      logical,parameter :: icompvoxel=.true.
      integer :: latot,latot2
      integer,allocatable :: lattmp(:),lattmp2(:)

      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'CTvoxel.dat',status='unknown')
      if(.not.icompvoxel)then
       do iz=1,iznum
        do iy=1,iynum
         do i=1,ixnum,10
          ii=min(i+9,ixnum)
          write(io,'(6x,10(x,I4))')(mat(ix,iy,iz),ix=i,ii)
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
       close(io)
      else
       latot=ixnum*iynum*iznum
       allocate(lattmp(latot),lattmp2(latot))
       do iz=1,iznum
        do iy=1,iynum
         do ix=1,ixnum
          lattmp(ix+(iy-1)*ixnum+(iz-1)*ixnum*iynum)=mat(ix,iy,iz)
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
       call latencode(latot,lattmp,latot2,lattmp2)
       do i=1,latot2,10
        ii=min(i+9,latot2)
        write(io,'(6x,10(x,I10))')(lattmp2(ix),ix=i,ii)
       enddo
       deallocate(lattmp,lattmp2)
      endif
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEfill
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEmat(Cinter,icolor)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use readtable, only:Nuniv,Nelement,Ncomm,Clines,Ccomment,CTthld
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: icolor
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: iline,iuniv,i,iend
      character(6) :: TAB='      '
* material section
      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'CTmaterial.dat',
     &     status='unknown')
      write(io,'(2a)')'$ ',Ccomment(1:Ncomm)
      iline=0
      do iuniv=1,Nuniv
       if(iuniv.eq.1)then
        write(io,'(a,i4,2a,f5.0)')'MAT[',5000+iuniv,'] ! ',
     &       ' CT number < ',CTthld(iuniv+1)
       elseif(iuniv.eq.Nuniv)then
        write(io,'(a,i4,a,f5.0,a)')'MAT[',5000+iuniv,'] ! ',
     &       CTthld(iuniv), ' <= CT number'
       else
        write(io,'(a,i4,a,f5.0,a,f5.0)')'MAT[',5000+iuniv,'] ! ',
     &       CTthld(iuniv), ' <= CT number < ',CTthld(iuniv+1)
       endif
       do i=1,Nelement(iuniv)
        iline=iline+1
        iend=len_trim(Clines(iline))
        write(io,'(2a)')TAB,Clines(iline)(1:iend)
       enddo
      enddo
      close(io)

* mat name color section
      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'CTmatnamecolor.dat',
     &     status='unknown')
      call CREATEcolor(io,icolor)
      close(io)

      return
      end subroutine CREATEmat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEcolor(io,icolor)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use readtable, only: Nuniv
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io,icolor
      integer :: iuniv
      if(icolor.eq.1)then
       do iuniv=1,Nuniv
        write(io,5000)5000+iuniv,iuniv,-(iuniv-1)/dble(Nuniv-1)
       enddo
      else
       write(io,5000)5000+1,1,0.0d0
       do iuniv=2,Nuniv
        write(io,5000)5000+iuniv,iuniv,
     &       (1.0d0-0.2d0)/dble(Nuniv-2)*(iuniv-2)+0.2d0
       enddo
      endif
 5000 format(' ',i4,' CT',i4.4,' ','{',f6.3,'}')
      return
      end subroutine CREATEcolor
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEphantominfo(Cinter,Cconvtable,
     &     iorg,icolor,ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax,izmin,izmax,nxc,nyc,nzc,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use readct, only:Cdir
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cconvtable
      integer,intent(in) :: iorg,icolor,ixnum,iynum,iznum
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg
      real(8),intent(in) :: xsh(3),xvec(3),yvec(3),zvec(3)
      integer,intent(in) :: ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax,izmin,izmax
      integer,intent(in) :: nxc,nyc,nzc
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: i,Ninter
      Ninter=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:Ninter)//'phantominfo.dat',status='unknown')

      write(io,5002)1,
     &     '! DICOM image data flag'
      write(io,5000)ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     '! number of x, y, z pixels'
      write(io,5001)xdel,ydel,zdel,
     &     '! unit voxel size x, y, z'
      write(io,5001)xorg,yorg,zorg,
     &     '! Origin x, y, z'
      write(io,5001)(xsh(i),i=1,3),
     &     '! Shift x, y, z'
      write(io,5001)(xvec(i),i=1,3),
     &     '! X vector x, y, z'
      write(io,5001)(yvec(i),i=1,3),
     &     '! Y vector x, y, z'
      write(io,5001)(zvec(i),i=1,3),
     &     '! Z vector x, y, z'
      write(io,5002)iorg,'! Coordinate option'
      write(io,'(a)')'#'
      write(io,'(a)')trim(Cconvtable)
      write(io,'(a)')trim(Cdir)
      write(io,'(2(i4,2x))')izmin,izmax
      write(io,'(4(i4,2x))')ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax
      write(io,'(3(i4,2x))')nxc,nyc,nzc
      write(io,'(i4)')iorg
      write(io,'(i4)')icolor
 5000 format(3(i4,2x),5x,a)
 5001 format(3(f15.7,2x),a)
 5002 format(i4,19x,a)

      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEphantominfo

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine latencode(latot,lattmp,latot2,lattmp2)
*       encode voxel elements; lattmp, to compressed format; lattmp2
*       copy from PHITS source
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: latot,lattmp(latot)
      integer,intent(out) :: latot2,lattmp2(latot)
      integer i,icount,jcount
      integer latold
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      latold=lattmp(1)
      lattmp2(1)=lattmp(1)
      icount=0
      jcount=1
      do i=2,latot
       if(lattmp(i).eq.latold)then
        icount=icount+1
       else
        if(icount.gt.0)then
         jcount=jcount+1
         lattmp2(jcount)=-icount
        endif
        jcount=jcount+1
        lattmp2(jcount)=lattmp(i)
        latold=lattmp(i)
        icount=0
       endif
      enddo
      if(icount.gt.0)then
       jcount=jcount+1
       lattmp2(jcount)=-icount
      endif
      latot2=jcount
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      return
      end subroutine latencode

      end module createct

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine COPYfile(file1,file2)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: file1,file2
      integer,parameter :: io1=10,io2=20
      character(LEN=200) :: dummy
      open(io1,file=file1,status='old',err=999)
      open(io2,file=file2,status='unknown')
      do
       read(io1,'(a)',end=100)dummy
       write(io2,'(a)')trim(dummy)
      enddo
 100  continue
      close(io1)
      close(io2)
      return
 999  continue
      write(istdout,'(2a)')'ERROR: File not found: ',file1
      call exit(-1)
      end subroutine COPYfile
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEphitsin(Cdir,Ctag)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: nchar
      character(LEN=200) :: outfile
      nchar=len_trim(Cdir)
      outfile=Cdir(1:nchar)//'phits.in'
      open(io,file=outfile,status='unknown')
      if(Ctag.eq.'NO')then
       write(io,*) 'file = phits.inp'
      else
       write(io,*) 'file = phits-'//Ctag//'.inp'
      endif
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEphitsin
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEphitsinp(
     &     iparam,isrc,ibeam,iphantom,iorg,itally,ipet,
     &     isrcvoxel,maxcas,maxbch,iparallel,nomp,nmpi,
     &     Cdir,Cparamfile,cdata,ndimV,ndimS,dimV,dimS,
     &     dpos,dose,z0,Ctag)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      real(8),intent(in) :: dpos(3),dose,z0
      integer,intent(in) :: iparam,isrc,ibeam,iphantom,iorg,itally(11)
      integer,intent(in) :: ipet,isrcvoxel
      integer,intent(in) :: maxcas,maxbch,iparallel,nomp,nmpi
      integer,intent(in) :: ndimV(3),ndimS(12)
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir,Cparamfile,cdata
      real(8),intent(in) :: dimV(18),dimS(9)
      integer,parameter :: io=10,io2=20
      integer :: nchar,i,ntiming
      logical :: iflagFLC,iflagBL
      real(8) :: dicompos(3)
      character(LEN=4) :: cswitch(0:1)
      character(LEN=200) :: outfile,filename,cdummy,tmpfile
      cswitch(0)=' off'
      cswitch(1)='    '
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* open phits input file (phits.inp)
      nchar=len_trim(Cdir)
      if(Ctag.eq.'NO')then
       outfile=Cdir(1:nchar)//'phits.inp'
      else
       outfile=Cdir(1:nchar)//'phits-'//Ctag//'.inp'
      endif
      open(io,file=outfile,status='unknown')

      if(iparallel.eq.1)then
       if(nomp.eq.0.or.nomp.gt.1)then
        write(io,*)'$OMP=',nomp
       endif
       if(nmpi.gt.1)then
        write(io,*)'$MPI=',nmpi
       endif
      endif

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(io,'(a)') '[ Title ]'
      write(io,'(a)') 'Input files generated by RT-PHITS'
      if(isrc.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(3a)') ' (RefID:',trim(cdata),')'
       write(io,'(a,f12.5,a,3f12.5,a)')
     &      ' (',dose,') Gy at [ ',dpos(1:3),' mm]'
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'[ Parameters ]'
      write(io,'(2a)')' icntl    =          0 ',
     &      '# (D=0) 3:ECH 5:NOR 6:SRC 7,8:GSH 11:DSH 12:DUMP'
      write(io,'(a)')
      if(isrc.eq.2)then
!     Reading temporary file and copy into phits.inp
       tmpfile=trim(Cdir)//'tmp.inp'
       open(io2,file=tmpfile,status='old')
       read(io2,*)ntiming
       read(io2,'(a)')cdummy
       write(io,'(a)')trim(cdummy)
       do i=0,ntiming
        read(io2,'(a)')cdummy
        write(io,'(a)')trim(cdummy)
        read(io2,'(a)')cdummy
        write(io,'(a)')trim(cdummy)
       enddo
       close(io2,status='delete')
       write(io,'(a)')
       if(isrcvoxel.eq.1)then
        write(io,'(2a)')' maxcas   = c31',
     &       ' # = number of src voxels'
       else
        write(io,'(a,i10,a)')' maxcas   = ',maxcas,
     &       ' # number of particles per one batch'
       endif
      else
       write(io,'(a,i10,a)')' maxcas   = ',maxcas,
     &      ' # number of particles per one batch'
      endif
      write(io,'(a,i10,a)')' maxbch   = ',maxbch*nmpi,
     &     ' # number of batches'
       write(io,'(2a)')' nlost    =      10000 ',
     &      ' # (D=10) Lost part: allowance of CG and GG errors'
      write(io,'(a)')
      call CREATEparam(io,iparam,ibeam,Cparamfile)
      write(io,'(2a)')' mdbatima =       3000 ',
     &     ' # (D=500) max database size of ATIMA'
      if(isrc.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(2a)')' file(6)  = phits-'//Ctag//'.out    ',
     &      '# (D=phits.out) general output file name'
      else
       write(io,'(2a)')' file(6)  = phits.out    ',
     &      '# (D=phits.out) general output file name'
      endif
      write(io,'(a)')
* set user-defined variables
      if(isrc.eq.0)then
       write(io,5000)30,dimS(1),'Source field size x [cm]'
       write(io,5000)31,dimS(2),'Source field size y [cm]'
       write(io,5000)32,dimS(3),'Source offset x [cm]'
       write(io,5000)33,dimS(4),'Source offset y [cm]'
       write(io,5000)34,dimS(5),'Source distance z [cm]'
       write(io,5000)35,dimS(6),'Source horizontal angle [deg]'
       write(io,5000)36,dimS(7),'Source vertical angle [deg]'
      elseif(isrc.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' infl:{PLANusrparam-'//Ctag//'.inp}'
       write(io,5000)74,z0/10.0d0,'z0 position of source [cm]'
       filename=trim(Cdir)//'PLANusrparam-'//Ctag//'.inp'
       iflagFLC=.true.
       iflagBL=.true.
       open(io2,file=filename,status='old',err=901)
       read(io2,'(a)')cdummy
       do i=1,2
        read(io2,'(a)')cdummy
        if(cdummy(3:4).eq.'No')then
         if(cdummy(6:8).eq.'FLC')then
          iflagFLC=.false.
         elseif(cdummy(6:10).eq.'Block')then
          iflagBL=.false.
         endif
        endif
       enddo
      endif
 5000 format('set: c',i2,'[',f12.5,'] $ ',a)
      if(iphantom.eq.0)then
       call CREATEusrparamWater(io,ndimV,dimV)
      elseif(iphantom.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' infl:{CTusrparam.inp}'
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'[ Source ]'
      if(isrc.eq.0)then
       call CREATEsourceSimple(io,ibeam)
      elseif(isrc.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' infl:{PLANsource-'//Ctag//'.inp}'
      elseif(isrc.eq.2)then
       call CREATEsourcePET(io,cdata,ndimS,ipet)
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'[ Material ]'
      if(isrc.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' infl:{PLANmaterial.inp}'
      else
       write(io,'(a)')'$   Air at ground level 1.21e-3 g/cm3'
       write(io,'(a)')'MAT[1000]   N   4.0586E-05'
       write(io,'(a)')'            O   1.0800E-05'
       write(io,'(a)')'           Ar   2.4255E-07'
      endif
      if(iphantom.eq.0)then
       write(io,'(a)')'$   Water 1.0 g/cm3'
       write(io,'(a)')'MAT[2000]  1H  6.6832156E-02'
       write(io,'(a)')'          16O  3.3416078E-02'
      elseif(iphantom.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' infl:{CTmaterial.inp}'
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'[ Mat Name Color ]'
      write(io,'(a)')' mat   name   color'
      if(isrc.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')
     &      ' infl:{PLANmatnamecolor.inp}'
      else
       write(io,'(a)')' m1000 Air black'
      endif
      if(iphantom.eq.0)then
       write(io,'(a)')' m2000 Water pastelblue'
      elseif(iphantom.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' infl:{CTmatnamecolor.inp}'
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'[ Surface ]'
      if(isrc.eq.1)write(io,'(a)')' infl:{PLANsurf-'//Ctag//'.inp}'
      if(iphantom.eq.0)then
       call CREATEsurfWater(io)
      elseif(iphantom.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' infl:{CTsurf.inp}'
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'[ Cell ]'
      if(isrc.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' infl:{PLANcell-'//Ctag//'.inp}'
      else
        write(io,'(a)')'$ Main Space'
        write(io,'(a)')' 999  -1            99            $ Outer void'
        write(io,'(2a)')' 1000  1000 -0.00121 -99 #1001',
     &       '  $ Air'
        write(io,'(2a)')' 1001   0   -98 fill=4000'
     &       ,'  $ Whole phantom'
        write(io,'(a)')
        write(io,'(a)')'$ Universe 4000 (whole phantom)'
        write(io,'(a)')' 998   0    97 trcl=500 u=4000'
        write(io,'(a)')' 997   0   -97 trcl=500 fill=5000 u=4000'
        write(io,'(a)')
       endif
       if(iphantom.eq.0)then
        call CREATEcellWater(io)
       elseif(iphantom.eq.1)then
        write(io,'(a)')' infl:{CTcell.inp}'
       endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'[ Transform ]'
      if(isrc.eq.0)then
       call CREATEtrans(io,iorg,iphantom)
      elseif(isrc.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' infl:{PLANtrans-'//Ctag//'.inp}'
      endif
      if(iphantom.eq.0)then
       call CREATEtransWater(io)
      elseif(iphantom.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' infl:{CTtrans.inp}'
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* set tallies
* 3D dose
      dicompos(1)=(dimV(7)+dimV(4)+0.5d0*dimV(1))*10d0
      dicompos(2)=(dimV(8)+dimV(5)+0.5d0*dimV(2))*10d0
      dicompos(3)=(dimV(9)+dimV(6)+0.5d0*dimV(3))*10d0
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'$ 3D dose'
*-----
*     Normal 3D dose distribution
      write(io,'(2a)')'[ T-Deposit ]',cswitch(itally(1))
      if(Ctag.eq.'NO')then
         write(io,'(a)')' file   = deposit.out'
      else
         write(io,'(3a)')' file   = deposit-',Ctag,'.out'
      endif
      call CREATEt3Ddeposit(io,0,dicompos)
*     Additional parameters
      if(isrc.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(a)')' trcl   = 4000'
      elseif(isrc.eq.2)then
       write(io,'(a)')' anatally start'
       write(io,'(a)')' anatally end'
      endif
*-----
*     MeV distribution for PET
      if(isrc.eq.2)then

*-----

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------

      write(io,'(a)')

     &     dimV(1),dimV(2),dimV(3),'xy',Ctag)
