* Patient deposit xz at isocenter
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Phantom dose xz at isocenter'
      write(io,'(2a)')'[ T-deposit ]',cswitch(itally(3))
      call CREATEtdeposit(io,iorg,ndimV(1),ndimV(2),ndimV(3),
     &     dimV(1),dimV(2),dimV(3),'xz',Ctag)
      if(isrc.eq.1)write(io,'(a)')' trcl   = 4000'
* Patient deposit xz at isocenter
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Phantom dose yz at isocenter'
      write(io,'(2a)')'[ T-deposit ]',cswitch(itally(4))
      call CREATEtdeposit(io,iorg,ndimV(1),ndimV(2),ndimV(3),
     &     dimV(1),dimV(2),dimV(3),'yz',Ctag)
      if(isrc.eq.1)write(io,'(a)')' trcl   = 4000'
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      if(isrc.eq.1)then ! Track in Beam Devices with RT-Plan
* Gantory track xz
       write(io,'(a)')
       write(io,'(a)')'$ Gantory track xz'
       write(io,'(2a)')'[ T-Track ]',cswitch(itally(5))
       call CREATEttrackGT(io,'xz',Ctag)
* Gantory track yz
       write(io,'(a)')
       write(io,'(a)')'$ Gantory track yz'
       write(io,'(2a)')'[ T-Track ]',cswitch(itally(6))
       call CREATEttrackGT(io,'yz',Ctag)
* Fourleaf collimator track xy
       if(iflagFLC)then
        write(io,'(a)')
        write(io,'(a)')'$ Fourleaf Collimator track xy'
        write(io,'(2a)')'[ T-Track ]',cswitch(itally(7))
        call CREATEttrackFLC(io,Ctag)
       endif
* Multileaf collimator track xy
       write(io,'(a)')
       write(io,'(a)')'$ Multileaf Collimator track xy'
       write(io,'(2a)')'[ T-Track ]',cswitch(itally(8))
       call CREATEttrackMLC(io,Ctag)
* Range compensator (Bolus) track xy
       write(io,'(a)')
       write(io,'(a)')'$ Range Compensator (Bolus) track xy'
       write(io,'(2a)')'[ T-Track ]',cswitch(itally(9))
       call CREATEttrackRC(io,'xy',Ctag)
* Range compensator (Bolus) track xz
       write(io,'(a)')
       write(io,'(a)')'$ Range Compensator (Bolus) track xz'
       write(io,'(2a)')'[ T-Track ]',cswitch(itally(10))
       call CREATEttrackRC(io,'xz',Ctag)
* Block (Patient collimator) track xy
       if(iflagBL)then
        write(io,'(a)')
        write(io,'(a)')'$ Block (Patient Collimator) track xy'
        write(io,'(2a)')'[ T-Track ]',cswitch(itally(11))
        call CREATEttrackBL(io,Ctag)
       endif
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* 3D show
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'$ 3D show'
      write(io,'(a)')'[ T-3dshow ]'
      call CREATEt3Dshow(io,isrc,iphantom,iorg,
     &     ndimV(1),ndimV(2),ndimV(3),
     &     dimV(1),dimV(2),dimV(3),Ctag)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* set [end]
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)') '[ End ]'

      return

 901  write(istdout,'(3a)')'ERROR: FILE=',trim(filename),
     &     'is missing'
      call exit(-1)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEPHITSinp

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEparam(io,iparam,ibeam,Cparamfile)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io,iparam,ibeam
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cparamfile

      if(iparam.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(3a)')' infl:{',trim(Cparamfile),'}'
      else
       write(io,'(a)')'$   ivoxel = 2'
       write(io,'(a)')' file(18) = voxel.bin'
       write(io,'(a)')'$   ipegs = -1'
       write(io, '(a)')

       if(ibeam.eq.0)then
        write(io,'(a)')'$ Default option of PHITS (no electrons)'
       elseif(ibeam.eq.1)then
        write(io,'(a)')'$ Optimized for Photon Therapy'
        write(io,'(2a)')' ipnint   =           1     ',
     &       '# (D=0) 0: no, 1: consider photo-nuclear reaction'
        write(io,'(2a)')' negs     =           1     ',
     &       '# (D=0) =1 EGS photon and electron'
       elseif(ibeam.eq.2)then
        write(io,'(a)')'$ Optimized for Particle Therapy'
        write(io,'(2a)')' e-mode   =           2     ',
     &       '# (D=0) 0: Normal, 1: Event generator mode'
        write(io,'(2a)')' nedisp   =           1     ',
     &       '# (D=0) 0: no, 1: with e straggling, 10: ATIMA'
        write(io,'(2a)')' nspred   =           2     ',
     &       '# (D=0) 0:no, 1:orig. 2:Lynch(Moliere), 10: ATIMA'
        write(io,'(2a)')' ascat1   =  13.6000000     ',
     &       '# (D=13.6) S2 parameter in Lynch formula for nspread = 2'
        write(io,'(2a)')' ascat2   = 3.800000000E-02 ',
     &       '# (D=0.038) e parameter in Lynch formula for nspread = 2'
        write(io,'(2a)')' negs     =           1     ',
     &       '# (D=0) =1 EGS photon and electron'
        write(io,'(2a)')' irqmd    =           1     ',
     &       '# (D=0) =1 JQMD 2.0'
        write(io,'(2a)')' ih2o     =          78.0   ',
     &       '# (D=-1) Ion.Pot.For H2O, <0:75, >0 IP ev'
       endif
      endif

      return
      end subroutine CREATEparam
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEsourceSimple(io,ibeam)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io,ibeam

      write(io,5000)' s-type = 2',
     &     ' $ Cylindrical source'
      write(io,5000)'$ Create radiation field centered on 0'
      write(io,5000)'$ Adjust center of radiation field in trcl=400'
      write(io,5000)'     x0 = -c30/2+c32'
      write(io,5000)'     x1 =  c30/2+c32'
      write(io,5000)'     y0 = -c34'
      write(io,5000)'     y1 = -c34'
      write(io,5000)'     z0 = -c31/2+c33'
      write(io,5000)'     z1 =  c31/2+c33'
      write(io,5000)'    dir =  0.0'
      write(io,5000)'    phi =  90.0'
      write(io,5000)'   trcl =  400'
      if(ibeam.eq.1)then
       write(io,5000)'   proj =  photon'
      else
       write(io,5000)'   proj =  proton'
      endif
      if(ibeam.eq.0)then
       write(io,5000)'     e0 = 100.0'
      else
       call CREATEspectrum(io,ibeam)
      endif
 5000 format(2a)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEsourceSimple
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEsourcePET(io,cdata,ndimS,ipet)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,parameter :: nrad=5
      integer,intent(in) :: io
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: cdata
      integer,intent(in) :: ndimS(12),ipet
      integer,parameter :: ioa=20
      integer :: iradflag(nrad)
      integer :: ip,imultisrc
      character(LEN=9) :: crad(nrad)
      data crad/'      all',
     &     '   photon',' electron',' positron','    alpha'/
      character(LEN=3) :: ctime

      iradflag(1:nrad)=ndimS(8:7+nrad)
      imultisrc=iradflag(2)+iradflag(3)+iradflag(4)+iradflag(5)
      if(imultisrc.eq.0.and.iradflag(1).eq.1)imultisrc=1
      write(io,5002)'totfact =',imultisrc
      write(ctime,'(i3.3)')ipet
      do ip=1,nrad
       if(iradflag(ip).eq.1) then
        write(io,'(a)')
        write(io,5000)' <source> = 1.0'
        write(io,5000)' s-type = 22 $ xyz mesh source'
        write(io,5000)' mesh   = xyz'
        write(io,5000)' x-type = 2'
        write(io,5000)' nx     = c81'
        write(io,5000)' xmin   = c91+c87'
        write(io,5000)' xmax   = c91+c87+c81*c84'
        write(io,5000)' y-type = 2'
        write(io,5000)' ny     = c82'
        write(io,5000)' ymin   = c92+c88'
        write(io,5000)' ymax   = c92+c88+c82*c85'
        write(io,5000)' z-type = 2'
        write(io,5000)' nz     = c83'
        write(io,5000)' zmin   = c93+c89'
        write(io,5000)' zmax   = c93+c89+c83*c86'
        write(io,5004)' infl:{voxel_src',ctime,'.inp}'
     &  ,' $ must be consistent with source intensity: c30'
        write(io,5000)' dir    = all'
        write(io,5000)' reg    = {5002 - 5024}'
        write(io,5000)' isbias = 2'
        write(io,5003)' proj   =',crad(ip)
        if(ip.eq.1.and.iradflag(4).eq.1) write(io,5000)' iannih = 1'
!     annihilation gamma should not be considered when positron source is considered
        write(io,5000)' e-type = 28'
        write(io,5000)' ni     = 1'
        write(io,5001)trim(cdata),' c30'
       endif
      enddo
 5000 format(a)
 5001 format(1x,a,a)
 5002 format(a,i3)
 5003 format(a,a9)
 5004 format(a,a3,a,a)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEsourcePET
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEsourcePETintensity(Cdir,ntiming,ipet,nvoxels,
     &     totalsource)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      integer,intent(in) :: ntiming,ipet
      integer,intent(in) :: nvoxels(0:ntiming)
      real(8),intent(in) :: totalsource(0:ntiming)
      integer,parameter :: ioa=20
      integer :: it
      character(LEN=3) :: ctime
      character(LEN=200) :: filename

      filename=trim(Cdir)//'tmp.inp'
      open(ioa,file=filename,status='unknown')
      write(ioa,*)ntiming
      write(ioa,'(''$ **** Select source intensity *****'')')
      do it=0,ntiming
       write(ctime,'(i3.3)') it
       if(it.eq.ipet)then
        write(ioa,'('' set: c30['',es12.4,
     &            ''] $ intensity for voxel_src'',a3,
     &            ''.inp'')')
     &       totalsource(it),ctime
        write(ioa,'('' set: c31['',i9,
     &            ''] $ # of src voxels for voxel_src'',a3,
     &            ''.inp'')')
     &       nvoxels(it),ctime
       else
        write(ioa,'(''$set: c30['',es12.4,
     &            ''] $ intensity for voxel_src'',a3,
     &            ''.inp'')')
     &       totalsource(it),ctime
        write(ioa,'(''$set: c31['',i9,
     &            ''] $ # of src voxels for voxel_src'',a3,
     &            ''.inp'')')
     &       nvoxels(it),ctime
       endif
      enddo
      close(ioa)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEsourcePETintensity
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEsourcePETvoxel(Cdir,ndimV,ndimS,dimV,dimS,
     &     pdata,nvoxels)
! Set closest Bq value for CT image mesh
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      integer,intent(in) :: ndimV(3),ndimS(12)
      real(8),intent(in) :: dimV(18),dimS(9)
      real(8),intent(in)::pdata(ndimS(4),ndimS(5),ndimS(6),0:ndimS(7))
      integer,intent(out)::nvoxels(0:ndimS(7))
      real(8),allocatable :: actmap(:,:,:)
      integer,parameter :: ioa=20
      integer :: nx,ny,nz
      integer :: ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      real(8) :: dx,dy,dz,xmin,ymin,zmin,xtrans,ytrans,ztrans
      real(8) :: xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,ysh,zsh
      integer :: ix,iy,iz,it,ix1,iy1,iz1,i,ii
      real(8) :: xmid,ymid,zmid
      character(LEN=3) :: ctime
      character(LEN=200) :: filename

      nx=ndimV(1)
      ny=ndimV(2)
      nz=ndimV(3)
      dx=dimV(1)
      dy=dimV(2)
      dz=dimV(3)
      xmin=dimV(4)
      ymin=dimV(5)
      zmin=dimV(6)
      xtrans=dimV(7)
      ytrans=dimV(8)
      ztrans=dimV(9)
      ixmin=ndimS(1)
      iymin=ndimS(2)
      izmin=ndimS(3)
      ixnum=ndimS(4)
      iynum=ndimS(5)
      iznum=ndimS(6)
      ntiming=ndimS(7)
      xdel=dimS(1)
      ydel=dimS(2)
      zdel=dimS(3)
      xorg=dimS(4)
      yorg=dimS(5)
      zorg=dimS(6)
      xsh=dimS(7)
      ysh=dimS(8)
      zsh=dimS(9)

      xmin=xmin+xtrans
      ymin=ymin+ytrans
      zmin=zmin+ztrans
      xorg=xorg+xsh
      yorg=yorg+ysh
      zorg=zorg+zsh

      nvoxels(0:ntiming)=0

      allocate( actmap(nx,ny,nz) )
      do it=0,ntiming
       do iz=1,nz
        write(istdout,'(a,i4)')'Setting iz =',iz
        zmid=zmin+(iz-0.5d0)*dz
        iz1=int((zmid-zorg)/zdel)+1
        if(iz1.lt.1.or.iz1.gt.iznum)then
         actmap(1:nx,1:ny,iz)=0.0d0
         cycle
        endif
        do iy=1,ny
         ymid=ymin+(iy-0.5d0)*dy
         iy1=int((ymid-yorg)/ydel)+1
         if(iy1.lt.1.or.iy1.gt.iynum)then
          actmap(1:nx,iy,iz)=0.0d0
          cycle
         endif
         do ix=1,nx
          xmid=xmin+(ix-0.5d0)*dx
          ix1=int((xmid-xorg)/xdel)+1
          if(ix1.lt.1.or.ix1.gt.ixnum)then
           actmap(ix,iy,iz)=0.0d0
          else
           actmap(ix,iy,iz)=pdata(ix1,iy1,iz1,it)
           if(pdata(ix1,iy1,iz1,it).gt.0.0d0)nvoxels(it)=nvoxels(it)+1
          endif
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
       write(ctime,'(i3.3)')it
       filename=trim(Cdir)//'voxel_src'//ctime//'.inp'
       open(ioa,file=filename,status='unknown')
       do iz=1,nz
        do iy=1,ny
         do i=1,nx,10
          ii=min(i+9,nx)
          write(ioa,'(6x,10es12.4)')(actmap(ix,iy,iz),ix=i,ii)
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
       close(ioa)
      enddo
      deallocate( actmap )
      return
      end subroutine CREATEsourcePETvoxel
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEdecaybioout(Cdir,ndimV,ndimS,dimV,dimS,
     &     decaybiodata)
! Set closest biological decay value for CT image mesh
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      integer,intent(in) :: ndimV(3),ndimS(12)
      real(8),intent(in) :: dimV(18),dimS(9)
      real(8),intent(in) :: decaybiodata(ndimS(4),ndimS(5),ndimS(6))
      real(8),allocatable :: decaybiomap(:,:,:)
      integer,parameter :: ioa=20
      integer :: nx,ny,nz
      integer :: ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      real(8) :: dx,dy,dz,xmin,ymin,zmin,xtrans,ytrans,ztrans
      real(8) :: xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh(3)
      integer :: ix,iy,iz,ix1,iy1,iz1,i
      real(8) :: xmid,ymid,zmid,bmin,bmax
      character(LEN=200) :: filename

      nx=ndimV(1)
      ny=ndimV(2)
      nz=ndimV(3)
      dx=dimV(1)
      dy=dimV(2)
      dz=dimV(3)
      xmin=dimV(4)
      ymin=dimV(5)
      zmin=dimV(6)
      xtrans=dimV(7)
      ytrans=dimV(8)
      ztrans=dimV(9)
      ixmin=ndimS(1)
      iymin=ndimS(2)
      izmin=ndimS(3)
      ixnum=ndimS(4)
      iynum=ndimS(5)
      iznum=ndimS(6)
      ntiming=ndimS(7)
      xdel=dimS(1)
      ydel=dimS(2)
      zdel=dimS(3)
      xorg=dimS(4)
      yorg=dimS(5)
      zorg=dimS(6)
      xsh(1:3)=dimS(7:9)

      xmin=xmin+xtrans
      ymin=ymin+ytrans
      zmin=zmin+ztrans

      allocate( decaybiomap(nx,ny,nz) )
      do iz=1,nz
       zmid=zmin+(iz-0.5d0)*dz
       iz1=min(iznum,max(1,int((zmid-xsh(3)-zorg)/zdel)+1))
       do iy=1,ny
        ymid=ymin+(iy-0.5d0)*dy
        iy1=min(iynum,max(1,int((ymid-xsh(2)-yorg)/ydel)+1))
        do ix=1,nx
         xmid=xmin+(ix-0.5d0)*dx
         ix1=min(ixnum,max(1,int((xmid-xsh(1)-xorg)/xdel)+1))
         decaybiomap(ix,iy,iz)=decaybiodata(ix1,iy1,iz1)
        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      bmin=min(1.0d0,minval(decaybiodata))
      bmax=max(0.0d0,maxval(decaybiodata))
!     Create decaybio.out file
      filename=trim(Cdir)//'decaybio.out'
      open(ioa,file=filename,status='unknown')
      write(ioa,*) '[ BiologicalDecay ]'
      write(ioa,*) '  title = biological decay constant (/s)'
      write(ioa,*) '  mesh = xyz'
      write(ioa,*) '  x-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  xmin = ',xmin
      write(ioa,*) '  xmax = ',xmin+dx*nx
      write(ioa,*) '    nx = ',nx
      write(ioa,*) '  y-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  ymin = ',ymin
      write(ioa,*) '  ymax = ',ymin+dy*ny
      write(ioa,*) '    ny = ',ny
      write(ioa,*) '  z-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  zmin = ',zmin
      write(ioa,*) '  zmax = ',zmin+dz*nz
      write(ioa,*) '    nz = ',nz
      write(ioa,*) '  axis = xy'
      do iz=1,nz
       if(iz.eq.1) then
        write(ioa,'(''#newpage:'')')
       else
        write(ioa,'('' newpage:'')')
       endif
       write(ioa,'(''x: x [cm]'')')
       write(ioa,'(''y: y [cm]'')')
       write(ioa,*) 'set: c1[ 0.584] c2[ 1.177] c5[ 0.800]',
     & ' c6[ 0.829] c7[ 0.000] c8[ 0.284]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: h2fs form[c1] xfac[c2] afac[c5]',
     & ' scal[c6] xorg[c7] yorg[c8] nosp'
       write(ioa,'(''set: c3['',es12.4,''] c4['',es12.4,'']'')')
     &  bmin,bmax
       write(ioa,*) 'p: cmin[c3] cmax[c4]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: dmin(1e-31)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: zlog'
       write(ioa,'(''p: xmin('',es12.4,'') xmax('',es12.4,'')'')')
     & xmin,xmin+dx*nx
       write(ioa,'(''p: ymin('',es12.4,'') ymax('',es12.4,'')'')')
     & ymin,ymin+dy*ny
       write(ioa,'(''hc: y = '',es16.8,'' to '',es16.8,'' by '',es16.8,
     & '' ; x = '',es16.8,'' to '',es16.8,'' by '',es16.8,'' ;'')')
     & ymin+dy*(ny-0.5d0),ymin+dy*0.5d0,dy,
     & xmin+dx*0.5d0,xmin+dx*(nx-0.5d0),dx
       write(ioa,'(10es11.3)')
     &      ((decaybiomap(ix,iy,iz),ix=1,nx),iy=ny,1,-1)
       write(ioa,*)
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg(1.03)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: xfac[c2*0.05] form[c1/0.05] notc noxt noyt',
     & ' dmin(1)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: ymin(0) ymax(1) xmin(0) xmax(1) cmin(1)',
     & ' cmax(100) nosp'
       write(ioa,'(''hc: y= 0.005 to 0.995 by 0.01 ;'',
     & '' x= 0.5 to 0.5 by 1 ;'')')
       write(ioa,'(20i4)') (i,i=1,100)
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg(0.0)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: xfac[c2*0.05] form[c1/0.05] nosp',
     & ' afac[c5*0.625] ymin[c3] ymax[c4]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: noxt noxn ytxt(-1) ynum(-1) xltd(-1)',
     & ' xstd(-1) itic(1) ylog'
       write(ioa,*) 'y: Biological decay constant [/s]'
       write(ioa,*) 'wt: s[c5]'
       write(ioa,*) '\vspace{-3}'
       write(ioa,'('' zmin &=& '',es12.4,'' [cm]'')') zmin+(iz-1)*dz
       write(ioa,'('' zmax &=& '',es12.4,'' [cm]'')') zmin+iz*dz
       write(ioa,*) 'e:'
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg[-1.03/0.05]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: form[c1] xfac[c2] afac[c5] nosp notf'
       write(ioa,'(''p: xmin( '',es12.4,'' ) xmax( '',es12.4, '' )'')')
     & xmin,xmin+dx*nx
       write(ioa,'(''p: ymin( '',es12.4,'' ) ymax( '',es12.4, '' )'')')
     & ymin,ymin+dy*ny
       write(ioa,'(''#--------------------------------------'')')
      enddo
      write(ioa,*)
      write(ioa,'(''#--------------------------------------'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# Dummy Information for Restart Calculation'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# This calculation was newly started'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# istdev = 1'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# resc2  = 1.00000000000000000E+00'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# resc3  = 1.00000000000000000E+00'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# maxcas =        1'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# rijklst=   0'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# bitrseed = '',
     &     ''00000000000000000000000000000000'',
     &     ''00000000000000000000000000000000'')')
      close(ioa)
      deallocate(decaybiomap)
!     Create decaybio_err.out DUMMY file
      filename=trim(Cdir)//'decaybio_err.out'
      open(ioa,file=filename,status='unknown')
      write(ioa,*) '[ BiologicalDecay ]'
      write(ioa,*) '  title = biological decay constant DUMMY'
      write(ioa,*) '  mesh = xyz'
      write(ioa,*) '  x-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  xmin = ',xmin
      write(ioa,*) '  xmax = ',xmin+dx*nx
      write(ioa,*) '    nx = ',nx
      write(ioa,*) '  y-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  ymin = ',ymin
      write(ioa,*) '  ymax = ',ymin+dy*ny
      write(ioa,*) '    ny = ',ny
      write(ioa,*) '  z-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  zmin = ',zmin
      write(ioa,*) '  zmax = ',zmin+dz*nz
      write(ioa,*) '    nz = ',nz
      write(ioa,*) '  axis = xy'
      do iz=1,nz
       if(iz.eq.1) then
        write(ioa,'(''#newpage:'')')
       else
        write(ioa,'('' newpage:'')')
       endif
       write(ioa,'(''x: x [cm]'')')
       write(ioa,'(''y: y [cm]'')')
       write(ioa,*) 'set: c1[ 0.584] c2[ 1.177] c5[ 0.800]',
     & ' c6[ 0.829] c7[ 0.000] c8[ 0.284]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: h2fs form[c1] xfac[c2] afac[c5]',
     & ' scal[c6] xorg[c7] yorg[c8] nosp'
       write(ioa,'(''set: c3['',es12.4,''] c4['',es12.4,'']'')')
     &  0.0d0,1.0d0
       write(ioa,*) 'p: cmin[c3] cmax[c4]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: dmin(1e-31)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: zlog'
       write(ioa,'(''p: xmin('',es12.4,'') xmax('',es12.4,'')'')')
     & xmin,xmin+dx*nx
       write(ioa,'(''p: ymin('',es12.4,'') ymax('',es12.4,'')'')')
     & ymin,ymin+dy*ny
       write(ioa,'(''hc: y = '',es16.8,'' to '',es16.8,'' by '',es16.8,
     & '' ; x = '',es16.8,'' to '',es16.8,'' by '',es16.8,'' ;'')')
     & ymin+dy*(ny-0.5d0),ymin+dy*0.5d0,dy,
     & xmin+dx*0.5d0,xmin+dx*(nx-0.5d0),dx
       write(ioa,'(10es11.3)')
     &      ((0.0d0,ix=1,nx),iy=ny,1,-1)
       write(ioa,*)
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg(1.03)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: xfac[c2*0.05] form[c1/0.05] notc noxt noyt',
     & ' dmin(1)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: ymin(0) ymax(1) xmin(0) xmax(1) cmin(1)',
     & ' cmax(100) nosp'
       write(ioa,'(''hc: y= 0.005 to 0.995 by 0.01 ;'',
     & '' x= 0.5 to 0.5 by 1 ;'')')
       write(ioa,'(20i4)') (i,i=1,100)
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg(0.0)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: xfac[c2*0.05] form[c1/0.05] nosp',
     & ' afac[c5*0.625] ymin[c3] ymax[c4]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: noxt noxn ytxt(-1) ynum(-1) xltd(-1)',
     & ' xstd(-1) itic(1) ylog'
       write(ioa,*) 'y: Biological decay constant [/s]'
       write(ioa,*) 'wt: s[c5]'
       write(ioa,*) '\vspace{-3}'
       write(ioa,'('' zmin &=& '',es12.4,'' [cm]'')') zmin+(iz-1)*dz
       write(ioa,'('' zmax &=& '',es12.4,'' [cm]'')') zmin+iz*dz
       write(ioa,*) 'e:'
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg[-1.03/0.05]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: form[c1] xfac[c2] afac[c5] nosp notf'
       write(ioa,'(''p: xmin( '',es12.4,'' ) xmax( '',es12.4, '' )'')')
     & xmin,xmin+dx*nx
       write(ioa,'(''p: ymin( '',es12.4,'' ) ymax( '',es12.4, '' )'')')
     & ymin,ymin+dy*ny
       write(ioa,'(''#--------------------------------------'')')
      enddo
      write(ioa,*)
      write(ioa,'(''#--------------------------------------'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# Dummy Information for Restart Calculation'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# This calculation was newly started'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# istdev = 1'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# resc2  = 1.00000000000000000E+00'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# resc3  = 1.00000000000000000E+00'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# maxcas =        1'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# rijklst=   0'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# bitrseed = '',
     &     ''00000000000000000000000000000000'',
     &     ''00000000000000000000000000000000'')')
      close(ioa)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEdecaybioout
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEdensityout(Cdir,ndimV,dimV)
! Set density value on CT image mesh
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      integer,intent(in) :: ndimV(3)
      real(8),intent(in) :: dimV(18)
      integer,parameter :: ioa=20
      integer :: nx,ny,nz
      real(8) :: dx,dy,dz,xmin,ymin,zmin,xtrans,ytrans,ztrans
       integer :: ix,iy,iz,i
      real(8) :: bmin,bmax
      character(LEN=200) :: filename,dummy
      integer :: icell,icell0,mat,isurf,ios,ncell,ist,iend,ilat
      integer :: latot,latold,itmp,iz0,iy0
      real(8) :: density
      character(LEN=6) :: cuniv
      integer,allocatable :: lat(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: denstble(:),densitymap(:,:,:)

      nx=ndimV(1)
      ny=ndimV(2)
      nz=ndimV(3)
      dx=dimV(1)
      dy=dimV(2)
      dz=dimV(3)
      xmin=dimV(4)
      ymin=dimV(5)
      zmin=dimV(6)
      xtrans=dimV(7)
      ytrans=dimV(8)
      ztrans=dimV(9)

      xmin=xmin+xtrans
      ymin=ymin+ytrans
      zmin=zmin+ztrans

      ncell=0
      filename=trim(Cdir)//'CTuniverse.inp'
      open(ioa,file=filename,status='old',err=901)
      do while(.true.)
       read(ioa,*,iostat=ios)icell,mat,density,isurf,cuniv
       if(ios.ne.0)exit
       ncell=ncell+1
      enddo
      allocate(denstble(ncell))
      rewind(ioa)
      icell=0
      do while(.true.)
       read(ioa,*,iostat=ios)icell0,mat,density,isurf,cuniv
       if(ios.ne.0)exit
       icell=icell+1
       denstble(icell)=-density
      enddo
      close(ioa)
      latot=nx*ny*nz
      allocate(lat(latot))
      filename=trim(Cdir)//'CTvoxel.inp'
      open(ioa,file=filename,status='old',err=902)
      ilat=0
      do while(.true.)
       ist=1
       read(ioa,'(a200)',iostat=ios)dummy
       if(ios.ne.0)exit
       iend=len_trim(dummy)
       do while(ist.le.iend)
        do i=ist,iend
         if(dummy(i:i).ne.' ')exit
        enddo
        if(i.gt.iend)then
         ist=iend+1
         cycle
        endif
        ist=i
        do i=ist,iend
         if(dummy(i:i).eq.' ')exit
        enddo
        read(dummy(ist:i-1),*)itmp
        ist=i
        if(itmp.gt.0)then
         ilat=ilat+1
         lat(ilat)=itmp
         latold=itmp
        else
         do i=1,-itmp
          lat(ilat+i)=latold
         enddo
         ilat=ilat-itmp
        endif
       enddo
      enddo
      allocate( densitymap(nx,ny,nz) )
      do iz=1,nz
       iz0=(iz-1)*nx*ny
       do iy=1,ny
        iy0=(iy-1)*nx
        do ix=1,nx
         densitymap(ix,iy,iz)=denstble(lat(ix+iy0+iz0)-5000)
        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      bmin=minval(denstble)
      bmax=maxval(denstble)
      deallocate(denstble,lat)
!     Create density.out file
      filename=trim(Cdir)//'density.out'
      open(ioa,file=filename,status='unknown')
      write(ioa,*) '[ Density ]'
      write(ioa,*) '  title = Density (g/cm^3)'
      write(ioa,*) '  mesh = xyz'
      write(ioa,*) '  x-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  xmin = ',xmin
      write(ioa,*) '  xmax = ',xmin+dx*nx
      write(ioa,*) '    nx = ',nx
      write(ioa,*) '  y-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  ymin = ',ymin
      write(ioa,*) '  ymax = ',ymin+dy*ny
      write(ioa,*) '    ny = ',ny
      write(ioa,*) '  z-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  zmin = ',zmin
      write(ioa,*) '  zmax = ',zmin+dz*nz
      write(ioa,*) '    nz = ',nz
      write(ioa,*) '  axis = xy'
      do iz=1,nz
       if(iz.eq.1) then
        write(ioa,'(''#newpage:'')')
       else
        write(ioa,'('' newpage:'')')
       endif
       write(ioa,'(''x: x [cm]'')')
       write(ioa,'(''y: y [cm]'')')
       write(ioa,*) 'set: c1[ 0.584] c2[ 1.177] c5[ 0.800]',
     & ' c6[ 0.829] c7[ 0.000] c8[ 0.284]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: h2fs form[c1] xfac[c2] afac[c5]',
     & ' scal[c6] xorg[c7] yorg[c8] nosp'
       write(ioa,'(''set: c3['',es12.4,''] c4['',es12.4,'']'')')
     &  bmin,bmax
       write(ioa,*) 'p: cmin[c3] cmax[c4]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: dmin(1e-31)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: zlog'
       write(ioa,'(''p: xmin('',es12.4,'') xmax('',es12.4,'')'')')
     & xmin,xmin+dx*nx
       write(ioa,'(''p: ymin('',es12.4,'') ymax('',es12.4,'')'')')
     & ymin,ymin+dy*ny
       write(ioa,'(''hc: y = '',es16.8,'' to '',es16.8,'' by '',es16.8,
     & '' ; x = '',es16.8,'' to '',es16.8,'' by '',es16.8,'' ;'')')
     & ymin+dy*(ny-0.5d0),ymin+dy*0.5d0,dy,
     & xmin+dx*0.5d0,xmin+dx*(nx-0.5d0),dx
       write(ioa,'(10es11.3)')
     &      ((densitymap(ix,iy,iz),ix=1,nx),iy=ny,1,-1)
       write(ioa,*)
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg(1.03)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: xfac[c2*0.05] form[c1/0.05] notc noxt noyt',
     & ' dmin(1)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: ymin(0) ymax(1) xmin(0) xmax(1) cmin(1)',
     & ' cmax(100) nosp'
       write(ioa,'(''hc: y= 0.005 to 0.995 by 0.01 ;'',
     & '' x= 0.5 to 0.5 by 1 ;'')')
       write(ioa,'(20i4)') (i,i=1,100)
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg(0.0)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: xfac[c2*0.05] form[c1/0.05] nosp',
     & ' afac[c5*0.625] ymin[c3] ymax[c4]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: noxt noxn ytxt(-1) ynum(-1) xltd(-1)',
     & ' xstd(-1) itic(1) ylog'
       write(ioa,*) 'y: Density [g/cm^3]'
       write(ioa,*) 'wt: s[c5]'
       write(ioa,*) '\vspace{-3}'
       write(ioa,'('' zmin &=& '',es12.4,'' [cm]'')') zmin+(iz-1)*dz
       write(ioa,'('' zmax &=& '',es12.4,'' [cm]'')') zmin+iz*dz
       write(ioa,*) 'e:'
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg[-1.03/0.05]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: form[c1] xfac[c2] afac[c5] nosp notf'
       write(ioa,'(''p: xmin( '',es12.4,'' ) xmax( '',es12.4, '' )'')')
     & xmin,xmin+dx*nx
       write(ioa,'(''p: ymin( '',es12.4,'' ) ymax( '',es12.4, '' )'')')
     & ymin,ymin+dy*ny
       write(ioa,'(''#--------------------------------------'')')
      enddo
      write(ioa,*)
      write(ioa,'(''#--------------------------------------'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# Dummy Information for Restart Calculation'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# This calculation was newly started'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# istdev = 1'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# resc2  = 1.00000000000000000E+00'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# resc3  = 1.00000000000000000E+00'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# maxcas =        1'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# rijklst=   0'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# bitrseed = '',
     &     ''00000000000000000000000000000000'',
     &     ''00000000000000000000000000000000'')')
      close(ioa)
      deallocate(densitymap)
!     Create density_err.out DUMMY file
      filename=trim(Cdir)//'density_err.out'
      open(ioa,file=filename,status='unknown')
      write(ioa,*) '[ Density ]'
      write(ioa,*) '  title = Density DUMMY'
      write(ioa,*) '  mesh = xyz'
      write(ioa,*) '  x-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  xmin = ',xmin
      write(ioa,*) '  xmax = ',xmin+dx*nx
      write(ioa,*) '    nx = ',nx
      write(ioa,*) '  y-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  ymin = ',ymin
      write(ioa,*) '  ymax = ',ymin+dy*ny
      write(ioa,*) '    ny = ',ny
      write(ioa,*) '  z-type = 2'
      write(ioa,*) '  zmin = ',zmin
      write(ioa,*) '  zmax = ',zmin+dz*nz
      write(ioa,*) '    nz = ',nz
      write(ioa,*) '  axis = xy'
      do iz=1,nz
       if(iz.eq.1) then
        write(ioa,'(''#newpage:'')')
       else
        write(ioa,'('' newpage:'')')
       endif
       write(ioa,'(''x: x [cm]'')')
       write(ioa,'(''y: y [cm]'')')
       write(ioa,*) 'set: c1[ 0.584] c2[ 1.177] c5[ 0.800]',
     & ' c6[ 0.829] c7[ 0.000] c8[ 0.284]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: h2fs form[c1] xfac[c2] afac[c5]',
     & ' scal[c6] xorg[c7] yorg[c8] nosp'
       write(ioa,'(''set: c3['',es12.4,''] c4['',es12.4,'']'')')
     &  0.0d0,1.0d0
       write(ioa,*) 'p: cmin[c3] cmax[c4]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: dmin(1e-31)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: zlog'
       write(ioa,'(''p: xmin('',es12.4,'') xmax('',es12.4,'')'')')
     & xmin,xmin+dx*nx
       write(ioa,'(''p: ymin('',es12.4,'') ymax('',es12.4,'')'')')
     & ymin,ymin+dy*ny
       write(ioa,'(''hc: y = '',es16.8,'' to '',es16.8,'' by '',es16.8,
     & '' ; x = '',es16.8,'' to '',es16.8,'' by '',es16.8,'' ;'')')
     & ymin+dy*(ny-0.5d0),ymin+dy*0.5d0,dy,
     & xmin+dx*0.5d0,xmin+dx*(nx-0.5d0),dx
       write(ioa,'(10es11.3)')
     &      ((0.0d0,ix=1,nx),iy=ny,1,-1)
       write(ioa,*)
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg(1.03)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: xfac[c2*0.05] form[c1/0.05] notc noxt noyt',
     & ' dmin(1)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: ymin(0) ymax(1) xmin(0) xmax(1) cmin(1)',
     & ' cmax(100) nosp'
       write(ioa,'(''hc: y= 0.005 to 0.995 by 0.01 ;'',
     & '' x= 0.5 to 0.5 by 1 ;'')')
       write(ioa,'(20i4)') (i,i=1,100)
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg(0.0)'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: xfac[c2*0.05] form[c1/0.05] nosp',
     & ' afac[c5*0.625] ymin[c3] ymax[c4]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: noxt noxn ytxt(-1) ynum(-1) xltd(-1)',
     & ' xstd(-1) itic(1) ylog'
       write(ioa,*) 'y: Density [g/cm^3]'
       write(ioa,*) 'wt: s[c5]'
       write(ioa,*) '\vspace{-3}'
       write(ioa,'('' zmin &=& '',es12.4,'' [cm]'')') zmin+(iz-1)*dz
       write(ioa,'('' zmax &=& '',es12.4,'' [cm]'')') zmin+iz*dz
       write(ioa,*) 'e:'
       write(ioa,*) 'z: xorg[-1.03/0.05]'
       write(ioa,*) 'p: form[c1] xfac[c2] afac[c5] nosp notf'
       write(ioa,'(''p: xmin( '',es12.4,'' ) xmax( '',es12.4, '' )'')')
     & xmin,xmin+dx*nx
       write(ioa,'(''p: ymin( '',es12.4,'' ) ymax( '',es12.4, '' )'')')
     & ymin,ymin+dy*ny
       write(ioa,'(''#--------------------------------------'')')
      enddo
      write(ioa,*)
      write(ioa,'(''#--------------------------------------'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# Dummy Information for Restart Calculation'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# This calculation was newly started'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# istdev = 1'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# resc2  = 1.00000000000000000E+00'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# resc3  = 1.00000000000000000E+00'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# maxcas =        1'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# rijklst=   0'')')
      write(ioa,'(''# bitrseed = '',
     &     ''00000000000000000000000000000000'',
     &     ''00000000000000000000000000000000'')')
      close(ioa)
      return

 901  write(istdout,'(2a)')'ERROR: FILE=CTuniverse.inp is missing in ',
     &     trim(Cdir)
      write(istdout,'(a)')' Execution of CT2PHITS is necessary'
      call exit(-1)
      return
 902  write(istdout,'(2a)')'ERROR: FILE=CTvoxel.dat is missing in ',
     &     trim(Cdir)
      write(istdout,'(a)')' Execution of CT2PHITS is necessary'
      call exit(-1)
      return

      end subroutine CREATEdensityout
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEtrans(io,iorg,iphantom)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io,iorg,iphantom
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Transform for beam angle'
      if(iorg.eq.1.and.iphantom.eq.1)then
       write(io,'(2a)')'*tr400 ','c91+c87+c81*c84/2'
       write(io,'(2a)')'       ','c92+c88+c82*c85/2'
       write(io,'(2a)')'       ','c93+c89+c83*c86/2'
       write(io,'(2a)')'       ','c35 0 -c36 0 0 0 0 0 0 2'
      else
       write(io,'(a)')'*tr400 0 0 0 c35 0 -c36 0 0 0 0 0 0 2'
      endif
      return
      end subroutine CREATEtrans

     &     1.4496E+02, 1.4970E+02, 1.5459E+02, 1.5965E+02, 1.6487E+02,
     &     1.7027E+02, 1.7584E+02, 1.8159E+02, 1.8753E+02, 1.9366E+02,
     &     2.0000E+02/
      data ydata2/

      data ydata4/
     &     2.5214E-06, 3.3220E-06, 1.0707E-05, 3.1906E-05, 8.3875E-05,
     &     3.9033E-04, 2.7505E-03, 4.7041E-03, 3.9563E-03, 3.8306E-03,
     &     3.8701E-03, 3.9164E-03, 3.9514E-03, 3.9985E-03, 4.0451E-03,
     &     4.0793E-03, 4.1186E-03, 4.1582E-03, 4.2102E-03, 4.2373E-03,
     &     4.3093E-03, 4.3629E-03, 4.4062E-03, 4.4628E-03, 4.4882E-03,
     &     4.5479E-03, 4.6032E-03, 4.6434E-03, 4.7113E-03, 4.7333E-03,
     &     4.7643E-03, 4.8201E-03, 4.8981E-03, 4.9461E-03, 5.0151E-03,
     &     5.0713E-03, 5.1325E-03, 5.2031E-03, 5.2508E-03, 5.2886E-03,
     &     5.3257E-03, 5.4007E-03, 5.4862E-03, 5.6024E-03, 5.7072E-03,
     &     5.8076E-03, 5.9254E-03, 6.0240E-03, 6.1435E-03, 6.2608E-03,
     &     6.3804E-03, 6.5044E-03, 6.6385E-03, 6.7747E-03, 6.9274E-03,
     &     7.0479E-03, 7.2032E-03, 7.3719E-03, 7.5105E-03, 7.6332E-03,
     &     7.7973E-03, 7.9582E-03, 8.1503E-03, 8.2534E-03, 8.4834E-03,
     &     8.6865E-03, 8.8711E-03, 8.9935E-03, 9.1088E-03, 9.3687E-03,
     &     9.5555E-03, 9.7270E-03, 9.9718E-03, 1.0109E-02, 1.0211E-02,

      if(iparam.eq.1)then
       write(io,5000)'$ Varian 6MV photon spectrum based on ',
     &      'D. Sheikh-Bagheri et al. PMB 29 (2002) 391'
       write(io,5000)' e-type = 21'
       write(io,5000)'     ne = 24'
       do i=1,24
        write(io,5010)xdata1(i),ydata1(i)
       enddo
       write(io,5010)xdata1(24+1)
      elseif(iparam.eq.2)then
       write(io,5000)'$ 190MeV proton 9cm SOBP spectrum based on ',
     &      'S. Matsumoto et al. Health Phys 110 (2016) 380'
       write(io,5000)' e-type = 21'
       write(io,5000)'     ne = 50'
       do i=1,50
        write(io,5010)xdata2(i),ydata2(i)
       enddo
       write(io,5010)xdata2(50+1)
      elseif(iparam.eq.3)then
       write(io,5000)'$ 290MeV carbon 6cm SOBP spectrum based on ',
     &      'T. Furuta et al. PMB 67 (2022) 145002'
       write(io,5000)' e-type = 21'
       write(io,5000)'     ne = 77'
       do i=1,77
        write(io,5010)xdata3(i),ydata3(i)
       enddo
       write(io,5010)xdata3(77+1)
      elseif(iparam.eq.4)then
       write(io,5000)'$ 400MeV carbon 8cm SOBP spectrum based on ',
     &      'T. Furuta et al. PMB 67 (2022) 145002'
       write(io,5000)' e-type = 21'
       write(io,5000)'     ne = 88'
       do i=1,88
        write(io,5010)xdata4(i),ydata4(i)
       enddo
       write(io,5010)xdata4(88+1)
      else
       write(*,'(a,i1,a)')'ERROR: Simple Source option = ',iparam,
     &      ' is under construction'
       call exit(-1)
      endif

 5000 format(2a)
 5010 format(2(1X,1PE12.4e2))
      return
      end subroutine CREATEspectrum
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEusrparamWater(io,ndimV,dimV)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io
      integer,intent(in) :: ndimV(3)
      real(8),intent(in) :: dimV(18)
      real(8) :: epsilon=1.0d-5

      write(io,'(a)')'$ Water parameters'
      write(io,5000)'set: c',81,'[',ndimV(1),']  $ number of x pixel'
      write(io,5000)'set: c',82,'[',ndimV(2),']  $ number of y pixel'
      write(io,5000)'set: c',83,'[',ndimV(3),']  $ number of z pixel'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',84,'[',dimV(1),'] $ unit voxel x'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',85,'[',dimV(2),'] $ unit voxel y'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',86,'[',dimV(3),'] $ unit voxel z'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',87,'[',dimV(4),'] $ smallest x'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',88,'[',dimV(5),'] $ smallest y'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',89,'[',dimV(6),'] $ smallest z'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',90,'[',epsilon,'] $ small quota'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',91,'[',dimV(7),'] $ x shift'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',92,'[',dimV(8),'] $ y shift'
      write(io,5001)'set: c',93,'[',dimV(9),'] $ z shift'
 5000 format(a,i2,a,i5,a)
 5001 format(a,i2,a,f12.5,a)

      end subroutine CREATEusrparamWater

      subroutine CREATEtransWater(io)

      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Transform for isocenter shift of Water'
      write(io,'(a)')'*tr500 c91 c92 c93 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 2'
      return
      end subroutine CREATEtransWater

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEt3Dshow(io,isrc,iphantom,iorg,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,Ctag)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io,isrc,iphantom,iorg
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      real(8) :: whgt
      real(8) :: wwdt

      wwdt=1.2d0*ixnum*xdel
      whgt=sqrt(iznum*iznum*zdel*zdel+iynum*iynum*ydel*ydel)
      whgt=1.2d0*whgt
      wwdt=max(wwdt,0.5d0*whgt)
      whgt=max(whgt,0.5d0*wwdt)
      write(io,5000)'   title  = [t-3dshow: icntl=11]'
      if(Ctag.eq.'NO')then
         write(io,'(a)')'   file   = CT3D.out'
      else
         write(io,'(3a)')'   file   = CT3D-'//Ctag//'.out'
      endif
      if(iorg.eq.0)then
        write(io,5001)'       x0 = ',0.0d0
        write(io,5001)'       y0 = ',0.0d0
        write(io,5001)'       z0 = ',0.0d0
      else
        write(io,5000)'       x0 = c87+c81*c84/2+c91'
        write(io,5000)'       y0 = c88+c82*c85/2+c92'
        write(io,5000)'       z0 = c89+c83*c86/2+c93'
      endif
      write(io,5000)'    e-the =  60.0000'
      write(io,5000)'    e-phi =  290.00000'
      write(io,5000)'    l-the =  40.0000'
      write(io,5000)'    l-phi =  310.00000'
      write(io,5001)'    w-wdt = ',1.2d0*ixnum*xdel
      write(io,5001)'    w-hgt = ',whgt
      write(io,5001)'    w-dst = ',3.0d0*whgt
      write(io,5000)'   heaven =   z'
      write(io,5000)'    resol =   1'
      write(io,5000)'   shadow =   1'
      write(io,5000)'    width =   0'
      write(io,5000)'   epsout =   1'
      if(isrc.eq.1.and.iphantom.eq.1)then
       write(io,5000)' material =  -2'
       write(io,5000)'             101 5001'
      elseif(isrc.eq.1.and.iphantom.eq.0)then
       write(io,5000)' material =  -1'
       write(io,5000)'             101'
      elseif(isrc.eq.0.and.iphantom.eq.1)then
       write(io,5000)' material =  -2'
       write(io,5000)'             1000 5001'
      elseif(isrc.eq.0.and.iphantom.eq.0)then
       write(io,5000)' material =  -1'
       write(io,5000)'             1000'
      endif
 5000 format(a)
 5001 format(a,f12.5)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEt3Dshow
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEttrack(io,iorg,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,xdel,ydel,zdel,tag,Ctag)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io,iorg
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      character(2),intent(in) :: tag,Ctag
      real(8) :: xdist,ydist,zdist

      xdist=xdel*ixnum
      ydist=ydel*iynum
      zdist=zdel*iznum
      if(tag.eq.'xy')then
       xdist=max(xdist,0.5d0*ydist)
       ydist=max(ydist,0.5d0*xdist)
      elseif(tag.eq.'yz')then
       zdist=max(zdist,0.5d0*ydist)
       ydist=max(ydist,0.5d0*zdist)
      elseif(tag.eq.'xz')then
       zdist=max(zdist,0.5d0*xdist)
       xdist=max(xdist,0.5d0*zdist)
      else
       write(*,*)'ERROR: tag should be xy or yz or xz'
      endif
      write(io,5000)' title  = Track on image'
      if(Ctag.eq.'NO')then
         write(io,5003)' file   = track-',tag,'.out'
      else
         write(io,5003)' file   = track-',tag,'-',Ctag,'.out'
      endif
      write(io,5000)' mesh   = xyz'
      write(io,5000)' x-type = 2'
      if(tag.eq.'xy'.or.tag.eq.'xz')then
       write(io,5002)' nx     = ',ixnum
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        write(io,5001)' xmin   = ',-0.5d0*xdist
        write(io,5001)' xmax   = ', 0.5d0*xdist
       else
        write(io,5001)' xmin   = c91+c87+',0.5d0*(xdel*ixnum-xdist)
        write(io,5001)' xmax   = c91+c87+',0.5d0*(xdel*ixnum+xdist)
       endif
      elseif(tag.eq.'yz')then
       write(io,5002)' nx     = ',1
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        if(mod(ixnum,2).eq.1)then
         write(io,5001)' xmin   = ',-xdel/2.0d0
         write(io,5001)' xmax   = ', xdel/2.0d0
        else
         write(io,5001)' xmin   = ',0.0d0
         write(io,5001)' xmax   = ',xdel
        endif
       else
        write(io,5001)' xmin   = c91+c87+',xdel*(ixnum/2)
        write(io,5001)' xmax   = c91+c87+',xdel*(ixnum/2+1)
       endif
      endif
      write(io,5000)' y-type = 2'
      if(tag.eq.'xy'.or.tag.eq.'yz')then
       write(io,5002)' ny     = ',iynum
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        write(io,5001)' ymin   = ',-0.5d0*ydist
        write(io,5001)' ymax   = ', 0.5d0*ydist
       else
        write(io,5001)' ymin   = c92+c88+',0.5d0*(ydel*iynum-ydist)
        write(io,5001)' ymax   = c92+c88+',0.5d0*(ydel*iynum+ydist)
       endif
      elseif(tag.eq.'xz')then
       write(io,5002)' ny     = ',1
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        if(mod(ixnum,2).eq.1)then
         write(io,5001)' ymin   = ',-ydel/2.0d0
         write(io,5001)' ymax   = ', ydel/2.0d0
        else
         write(io,5001)' ymin   = ',0.0d0
         write(io,5001)' ymax   = ',ydel
        endif
       else
        write(io,5001)' ymin   = c92+c88+',ydel*(iynum/2)
        write(io,5001)' ymax   = c92+c88+',ydel*(iynum/2+1)
       endif
      endif
      write(io,5000)' z-type = 2'
      if(tag.eq.'yz'.or.tag.eq.'xz')then
       write(io,5002)' nz     = ',iznum
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        write(io,5001)' zmin   = ',-0.5d0*zdist
        write(io,5001)' zmax   = ', 0.5d0*zdist
       else
        write(io,5001)' zmin   = c93+c89+',0.5d0*(zdel*iznum-zdist)
        write(io,5001)' zmax   = c93+c89+',0.5d0*(zdel*iznum+zdist)
       endif
      elseif(tag.eq.'xy')then
       write(io,5002)' nz     = ',1
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        if(mod(iznum,2).eq.1)then
         write(io,5001)' zmin   = ',-zdel/2.0d0
         write(io,5001)' zmax   = ', zdel/2.0d0
        else
         write(io,5001)' zmin   = ',0.0d0
         write(io,5001)' zmax   = ',zdel
        endif
       else
        write(io,5001)' zmin   = c93+c89+',zdel*(iznum/2)
        write(io,5001)' zmax   = c93+c89+',zdel*(iznum/2+1)
       endif
      endif
      write(io,5000)' e-type = 1'
      write(io,5000)' ne     = 1'
      write(io,5000)'          0.0 2000.0'
      write(io,5000)' unit   = 1'
      write(io,5003)' axis   = ',tag
      write(io,5000)' gshow  = 1'
      write(io,5000)' gslat  = 0'
      write(io,5000)'$ resol  = 2'
      write(io,5000)' epsout = 1'
 5000 format(a)
 5001 format(a,'(',f12.5,')')
 5002 format(a,i4)
 5003 format(5a)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEttrack
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEtdeposit(io,iorg,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,xdel,ydel,zdel,tag,Ctag)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io,iorg
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      character(2),intent(in) :: tag,Ctag
      real(8) :: xdist,ydist,zdist

      xdist=xdel*ixnum
      ydist=ydel*iynum
      zdist=zdel*iznum
      if(tag.eq.'xy')then
        xdist=max(xdist,0.5d0*ydist)
        ydist=max(ydist,0.5d0*xdist)
      elseif(tag.eq.'yz')then
        zdist=max(zdist,0.5d0*ydist)
        ydist=max(ydist,0.5d0*zdist)
      elseif(tag.eq.'xz')then
        zdist=max(zdist,0.5d0*xdist)
        xdist=max(xdist,0.5d0*zdist)
      else
        write(*,*)'ERROR: tag should be xy or yz or xz'
      endif

      write(io,5000)' title  = Energy deposition on image'
      if(Ctag.eq.'NO')then
         write(io,5003)' file   = deposit-',tag,'.out'
      else
         write(io,5003)' file   = deposit-',tag,'-',Ctag,'.out'
      endif
      write(io,5000)' mesh   = xyz'
      write(io,5000)' x-type = 2'
      if(tag.eq.'xy'.or.tag.eq.'xz')then
       write(io,5002)' nx     = ',ixnum
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        write(io,5001)' xmin   = ',-0.5d0*xdist
        write(io,5001)' xmax   = ', 0.5d0*xdist
       else
        write(io,5001)' xmin   = c91+c87+',0.5d0*(xdel*ixnum-xdist)
        write(io,5001)' xmax   = c91+c87+',0.5d0*(xdel*ixnum+xdist)
       endif
      elseif(tag.eq.'yz')then
       write(io,5002)' nx     = ',1
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        if(mod(ixnum,2).eq.1)then
         write(io,5001)' xmin   = ',-xdel/2.0d0
         write(io,5001)' xmax   = ', xdel/2.0d0
        else
         write(io,5001)' xmin   = ',0.0d0
         write(io,5001)' xmax   = ',xdel
        endif
       else
        write(io,5001)' xmin   = c91+c87+',xdel*(ixnum/2)
        write(io,5001)' xmax   = c91+c87+',xdel*(ixnum/2+1)
       endif
      endif
      write(io,5000)' y-type = 2'
      if(tag.eq.'xy'.or.tag.eq.'yz')then
       write(io,5002)' ny     = ',iynum
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        write(io,5001)' ymin   = ',-0.5d0*ydist
        write(io,5001)' ymax   = ', 0.5d0*ydist
       else
        write(io,5001)' ymin   = c92+c88+',0.5d0*(ydel*iynum-ydist)
        write(io,5001)' ymax   = c92+c88+',0.5d0*(ydel*iynum+ydist)
       endif
      elseif(tag.eq.'xz')then
       write(io,5002)' ny     = ',1
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        if(mod(ixnum,2).eq.1)then
         write(io,5001)' ymin   = ',-ydel/2.0d0
         write(io,5001)' ymax   = ', ydel/2.0d0
        else
         write(io,5001)' ymin   = ',0.0d0
         write(io,5001)' ymax   = ',ydel
        endif
       else
        write(io,5001)' ymin   = c92+c88+',ydel*(iynum/2)
        write(io,5001)' ymax   = c92+c88+',ydel*(iynum/2+1)
       endif
      endif
      write(io,5000)' z-type = 2'
      if(tag.eq.'yz'.or.tag.eq.'xz')then
       write(io,5002)' nz     = ',iznum
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        write(io,5001)' zmin   = ',-0.5d0*zdist
        write(io,5001)' zmax   = ', 0.5d0*zdist
       else
        write(io,5001)' zmin   = c93+c89+',0.5d0*(zdel*iznum-zdist)
        write(io,5001)' zmax   = c93+c89+',0.5d0*(zdel*iznum+zdist)
       endif
      elseif(tag.eq.'xy')then
       write(io,5002)' nz     = ',1
       if(iorg.eq.0)then
        if(mod(iznum,2).eq.1)then
         write(io,5001)' zmin   = ',-zdel/2.0d0
         write(io,5001)' zmax   = ', zdel/2.0d0
        else
         write(io,5001)' zmin   = ',0.0d0
         write(io,5001)' zmax   = ',zdel
        endif
       else
        write(io,5001)' zmin   = c93+c89+',zdel*(iznum/2)
        write(io,5001)' zmax   = c93+c89+',zdel*(iznum/2+1)
       endif
      endif
      write(io,5000)' unit   = 2'
      write(io,5003)' axis   = ',tag
      write(io,5000)' gshow  = 1'
      write(io,5000)' gslat  = 0'
      write(io,5000)' output = dose'
      write(io,5000)' epsout = 1'
      write(io,5000)'$ resol  = 2'
 5000 format(a)
 5001 format(a,'(',f12.5,')')
 5002 format(a,i4)
 5003 format(5a)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEtdeposit
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEt3Ddeposit(io,iunit,dicompos)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io,iunit
      real(8),intent(in) :: dicompos(3)

 5000 format(a)
 5001 format(a,3f12.5,a)
 5002 format(a,i4)
      write(io,5001)' title  =  (ImagePositionPatient',
     &      dicompos(1:3),' mm)'
      write(io,5000)' mesh   = xyz'
      write(io,5000)' x-type = 2'
      write(io,5000)' nx     = c81'
      write(io,5000)' xmin   = c91+c87'
      write(io,5000)' xmax   = c91+c87+c81*c84'
      write(io,5000)' y-type = 2'
      write(io,5002)' ny     = c82'
      write(io,5000)' ymin   = c92+c88'
      write(io,5000)' ymax   = c92+c88+c82*c85'
      write(io,5000)' z-type = 2'
      write(io,5000)' nz     = c83'
      write(io,5000)' zmin   = c93+c89'
      write(io,5000)' zmax   = c93+c89+c83*c86'
      write(io,5002)' unit   = ',iunit
      write(io,5000)' axis   = xy'
      write(io,5000)' gshow  = 0'
      write(io,5000)' gslat  = 0'

 5000 format(a)
 5001 format(5a)

         write(io,5001)' file   = track-GT-',tag,'.out'

      endif
      write(io,5000)' mesh   = xyz'

       write(io,5000)' xmin   = -50.0'
       write(io,5000)' xmax   =  50.0'

       write(io,5000)' xmin   = -5.0'
       write(io,5000)' xmax   =  5.0'

       write(io,5000)' ny     = 100'
       write(io,5000)' ymin   = -50.0'
       write(io,5000)' ymax   =  50.0'
      else
       write(io,5000)' ny     = 1'
       write(io,5000)' ymin   = -5.0'
       write(io,5000)' ymax   =  5.0'
      endif
      write(io,5000)' z-type = 2'
      write(io,5000)' nz     = 300'
      write(io,5000)' zmin   = -C34-10.0'
      write(io,5000)' zmax   =  50.0'
      write(io,5000)' e-type = 1'

      write(io,5000)' unit   = 1'
      if(tag.eq.'xz')then

       write(io,5000)' axis   = yz'

      write(io,5000)' gshow  = 1'
      write(io,5000)' gslat  = 0'
      write(io,5000)'$ resol  = 2'

*********************************************************************
      module createpet
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEsourceinfo(Cinter,cRIname,CRIlist,iradflag,
     &     ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,inorm,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,decaybioinp)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use readpet, only:Cdir
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter,cRIname,CRIlist
      integer,intent(in) :: iradflag(5)
      integer,intent(in) :: ixmin,iymin,izmin
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,inorm
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh(3)
      real(8),intent(in) :: decaybioinp
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: iend
      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'sourceinfo.dat',status='unknown')
      write(io,'(i4)')2
      write(io,'(a)')trim(cRIname)
      write(io,'(5(i4,2x))')iradflag(1:5)
      write(io,'(3(i4,2x))')ixmin,iymin,izmin
      write(io,'(4(i4,2x))')ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      write(io,'(3(f15.7,2x))')xdel,ydel,zdel
      write(io,'(3(f15.7,2x))')xorg,yorg,zorg
      write(io,'(3(f15.7,2x))')xsh(1:3)
      write(io,'(a)')'#'
      write(io,'(a)')trim(CRIlist)
      write(io,'(a)')trim(Cdir)
      write(io,'(a)')trim(Cdir)
      write(io,'(f15.7)')decaybioinp
      write(io,'(i4)')inorm
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEsourceinfo
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEbqdata(Cinter,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,
     &     totalsource,pidata,pdata)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      real(8),intent(in) :: totalsource(0:ntiming)
      real(8),intent(in) :: pidata(ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      real(8),intent(in) :: pdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming)
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: iend,ix,iy,iz,ii,i,it

      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'bqdata.dat',status='unknown')
      do it=0,ntiming
       write(io,'(2es12.4)')totalsource(it)
      enddo
      do iz=1,iznum
       do iy=1,iynum
        do i=1,ixnum,10
         ii=min(i+9,ixnum)
         write(io,'(6x,10es12.4)')(pidata(ix,iy,iz),ix=i,ii)
        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      do it=1,ntiming
       do iz=1,iznum
        do iy=1,iynum
         do i=1,ixnum,10
          ii=min(i+9,ixnum)
          write(io,'(6x,10es12.4)')(pdata(ix,iy,iz,it),ix=i,ii)
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEbqdata

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEpetparam(Cinter,
     &     ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,
     &     activity,decayPET)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: ixmin,iymin,izmin
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh(3)
      real(8),intent(in) :: activity,decayPET
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: iend

      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'pettmpparam.dat',status='unknown')
      write(io,'(7(i5,x))')ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      write(io,*)xdel,ydel,zdel
      write(io,*)xorg,yorg,zorg
      write(io,*)xsh(1:3)
      write(io,*)activity,decayPET
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEpetparam

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEpettmpdata(Cinter,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,tlist,pdata)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      real(8),intent(in) :: tlist(2,ntiming)
      real(8),intent(in) :: pdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming)
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: iend,ix,iy,iz,ii,i,it

      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'pettmpdata.dat',status='unknown')
      do it=1,ntiming
       write(io,'(2es12.4)')tlist(1:2,it)
      enddo
      do it=1,ntiming
       do iz=1,iznum
        do iy=1,iynum
         do i=1,ixnum,10
          ii=min(i+9,ixnum)
          write(io,'(6x,10es12.4)')(pdata(ix,iy,iz,it),ix=i,ii)
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEpettmpdata

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEdecaybiodata(Cinter,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,decaybiodata)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum

        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      close(io)
      return

*********************************************************************
      module createplan
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEplaninp(
     &     npairMLC,ndimRC,npointBL,iflagFLC,Cdir,Ctag,
     &     cbeamID,cmatRS,cmatFLC,cmatMLC,cmatRC,cmatBL,
     &     dimGT,dimRS,dimFLC,dimMLC,dimRC,dimBL,dimPS)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: npairMLC,ndimRC(2),npointBL
      logical,intent(in) :: iflagFLC
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir,cbeamID
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: cmatRS,cmatFLC(2)
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: cmatMLC,cmatRC,cmatBL
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      real(8),intent(in) :: dimGT(7),dimRS(5),dimFLC(12),dimMLC(3)
      real(8),intent(in) :: dimRC(10),dimBL(4),dimPS(3)
      integer,parameter :: io=10
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      call CREATEusrparamPlan(io,Cdir,Ctag,
     &     npairMLC,ndimRC,npointBL,iflagFLC,
     &     dimGT,dimRS,dimFLC,dimMLC,dimRC,dimBL,dimPS)
      call CREATEsourcePlan(io,Cdir,Ctag,cbeamID)
      call CREATEsurfPlan(io,Cdir,Ctag,
     &     npointBL,ndimRC,iflagFLC,dimRS)
      call CREATEcellPlan(io,Cdir,Ctag,
     &     npairMLC,npointBL,ndimRC,iflagFLC,dimRS)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* create device include files
      if(dimRS(5).gt.0.0d0)
     &     call CREATErangeshifter(Cdir,Ctag,cmatRS)
      call CREATEbeamlimitingdevice(iflagFLC,npairMLC,Cdir,Ctag,
     &     cmatFLC,cmatMLC)
      if(ndimRC(1).gt.0)
     &     call CREATErangecompensator(ndimRC,Cdir,Ctag,cmatRC,dimRC)
      if(npointBL.gt.0)call CREATEblock(npointBL,Cdir,Ctag,cmatBL)
      call CREATEtransPlan(Cdir,Ctag)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------

      return
      end subroutine CREATEplaninp

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEusrparamPlan(io,Cdir,Ctag,
     &     npairMLC,ndimRC,npointBL,iflagFLC,
     &     dimGT,dimRS,dimFLC,dimMLC,dimRC,dimBL,dimPS)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      integer,intent(in) :: npairMLC,ndimRC(2),npointBL
      logical,intent(in) :: iflagFLC
      real(8),intent(in) :: dimGT(7),dimRS(5),dimFLC(12),dimMLC(3)
      real(8),intent(in) :: dimRC(10),dimBL(4),dimPS(3)
      integer :: iend
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      iend=len_trim(Cdir)
      open(io,file=Cdir(1:iend)//'PLANusrparam-'//Ctag//'.inp',
     &     status='unknown')
      write(io,'(a)') '$ User-defined variables'
      if(.not.iflagFLC)write(io,'(a)') '$ No FLC'
      if(npointBL.eq.0)write(io,'(a)') '$ No Block'
 5000 format('set: c',i2,'[',i5,'] $ ',a)
 5001 format('set: c',i2,'[',f12.5,'] $ ',a)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* from Plan.dat c30-31
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Gantory'
      write(io,5001)30,dimGT(1),'Gantry Angle [deg]'
      write(io,5001)31,dimGT(2),'Pitch Angle [deg]'

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* from RangeShifter.dat c32-35
      if(dimRS(5).gt.0.0d0)then
       write(io,'(a)') '$ Range Shifter'
       write(io,5001)32,dimRS(1),'x of Range Shifter size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)33,dimRS(2),'y of Range Shifter size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)34,dimRS(3),
     &      'Isocenter To Range Shifter Distance [cm]'
       write(io,5001)35,dimRS(5),'Range Shifter Thickness [cm]'
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* from BeamLimitingDeviceFLC.dat c36-48
      write(io,'(a)') '$ Beam Limiting Device FLC'
      write(io,5001)36,dimGT(3),'Beam Limiting Device Angle [deg]'
      if(iflagFLC)then
       write(io,'(a)') '$  FLC-X'
       write(io,5001)37,dimFLC(1),'Width of Device Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)38,dimFLC(3),'Length of Device Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)39,dimFLC(5),'Thickness of Device Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)40,dimFLC(7),
     &      'Isocenter To Beam Limiting Device Distance [cm]'
       write(io,5001)41,dimFLC(9),'Leaf Jaw Position 1 [cm]'
       write(io,5001)42,dimFLC(11),'Leaf Jaw Position 2 [cm]'
       write(io,'(a)') '$  FLC-Y'
       write(io,5001)43,dimFLC(2),'Width of Device Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)44,dimFLC(4),'Length of Device Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)45,dimFLC(6),'Thickness of Device Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)46,dimFLC(8),
     &      'Isocenter To Beam Limiting Device Distance [cm]'
       write(io,5001)47,dimFLC(10),'Leaf Jaw Position 1 [cm]'
       write(io,5001)48,dimFLC(12),'Leaf Jaw Position 2 [cm]'
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* from BeamLimitingDeviceMLC.dat c49-52
      write(io,'(a)') '$ Beam Limiting Device MLC'
      write(io,5001)49,dimMLC(1),'Leaf Length [cm]'
      write(io,5001)50,dimMLC(2),'Leaf Thickness'
      write(io,5001)51,dimMLC(3),
     &     'Isocenter To Beam Limiting Device Distance [cm]'
      write(io,5000)52,npairMLC,'Number Of Leaf Jaw Pairs'
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* from RangeCompensator.dat (Bolus) c53-64
      if(ndimRC(1).gt.0)then
       write(io,'(a)') '$ Range Compensator (Bolus)'
       write(io,5000)53,ndimRC(1),
     &      'Num. of Compensator Rows corresponding to y-axis'
       write(io,5000)54,ndimRC(2),
     &      'Num. of Compensator Columns corresponding to x-axis'
       write(io,5001)55,dimRC(1),'x of Compensator Pixel Spacing [cm]'
       write(io,5001)56,dimRC(2),'y of Compensator Pixel Spacing [cm]'
       write(io,5001)57,dimRC(3),'x of Compensator Position [cm]'
       write(io,5001)58,dimRC(4),'y of Compensator Position [cm]'
       write(io,5001)59,dimRC(5),'x of Compensator Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)60,dimRC(6),'y of Compensator Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)61,dimRC(7),
     &      'Isocenter To Compensator Tray Distance [cm]'
       write(io,5001)62,dimRC(8),'zmax of Compensator [cm]'
       write(io,5001)63,dimRC(9),'zmin of Compensator [cm]'
       write(io,5001)64,dimRC(10),'Compensator Thickness [cm]'
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* from Block.dat (Patient collimator) c65-69
      if(npointBL.gt.0)then
       write(io,'(a)') '$ Block (Patient collimator)'
       write(io,5000)65,npointBL,'Block Number Of Points'
       write(io,5001)66,dimBL(1),'x of Block Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)67,dimBL(2),'y of Block Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)68,dimBL(3),'z of Block Size [cm]'
       write(io,5001)69,dimBL(4),'Isocenter To Block Tray Distance [cm]'
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* from PatientSetup.dat c70-73
      write(io,'(a15)') '$ Patient Setup'
      write(io,5001)70,dimPS(1),
     &     'Vert, Table Top Vertical Setup Displacement [cm]'
      write(io,5001)71,dimPS(2),
     &     'Long, Table Top Longitudinal Setup Displacement [cm]'
      write(io,5001)72,dimPS(3),
     &     'Lat, Table Top Lateral Setup Displacement [cm]'
      write(io,5001)73,dimGT(4),
     &     'Patient Support Angle [deg]'

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEusrparamplan

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEsurfPlan(io,Cdir,Ctag,
     &     npointBL,ndimRC,iflagFLC,dimRS)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in):: io
      integer,intent(in):: npointBL,ndimRC(2)
      logical,intent(in):: iflagFLC
      real(8),intent(in):: dimRS(5)
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      integer :: iend

      iend=len_trim(Cdir)
      open(io,file=Cdir(1:iend)//'PLANsurf-'//Ctag//'.inp',
     &     status='unknown')
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Frames of gantry and Group of collimators'
      if(npointBL.gt.0)then
       if(dimRS(5).gt.0.0d0)then
        write(io,'(2a)')' 1002 rcc  0 0 -c69+1.1 0 0 ',
     &       '-(c34-c69+10.0)    50'
        if(iflagFLC)then
         write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c69+1.0 0 0 ',
     &        '-(c40+c39-c69+5.0) 40'
        else                    ! No FLC
         write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c69+1.0 0 0 ',
     &        '-(c51+c39-c69+5.0) 40'
        endif
       else                     ! No Range Shifter
        if(iflagFLC)then
         write(io,'(2a)')' 1002 rcc  0 0 -c69+1.1 0 0 ',
     &        '-(c40+c39-c69+10.0) 50'
         write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c69+1.0 0 0 ',
     &        '-(c40+c39-c69+5.0) 40'
        else                    ! No FLC
         write(io,'(2a)')' 1002 rcc  0 0 -c69+1.1 0 0 ',
     &        '-(c51+c50-c69+10.0) 50'
         write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c69+1.0 0 0 ',
     &        '-(c51+c50-c69+5.0) 40'
        endif
       endif
      else                      ! No Block
       if(ndimRC(1).gt.0)then
        if(dimRS(5).gt.0.0d0)then
         write(io,'(2a)')' 1002 rcc  0 0 -c61+1.1 0 0 ',
     &        '-(c34-c61+10.0)    50'
         if(iflagFLC)then
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c61+1.0 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c40+c39-c61+5.0) 40'
         else                   ! No FLC
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c61+1.0 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c51+c50-c61+5.0) 40'
         endif
        else
         if(iflagFLC)then
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1002 rcc  0 0 -c61+1.1 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c40+c39-c61+10.0) 50'
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c61+1.0 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c40+c39-c61+5.0) 40'
         else                   ! No FLC
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1002 rcc  0 0 -c61+1.1 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c51+c50-c61+10.0) 50'
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c61+1.0 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c51+c50-c61+5.0) 40'
         endif
        endif
       else ! No RangeCompensator
        if(dimRS(5).gt.0.0d0)then
         write(io,'(2a)')' 1002 rcc  0 0 -c51+1.1 0 0 ',
     &        '-(c34-c51+10.0)     50'
         if(iflagFLC)then
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c51+1.0 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c40+c39-c51+5.0) 40'
         else                   ! No FLC
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c51+1.0 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c51+c50-c51+5.0) 40'
         endif
        else
         if(iflagFLC)then
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1002 rcc  0 0 -c51+1.1 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c40+c39-c51+10.0) 50'
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c51+1.0 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c40+c39-c51+5.0) 40'
         else                   ! No FLC
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1002 rcc  0 0 -c51+1.1 0 0 ',
     &         '-(c51+c50-c51+10.0) 50'
          write(io,'(2a)')' 1003 rcc  0 0 -c51+1.0 0 0 ',

!----------------------------------------------------------------------

     &     npairMLC,npointBL,ndimRC,iflagFLC,dimRS)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use deviceproperty, only:SEARCHmatID
      implicit none

      logical,intent(in) :: iflagFLC

     &     status='unknown')

 5000 format(a,i4,1x,1p1e10.3,2x,a)
 5001 format(5x,2a)

      call SEARCHmatID(cmatID,matair,densair,ierr)
      write(io,5000)
     &     ' 1000', matair, -densair, '-99 #1001 #1002  $ Air'
      write(io,'(2a)')' 1001   0   -98 #1002 trcl=4000 fill=4000'
     &     ,'  $ Whole phantom'
      write(io,'(2a)')' 1002   0 -1002 fill=4001 trcl=4001  '
     &     ,'$ Gantry'
      write(io,'(a)')
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Universe 4000 (whole phantom)'
      write(io,'(a)')' 998   0    97 trcl=500 u=4000'
      write(io,'(a)')' 997   0   -97 trcl=500 fill=5000 u=4000'
      write(io,'(a)')
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* for Universe 4001 (Gantry)
      write(io,'(a)') '$ Universe 4001 (Gantry)'
      write(io,5000)
     &     ' 1003', matair, -densair, '-99  $ Air in universe 4001'
      if(dimRS(5).gt.0.0d0)write(io,5001)'#1999  $ Range Shifter'
      write(io,5001)'#2000  $ Group of collimators'
      write(io,5001)'u=4001'
      write(io,'(a)')
      if(dimRS(5).gt.0.0d0)then
       write(io,'(a)')'$ Range Shifter u=4001'
       write(io,'(3a)')' infl:{RScell-',Ctag,'.inp}'
       write(io,'(a)')
      endif
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Group of collimators'
      write(io,'(a)')' 2000 0 -1003 fill=4002 trcl=4002 u=4001 '
      write(io,'(a)')
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* for Universe 4002 (Group of collimators)
 5002 format(5x,10(i4,2x))
      write(io,'(a)') '$ Universe 4002 (Group of collimators)'
      write(io,5000)
     &     ' 2001', matair, -densair, '-99  $ Air in universe 4002'
      if(iflagFLC)then
       write(io,5001)'2002 2003 2004 2005 ',
     &      '$ Beam Limiting Device FLC and MLC (below)'
      else
       write(io,5001)'$ Beam Limiting Device MLC (below)'
      endif
      nline = (npairMLC*2)/10
      nmod = mod(npairMLC*2,10)
      do iline = 1,nline
         write(io,5002)(2005+(iline-1)*10+ileaf, ileaf=1,10)
      end do
      if (nmod .gt. 0) then
         write(io,5002)(2005+(iline-1)*10+ileaf, ileaf=1,nmod)
      end if

     &     '10000 $ Range Compensator (Bolus)'

       write(io,'(3a)')' infl:{FLCcell-',Ctag,'.inp}'
      endif

       write(io,'(a)')'$ Range Compensator (Bolus) u=4002'
