!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEbeamlimitingdevice(iflagFLC,npairMLC,Cdir,Ctag,
     &     cmatFLC,cmatMLC)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use deviceproperty, only:SEARCHmatID,bdataMLC,pdataMLC
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir,cmatFLC(2),cmatMLC
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      integer,intent(in) :: npairMLC
      logical,intent(in) :: iflagFLC
      integer,parameter :: io=21
      integer :: matID,i,iend,ierr
      real(8) :: density
      character(LEN=200) :: outfile
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* [surface]
      iend=len_trim(Cdir)
      if(iflagFLC)then
       outfile=Cdir(1:iend)//'FLCsurf-'//Ctag//'.inp'
       open(io,file=outfile,status='unknown')
       write(io,5000)2002,'rpp c41 c41+c38 -c37/2 c37/2 -c40-c39 -c40'
       write(io,5000)2003,'rpp c42-c38 c42 -c37/2 c37/2 -c40-c39 -c40'
       write(io,5000)2004,'rpp -c43/2 c43/2 c47-c44 c47 -c46-c45 -c46'
       write(io,5000)2005,'rpp -c43/2 c43/2 c48 c48+c44 -c46-c45 -c46'
       close(io)
      endif
      outfile=Cdir(1:iend)//'MLCsurf-'//Ctag//'.inp'
      open(io,file=outfile,status='unknown')
      do i=1,npairMLC*2
       if(i.le.npairMLC) then
        write(io,5000)2005+i,'rpp',pdataMLC(i),pdataMLC(i),'+c49',
     &       bdataMLC(i), bdataMLC(i+1),'-c51-c50 -c51'
       else
        write(io,5001)2005+i,'rpp',pdataMLC(i),'-c49', pdataMLC(i),
     &       bdataMLC(i-npairMLC),bdataMLC(i+1-npairMLC),'-c51-c50 -c51'
       end if
      end do
 5000 format(i6,2x,a,2x,2f11.4,a,2x,2f11.4,2x,a)
 5001 format(i6,2x,a,2x, f11.4,a,2x,3f11.4,2x,a)
      close(io)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* [cell]
      if(iflagFLC)then
       outfile=Cdir(1:iend)//'FLCcell-'//Ctag//'.inp'
       open(io,file=outfile,status='unknown')
       call SEARCHmatID(cmatFLC(1),matID,density,ierr)
       write(io,5002)2002,matID,-density,'-2002 u=4002'
       write(io,5002)2003,matID,-density,'-2003 u=4002'
       call SEARCHmatID(cmatFLC(2),matID,density,ierr)
       write(io,5002)2004,matID,-density,'-2004 u=4002'
       write(io,5002)2005,matID,-density,'-2005 u=4002'
       close(io)
      endif
      outfile=Cdir(1:iend)//'MLCcell-'//Ctag//'.inp'
      open(io,file=outfile,status='unknown')
      call SEARCHmatID(cmatMLC,matID,density,ierr)
      do i=1,npairMLC*2
       write(io,5003)2005+i,matID,-density,-(2005+i)," u=4002"
      end do
 5002 format(i6,2x,i3,2x,f10.5,2x,a)
 5003 format(i6,2x,i3,2x,f10.5,2x,i5,2x,a)
      close(io)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      return
      end subroutine CREATEbeamlimitingdevice

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATErangecompensator(ndimRC,Cdir,Ctag,cmatRC,dimRC)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use deviceproperty, only:SEARCHmatID,hdataRC
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir,cmatRC
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      integer,intent(in) :: ndimRC(2)
      real(8),intent(in) :: dimRC(10)
      integer,parameter :: io=21
      integer :: i,j,matID,iend,matair,ierr
      integer :: nsurf,ncell,nstx,nsty,nstz,nendx,nendy,nendz
      real(8) :: density,zp,densair
      character(LEN=200) :: outfile,cmatID
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      nstx=10001
      nsty=11001
      nstz=12000
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* [surface]
      iend=len_trim(Cdir)
      outfile=Cdir(1:iend)//'RCsurf-'//Ctag//'.inp'
      open(io,file=outfile,status='unknown')
 5000 format(i6,2x,a,i0)
      nsurf=nstx-1
      write(io,'(i6,2x,a)')
     &     nsurf,'rpp -c59/2 c59/2 -c60/2 c60/2 c63 c62'
      do i=1,ndimRC(2)+1
       nsurf=nsurf+1
       write(io,5000)nsurf,'px  c57+c55/2-c55*',i-1
      enddo
      nendx=nsurf
      nsurf=nsty-1
      do j=1,ndimRC(1)+1
       nsurf=nsurf+1
       write(io,5000)nsurf,'py  c58+c56/2-c56*',j-1
      enddo
 5001 format(i6,2x,a,f0.5)
      nendy=nsurf
      nsurf=nstz
      write(io,5001)nsurf,'pz  c62'
      do j = 1,ndimRC(1)
       do i = 1,ndimRC(2)
        nsurf=nsurf+1
        zp=dimRC(9)-hdataRC(i,j)
        if(dabs(zp-dimRC(10)).gt.1d-4)then
         write(io,5001)nsurf,'pz  c62-',hdataRC(i,j)
        endif
       enddo
      enddo
      nendz=nsurf+1
      write(io,5001)nendz,'pz  c63'
      close(io)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* [cell]
      outfile=Cdir(1:iend)//'RCcell-'//Ctag//'.inp'
      ncell=10000
      open(io,file=outfile,status='unknown')
      call SEARCHmatID(cmatRC,matID,density,ierr)
 5002 format(i6,2x,i3,2x,f10.5,2x,i6)
      write(io,5002) ncell,matID,-density,-ncell
      write(io,'(5x,a,6(2x,i6),a)') "#(",
     &     -nstx,nendx,-nsty,nendy,-nstz,nendz, ") u=4002"
      cmatID = 'air '
      call SEARCHmatID(cmatID,matair,densair,ierr)
 5003 format(i6,2x,i3,2x,f10.5,6(2x,i6),2x,a)
      do j=1,ndimRC(1)
       do i=1,ndimRC(2)
        ncell=ncell+1
        zp=dimRC(9)-hdataRC(i,j)
        if(dabs(zp-dimRC(10)).lt.1d-4)then
         write(io,5003)ncell,matID,-density,-(nstx-1+i),nstx+i,
     &        -(nsty-1+j),nsty+j,-nstz,nendz,
     &        " u=4002"
        else
         write(io,5003)ncell,matID,-density,-(nstx-1+i),nstx+i,
     &        -(nsty-1+j),nsty+j,-nstz,nstz+i+ndimRC(2)*(j-1),
     &        " u=4002"
        end if
       end do
      end do
      do j=1,ndimRC(1)
       do i=1,ndimRC(2)
        zp=dimRC(9)-hdataRC(i,j)
        if(dabs(zp-dimRC(10)).ge.1d-4)then
         ncell = ncell + 1
         write(io,5003) ncell,matair,-densair,-(nstx-1+i),nstx+i,
     &        -(nsty-1+j),nsty+j,-(nstz+i+ndimRC(2)*(j-1)),nendz,
     &        " u=4002"
        end if
       end do
      end do
      close(io)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      return
      end subroutine CREATErangecompensator

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEblock(npointBL,Cdir,Ctag,cmatBL)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use deviceproperty, only:SEARCHmatID,xdataBL,ydataBL
      use surflist
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: npointBL
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: cmatBL,Cdir
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      integer,parameter :: io=21,ioc=22,nlimit=900
      integer :: nsurf,ncell,n,i,j,k,l,ip,iloop,is,isurf
      integer :: matair,matID,nline,nmod,iend,ist,ierr
      real(8) :: density,densityair
      real(8) :: ax,bx,cx,dx,ay,by,cy,dy
      character(LEN=200) cmatID,outfile1,outfile2
      logical iflag
      real(8),allocatable:: xdata(:),ydata(:)
      real(8) :: vec1x,vec1y,vec2x,vec2y,ang

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      nsurf = 7000
      ncell = 7000
      n=npointBL
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      ! Check clockwise or counterclockwise
      allocate( xdata(n),ydata(n) )
      ax=xdataBL(n-2)
      ay=ydataBL(n-2)
      bx=xdataBL(n-1)
      by=ydataBL(n-1)
      ang=0.0d0
      do i=1,n-1
       cx=xdataBL(i)
       cy=ydataBL(i)
       vec1x=bx-ax
       vec1y=by-ay
       vec2x=cx-bx
       vec2y=cy-by
       ang=ang+asin((vec1x*vec2y-vec2x*vec1y)
     &      /sqrt(vec1x**2+vec1y**2)
     &      /sqrt(vec2x**2+vec2y**2))
       ax=bx
       ay=by
       bx=cx
       by=cy
      enddo
      if(ang.gt.0.0d0)then ! Clockwise
       do i=1,n
        xdata(i)=xdataBL(i)
        ydata(i)=ydataBL(i)
       enddo
      else                 ! CounterClockwise
       do i=1,n
        xdata(i)=xdataBL(n-i+1)
        ydata(i)=ydataBL(n-i+1)
       enddo
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* [surface] & [cell]
      iend=len_trim(Cdir)
      outfile1=Cdir(1:iend)//'BLsurf-'//Ctag//'.inp'
      outfile2=Cdir(1:iend)//'BLcell-'//Ctag//'.inp'
      open(io,file=outfile1,status='unknown')
      open(ioc,file=outfile2,status='unknown')
 5000 format(i6,2x,a,4(2x,f10.5))
 5001 format(i6,2x,i3,2x,f10.5,2x,a)
 5002 format(5x,'(',i6,2x,i6,2x,i6,2x,i6'):')
      write(io,5000)nsurf,'rpp -c66/2 c66/2 -c67/2 c67/2 -c69-c68 -c69'
      call SEARCHmatID(cmatBL,matID,density,ierr)
      write(ioc,5001)ncell,matID,-density,'-7000 #7001 u=4002'
      cmatID='air '
      call SEARCHmatID(cmatID,matair,densityair,ierr)
      write(ioc,5001)ncell+1,matair,-densityair,'-7000'
      call ALLOCATEsurflist(n)
      call INITsurflist(n)
      bx=xdata(n-1)
      by=ydata(n-1)
      j=n-1
      k=1
      ist=1
      do iloop=1,nlimit
       cx=xdata(k)
       cy=ydata(k)
       l=k+1
       if(l.ge.n)l=1
       do ip=1,n
        if(ipflag(l))exit
        l=l+1
        if(l.ge.n)l=1
       enddo
       if(ip.gt.n)exit
       dx=xdata(l)
       dy=ydata(l)
       if((cx-bx)*(dy-cy)-(cy-by)*(dx-cx).le.0.0d0)then
        i=j-1
        if(i.lt.1)i=n-1
        do ip=1,n
         if(ipflag(i))exit
         i=i-1
         if(i.lt.1)i=n-1
        enddo
        if(ip.gt.n)exit
        ax=xdata(i)
        ay=ydata(i)
        if((bx-ax)*(cy-by)-(by-ay)*(cx-bx).le.0.0d0)then
          bx=cx
          by=cy
          j=k
          k=l
        else
         call CHECKinterloop(xdata,ydata,i,k,n,iflag)
         if(iflag)then
          bx=cx
          by=cy
          j=k
          k=l
         else
          call CHECKsurflist(i,k,isurf)
          if(isurf.eq.0)then
           nsurf=nsurf+1
           write(io,5000)nsurf,'p',-(cy-ay),(cx-ax),0.0,(cx*ay-cy*ax)
           call REGISTERsurflist(i,k,nsurf)
           jslist(3)=nsurf
          else
           jslist(3)=-isurf
          endif
          ipflag(j)=.false.
          call CHECKsurflist(i,j,isurf)
          if(isurf.eq.0)then
           nsurf=nsurf+1
           write(io,5000)nsurf,'p',-(ay-by),(ax-bx),0.0,(ax*by-ay*bx)
           call REGISTERsurflist(i,j,nsurf)
           jslist(1)=nsurf
          else
           jslist(1)=-isurf
          endif
          call CHECKsurflist(j,k,isurf)
          if(isurf.eq.0)then
           nsurf=nsurf+1
           write(io,5000)nsurf,'p',-(by-cy),(bx-cx),0.0,(bx*cy-by*cx)
           call REGISTERsurflist(j,k,nsurf)
           jslist(2)=nsurf
          else
           jslist(2)=-isurf
          endif
          write(ioc,5002)(-jslist(is),is=1,3),-7000
          bx=ax
          by=ay
          j=i
         endif
        endif
        ist=k
        cycle
       endif
       bx=cx
       by=cy
       j=k
       k=l
       if(k.eq.ist)exit
      enddo
      if(iloop.ge.nlimit.or.ip.gt.n)then
       write(*,*)'Error: Fail to set block'
       write(*,*)'npointBL=',npointBL
       write(*,*)'iloop=',iloop,'ip=',ip
       do i=1,n-1
        if(ipflag(i))then
         write(*,*)i,xdata(i),ydata(i)
        endif
       enddo
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      k=0
      i=n-1
      do ip=i,n
       if(ipflag(i))exit
       i=i-1
      enddo
      ax=xdata(i)
      ay=ydata(i)
      do j=1,n-1
       if(.not.ipflag(j))cycle
       bx=xdata(j)
       by=ydata(j)
       call CHECKsurflist(i,j,isurf)
       k=k+1
       if(isurf.eq.0)then
        nsurf=nsurf+1
        write(io,5000)nsurf,'p',-(ay-by),(ax-bx),0.0,(ax*by-ay*bx)
        call REGISTERsurflist(i,j,nsurf)
        jslist(k)=nsurf
       else
        jslist(k)=-isurf
       endif
       i=j
       ax=bx
       ay=by
      enddo
      nline=k/5
      nmod=mod(k,5)
      write(ioc,'(5x,a)')'('
 5003 format(5x,5(i5,2x))
      do i=1,nline
       write(ioc,5003)(-jslist((i-1)*5+is),is=1,5)
      enddo
      if(nmod.gt.1)then
       write(ioc,5003)(-jslist(nline*5+is),is=1,nmod)
      endif
      write(ioc,'(5x,a)')'-7000 ) u=4002'
      call DEALLOCATEsurflist
      close(io)
      close(ioc)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      return
      end subroutine CREATEblock

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CHECKinterloop(xdata,ydata,i,k,n,iflag)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use surflist
      implicit none
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdata(n),ydata(n)
      integer,intent(in) :: i,k,n
      logical,intent(out) :: iflag
      integer :: j,j0
      real(8) :: ax,ay,bx,by,cx,cy,dx,dy

      cx=xdata(i)
      cy=ydata(i)
      dx=xdata(k)
      dy=ydata(k)
      iflag=.false.
      j0=0
      do j=k+1,n-1
       if(ipflag(j))then
        if(j0.gt.0)then
         bx=xdata(j)
         by=ydata(j)
         call CHECKinter(ax,ay,bx,by,cx,cy,dx,dy,iflag)
         if(iflag)exit
         ax=bx
         ay=by
         j0=j
        else
         j0=j
         ax=xdata(j)
         ay=ydata(j)
        endif
       endif
      enddo
      if(.not.iflag)then
       do j=1,i-1
        if(ipflag(j))then
         if(j0.gt.0)then
          bx=xdata(j)
          by=ydata(j)
          call CHECKinter(ax,ay,bx,by,cx,cy,dx,dy,iflag)
          if(iflag)exit
          ax=bx
          ay=by
          j0=j
         else
          j0=j
          ax=xdata(j)
          ay=ydata(j)
         endif
        endif
       enddo
      endif
      return
      end subroutine CHECKinterloop

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CHECKinter(ax,ay,bx,by,cx,cy,dx,dy,iflag)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      real(8),intent(in) :: ax,ay,bx,by,cx,cy,dx,dy
      logical,intent(out) :: iflag
      if(ax.ge.bx)then
       if((ax.lt.cx.and.ax.lt.dx).or.(bx.gt.cx.and.bx.gt.dx))then
        iflag=.false.
        return
       endif
      else
       if((bx.lt.cx.and.bx.lt.dx).or.(ax.gt.cx.and.ax.gt.dx))then
        iflag=.false.
        return
       endif
      endif
      if(ay.ge.by)then
       if((ay.lt.cy.and.ay.lt.dy).or.(by.gt.cy.and.by.gt.dy))then
        iflag=.false.
        return
       endif
      else
       if((by.lt.cy.and.by.lt.dy).or.(ay.gt.cy.and.ay.gt.dy))then
        iflag=.false.
        return
       endif
      endif
      if(((ax-bx)*(cy-ay)+(ay-by)*(ax-cx))*
     &     ((ax-bx)*(dy-ay)+(ay-by)*(ax-dx)).gt.0.0d0)then
       iflag=.false.
       return
      endif
      if(((cx-dx)*(ay-cy)+(cy-dy)*(cx-ax))*
     &     ((cx-dx)*(by-cy)+(cy-dy)*(dx-bx)).gt.0.0d0)then
       iflag=.false.
       return
      endif
      iflag=.true.
      return
      end subroutine CHECKinter

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEmatelems(Cdir)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use deviceproperty
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: imat,iline,iend
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      iend=len_trim(Cdir)
      open(io,file=Cdir(1:iend)//'PLANmaterial.inp',
     &     status='unknown')
      do imat=1,nmatmax
       if(imatflag(imat))then
        do iline=ielemst(imat),ielemst(imat+1)-1
         iend=len_trim(celemlines(iline))
         write(io,'(a)')celemlines(iline)(1:iend)
        enddo
       endif
      enddo
      close(io)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      iend=len_trim(Cdir)
      open(io,file=Cdir(1:iend)//'PLANmatnamecolor.inp',
     &     status='unknown')
      do imat=1,nmatmax
       if(imatflag(imat))then
        iline=ielemst(imat)+1
        iend=index(celemlines(iline),' ')-1
        write(io,'(a,2x,a8,2x,a)')celemlines(iline)(1:iend),
     &       trim(cname(imat)),trim(ccolor(imat))
       endif
      enddo
      close(io)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      return
      end subroutine CREATEmatelems

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEtransPlan(Cdir,Ctag)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: iend
      iend=len_trim(Cdir)
      open(io,file=Cdir(1:iend)//'PLANtrans-'//Ctag//'.inp',
     &     status='unknown')
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* for Patient Setup (tr4000)
 5000 format('set: c',i2,'[',a,'] $ ',a)
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Transform for Patient Setup'
      write(io,5000)75,'c73/180.0*pi','Patient Support Angle [rad]'
      write(io,5000)76,'sin(c75)','sin'
      write(io,5000)77,'cos(c75)','cos'
      write(io,'(a)')' tr4000 -c72 c70 -c71'
      write(io,'(a)')'        -c77 -c76 0 0 0 1 -c76 c77 0'
      write(io,'(a)')'        -1'
      write(io,'(a)')
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* for Gantry Angle (tr4001)
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Transform for Gantry angle'

      write(io,*)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* for Beam Limiting Device Angle (tr4002)
      write(io,'(a)')'$ Transform for Beam Limiting Device Angle'
      write(io,'(a)')'*tr4002 0 0 0 -c36 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 2'
      write(io,*)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      close(io)

      end subroutine CREATEtransPlan

      end module createplan

FILE: src/createroimod.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
      module createroi
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer :: nROI,nbankROI
      integer,allocatable :: idROI(:)
      integer,allocatable :: ivolROI(:)
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine INIT_idROI
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      nbankROI=10
      allocate( idROI(nbankROI),ivolROI(nbankROI) )
      nROI=0
      return
      end subroutine INIT_idROI

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine FIN_idROI
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      deallocate( idROI,ivolROI )
      return
      end subroutine FIN_idROI

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEroiinfo(Cinter,dV)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      real(8),intent(in) :: dV
      integer :: Ninter
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: i,j,ii,imin,itmp,itmp2
      integer,allocatable :: ia(:),iorder(:)

!-----Sorting
      allocate( ia(nROI),iorder(nROI) )
      ia(1:nROI)=idROI(1:nROI)
      do i=1,nROI
       iorder(i)=i
      enddo
      do i=1,nROI
       imin=99999999
       do j=i,nROI
        if(ia(j).lt.imin)then
         imin=ia(j)
         ii=j
         itmp=ia(i)
         itmp2=iorder(i)
         ia(i)=ia(ii)
         iorder(i)=iorder(ii)
         ia(ii)=itmp
         iorder(ii)=itmp2
        endif
       enddo
      enddo
!-----
      Ninter=len_trim(Cinter)-1
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:Ninter)//'roiinfo.dat',status='unknown')
      write(io,'(i5)')1
      write(io,'(i5)')nROI
      do i=1,nROI
       write(io,'(i5,1x,f15.8)')idROI(iorder(i)),dV*ivolROI(iorder(i))
      enddo
      close(io)
      deallocate( ia,iorder )
      return
      end subroutine CREATEroiinfo

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEfillROI(Cinput,ixnum,iynum,iznum,mat)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      integer,intent(in) :: mat(ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinput
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: ix,iy,iz,i,ii,Ninput
      logical,parameter :: icompvoxel=.true.
      integer :: latot,latot2
      integer,allocatable :: lattmp(:),lattmp2(:)

      Ninput=len_trim(Cinput)-1
      open(io,file=Cinput(1:Ninput)//'ROIvoxel.inp',status='unknown')
      if(.not.icompvoxel)then
       do iz=1,iznum
        do iy=1,iynum
         do i=1,ixnum,10
          ii=min(i+9,ixnum)
          write(io,'(6x,10(x,I4))')(mat(ix,iy,iz),ix=i,ii)
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
       close(io)
      else
       latot=ixnum*iynum*iznum
       allocate(lattmp(latot),lattmp2(latot))
       do iz=1,iznum
        do iy=1,iynum
         do ix=1,ixnum
          lattmp(ix+(iy-1)*ixnum+(iz-1)*ixnum*iynum)=mat(ix,iy,iz)
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
       call latencode(latot,lattmp,latot2,lattmp2)
       do i=1,latot2,10
        ii=min(i+9,latot2)
        write(io,'(6x,10(x,I10))')(lattmp2(ix),ix=i,ii)
       enddo
       deallocate(lattmp,lattmp2)
      endif
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEfillROI

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine latencode(latot,lattmp,latot2,lattmp2)
*       encode voxel elements; lattmp, to compressed format; lattmp2
*       copy from PHITS source
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: latot,lattmp(latot)
      integer,intent(out) :: latot2,lattmp2(latot)
      integer i,icount,jcount
      integer latold
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      latold=lattmp(1)
      lattmp2(1)=lattmp(1)
      icount=0
      jcount=1
      do i=2,latot
       if(lattmp(i).eq.latold)then
        icount=icount+1
       else
        if(icount.gt.0)then
         jcount=jcount+1
         lattmp2(jcount)=-icount
        endif
        jcount=jcount+1
        lattmp2(jcount)=lattmp(i)
        latold=lattmp(i)
        icount=0
       endif
      enddo
      if(icount.gt.0)then
       jcount=jcount+1
       lattmp2(jcount)=-icount
      endif
      latot2=jcount
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      return
      end subroutine latencode
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      end module createroi
END_FILE

FILE: src/ct2phits.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
*     PROGRAM ct2phits (renamed from dicom2phits since 2021/03)     *
*                                                                   *
*         Created by T. Furuta on 2013/09/05                        *
*             Under collaboration between JAEA and RIKEN            *
*                                                                   *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  C filess; "dicomlib.c", "utillib.c", "interface.c",              *
*  OS dependent C files; "winlib.c" or "nonwinlib.c",               *
*  FORTRAN files; "stdmod.f", "readctmod.f", "tablemod.f",          *
*                 "createctmod.f" are required                      *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                                                                   *
*     Purpose                                                       *
*         Convert DICOM CT data to PHITS geometry input             *
*     Required files and a directry for run                         *
*         Conversion table file                                     *
*         DICOM CT file directory                                   *
*     Outputs                                                       *
*       DAT files                                                   *
*         Setting info (phantominfo.dat)                            *
*       Include files for PHITS input                               *
*         Cell info (CTcell.dat)                                    *
*         Surface info (CTsurf.dat)                                 *
*         Voxel info (CTvoxel.dat)                                  *
*         Transformation info (CTtrans.dat)                         *
*         Universe info (CTuniverse.dat)                            *
*         Material info (CTmaterial.dat)                            *
*         Material color info (CTmatnamecolor.dat)                  *
*         User defined parameter info (CTusrparam.dat)              *
*                                                                   *
*         Last modified by T. Furuta on 2022/03/20                  *
*********************************************************************
      PROGRAM ct2phits ! Main program
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout
      use readtable, only:READhvtable
      use readct, only:READctinputs,READheader,READfilenames,
     &     READdirectory,ALLOCATEfilenames,DEALLOCATEfilenames,
     &     ALLOCATEzloc,DEALLOCATEzloc
      use createct, only:CREATEctinp,CREATEfill,CREATEphantominfo
      implicit none
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      real,parameter :: version=5.00
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      integer :: nxnum,nynum,nznum
      integer :: nxc,nyc,nzc
      integer :: ixmin0,ixmax0,iymin0,iymax0,izmin0,izmax0
      integer :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ixnum0,iynum0,iznum0
      integer :: izmin,izmax
      integer :: izstep,iorg,icolor
      integer :: nlist
      integer,allocatable :: mat(:,:,:),zlist(:)
      real(8) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      real(8) :: xorg,yorg,zorg
      real(8) :: xsh(3),xvec(3),yvec(3),zvec(3)
      real(8) :: xdel0,ydel0,zdel0
      character(LEN=200) :: Cconvtable,Cinter
      logical :: cgflag

      call DSPheader(version)

      call READctinputs(ixmin0,ixmax0,iymin0,iymax0,izmin0,izmax0,
     &     nxc,nyc,nzc,izstep,iorg,icolor,Cconvtable,Cinter)
      ixnum0=ixmax0-ixmin0+1
      iynum0=iymax0-iymin0+1
      iznum0=izmax0-izmin0+1

      call READhvtable(Cconvtable)

      call READdirectory(izmax0,nlist)
      nznum=nlist

      call ALLOCATEfilenames(nlist)
      call ALLOCATEzloc(nlist)

      call READfilenames(nlist)

      allocate(zlist(nznum))
      call SETzlist(izmin0,nznum,zlist)

      call READheader(izmin0,izmin0+1,nxnum,nynum,xdel0,ydel0,zdel0,
     &     xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec)

      call SETcoarse(nxc,nyc,nzc,
     &     ixnum0,iynum0,iznum0,ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     xdel0,ydel0,zdel0,xdel,ydel,zdel,cgflag)

      call SETzdirec(izstep,iorg,iznum0,izmin,izmax,zdel)

      allocate( mat(ixnum,iynum,iznum) )
      mat(:,:,:)=0
      call READCONV(ixmin0,iymin0,ixnum0,iynum0,izmin,izmax,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,nxc,nyc,nzc,izstep,nxnum,nynum,
     &     nznum,zlist,mat)
      call CREATEfill(Cinter,ixnum,iynum,iznum,mat)
      deallocate( mat,zlist)

      call DEALLOCATEfilenames
      call DEALLOCATEzloc

      xorg=(ixmin0-1.5d0)*xdel0
      yorg=(iymin0-1.5d0)*ydel0
      zorg=-0.5d0*zdel0

      call CREATEctinp(Cinter,iorg,icolor,
     &     ixmin0,iymin0,izmin0,ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec)

      call CREATEphantominfo(Cinter,Cconvtable,
     &     iorg,icolor,ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     ixmin0,ixmax0,iymin0,iymax0,izmin0,izmax0,nxc,nyc,nzc,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec)

      call DSPparam(nxnum,nynum,nznum,xdel0,ydel0,zdel0,'ORIGINAL')

      call DSPparam(ixnum0,iynum0,iznum0,xdel0,ydel0,zdel0,'CLIPPED ')

      if(cgflag)then
         call DSPmessageCG
         call DSPparam(ixnum,iynum,iznum,xdel,ydel,zdel,'COASED  ')
      endif

      write(istdout,'(2a)')'***************************',
     &     '******************************************'
      write(istdout,*)' CT2PHITS successfully FINISHED !!'

      stop
      end

*********************************************************************
      subroutine SETzlist(izmin0,nznum,zlist)
*********************************************************************
      use readct, only:Cfilenames,zloc
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: izmin0,nznum
      integer,intent(out) :: zlist(nznum)
      integer :: iz,iz0,izmax0
      character(200) Ctmp
      real(8) ztmp

      do iz=1,nznum-1
        do iz0=iz,nznum
          if(zloc(iz0)<zloc(iz))then
            Ctmp=Cfilenames(iz)
            Cfilenames(iz)=Cfilenames(iz0)
            Cfilenames(iz0)=Ctmp
            ztmp=zloc(iz)
            zloc(iz)=zloc(iz0)
            zloc(iz0)=ztmp
          endif
        enddo
      enddo
      izmax0=izmin0+nznum-1
      iz=0
      do iz0=izmin0,izmax0
        iz=iz+1
        zlist(iz)=iz0
      enddo

      return
      end subroutine SETzlist

*********************************************************************
      subroutine SETcoarse(nxc,nyc,nzc,
     &     ixnum0,iynum0,iznum0,ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     xdel0,ydel0,zdel0,xdel,ydel,zdel,cgflag)
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nxc,nyc,nzc
      integer,intent(inout) :: ixnum0,iynum0,iznum0
      integer,intent(out) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      real(8),intent(inout) :: xdel0,ydel0,zdel0
      real(8),intent(out) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      logical,intent(out) :: cgflag
      if(nxc.gt.ixnum0)then
        write(istdout,'(a)')' ERROR: nxc is greter than PIXEL rows'
        write(istdout,'(a,i5,a,i5)')' nxc= ',nxc,'  nxnum=',ixnum0
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      if(nyc.gt.iynum0)then
        write(istdout,'(a)')' ERROR: nyc is greter than PIXEL columns'
        write(istdout,'(a,i5,a,i5)')' nyc= ',nyc,'  nynum=',iynum0
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      if(nzc.gt.iznum0)then
       write(istdout,'(a)')' ERROR: nzc is greter than # of DICOM files'
        write(istdout,'(a,i5,a,i5)')' nzc= ',nzc,'  nznum=',iznum0
        call exit(-1)
      endif

      if(nxc.ne.1.or.nyc.ne.1.or.nzc.ne.1)then
         cgflag=.true.
      else
         cgflag=.false.
      endif
      ixnum=ixnum0/nxc
      ixnum0=ixnum*nxc
      xdel=xdel0*nxc
      iynum=iynum0/nyc
      iynum0=iynum*nxc
      ydel=ydel0*nyc
      iznum=iznum0/nzc
      iznum0=iznum*nzc
      zdel=zdel0*nzc
      return
      end subroutine SETcoarse
*********************************************************************
      subroutine SETzdirec(izstep,iorg,iznum,izmin,izmax,zdel)
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(inout) :: izstep
      integer,intent(in) :: iznum,iorg
      integer,intent(out) :: izmin,izmax
      real(8),intent(inout) :: zdel

      if(iorg.eq.0)then
        if(zdel.lt.0.0d0)then
         write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &        '**************************************************',
     &        '*******************'
          write(istdout,*)
     &        ' CAUTION: DICOM param SpacingBetweenSlices was set minus'
          write(istdout,*)
     &         ' CAUTION: Z direction is reversed'
          write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &         '**************************************************',
     &         '*******************'
          izstep=izstep*(-1)
          zdel=abs(zdel)
        endif
        if(izstep.eq.1)then
          izmin=1
          izmax=iznum
        elseif(izstep.eq.-1)then
         write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &        '**************************************************',
     &        '*******************'
          write(istdout,*)
     &        ' CAUTION: z direction set in descending order',
     &        ' of the slice number'
          write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &         '**************************************************',
     &         '*******************'
          izmin=iznum
          izmax=1
        else
          write(istdout,*)
     &         ' ERROR: Z direction should be +1 or -1 :: ',izstep
          call exit(-1)
        endif
      else
        izstep=1
        izmin=1
        izmax=iznum
      endif
      return
      end subroutine SETzdirec
*********************************************************************
      subroutine READCONV(ixmin0,iymin0,ixnum0,iynum0,izmin,izmax,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,nxc,nyc,nzc,izstep,nxnum,nynum,
     &     nznum,zlist,mat)
*     RescaleIntercept
*     RescaleSlope
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      use readtable, only:CT2mat
      use readct, only:SETreadfile,Cpath,Cfilenames,Nfile
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: ixmin0,iymin0
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum0,iynum0
      integer,intent(in) :: izmin,izmax
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,izstep
      integer,intent(in) :: nxnum,nynum,nxc,nyc,nzc
      integer,intent(in) :: nznum,zlist(nznum)
      integer,intent(out) :: mat(ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      integer :: ixmax0,iymax0
      integer :: i,ix,iy,iz,iz0,matnum
      integer :: k,ntot
      logical :: Flow=.false.,Fup=.false.
      real(8) :: CTmin,CTmax
      real(8),allocatable:: hudata(:)
      real(8),allocatable:: hutmp(:,:)

      ixmax0=ixmin0+ixnum0-1
      iymax0=iymin0+iynum0-1

      if(ixmax0.gt.nxnum)then
        write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' ERROR: Nxmax should be <= ',nxnum
        call exit(-1)
      elseif(iymax0.gt.nynum)then
        write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' ERROR: Nymax should be <= ',nynum
        call exit(-1)
      endif

      ntot=nxnum*nynum
      allocate( hudata(nxnum*nynum),hutmp(ixnum,iynum) )
      hutmp(:,:)=0.0d0

      iz=0
      do i=izmin,izmax,izstep
        iz0=zlist(i)
        write(*,'(2a)')' Loading file = ',Cfilenames(iz0)(1:Nfile)
        call SETreadfile(iz0)
        call c_get_data(hudata,ntot,Cpath)

        do iy=1,nynum
          do ix=1,nxnum
            k=(iy-1)*nxnum+ix
            if(ix.ge.ixmin0.and.ix.le.ixmax0.and.
     &           iy.ge.iymin0.and.iy.le.iymax0)then
              hutmp((ix-ixmin0)/nxc+1,(iy-iymin0)/nyc+1)
     &             =hutmp((ix-ixmin0)/nxc+1,(iy-iymin0)/nyc+1)
     &             +hudata(k)/dble(nxc*nyc*nzc)
            endif
          enddo
        enddo
        if(mod(izstep*(i-izmin)+1,nzc).eq.0)then
          iz=iz+1
          do iy=1,iynum
            do ix=1,ixnum
              call CT2mat(hutmp(ix,iy),matnum,Flow,Fup,CTmin,CTmax)
              mat(ix,iy,iz) = matnum+5000
              hutmp(ix,iy)=0.0d0
            enddo
          enddo
        endif
      enddo

      deallocate( hudata,hutmp )

      if(Flow)then
        write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &       '**************************************************',
     &       '*******************'
        write(istdout,'(a)')
     &       ' WARNING: CT value lower than defined exists'
        write(istdout,'(a)')
     &       '     First universe is used for such a voxel'
        write(istdout,'(a,f10.2)')
     &       '           Lowest CT value =',CTmin
        write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &       '**************************************************',
     &       '*******************'
      endif
      if(Fup)then
        write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &       '**************************************************',
     &       '*******************'
        write(istdout,'(a)')
     &       ' WARNING: CT value higher than defined exists'
        write(istdout,'(a)')
     &       '     Last universe is used for such a voxel'
        write(istdout,'(a,f10.2)')
     &       '           Highest CT value =',CTmax
        write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &       '**************************************************',
     &       '*******************'
      endif
      return
      end subroutine READCONV

*********************************************************************
      subroutine DSPparam(nxnum,nynum,nznum,xdel,ydel,zdel,tag)
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nxnum,nynum,nznum
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      character(8),intent(in) :: tag

      write(istdout,'(3a)')'--------',tag,'--------'
      write(istdout,'(a,i5,a,i5,a,i5)')
     &     ' nx=',nxnum,' ny=',nynum,' nz=',nznum
      write(istdout,'(a,f12.5,a,f12.5,a,f12.5)')
     &     ' x=',xdel*nxnum,' y=',ydel*nynum,' z=',zdel*nznum
      return
      end subroutine DSPparam

*********************************************************************
      module deviceproperty
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer :: nmatmax,nelemmax
      integer,allocatable :: matnum(:),ielemst(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: densmat(:)
      character(LEN=200),allocatable :: cmatname(:),celemlines(:)
      character(LEN=200),allocatable :: cname(:),ccolor(:)
      logical,allocatable :: imatflag(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: bdataMLC(:),pdataMLC(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: hdataRC(:,:)
      real(8),allocatable :: xdataBL(:),ydatabL(:)
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine ALLOCATEmaterial
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      allocate(matnum(nmatmax),densmat(nmatmax))
      allocate(cmatname(nmatmax),celemlines(nelemmax))
      allocate(cname(nmatmax),ccolor(nmatmax))
      allocate(imatflag(nmatmax),ielemst(nmatmax+1))
      return
      end subroutine ALLOCATEmaterial
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine DEALLOCATEmaterial
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      deallocate(matnum,densmat,cmatname,celemlines,cname,ccolor)
      return
      end subroutine DEALLOCATEmaterial
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine ALLOCATEmultileaf(npairMLC)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: npairMLC
      allocate(bdataMLC(npairMLC+1),pdataMLC(npairMLC*2))
      return
      end subroutine ALLOCATEmultileaf
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine DEALLOCATEmultileaf
      implicit none
      deallocate(bdataMLC,pdataMLC)
      return
      end subroutine DEALLOCATEmultileaf
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine ALLOCATErangecompensator(ndimRC)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: ndimRC(2)
      allocate(hdataRC(ndimRC(2),ndimRC(1)))
      return
      end subroutine ALLOCATErangecompensator
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine DEALLOCATErangecompensator
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      deallocate(hdataRC)
      return
      end subroutine DEALLOCATErangecompensator
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine ALLOCATEblock(npointBL)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: npointBL
      allocate(xdataBL(npointBL),ydataBL(npointBL))
      return
      end subroutine ALLOCATEblock
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine DEALLOCATEblock
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      deallocate(xdataBL,ydataBL)
      return
      end subroutine DEALLOCATEblock
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine SEARCHmatID(cmatID,matID,density,ierr)
* for Material.dat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: cmatID
      integer,intent(out) :: matID,ierr
      real(8),intent(out) :: density
      integer :: iend,imat
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      iend=index(cmatID,' ')-1
      do imat = 1, nmatmax
         if ( cmatID(1:iend) .eq. cmatname(imat)(1:iend) ) then
            matID = matnum(imat)
            density = densmat(imat)
            ierr=0
            exit
         end if
      end do
      if ( imat .le. nmatmax ) then
       imatflag(imat)=.true.
      else
       write(istdout,*) 'Error: ',cmatID(1:iend),
     &      ' is not defined in Material Information File'
       ierr=1
      end if
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      return
      end subroutine SEARCHmatID

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      end module deviceproperty
END_FILE

#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <time.h>

#define BS_BYTE1(x) (  x        & 0xFF )
#define BS_BYTE2(x) ( (x >>  8) & 0xFF )
#define BS_BYTE3(x) ( (x >> 16) & 0xFF )
#define BS_BYTE4(x) ( (x >> 24) & 0xFF )
#define BS_INT16(x) ( (unsigned short)(BS_BYTE1(x)<<8 | BS_BYTE2(x)) )
#define BS_INT32(x) ( (unsigned int)(BS_BYTE1(x)<<24 | BS_BYTE2(x)<<16 | BS_BYTE3(x)<<8 | BS_BYTE4(x)) )
#define BS_INT16s(x) ( (short)(BS_BYTE1(x)<<8 | BS_BYTE2(x)) )
#define BS_INT32s(x) ( (int)(BS_BYTE1(x)<<24 | BS_BYTE2(x)<<16 | BS_BYTE3(x)<<8 | BS_BYTE4(x)) )
/********** Module variables ***********************************************/

/********** Module functions ********************************************/
int open_file(FILE **fp,char *fname,char *mode)
{
  memset(cfname,0,max_cb);
  strcpy(cfname,fname);
  *fp = fopen(fname,mode);
  if(*fp == NULL) {
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning file: %s\n",fname);
    return(-1);
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int close_file(FILE *fp)
{
  int ierr;
  ierr = fclose(fp);
  if(ierr == EOF) {
    printf("ERROR:: Closing output file\n");
    return(-1);
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int copy_binary(FILE *fp1,FILE *fp2)
{
  int max_num=1000000;
  unsigned char buff[max_num];
  int size;
  size=max_num;
  while(size==max_num){
    size=(int)fread(buff,sizeof(unsigned char),max_num,fp1);
    if(fwrite(buff,sizeof(unsigned char),size,fp2)!=size)return(-1);
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int check_file(FILE *fp,char *cin)
{
  int ierr;
  if(eval_ifendian(fp)!=0)return(-1);
  ierr=check_modality(fp,cin);
  return(ierr);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int check_modality(FILE *fp,char *cin)
{
  char cmod[256];
  int len;
  int verbose=0;
  if(get_cshort(fp,&ttag[6],cmod)==0){ // Modality
    len=strlen(cmod);
    if(strncmp(cin,cmod,len)!=0){
      if(verbose==1){
	printf(" ERROR:: File Modality dose not match\n");
	printf(" expected = %s\n",cin);
	printf(" found    = %s\n",cmod);
      }
      return(-1);
    }
  }else{
    printf(" ERROR:: Modality tag could not be obtained\n");
    return(-1);
  }
  rewind(fp);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void switchttag_endian()
{
  int i;
  for(i=0;i<NTDICOM;i++){
    ttag[i].group=BS_INT16(ttag[i].group);
    ttag[i].element=BS_INT16(ttag[i].element);
  }
  return;
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void switchdtag_endian()
{
  int i;
  for(i=0;i<NDICOM;i++){
    dtag[i].group=BS_INT16(dtag[i].group);
    dtag[i].element=BS_INT16(dtag[i].element);
  }
  return;
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int readwrite_dicomheader(FILE *fp)
{
  unsigned short group,element;
  char vr[3],name[128];
  unsigned char sbuff1[4],sbuff2[4];
  unsigned int nbytes;
  int i,j,iflag,jflag,ivr;
  int rank=0,nrank=10,nremain[nrank],ntype[nrank],nreadbytes;

  if(check_dicom(fp)!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: File is not DICOM format\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  for(i=0;i<Nloop;i++){
    if(get_tag(fp,&group,&element)!=0)break;
    if(find_tag(group,element,vr,name)!=0){
      strcpy(vr,"UN");
      strcpy(name,"Unknown");
    }
    if(get_bytes(fp,vr,&nbytes,&iflag,&ivr,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0)return(-1);
    if((strcmp(vr,"SQ") && strcmp(vr,"DL"))!=0){
      if((int)nbytes>0){
	if(get_buff(fp,nbytes,cbuff)!=0){
	  printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header\n");
	  return(-1);
	}
      }else{
	printf(" WARNING:: Assumed undefined length\n");
	strcpy(vr,"SQ");
      }
    }
    if(group==0xFFFE && (element==0xE00D || element==0xE0DD))rank--;
    print_dicomheader(group,element,vr,name,cbuff,nbytes,rank);
    jflag=0;
    nreadbytes=8;
    if(iflag>1)nreadbytes+=4;
    if(strcmp(vr,"SQ")==0){
      ntype[rank]=0;
      if(nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(nbytes==0){
      	for(i=0;i<rank;i++){
      	  printf("  ");
      	}
      	if(ntype[rank]==0){
      	  //printf("(fffe,e0dd) DL (implicit insertion) \t# 0, Sequence Delimitation Item\n");
      	}else if(ntype[rank]==1){
      	  printf("(fffe,e00d) DL (implicit insertion) \t# 0, Item Delimitation Item\n");
      	}
      	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else if(group==0xFFFE && element==0xE000){
      ntype[rank]=1;
      if(nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(nbytes==0){
      	for(i=0;i<rank;i++){
      	  printf("  ");
      	}
      	if(ntype[rank]==0){
      	  //printf("(fffe,e0dd) DL (implicit insertion) \t# 0, Sequence Delimitation Item\n");
      	}else if(ntype[rank]==1){
      	  printf("(fffe,e00d) DL (implicit insertion) \t# 0, Item Delimitation Item\n");
      	}
      	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else{
      nreadbytes+=nbytes;
    }
    for(j=rank-1;j>=0;j--){
      nremain[j]-=nreadbytes;
      if(nremain[j]<=0){
	rank--;
	for(i=0;i<rank;i++){
	  printf("  ");
	}
	if(ntype[rank]==0){
	  //printf("(fffe,e0dd) DL (implicit insertion) \t# 0, Sequence Delimitation Item\n");
	}else if(ntype[rank]==1){
	  printf("(fffe,e00d) DL (implicit insertion) \t# 0, Item Delimitation Item\n");
	}
      }
    }
    if(jflag==1){
      rank++;
      if(rank>nrank){
	printf(" ERROR:: More than Nrank sequences\n");
	return(-1);
      }
    }
  }
  if(i>Nloop){
    printf(" ERROR:: More than Nloop headers\n");
    return(-1);
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void print_dicomheader(unsigned short group,unsigned short element,
		       char *vr,char *name,char *buff,unsigned int nbytes,
		       int rank)
{
  int iflag=0,i,n;
  unsigned short usdata;
  unsigned long uldata;
  short ssdata;
  long sldata;
  union UFloatLong{
    long  ldata;
    float fdata;
  };
  union UFloatLong fbuff;
  for(i=0;i<rank;i++){
    printf("  ");
  }
  printf("(%04x,%04x) %s ",group,element,vr);
  switch(vr[0]){
  case 'A':
    switch(vr[1]){
    case 'T':
      iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'D':
    switch(vr[1]){
    case 'L':
      iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'F':
    switch(vr[1]){
    case 'L':
      iflag=2;
      n=nbytes/4;
      printf("[");
      for(i=0;i<n;i++){
	if(ifendian==1){
	  fbuff.ldata=(long)((buff[i*4+0]&0xff)|
			     ((buff[i*4+1]<<8)&0xff00)|
			     ((buff[i*4+2]<<16)&0xff0000)|
			     ((buff[i*4+3]<<24)&0xff000000));
	}else{
	  fbuff.ldata=(long)((buff[i*4+3]&0xff)|
			     ((buff[i*4+2]<<8)&0xff00)|
			     ((buff[i*4+1]<<16)&0xff0000)|
			     ((buff[i*4+0]<<24)&0xff000000));
	}
	if(i!=0)printf("\\");
	printf("%f",fbuff.fdata);
      }
      printf("] \t");
      break;
    case 'D':
      iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'O':
    switch(vr[1]){
    case 'B':
      iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'F':
      iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'X':
      iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'W':
      iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'S':
    switch(vr[1]){
    case 'L':
      iflag=2;
      n=nbytes/4;
      printf("[");
      for(i=0;i<n;i++){
	if(ifendian==1){
	  sldata=(long)((buff[0]&0xff)|
			((buff[1]<<8)&0xff00)|
			((buff[2]<<16)&0xff0000)|
			((buff[3]<<24)&0xff000000));
	}else{
	  sldata=(long)((buff[3]&0xff)|
			((buff[2]<<8)&0xff00)|
			((buff[1]<<16)&0xff0000)|
			((buff[0]<<24)&0xff000000));
	}
	if(i!=0)printf("\\");
	printf("%ld",sldata);
      }
      printf("] \t");
      break;
    case 'Q':
      iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'S':
      iflag=2;
      n=nbytes/2;
      printf("[");
      for(i=0;i<n;i++){
	if(ifendian==1){
	  ssdata=(short)((buff[0]&0xff)|((buff[1]<<8)&0xff00));
	}else{
	  ssdata=(short)((buff[1]&0xff)|((buff[0]<<8)&0xff00));
	}
	if(i!=0)printf("\\");
	printf("%d",ssdata);
      }
      printf("] \t");
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'U':
    switch(vr[1]){
    case 'L':
      iflag=2;
      n=nbytes/4;
      printf("[");
      for(i=0;i<n;i++){
	if(ifendian==1){
	  uldata=(unsigned long)((buff[0]&0xff)|
				 ((buff[1]<<8)&0xff00)|
				 ((buff[2]<<16)&0xff0000)|
				 ((buff[3]<<24)&0xff000000));
	}else{
	  uldata=(unsigned long)((buff[3]&0xff)|
				 ((buff[2]<<8)&0xff00)|
				 ((buff[1]<<16)&0xff0000)|
				 ((buff[0]<<24)&0xff000000));
	}
	if(i!=0)printf("\\");
	printf("%lu",uldata);
      }
      printf("] \t");
      break;
    case 'S':
      iflag=2;
      n=nbytes/2;
      printf("[");
      for(i=0;i<n;i++){
	if(ifendian==1){
	  usdata=(unsigned short)((buff[0]&0xff)|((buff[1]<<8)&0xff00));
	}else{
	  usdata=(unsigned short)((buff[1]&0xff)|((buff[0]<<8)&0xff00));
	}
	if(i!=0)printf("\\");
	printf("%u",usdata);
      }
      printf("] \t");
      break;
    }
    break;
  }
  if(iflag==0){
    printf("[%s] \t",buff);
  }else if(iflag==1){
    printf("(no value) \t");
  }
  printf("# %d, %s\n",nbytes,name);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_buff(FILE *fp,unsigned int nbytes0,char *buff)
{
  unsigned int nbytes,nrest;
  char buff2[max_cb];
  memset(buff,0,max_cb);
  nbytes=nbytes0;
  if(nbytes0>max_cb)nbytes=max_cb;
  if(fread(buff,sizeof(char),nbytes,fp)!=nbytes)return(-1);
  nrest=nbytes0-nbytes;
  while(nrest>0){
    nbytes=nrest;
    if(nrest>max_cb)nbytes=max_cb;
    if(fread(buff2,sizeof(char),nbytes,fp)!=nbytes)return(-1);
    nrest=nrest-nbytes;
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_bytes(FILE *fp,char *vr,unsigned int *nbytes,int *iflag,int *ivr,
	      unsigned char *sbuff1,unsigned char *sbuff2)
{
  *iflag=0; // Byte length expression flag
  *ivr=0;   // Existence of explicit VR
  memset(sbuff1,0,4);
  memset(sbuff2,0,4);
  if(fread(sbuff1,sizeof(char),4,fp)!=4)return(-1);
  switch(sbuff1[0]){
  case 'A':
    switch(sbuff1[1]){
    case 'E':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'S':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'T':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'C':
    switch(sbuff1[1]){
    case 'S':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'D':
    switch(sbuff1[1]){
    case 'A':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'S':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'T':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'F':
    switch(sbuff1[1]){
    case 'L':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'D':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'I':
    switch(sbuff1[1]){
    case 'S':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'L':
    switch(sbuff1[1]){
    case 'O':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'T':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'O':
    switch(sbuff1[1]){
    case 'B':
      *iflag=2;
      break;
    case 'D':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'F':
      *iflag=2;
      break;
    case 'W':
      *iflag=2;
      break;
    case 'X':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'P':
    switch(sbuff1[1]){
    case 'N':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'S':
    switch(sbuff1[1]){
    case 'H':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'L':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'S':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'T':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'Q':
      *iflag=2;
      break;
    }
    break;
  case 'U':
    switch(sbuff1[1]){
    case 'I':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'L':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'N':
      *iflag=2;
      break;
    case 'S':
      *iflag=1;
      break;
    case 'T':
      *iflag=2;
      break;
    }
    break;
  }

  if(*iflag==0){
    if((char)sbuff1[0]==vr[0] && (char)sbuff1[1]==vr[1]){
      if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
	*nbytes=sbuff1[2]+sbuff1[3]*256;
      }else{ // File is written in Big Endian
	*nbytes=sbuff1[2]*256+sbuff1[3];
      }
      *ivr=1;
    }else{
      if(strcmp(vr,"UN")==0){
	if((isupper(sbuff1[0]) && isupper(sbuff1[1])) && sbuff1[2]+sbuff1[3]!=0){
	  if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
	    *nbytes=sbuff1[2]+sbuff1[3]*256;
	  }else{ // File is written in Big Endian
	    *nbytes=sbuff1[2]*256+sbuff1[3];
	  }
	  *ivr=1;
	}else{
	  if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
	    *nbytes=sbuff1[0]+sbuff1[1]*256+sbuff1[2]*256*256+sbuff1[3]*256*256*256;
	  }else{ // File is written in Big Endian
	    *nbytes=sbuff1[0]*256*256*256+sbuff1[1]*256*256+sbuff1[2]*256+sbuff1[3];
	  }
	}
      }else{
	if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
	  *nbytes=sbuff1[0]+sbuff1[1]*256+sbuff1[2]*256*256+sbuff1[3]*256*256*256;
	}else{ // File is written in Big Endian
	  *nbytes=sbuff1[0]*256*256*256+sbuff1[1]*256*256+sbuff1[2]*256+sbuff1[3];
	}
      }

    }
  }else if(*iflag==1){
    if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
      *nbytes=sbuff1[2]+sbuff1[3]*256;
    }else{ // File is written in Big Endian
      *nbytes=sbuff1[2]*256+sbuff1[3];
    }
    *ivr=1;
  }else if(*iflag==2){
    if(fread(sbuff2,sizeof(char),4,fp)!=4)return(-1);
    if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
      *nbytes=sbuff2[0]+sbuff2[1]*256+sbuff2[2]*256*256+sbuff2[3]*256*256*256;
    }else{ // File is written in Big Endian
      *nbytes=sbuff2[0]*256*256*256+sbuff2[1]*256*256+sbuff2[2]*256+sbuff2[3];
    }
  }
  if(strcmp(vr,"UN")==0){
    if((sbuff1[0]>='a' && sbuff1[0]<='z') || (sbuff1[0]>='A' && sbuff1[0]<='Z')){
      vr[0] = (char)sbuff1[0];
      vr[1] = (char)sbuff1[1];
    }
  }

  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int eval_ifendian(FILE *fp)
{
  unsigned short group,element;
  unsigned short groupB,groupL,elementB,elementL;
  char vr[3],name[128];
  unsigned char sbuff[2];
  if(check_dicom(fp)!=0)return(-1);
  if(get_tag(fp,&group,&element)!=0)return(-1);
  if(imendian==1){
    groupL=group;
    elementL=element;
    groupB=BS_INT16(group);
    elementB=BS_INT16(element);
  }else{
    groupB=group;
    elementB=element;
    groupL=BS_INT16(group);
    elementL=BS_INT16(element);
  }
  if(find_tag(groupB,elementB,vr,name)!=0)ifendian=1;
  if(fread(sbuff,sizeof(char),2,fp)!=2)return(-1);
  if(ifendian==0){
    if(vr[0]==sbuff[0] && vr[1]==sbuff[1]){
      ifendian=-1;
    }else{
      ifendian=1;
    }
  }
  if(ifendian==1){
    if(find_tag(groupL,elementL,vr,name)!=0){
      printf(" ERROR:: File endian could not be identified\n");
      return(-1);
    }
  }
  if(ifendian==imendian){
    imatch=0;
  }else{
    imatch=1;
  }
  if(imatch==1){
    switchdtag_endian();
    switchttag_endian();
  }
  rewind(fp);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_tag(FILE *fp,unsigned short *group,unsigned short *element)
{
  if(fread(group,sizeof(short),1,fp)<1)return(-1);
  if(fread(element,sizeof(short),1,fp)<1)return(-1);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int find_tag(unsigned short group,unsigned short element,char *vr0,char *name0)
{
  int i;
  for(i=0;i<NDICOM;i++){
    if(dtag[i].group==group && dtag[i].element==element){
      memset(vr0,0,3);
      memset(name0,0,128);
      strncpy(vr0,dtag[i].vr,3);
      strncpy(name0,dtag[i].name,128);
      return(0);
    }
  }
  return(-1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int check_dicom(FILE *fp)
{
  char dicmt[5]="DICM",buff[128];
  int ierr;
  ierr=0;
  if((fread(buff,sizeof(char),128,fp))<128)ierr=1;
  if(ierr==0 && (fread(buff,sizeof(char),4,fp))<4)ierr=1;
  buff[4]='\0';
  if(ierr==0 && (strcmp(buff,dicmt))!=0)ierr=1;
  if(ierr!=0)return(-1);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int readwrite_dicom(FILE *fp0,FILE *fp)
{
  char buff[132];
  int ierr;
  ierr=0;
  if((fread(buff,sizeof(char),132,fp0))<132)ierr=1;
  if((fwrite(buff,sizeof(char),132,fp))<132)ierr=1;
  if(ierr!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: Format file is not DICOM\n");
    return(-1);
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void switch_endian()
{
  int i;
  for(i=0;i<NDICOM;i++){
    dtag[i].group=BS_INT16(dtag[i].group);
    dtag[i].element=BS_INT16(dtag[i].element);
  }
  return;
}

void print_RTdoseheader(FILE *fp)
{
  int nx=-9999,ny=-9999,nz=-9999;
  //  int nalloc,nstore,nhigh;
  double xdel,ydel;
  double xsh[3],xvec[3],yvec[3],xnorm[3];
  double dgscale=-9999.0;
  char clong[max_cb];
  char cdate[256],ctime[256];
  unsigned int len;

  if(get_cshort(fp,&ttag[0],cdate)!=0)get_error(&ttag[0]); // Instance Creation Date
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_cshort(fp,&ttag[1],ctime)!=0)get_error(&ttag[1]); // Instance Creation Time
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DS3(fp,&ttag[23],xsh)!=0)get_error(&ttag[23]); // Image Position Patient
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DS6(fp,&ttag[24],xvec,yvec)!=0)get_error(&ttag[24]); // Image Orientation Patient
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_IS(fp,&ttag[28],&nz)!=0)get_error(&ttag[28]); // Number of Frames
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_US(fp,&ttag[30],&ny)!=0)get_error(&ttag[30]); // Rows
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_US(fp,&ttag[31],&nx)!=0)get_error(&ttag[31]); // Columns
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DS2(fp,&ttag[32],&xdel,&ydel)!=0)get_error(&ttag[32]); // Pixel Spacing
  rewind(fp);
  /* nalloc=get_US(fp,&ttag[33]); */
  /* rewind(fp); */
  /* nstore=get_US(fp,&ttag[34]); */
  /* rewind(fp); */
  /* nhigh=get_US(fp,&ttag[35]); */
  /* rewind(fp); */
  if(get_DS3(fp,&ttag[39],xnorm)!=0)get_error(&ttag[39]); // Normalization Point
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DSseq(fp,&ttag[40],&len,clong)!=0)get_error(&ttag[40]); // Grid Frame Offset Vector
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DS(fp,&ttag[41],&dgscale)!=0)get_error(&ttag[41]); // Dose Grid Scaling
  rewind(fp);

  printf("Date=%8.8s\n",cdate);
  printf("Time=%6.6s\n",ctime);
  printf("offset position=%lf %lf %lf\n",xsh[0],xsh[1],xsh[2]);
  printf("nx=%d ny=%d nz=%d\n",nx,ny,nz);
  printf("xdel=%lf ydel=%lf\n",xdel,ydel);
  printf("normalization at position=%lf %lf %lf\n",xnorm[0],xnorm[1],xnorm[2]);
  printf("dgscale=%G\n",dgscale);
  printf("Grid Frame Offset Vector= %d bytes\n",len);

}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void get_imagedimension(FILE *fp,int *nx,int *ny,int *nalloc,
			double *xdel,double *ydel,double *zdel,
			double *xsh,double *xvec,double *yvec)
{
  if(get_DS(fp,&ttag[17],zdel)!=0){ // Spacing Between Slices
    rewind(fp);
    if(get_DS(fp,&ttag[16],zdel)!=0)get_error(&ttag[16]); // Slice Thickness
  }
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DS3(fp,&ttag[23],xsh)!=0){  // Image Position Patient
    rewind(fp);
    if(get_DS3x(fp,&ttag[23],xsh)!=0)get_error(&ttag[23]);
  }
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DS6(fp,&ttag[24],xvec,yvec)!=0){ // Image Orientation Patient
    printf(" WARNING:: Image Orientation Patient is missing\n");
    printf("           1 0 0 0 1 0 is assumed\n");
    xvec[0]=0.0;
    xvec[1]=0.0;
    xvec[2]=0.0;
    yvec[0]=0.0;
    yvec[1]=0.0;
    yvec[2]=0.0;
  }
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_US(fp,&ttag[30],ny)!=0)get_error(&ttag[30]); // Rows
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_US(fp,&ttag[31],nx)!=0)get_error(&ttag[31]); // Columns
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DS2(fp,&ttag[32],xdel,ydel)!=0)get_error(&ttag[32]); // Pixel Spacing
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_US(fp,&ttag[33],nalloc)!=0)get_error(&ttag[33]); // Bits Allocated
  rewind(fp);

  /* printf("nx=%d ny=%d\n",*nx,*ny); */
  /* printf("xdel=%lf ydel=%lf\n",*xdel,*ydel); */

}

/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_CTimagedata(FILE *fp, int ndata, int nalloc, float *data)
{
  int i,ierr,irep;
  double hu0,slope;
  if(get_US(fp,&ttag[49],&irep)!=0){  // Pixel Representation
    irep=0;
  }
  rewind(fp);
  ierr=get_dicomdata(fp,irep,ndata,nalloc,data);
  if(ierr<0)return(-1);
  if(ierr>0){
    printf(" ERROR:: Reading CT image data %d-th\n",ierr);
    exit(-1);
  }
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DS(fp,&ttag[36],&hu0)!=0){  // Rescale Intercept
      hu0=0.0;
  }
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DS(fp,&ttag[37],&slope)!=0){ // Rescale Slope
      slope=1.0;
  }
  rewind(fp);
  for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
    data[i]=data[i]*slope+hu0;
  }
  return(0);
}

/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int overwrite_RTdoseheader(FILE *fp, int ipart, double *xval,
			   double *xsh, int *ngrid,
			   float dmax, int *ipmax, double *fac,
			   int ifnorm, float *data, double *xn, double vnorm,
			   double *tdata, double *fnorm,
			   char *cver, char *cdate, char *ctime)
{
  double xdel,ydel,zdel;
  double xnorm;
  int ip[3],i0;
  int ierr;
  *tdata=dmax;
  *fac=(double) dmax/(256*256-1);
  xdel=(xval[1]-xval[0])/ngrid[0];
  ydel=(xval[3]-xval[2])/ngrid[1];
  zdel=(xval[5]-xval[4])/ngrid[2];
  xnorm=0.0;
  if(ipart>0){
    xn[0]=xsh[0]+(*ipmax)*xdel;
    xn[1]=xsh[1]+(*(ipmax+1))*ydel;
    xn[2]=xsh[2]+(*(ipmax+2))*zdel;
    xnorm=(*fnorm)*(*fac); // normalized by normalization factor
  }else{
    if(ifnorm==0){
      xn[0]=xsh[0]+(*ipmax)*xdel;
      xn[1]=xsh[1]+(*(ipmax+1))*ydel;
      xn[2]=xsh[2]+(*(ipmax+2))*zdel;
      *fnorm=1.0;
      xnorm=*fac; // as it is
    }else if(ifnorm==1){
      xn[0]=xsh[0]+(*ipmax)*xdel;
      xn[1]=xsh[1]+(*(ipmax+1))*ydel;
      xn[2]=xsh[2]+(*(ipmax+2))*zdel;
      *fnorm=1.0/(*tdata);
      xnorm=(double)1.0/(256*256-1); // normalized the Max dose to 1
    }else if(ifnorm==2){
      xn[0]=xsh[0]+(*ipmax)*xdel;
      xn[1]=xsh[1]+(*(ipmax+1))*ydel;
      xn[2]=xsh[2]+(*(ipmax+2))*zdel;
      xnorm=(*fnorm)*(*fac); // normalized by normalization factor
    }else if(ifnorm==3){
      if(xn[0]<xval[0] || xn[0]>=xval[1]){
	printf(" ERROR:: Normalization point is outside of data range\n");
	printf("  Data range [mm]: x=%lf : %lf\n",xval[0],xval[1]);
	printf("  Specified [mm] : x=%lf\n",xn[0]);
	return(-1);
      }else if(xn[1]<xval[2] || xn[1]>=xval[3]){
	printf(" ERROR:: Normalization point is outside of data range\n");
	printf("  Data range [mm]: y=%lf : %lf\n",xval[2],xval[3]);
	printf("  Specified [mm] : y=%lf\n",xn[1]);
	return(-1);
      }else if(xn[2]<xval[4] || xn[2]>=xval[5]){
	printf(" ERROR:: Normalization point is outside of data range\n");
	printf("  Data range [mm]: z=%lf : %lf\n",xval[4],xval[5]);
	printf("  Specified [mm] : z=%lf\n",xn[2]);
	return(-1);
      }
      ip[0]=(xn[0]-xsh[0]+0.5*xdel)/xdel;
      ip[1]=(xn[1]-xsh[1]+0.5*ydel)/ydel;
      ip[2]=(xn[2]-xsh[2]+0.5*zdel)/zdel;
      i0=ip[0]+ip[1]*ngrid[0]+ip[2]*ngrid[0]*ngrid[1];
      if(data[i0]>0.0){
	*tdata=data[i0];
	*fnorm=vnorm/(*tdata);
      }else{
	printf("***********************************************************\n");
	printf(" WARNING:: Value at specified normalization point is zero\n");
	printf("           Normalization is changed to 'as it is'\n");
	printf("***********************************************************\n");
	xn[0]=xsh[0]+(*ipmax)*xdel;
	xn[1]=xsh[1]+(*(ipmax+1))*ydel;
	xn[2]=xsh[2]+(*(ipmax+2))*zdel;
	*fnorm=1.0; // as it is
      }
      xnorm=(*fnorm)*(*fac);
    }
  }

  ierr=0;
  if(itagjump[0]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[0],cdate); // Instance Creation Date
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[1]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[1],ctime); // Instance Creation Time
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[2]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[2],csdate); // Study Date
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[3]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[3],ccdate); // Content Date
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[4]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[4],cstime); // Study Time
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[5]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[5],cctime); // Content Time
    rewind(fp);
  }
  /* ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[7],"DICOM2PHITS"); // Manufacturer */
  /* rewind(fp); */
  if(itagjump[8]){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[8],cinst); // Institution Name
    rewind(fp);
  }
  /* ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[9],"DICOM2PHITS"); // Station Name */
  /* rewind(fp); */
  /* ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[10],"department none"); // Institutional Department Name */
  /* rewind(fp); */
  /* ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[11],"PHITS"); // Manufacturer Model Name */
  /* rewind(fp); */
  if(itagjump[12]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[12],cpname); // Patient Name
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[13]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[13],cpid); // Patient ID
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[14]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[14],cpbirth); // Patient Birth Date
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[15]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[15],cpsex); // Patient Sex
    rewind(fp);
  }
  /* ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[18],"PHITS"); // Device Serial Number */
  /* rewind(fp); */
  ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[19],cver); // Software Versions
  rewind(fp);
  if(itagjump[20]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[20],cstid); // Study ID
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[21]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[21],csnum); // Series Number
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[23]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_DS3(fp,&ttag[23],xsh[0],xsh[1],xsh[2]); // Image Position Patient
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[25]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[25],cframeid); // Frame Of Reference UID
    rewind(fp);
  }
  if(itagjump[26]==0){
    ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[26],cposi); // Position Reference Indicator
    rewind(fp);
  }
  ierr+=overwrite_IS(fp,&ttag[28],ngrid[2]); // Number of Frames
  rewind(fp);
  ierr+=overwrite_US(fp,&ttag[30],ngrid[1]); // Rows
  rewind(fp);
  ierr+=overwrite_US(fp,&ttag[31],ngrid[0]); // Columns
  rewind(fp);
  ierr+=overwrite_DS2(fp,&ttag[32],xdel,ydel); // Pixel Spacing
  rewind(fp);
  /* ierr+=overwrite_cshort(fp,&ttag[38],"PHYSICAL"); // Dose Type */
  /* rewind(fp); */
  ierr+=overwrite_DS3(fp,&ttag[39],xn[0],xn[1],xn[2]); // Normalization Point
  rewind(fp);
  ierr+=overwrite_DSseq(fp,&ttag[40],ngrid[2],zdel); // Grid Frame Offset Vector
  rewind(fp);
  ierr+=overwrite_DS(fp,&ttag[41],xnorm); // Dose Grid Scaling
  rewind(fp);
  ierr+=overwrite_US(fp,&ttag[49],0); // Pixel Representaion (unsigned)
  rewind(fp);

  if(ierr!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: Overwritting DICOM header\n");
    return(-1);
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int overwrite_RTdosedata(FILE *fp,double fac,int ngridtot,float *data)
{
  unsigned short group,element;
  char vr[3],name[128];
  unsigned char sbuff1[4],sbuff2[4],dbuff[2];
  unsigned int nbytes,nbytes0;
  int i,iflag,idata,ivr;
  FILE *fp0;
  double invfac;

  invfac=1.0e0/fac;
  if(open_file(&fp0,"tmp.bin","w+b")!=0)return(-1);
  if(copy_binary(fp,fp0)!=0)return(-1);
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)return(-1);
  if(open_file(&fp,Fout,"w+b")!=0)return(-1);
  rewind(fp0);
  nbytes=2*ngridtot;
  nbytes=((nbytes+1)/2)*2;
  if(readwrite_dicom(fp0,fp)!=0)return(-1);
  for(i=0;i<Nloop;i++){
    if(get_tag(fp0,&group,&element)!=0)break;
    if(write_tag(fp,group,element)!=0)return(-1);
    if(find_tag(group,element,vr,name)!=0){
      strcpy(vr,"UN");
      strcpy(name,"Unknown");
    }
    if(get_bytes(fp0,vr,&nbytes0,&iflag,&ivr,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0)return(-1);
    if(group==ttag[42].group && element==ttag[42].element){
      set_bytes(nbytes,iflag,ivr,sbuff1,sbuff2);
      if(write_bytes(fp,iflag,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0)return(-1);
      break;
    }else{
      if(write_bytes(fp,iflag,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0)return(-1);
      if(readwrite_buff(fp0,fp,nbytes0)!=0)return(-1);
    }
  }
  if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
    for(i=0;i<ngridtot;i++){
      idata=data[i]*invfac;
      dbuff[0]=idata%256;
      dbuff[1]=idata/256;
      if(fwrite(dbuff,sizeof(char),2,fp)!=2){
	printf(" ERROR:: Overwritting RT dose data %d-th\n",i);
	return(-1);
      }
    }
  }else{ // File is written in Big Endian
    for(i=0;i<ngridtot;i++){
      idata=data[i]*invfac;
      dbuff[0]=idata/256;
      dbuff[1]=idata%256;
      if(fwrite(dbuff,sizeof(char),2,fp)!=2){
	printf(" ERROR:: Overwritting DICOM data %d-th\n",i);
	return(-1);
      }
    }
  }
  close_file(fp0);
  if(remove("tmp.bin")!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: Fail to remove temporary file\n");
    return(-1);
  }
  return(0);
}
