/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_StructureSetROIparam(FILE *fp,int *nROI,int *nslice,int *npoint)
{
  unsigned short group,element;
  char vr[3],name[128];
  unsigned char sbuff1[4],sbuff2[4];
  unsigned int nbytes;
  int i,j,k,iflag,jflag,kflag,ivr;
  int rank=0,nrank=10,nremain[nrank],nreadbytes;
  int islice,ipoint;

  if(check_dicom(fp)!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: File is not DICOM format\n");
    printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  kflag=0;
  k=0;
  ipoint=0;
  islice=0;
  for(i=0;i<Nloop;i++){
    if(get_tag(fp,&group,&element)!=0)break;
    if(find_tag(group,element,vr,name)!=0){
      strcpy(vr,"UN");
      strcpy(name,"Unknown");
    }
    if(get_bytes(fp,vr,&nbytes,&iflag,&ivr,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0){
      printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header VR\n");
      printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
      printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
      exit(-1);
    }
    if((strcmp(vr,"SQ") && strcmp(vr,"DL"))!=0){
      if((int)nbytes>0){
	if(get_buff(fp,nbytes,cbuff)!=0){
	  printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header %d bytes\n",nbytes);
	  printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
	  printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
	  return(-1);
	}
      }else{
	strcpy(vr,"SQ");
      }
    }
    if(group==0xFFFE && (element==0xE00D || element==0xE0DD)){
      rank--;
      if(kflag==1 && rank==0){
	*nROI=k;
	k=0;
      }else if(kflag==2 && rank==0){
	*nslice=islice;
	*npoint=ipoint;
	return(0);
      }
    }
    if(group==sttag[0].group && element==sttag[0].element){
      kflag=1;
    }else if(group==sttag[1].group && element==sttag[1].element){
      k++;
    }else if(group==sttag[4].group && element==sttag[4].element){
      kflag=2;
    }
    if(kflag>0){
      if(group==sttag[5].group && element==sttag[5].element){
	if(strncmp(cbuff,"CLOSED_PLANAR",13)!=0){
	  printf("ERROR:: Contour Geometric Type is %s which is not CLOSED_PLANAR\n",cbuff);
	  return(1);
	}
      }else if(group==sttag[6].group && element==sttag[6].element){
	ipoint+=atoi(cbuff);
	islice++;
      }else if(group==sttag[7].group && element==sttag[7].element){
      }
    }
    jflag=0;
    nreadbytes=8;
    if(iflag>1)nreadbytes+=4;
    if(strcmp(vr,"SQ")==0){
      if(nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(nbytes==0){
	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else if(group==0xFFFE && element==0xE000){
      if(nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(nbytes==0){
	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else{
      nreadbytes+=nbytes;
    }
    for(j=rank-1;j>=0;j--){
      nremain[j]-=nreadbytes;
      if(nremain[j]<=0){
	rank--;
	if(kflag==1 && rank==0){
	  *nROI=k;
	  k=0;
	}else if(kflag==2 && rank==0){
	  *nslice=islice;
	  *npoint=ipoint;
	  return(0);
	}
      }

    }
    if(jflag==1){
      rank++;
      if(rank>nrank){
	printf(" ERROR:: More than Nrank sequences\n");
	return(-1);
      }
    }
  }
  if(i>Nloop){
    printf(" ERROR:: more than Nloop headers\n");
    printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  return(-1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_StructureSetROIdata(FILE *fp,int *numROI,double *volROI,char *nameROI,
			    int *indslice,int *indpoint,double *pdata)
{
  unsigned short group,element;
  char vr[3],name[128];
  unsigned char sbuff1[4],sbuff2[4];
  unsigned int nbytes;
  int i,j,k,iflag,jflag,kflag,ivr;
  int rank=0,nrank=10,nremain[nrank],nreadbytes;
  int ipoint,islice,i0;
  char *sbuff;

  if(check_dicom(fp)!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: File is not DICOM format\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  kflag=0;
  k=0;
  ipoint=0;
  islice=0;
  for(i=0;i<Nloop;i++){
    if(get_tag(fp,&group,&element)!=0)break;
    if(find_tag(group,element,vr,name)!=0){
      strcpy(vr,"UN");
      strcpy(name,"Unknown");
    }
    if(get_bytes(fp,vr,&nbytes,&iflag,&ivr,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0){
      printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header VR\n");
      printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
      printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
      exit(-1);
    }
    if((strcmp(vr,"SQ") && strcmp(vr,"DL"))!=0){
      if((int)nbytes>0){
	if(get_buff(fp,nbytes,cbuff)!=0){
	  printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header %d bytes\n",nbytes);
	  printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
	  printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
	  return(-1);
	}
      }else{
	strcpy(vr,"SQ");
      }
    }
    if(group==0xFFFE && (element==0xE00D || element==0xE0DD)){
      rank--;
      if(kflag==1 && rank==0){
	k=0;
      }else if(kflag==2 && rank==0){
	return(0);
      }
    }
    if(group==sttag[0].group && element==sttag[0].element){
      kflag=1;
    }else if(group==sttag[4].group && element==sttag[4].element){
      kflag=2;
    }
    if(kflag>0){
      if(group==sttag[1].group && element==sttag[1].element){
	k++;
	*(numROI+k-1)=atoi(cbuff);
      }else if(group==sttag[2].group && element==sttag[2].element){
	strcpy(nameROI+(k-1)*1024,cbuff);
      }else if(group==sttag[3].group && element==sttag[3].element){
	*(volROI+k-1)=atof(cbuff);
      }else if(group==sttag[6].group && element==sttag[6].element){
	ipoint+=atoi(cbuff);
	*(indpoint+islice)=ipoint;
	islice++;
      }else if(group==sttag[7].group && element==sttag[7].element){
      }else if(group==sttag[8].group && element==sttag[8].element){
	if(islice==1){
	  i0=0;
	}else{
	  i0=*(indpoint+islice-2)*3;
	}
	pdata[i0]=strtod(cbuff,&sbuff);
	for(i=i0+1;i<ipoint*3-1;i++){
	  pdata[i]=strtod(sbuff+1,&sbuff);
	}
	pdata[ipoint*3-1]=atof(sbuff+1);
      }else if(group==sttag[9].group && element==sttag[9].element){
	*(indslice+k)=islice;
	k++;
      }
    }
    jflag=0;
    nreadbytes=8;
    if(iflag>1)nreadbytes+=4;
    if(strcmp(vr,"SQ")==0){
      if(nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(nbytes==0){
	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else if(group==0xFFFE && element==0xE000){
      if(nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(nbytes==0){
	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else{
      nreadbytes+=nbytes;
    }
    for(j=rank-1;j>=0;j--){
      nremain[j]-=nreadbytes;
      if(nremain[j]<=0){
	rank--;
	if(kflag==1 && rank==0){
	  k=0;
	}else if(kflag==2 && rank==0){
	  return(0);
	}
      }

    }
    if(jflag==1){
      rank++;
      if(rank>nrank){
	printf(" ERROR:: More than Nrank sequences\n");
	return(-1);
      }
    }
  }
  if(i>Nloop){
    printf(" ERROR:: more than Nloop headers\n");
    printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  return(-1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_dicomheader(FILE *fp, struct TARGETTAG *p,
		    unsigned int *nbytes, char *buff, int imode)
{
  unsigned short group,element;
  char vr[3],name[128];
  unsigned char sbuff1[4],sbuff2[4];
  int i,j,iflag,jflag,ivr;
  int rank=0,nrank=10,nremain[nrank],nreadbytes;
  if(check_dicom(fp)!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: File is not DICOM format\n");
    printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  for(i=0;i<Nloop;i++){
    if(get_tag(fp,&group,&element)!=0)break;
    if(find_tag(group,element,vr,name)!=0){
      strcpy(vr,"UN");
      strcpy(name,"Unknown");
    }
    if(get_bytes(fp,vr,nbytes,&iflag,&ivr,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0){
      printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header VR\n");
      printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
      printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
      exit(-1);
    }
    if((strcmp(vr,"SQ") && strcmp(vr,"DL"))!=0){
      if(*nbytes>0){
	if(get_buff(fp,*nbytes,cbuff)!=0){
	  printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header %d bytes\n",*nbytes);
	  printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
	  printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
	  return(-1);
	}
      }else{
	strcpy(vr,"SQ");
      }
    }
    if(group==0xFFFE && (element==0xE00D || element==0xE0DD))rank--;
    if((rank==0 || imode)&& group==p->group && element==p->element){
      return(0);
    }
    jflag=0;
    nreadbytes=8;
    if(iflag>1)nreadbytes+=4;
    if(strcmp(vr,"SQ")==0){
      if(*nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(*nbytes==0){
	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=*nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else if(group==0xFFFE && element==0xE000){
      if(*nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(*nbytes==0){
	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=*nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else{
      nreadbytes+=*nbytes;
    }
    for(j=rank-1;j>=0;j--){
      nremain[j]-=nreadbytes;
      if(nremain[j]<=0){
	rank--;
      }

    }
    if(jflag==1){
      rank++;
      if(rank>nrank){
	printf(" ERROR:: More than Nrank sequences\n");
	return(-1);
      }
    }
  }
  if(i>Nloop){
    printf(" ERROR:: more than Nloop headers\n");
    printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  return(-1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_dicomdata(FILE *fp, int irep, int ndata, int nalloc, float *data) //CT format
{
  unsigned short group,element;
  char vr[3],name[128];
  unsigned char sbuff1[4],sbuff2[4];
  unsigned int nbytes;
  int i,j,iflag,jflag,ivr;
  int rank=0,nrank=10,nremain[nrank],nreadbytes;
  unsigned short hu2u;
  unsigned int hu4u;
  signed short hu2s;
  signed int hu4s;
  if(check_dicom(fp)!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: File is not DICOM format\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  for(i=0;i<Nloop;i++){
    if(get_tag(fp,&group,&element)!=0)break;
    if(find_tag(group,element,vr,name)!=0){
      strcpy(vr,"UN");
      strcpy(name,"Unknown");
    }
    if(get_bytes(fp,vr,&nbytes,&iflag,&ivr,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0){
      printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header VR\n");
      printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
      exit(-1);
    }
    if(rank==0 && group==ttag[42].group && element==ttag[42].element){
      if(nbytes!=ndata*nalloc/8){
	printf(" ERROR:: Data size mismatch\n");
	printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
	printf(" expected = %d\n",ndata);
	printf(" found    = %d\n",nbytes/nalloc*8);
	return(-1);
      }
      break;
    }
    if((strcmp(vr,"SQ") && strcmp(vr,"DL"))!=0){
      if((int)nbytes>0){
	if(get_buff(fp,nbytes,cbuff)!=0){
	  printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header %d bytes\n",nbytes);
	  printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
	  printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
	  return(-1);
	}
      }else{
	strcpy(vr,"SQ");
      }
    }
    if(group==0xFFFE && (element==0xE00D || element==0xE0DD))rank--;
    jflag=0;
    nreadbytes=8;
    if(iflag>1)nreadbytes+=4;
    if(strcmp(vr,"SQ")==0){
      if(nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(nbytes==0){
	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else if(group==0xFFFE && element==0xE000){
      if(nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(nbytes==0){
	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else{
      nreadbytes+=nbytes;
    }
    for(j=rank-1;j>=0;j--){
      nremain[j]-=nreadbytes;
      if(nremain[j]<=0){
	rank--;
      }
    }
    if(jflag==1){
      rank++;
      if(rank>nrank){
	printf(" ERROR:: More than Nrank sequences\n");
	return(-1);
      }
    }
  }
  if(i>Nloop){
    printf(" ERROR:: more than Nloop headers\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  switch(nalloc){
  case 16:
    if(irep==0){
      for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
	if(fread(&hu2u,sizeof(short),1,fp)==0){
	  printf("fail to read %d\n",i);
	  return(i+1);
	}
	if(imatch!=0)hu2u=BS_INT16(hu2u);
	data[i]=hu2u;
      }
    }else{
      for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
	if(fread(&hu2s,sizeof(short),1,fp)==0){
	  printf("fail to read %d\n",i);
	  return(i+1);
	}
	if(imatch!=0)hu2s=BS_INT16s(hu2s);
	data[i]=hu2s;
      }
    }
    break;
  case 32:
    if(irep==0){
      for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
	if(fread(&hu4u,sizeof(int),1,fp)==0)return(i+1);
	if(imatch!=0)hu4u=BS_INT32(hu4u);
	data[i]=hu4u;
      }
    }else{
      for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
	if(fread(&hu4s,sizeof(int),1,fp)==0)return(i+1);
	if(imatch!=0)hu4s=BS_INT32s(hu4s);
	data[i]=hu4s;
      }
    }
    break;
  default:
    printf(" ERROR:: Value of nalloc is %d and not 16 or 32\n",nalloc);
    return(-1);
  }
  return(0);
}

int get_dicomdata2(FILE *fp, int irep, int ndata, float *data) // RTdose format
{
  unsigned short group,element;
  char vr[3],name[128];
  unsigned char sbuff1[4],sbuff2[4];
  unsigned int nbytes;
  int i,j,iflag,jflag,ivr;
  int rank=0,nrank=10,nremain[nrank],nreadbytes;
  unsigned short hu2u;
  signed short hu2s;
  if(check_dicom(fp)!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: File is not DICOM format\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  for(i=0;i<Nloop;i++){
    if(get_tag(fp,&group,&element)!=0)break;
    if(find_tag(group,element,vr,name)!=0){
      strcpy(vr,"UN");
      strcpy(name,"Unknown");
    }
    if(get_bytes(fp,vr,&nbytes,&iflag,&ivr,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0){
      printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header VR\n");
      printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
      exit(-1);
    }
    if(rank==0 && group==ttag[42].group && element==ttag[42].element){
      if(nbytes!=2*ndata){
	printf(" ERROR:: Data size mismatch\n");
	printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
	printf(" expected = %d\n",2*ndata);
	printf(" found    = %d\n",nbytes);
	return(-1);
      }
      break;
    }
    if((strcmp(vr,"SQ") && strcmp(vr,"DL"))!=0){
      if((int)nbytes>0){
	if(get_buff(fp,nbytes,cbuff)!=0){
	  printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header %d bytes\n",nbytes);
	  printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
	  printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
	  return(-1);
	}
      }else{
	strcpy(vr,"SQ");
      }
    }
    if(group==0xFFFE && (element==0xE00D || element==0xE0DD))rank--;
    jflag=0;
    nreadbytes=8;
    if(iflag>1)nreadbytes+=4;
    if(strcmp(vr,"SQ")==0){
      if(nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(nbytes==0){
	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else if(group==0xFFFE && element==0xE000){
      if(nbytes==-1){
	nremain[rank]=Nloop;
	jflag=1;
      }else if(nbytes==0){
	jflag=0;
      }else{
	nremain[rank]=nbytes;
	jflag=1;
      }
    }else{
      nreadbytes+=nbytes;
    }
    for(j=rank-1;j>=0;j--){
      nremain[j]-=nreadbytes;
      if(nremain[j]<=0){
	rank--;
      }
    }
    if(jflag==1){
      rank++;
      if(rank>nrank){
	printf(" ERROR:: More than Nrank sequences\n");
	return(-1);
      }
    }
  }
  if(i>Nloop){
    printf(" ERROR:: more than Nloop headers\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(irep==0){
    for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
      if(fread(&hu2u,sizeof(short),1,fp)==0){
	printf("fail to read %d\n",i);
	return(i+1);
      }
      if(imatch!=0)hu2u=BS_INT16(hu2u);
      data[i]=hu2u;
    }
  }else{
    for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
      if(fread(&hu2s,sizeof(short),1,fp)==0){
	printf("fail to read %d\n",i);
	return(i+1);
      }
      if(imatch!=0)hu2s=BS_INT16s(hu2s);
      data[i]=hu2s;
    }
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_sloc(char *fname, double *sloc, char *cin)
{
  FILE *fp;
  double xsh[3];
  if(open_file(&fp,fname,"rb")!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning DICOM file: %s\n",fname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(check_file(fp,cin)!=0)return(-1);

  if(get_DS3(fp,&ttag[23],xsh)!=0){ // Image Position Patient
    printf(" ERROR:: Reading Slice Location in DICOM file: %s\n",fname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  *sloc=xsh[2];

  /* if(get_DS(fp,&ttag[27],sloc)!=0){ */
  /*   rewind(fp); */
  /*   if(get_DS3(fp,&ttag[23],xsh)!=0){ // Image Position Patient */
  /*     printf(" ERROR:: Reading Slice Location in DICOM file: %s\n",fname); */
  /*     exit(-1); */
  /*   } */
  /*   *sloc=xsh[2]; */
  /* } */
  close_file(fp);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_sloc_time(char *fname, double *sloc, double *timing, int *iduration ,char *cin, int *iflag)
{
  FILE *fp;
  double xsh[3];
  if(open_file(&fp,fname,"rb")!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning DICOM file: %s\n",fname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(check_file(fp,cin)!=0)return(-1);

  if(get_DS3(fp,&ttag[23],xsh)!=0){ // Image Position Patient
    rewind(fp);
    if(get_DS3x(fp,&ttag[23],xsh)!=0){
      printf(" ERROR:: Reading Slice Location in DICOM file: %s\n",fname);
      exit(-1);
    }
  }
  *sloc=xsh[2];

  /* if(get_DS(fp,&ttag[27],sloc)!=0){ */
  /*   rewind(fp); */
  /*   if(get_DS3(fp,&ttag[23],xsh)!=0){ // Image Position Patient */
  /*     printf(" ERROR:: Reading Slice Location in DICOM file: %s\n",fname); */
  /*     exit(-1); */
  /*   } */
  /*   *sloc=xsh[2]; */
  /* } */

  rewind(fp);
  if(get_DS(fp,&ttag[43],timing)!=0&&*iflag==0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Frame Reference Time is missing: %s\n",fname);
      *timing=0.0;
      *iflag=1;
  }
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_IS(fp,&ttag[44],iduration)!=0&&*(iflag+1)==0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Reading Actual Frame Duration is missing: %s\n",fname);
      *iduration=0;
      *(iflag+1)=1;
  }
  close_file(fp);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_nslices(char *fname, int *nslices, int *nlist)
{
  FILE *fp;
  if(open_file(&fp,fname,"rb")!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning DICOM file: %s\n",fname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(get_USx(fp,&ttag[47],nslices)!=0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Number of Slices is missing: %s\n",fname);
      *nslices=0;
  }
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_IS(fp,&ttag[48],nlist)!=0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Images in Acquisition is missing: %s\n",fname);
      *nlist=0;
  }
  close_file(fp);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_nframes(char *fname, int *nframes)
{
  FILE *fp;
  if(open_file(&fp,fname,"rb")!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning DICOM file: %s\n",fname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(get_IS(fp,&ttag[28],nframes)!=0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Number of Frames is missing: %s\n",fname);
      *nframes=1;
  }
  close_file(fp);
  return(0);
}

int get_radioactivity(char *fname, double *activity, int *halflife)
{
  FILE *fp;
  if(open_file(&fp,fname,"rb")!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning DICOM file: %s\n",fname);
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(get_DSx(fp,&ttag[45],activity)!=0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Radionuclide Total Dose is missing: %s\n",fname);
      printf("           inorm = 0 option is automatically chosen\n");
      *activity=0.0;
  }
  rewind(fp);
  if(get_ISx(fp,&ttag[46],halflife)!=0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Radionuclide Half Life is missing: %s\n",fname);
      printf("           Same as specified radionuclide is assumed\n");
      *halflife=0.0;
  }
  close_file(fp);
  return(0);
}

{
  unsigned int nbytes;
  int ierr;
  ierr=get_dicomheader(fp,p,&nbytes,cbuff,0);
  if(ierr==0){
    if(nbytes>256)nbytes=256;
    memset(cshort,0,256);
    strncpy(cshort,cbuff,nbytes);
  }
  return(ierr);
}

/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int overwrite_dicomheader(FILE *fp, struct TARGETTAG *p,
			  unsigned int nbytes, char *buff)
{
  unsigned short group,element;
  char vr[3],name[128];
  unsigned char sbuff1[4],sbuff2[4];
  unsigned int nbytes0;
  int i,iflag,jflag,ivr;
  FILE *fp0;
  if(open_file(&fp0,"tmp.bin","w+b")!=0)return(-1);
  if(copy_binary(fp,fp0)!=0)return(-1);
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)return(-1);
  if(open_file(&fp,Fout,"w+b")!=0)return(-1);
  rewind(fp0);
  jflag=0;
  if(readwrite_dicom(fp0,fp)!=0)return(-1);
  for(i=0;i<Nloop;i++){
    if(get_tag(fp0,&group,&element)!=0)break;
    if(write_tag(fp,group,element)!=0)return(-1);
    if(find_tag(group,element,vr,name)!=0){
      strcpy(vr,"UN");
      strcpy(name,"Unknown");
    }
    if(get_bytes(fp0,vr,&nbytes0,&iflag,&ivr,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0){
      printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header VR\n");
      printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
      printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
      return(-1);
    }
    if(group==p->group && element==p->element){
      set_bytes(nbytes,iflag,ivr,sbuff1,sbuff2);
      if(write_bytes(fp,iflag,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0)return(-1);
      if(get_buff(fp0,nbytes0,cbuff)!=0){
	printf(" ERROR:: Reading DICOM header %d bytes\n",nbytes);
	printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",group,element);
	printf("   %s\n",p->name);
	printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
	return(-1);
      }
      if(write_buff(fp,nbytes,buff)!=0)return(-1);
      jflag=1;
    }else{
      if(write_bytes(fp,iflag,sbuff1,sbuff2)!=0)return(-1);
      if(readwrite_buff(fp0,fp,nbytes0)!=0)return(-1);
    }
  }
  if(i>Nloop){
    printf(" ERROR:: more than Nloop headers\n");
    printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
    return(-1);
  }
  if(jflag==0){
    printf(" ERROR:: dicom tag is missing\n");
    printf(" group=%04x element=%04x\n",p->group,p->element);
    printf("   %s\n",p->name);
    printf(" File: %s\n",cfname);
    return(-1);
  }
  close_file(fp0);
  if(remove("tmp.bin")!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: Fail to remove temporary file\n");
    return(-1);
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int write_tag(FILE *fp,unsigned short group,unsigned short element)
{
  if(fwrite(&group,sizeof(short),1,fp)<1)return(-1);
  if(fwrite(&element,sizeof(short),1,fp)<1)return(-1);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int write_bytes(FILE *fp,int iflag,
		unsigned char *sbuff1, unsigned char *sbuff2)
{
  if(fwrite(sbuff1,sizeof(char),4,fp)<4)return(-1);
  if(iflag==2){
    if(fwrite(sbuff2,sizeof(char),4,fp)<4)return(-1);
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void set_bytes(unsigned int nbytes,int iflag,int ivr,
		unsigned char *sbuff1, unsigned char *sbuff2)
{
  if(iflag==0){
    if(ivr==1){
      if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
	sbuff1[2]=nbytes%256;
	sbuff1[3]=nbytes/256;
      }else{ // File is written in Big Endian
	sbuff1[2]=nbytes/256;
	sbuff1[3]=nbytes%256;
      }
    }else{
      if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
	sbuff1[0]=nbytes%256;
	sbuff1[3]=nbytes/(256*256*256);
	sbuff1[2]=(nbytes-sbuff2[3]*256*256*256)/(256*256);
	sbuff1[1]=(nbytes-sbuff2[3]*256*256*256-sbuff2[2]*256*256)/256;
      }else{ // File is written in Big Endian
	sbuff1[0]=nbytes/(256*256*256);
	sbuff1[1]=(nbytes-sbuff2[0]*256*256*256)/(256*256);
	sbuff1[2]=(nbytes-sbuff2[0]*256*256*256-sbuff2[1]*256*256)/256;
	sbuff1[3]=nbytes%256;
      }
    }
  }else if(iflag==1){
    if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
      sbuff1[2]=nbytes%256;
      sbuff1[3]=nbytes/256;
    }else{ // File is written in Big Endian
      sbuff1[2]=nbytes/256;
      sbuff1[3]=nbytes%256;
    }
  }else if(iflag==2){
    if(ifendian==1){ // File is written in Little Endian
      sbuff2[0]=nbytes%256;
      sbuff2[3]=nbytes/(256*256*256);
      sbuff2[2]=(nbytes-sbuff2[3]*256*256*256)/(256*256);
      sbuff2[1]=(nbytes-sbuff2[3]*256*256*256-sbuff2[2]*256*256)/256;
    }else{ // File is written in Big Endian
      sbuff2[0]=nbytes/(256*256*256);
      sbuff2[1]=(nbytes-sbuff2[0]*256*256*256)/(256*256);
      sbuff2[2]=(nbytes-sbuff2[0]*256*256*256-sbuff2[1]*256*256)/256;
      sbuff2[3]=nbytes%256;
    }
  }
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int write_buff(FILE *fp,unsigned int nbytes,char *buff)
{
  if(fwrite(buff,sizeof(char),nbytes,fp)<nbytes)return(-1);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int readwrite_buff(FILE *fp0,FILE *fp,unsigned int nbytes0)
{
  unsigned int nbytes,nrest;
  char buff[max_cb];
  nrest=nbytes0;
  while(nrest>0){
    nbytes=nrest;
    if(nbytes>max_cb)nbytes=max_cb;
    memset(buff,0,max_cb);
    if(fread(buff,sizeof(char),nbytes,fp0)!=nbytes)return(-1);
    if(fwrite(buff,sizeof(char),nbytes,fp)!=nbytes)return(-1);
    nrest=nrest-nbytes;
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int overwrite_cshort(FILE *fp, struct TARGETTAG *p, char *cshort)
{
  unsigned int nbytes;
  int ierr;
  nbytes=strlen(cshort);
  nbytes=((nbytes+1)/2)*2;
  ierr=overwrite_dicomheader(fp,p,nbytes,cshort);
  return(ierr);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int overwrite_IS(FILE *fp, struct TARGETTAG *p, int idata)
{
  unsigned int nbytes;
  char mbuff[256];
  int ierr;
  memset(mbuff,0,256);
  sprintf(mbuff,"%d",idata);
  nbytes=strlen(mbuff);
  nbytes=((nbytes+1)/2)*2;
  ierr=overwrite_dicomheader(fp,p,nbytes,mbuff);
  return(ierr);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int overwrite_US(FILE *fp, struct TARGETTAG *p, int idata)
{
  unsigned int nbytes;
  unsigned short data;
  char *mbuff;
  int ierr;
  data=(unsigned short)idata;
  if(imatch!=0)data=BS_INT16(data);
  mbuff=(char *)&data;
  nbytes=sizeof(short);
  ierr=overwrite_dicomheader(fp,p,nbytes,mbuff);
  return(ierr);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int overwrite_DS(FILE *fp, struct TARGETTAG *p, double data)
{
  unsigned int nbytes;
  char mbuff[256];
  int ierr;
  memset(mbuff,0,256);
  sprintf(mbuff,"%G",data);
  nbytes=strlen(mbuff);
  nbytes=((nbytes+1)/2)*2;
  ierr=overwrite_dicomheader(fp,p,nbytes,mbuff);
  return(ierr);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int overwrite_DS2(FILE *fp, struct TARGETTAG *p, double data1, double data2)
{
  unsigned int nbytes;
  char mbuff[256];
  int ierr;
  memset(mbuff,0,256);
  sprintf(mbuff,"%G\\%G ",data1,data2);
  nbytes=strlen(mbuff);
  nbytes=((nbytes+1)/2)*2;
  ierr=overwrite_dicomheader(fp,p,nbytes,mbuff);
  return(ierr);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int overwrite_DS3(FILE *fp, struct TARGETTAG *p,
		  double data1, double data2, double data3)
{
  unsigned int nbytes;
  char mbuff[256];
  int ierr;
  memset(mbuff,0,256);
  sprintf(mbuff,"%G\\%G\\%G ",data1,data2,data3);
  nbytes=strlen(mbuff);
  nbytes=((nbytes+1)/2)*2;
  ierr=overwrite_dicomheader(fp,p,nbytes,mbuff);
  return(ierr);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int overwrite_DSseq(FILE *fp, struct TARGETTAG *p, int ngrid, double zdel)
{
  unsigned int nbytes;
  char mbuff[256],lbuff[max_cb];
  int i,ierr;
  double data;
  memset(lbuff,0,max_cb);
  data=0.0;
  sprintf(lbuff,"%G",data);
  for(i=1;i<ngrid;i++){
    memset(mbuff,0,256);
    data+=zdel;
    sprintf(mbuff,"\\%G",data);
    strcat(lbuff,mbuff);
  }
  nbytes=strlen(lbuff);
  nbytes=((nbytes+1)/2)*2;
  ierr=overwrite_dicomheader(fp,p,nbytes,lbuff);
  return(ierr);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void get_error(struct TARGETTAG *p)
{
  printf(" ERROR:: dicom tag is missing\n");
  printf(" Group=%04x Element=%04x\n",p->group,p->element);
  printf("   %s\n",p->name);
  exit(-1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void get_warn(struct TARGETTAG *p)
{
  printf(" WARNING:: Dicom tag is missing\n");
  printf(" Group=%04x Element=%04x\n",p->group,p->element);
  printf("   %s\n",p->name);
  itagjump[p->num]=1;
}

/***************************************************************************/
/* PROGRAM dicomreader                                                     */
/*                                                                         */
/*   Created by T. Furuta @ JAEA on 2022/03/20                             */
/*     under collaboration between JAEA and QST                            */
/*                                                                         */
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*                                                                         */
/*   Purpose                                                               */
/*        Read DICOM binary file and display in text                       */
/*                                                                         */
/*   Last modified by T. Furuta on 2022/03/20                              */
/***************************************************************************/
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include "dicomlib.h"
#include "utllib.h"
/********** Module variables ***********************************************/
int ifendian=0,imendian=0,imatch;
char Fout[1024];

/********** Interface functions ********************************************/

int main(int argc, char *argv[])
{
  char Fname[1024];
  FILE *fp;
  int len;

/*--------- Input --------------------------------------------------------*/
  if(argc==1){
    printf(" ERROR:: DICOM file name should be specified after EXECUTABLE\n");
    exit(1);
  }
  len=strlen(argv[1]);
  memset(Fname,0,1024);
  strncpy(Fname,argv[1],len);
  imendian=eval_imendian();

/*--------- Read DICOM header --------------------------------------------*/
  if(open_file(&fp,Fname,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);
  if(eval_ifendian(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
  //printf("imendian=%d ifendian=%d imatch=%d\n",imendian,ifendian,imatch);

  printf("# -----------------------------------------------------------\n");
  if(readwrite_dicomheader(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
  printf("# -----------------------------------------------------------\n");

  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);

  printf("# *** DICOMreader successfully finished *********************\n");
  return(0);
}

FILE: src/dmhcreater.c
BEGIN_FILE
/***************************************************************************/
/* PROGRAM DMHcreater                                                      */
/*                                                                         */
/*   Created by T. Furuta @ JAEA on 2026/02/27                             */
/*                                                                         */
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*                                                                         */
/*   Purpose                                                               */
/*        Create DMH from RT dose files                                    */
/*                                                                         */
/*   Last modified by T. Furuta on 2026/03/04                              */
/***************************************************************************/
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <float.h>
#include <math.h>
#include "dicomlib.h"
#include "utllib.h"
#define MAXLINE 256
/********** Module variables ***********************************************/
int ifendian=0,imendian=0,imatch;
char Fout[1024];
float version=1.00;
void dsp_header(void);

/********** Interface functions ********************************************/

int main()
{
  char Frtdose[1024],Foutdir[1024],Fout[1024],Finter[1024],Fin[1024];
  char Cnum[1024];
  char *Frtpart=NULL;
  FILE *fp,*fp1;
  int i,j,ngrid[3],ngrid0[3],ndata,ndata0;
  int ie,ne,jhigh,jout,jcut,jzero,ntot;
  int ipart,npart,ifROI,iROIoption,iDMHform;
  int iflog,ifzero;
  int iROI,nROI;
  char *ind,*ind2;
  double emin,edel,emax,etot,xnorm;
  char dummy[1024],sign0[11]="DMHCREATER",sign1[11]="DVHCREATER";
  char filename[1024];
  char croiinfofile[12]="roiinfo.dat";
  float ediff;
  float *data=NULL,*datapart=NULL;
  double *edmh=NULL,*edmhpart=NULL;
  int *idata=NULL,*jdata=NULL;
  int *ndmh=NULL;
  double *ddmh=NULL,*ddata=NULL;
  char *cpointer;
  int *numROI;
  double *volROI;
  char *nameROI;
  char line[MAXLINE];
  size_t ncap=0;
  int iuniv,nuniv,*iunivarray=NULL;
  double dens,dtot,dzero,*densarray=NULL;

/*--------- Header display -----------------------------------------------*/
  dsp_header();
/*--------- Input --------------------------------------------------------*/
  if(get_fname("Type DMHCEATER to run dmhcreater",dummy)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(strncmp(dummy,sign0,11)!=0&&strncmp(dummy,sign1,11)!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: signature DMHCREATER is not confirmed\n");
    printf(" This input may not be for dmhcreater\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(get_fname("Name of RTdose file with PATH for DMH",Frtdose)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_int("Number of additional RTdose files for partial DMH",&npart)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(npart>0){
    Frtpart=(char *)calloc(npart,sizeof(char)*1024);
  }
  for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
    memset(dummy,0,1024);
    if(get_fname("Name of RTdose file with PATH for partial DMH",dummy)!=0)exit(-1);
    memcpy(Frtpart+ipart*1024,dummy,1024);
  }
  if(get_fname("Directory for output (PHITSinput/)",Foutdir)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_fname("Directory for intermediate files (DATfiles/)",Finter)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_int("Consideration of ROI; 0:No 1:Yes",&ifROI)!=0)exit(-1);
  imendian=eval_imendian();
/*--------- Input2 -------------------------------------------------------*/
  if(get_int("Linear scale or log scale; 0:linear 1:log",&iflog)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_double("Min. limit of dose bin",&emin)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_double("Max. limit of dose bin",&emax)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_int("Number of energy bin",&ne)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_int("Zero dose voxel; 0:including 1:excluding",&ifzero)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_int("DMH format; 0:Differential 1:Cumulative",&iDMHform)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(iflog==1){
    if(emin<=0.0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Min. Dose %g needs to be larger than 0 for log scale\n",
	     emin);
      printf(" WARNING:: Min. Dose = 0.0001 * Max. Dose is adopted\n");
      emin=0.0001*emax;
    }
    edel=(log(emax)-log(emin))/(double)ne;
  }else{
    if(emin>0.0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Min. Dose = 0 is adopted for linear scale\n");
      emin=0.0;
    }
    edel=(emax-emin)/(double)ne;
  }
  ndmh=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*ne);
  ddmh=(double *)malloc(sizeof(double)*ne);
  edmh=(double *)malloc(sizeof(double)*ne);
/*--------- Read RTdose --------------------------------------------------*/
  if(open_file(&fp1,Frtdose,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);
  if(check_file(fp1,"RTDOSE")!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: %s is not RTDOSE file\n",Frtdose);
    exit(-1);
  }
  get_RTdoseheader(fp1,ngrid,&xnorm);
  ndata=ngrid[0]*ngrid[1]*ngrid[2];
  jdata=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*ndata);
  data=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*ndata);
  get_RTdosedata(fp1,ndata,xnorm,data);
  if(close_file(fp1)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(npart>0){
    edmhpart=(double *)malloc(sizeof(double)*ne*npart);
    datapart=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*ndata*npart);
    for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
      if(open_file(&fp1,Frtpart+ipart*1024,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);
      if(check_file(fp1,"RTDOSE")!=0)exit(-1);
      get_RTdoseheader(fp1,ngrid0,&xnorm);
      for(i=0;i<3;i++){
	if(ngrid0[i]!=ngrid[i]){
	  printf(" ERROR:: Inconsistent voxel dimension\n");
	  printf(" %d %d %d for %s\n",ngrid0[0],ngrid0[1],ngrid0[2],Frtpart+ipart*1024);
	  printf(" %d %d %d for %s\n",ngrid[0],ngrid[1],ngrid[2],Frtdose);
	  exit(-1);
	}
      }
      get_RTdosedata(fp1,ndata,xnorm,datapart+ipart*ndata);
      if(close_file(fp1)!=0)exit(-1);
    }
  }
/*--------- Read CTuniverse ----------------------------------------------*/
  memset(Fin,0,1024);
  sprintf(Fin,"%s",Finter);
  strcat(Fin,"CTuniverse.dat\0");
  if(open_file(&fp,Fin,"r")!=0)exit(-1);
  nuniv=0;
  while(fgets(line,MAXLINE,fp)!=NULL){
    if(sscanf(line,"%*d %*d %lf %*d u=%d",&dens,&iuniv)==2){
      if(nuniv==ncap){
	ncap=(ncap==0)?128:ncap*2;
	iunivarray=realloc(iunivarray,ncap*sizeof(int));
	densarray=realloc(densarray,ncap*sizeof(double));
      }
      iunivarray[nuniv]=iuniv;
      densarray[nuniv]=-dens;
      nuniv=nuniv+1;
    }
  }
  if(nuniv==0){
    printf(" ERROR:: no universe data found in %s\n",Fin);
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
/*--------- Read CTvoxel & Set mass --------------------------------------*/
  ddata=(double *)malloc(sizeof(double)*ndata);
  memset(Fin,0,1024);
  sprintf(Fin,"%s",Finter);
  strcat(Fin,"CTvoxel.dat\0");
  if(open_file(&fp,Fin,"r")!=0)exit(-1);
  ndata0=count_voxel(fp);
  if(ndata0!=ndata){
    printf(" ERROR:: Inconsistent voxel dimension\n");
    printf(" %d for %s\n",ndata0,Fin);
    printf(" %d for %s\n",ndata,Frtdose);
  }
  if(get_voxelmass(fp,nuniv,iunivarray,densarray,ddata)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
/*--------- Read ROIvoxel ------------------------------------------------*/
  if(ifROI==1){
    memset(dummy,0,1024);
    strcpy(dummy,Finter);
    cpointer=strrchr(dummy,'/');
    memcpy(cpointer+1,croiinfofile,12);
    memset(Fin,0,1024);
    strcpy(Fin,dummy);
    if(open_file(&fp,Fin,"r")!=0)exit(-1);
    if(get_int_FP(fp,&iROIoption)!=0)exit(-1);
    if(iROIoption==0){
      if(get_int_FP(fp,&nROI)!=0)exit(-1);
      numROI=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*nROI);
      volROI=(double *)malloc(sizeof(double)*nROI);
      nameROI=(char *)calloc(nROI,sizeof(char)*1024);
      idata=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*ndata*nROI);
      for(i=0;i<nROI;i++){
	fscanf(fp,"%d %s %lf",numROI+i,nameROI+1024*i,volROI+i);
	printf("numROI=%d nameROI=%s volROI=%lf\n",numROI[i],nameROI+1024*i,volROI[i]);
      }
      if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);

      for(i=0;i<nROI;i++){
	memset(Fin,0,1024);
	sprintf(Fin,"%s",Foutdir);
	strcat(Fin,"ROIvoxel_\0");
	strcat(Fin,nameROI+1024*i);
	trim_str(Fin);
	strcat(Fin,".inp\0");
	if(open_file(&fp,Fin,"r")!=0)exit(-1);
	ndata0=count_voxel(fp);
	if(ndata0!=ndata){
	  printf(" ERROR:: Inconsistent voxel dimension\n");
	  printf(" %d for %s\n",ndata0,Fin);
	  printf(" %d for %s\n",ndata,Frtdose);
	  exit(-1);
	}
	if(get_voxel(fp,idata+i*ndata)!=0)exit(-1);
	if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
      }
    }else if(iROIoption==1){
      if(get_int_FP(fp,&nROI)!=0)exit(-1);
      numROI=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*nROI);
      volROI=(double *)malloc(sizeof(double)*nROI);
      idata=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*ndata);
      for(i=0;i<nROI;i++){
	fscanf(fp,"%d %lf",numROI+i,volROI+i);
	printf("numROI=%d volROI=%lf\n",numROI[i],volROI[i]);
      }
      if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
      memset(Fin,0,1024);
      sprintf(Fin,"%s",Foutdir);
      strcat(Fin,"ROIvoxel.inp\0");
      if(open_file(&fp,Fin,"r")!=0)exit(-1);
      ndata0=count_voxel(fp);
      if(ndata0!=ndata){
	printf(" ERROR:: Inconsistent voxel dimension\n");
	printf(" %d for %s\n",ndata0,Fin);
	printf(" %d for %s\n",ndata,Frtdose);
      }
      if(get_voxel(fp,idata)!=0)exit(-1);
      if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
    }else{
      printf(" ERROR:: iROIoption should be 0 or 1: %d\n",iROIoption);
      exit(-1);
    }
  }else{
    nROI=1;
  }
  for(iROI=0;iROI<nROI;iROI++){
/*--------- Compute DMH --------------------------------------------------*/
    if(ifROI==1)printf("numROI=%d\n",numROI[iROI]);
    for(j=0;j<ne;j++){
      ndmh[j]=0;
      ddmh[j]=0.0;
      edmh[j]=0.0;
    }
    if(npart>0){
      for(j=0;j<npart*ne;j++){
	edmhpart[j]=0.0;
      }
    }
    jhigh=0;
    jout=0;
    jcut=0;
    jzero=0;
    dzero=0.0;
    for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
      if(data[i]==0.0){
	j=-2;
      }else if(data[i]<emin){
	j=-1;
      }else{
	if(iflog==0){
	  j=(int)((data[i]-emin)/edel);
	}else{
	  j=(int)((log(data[i])-log(emin))/edel);
	}
      }
      if(ifROI>0){
	if(iROIoption==0){
	  if(idata[i+iROI*ndata]!=numROI[iROI])j=-3;
	}else if (iROIoption==1){
	  if(idata[i]!=numROI[iROI]) j=-3;
	}
      }
      if(j==-3){
	jout++;
	jdata[i]=-2;
      }else if(j==-2){
	jzero++;
	dzero+=ddata[i];
	jdata[i]=-1;
      }else if(j==-1){
	jcut++;
	jdata[i]=0; // < emin is considered as j=0
	ndmh[0]++;
      	ddmh[0]+=ddata[i];
      	edmh[0]+=data[i]*ddata[i];
      }else if(j>=ne){
      	jhigh++;
      	jdata[i]=ne-1; // j>=ne is considered as j=ne-1
	ndmh[ne-1]++;
	ddmh[ne-1]+=ddata[i];
	edmh[ne-1]+=data[i]*ddata[i];
      }else{
	ndmh[j]++;
      	ddmh[j]+=ddata[i];
      	edmh[j]+=data[i]*ddata[i];
      	jdata[i]=j;
      }
    }
    if(npart>0){
      for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
    	for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
    	  j=jdata[i];
	  if(j>=0){
	    edmhpart[j+ipart*ne]+=datapart[i+ipart*ndata]*ddata[i];
	  }
    	}
      }
    }
    if(ifzero==0){
      ndmh[0]+=jzero; // jzero is included in ndmh[0] for ifzero=0
      ddmh[0]+=dzero;
    }
/*--------- Set OutFile --------------------------------------------------*/
    memset(Fout,0,1024);
    sprintf(Fout,"%s",Foutdir);
    strcat(Fout,"dmh_\0");
    memset(dummy,0,1024);
    ind=strrchr(Frtdose,'/');
    ind2=strrchr(Frtdose,'\\');
    if(ind2>ind)ind=ind2;
    if(ind!=0)ind=ind+1;
    ind2=strrchr(ind,'.')-1;
    strncpy(dummy,ind,ind2-ind+1);
    strcat(Fout,dummy);
    if(nROI>1){
      strcat(Fout,"_\0");
      if(iROIoption==0){
	strcat(Fout,nameROI+1024*iROI);
      }else if(iROIoption==1){
	sprintf(Cnum,"%d",numROI[iROI]);
	strcat(Fout,Cnum);
      }
      trim_str(Fout);
    }
    strcat(Fout,".out\0");
    ntot=0;
    etot=0.0;
    dtot=0.0;
    for(ie=0;ie<ne;ie++){
      ntot+=ndmh[ie];
      etot+=edmh[ie];
      dtot+=ddmh[ie];
    }
    if(open_file(&fp,Fout,"w")!=0)exit(-1);
    memcpy(dummy,Frtdose,1024);
    ind=strrchr(dummy,'/');
    ind2=strrchr(dummy,'\\');
    if(ind2>ind)ind=ind2;
    if(ind!=0)ind=ind+1;
    ind2=strrchr(ind,'.')-1;
    memset(filename,0,1024);
    strncpy(filename,ind,ind2-ind+1);
    fprintf(fp,"#emin     emax     DMH(%s) ",filename);
    if(npart>0){
      for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
	memcpy(dummy,Frtpart+ipart*1024,1024);
	ind=strrchr(dummy,'/');
	ind2=strrchr(dummy,'\\');
	if(ind2>ind)ind=ind2;
	if(ind!=0)ind=ind+1;
	ind2=strrchr(ind,'.')-1;
	memset(filename,0,1024);
	strncpy(filename,ind,ind2-ind+1);
	fprintf(fp," %s",filename);
      }
      fprintf(fp,"  Others\n");
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"\n");
    }
/*--------- Cumulative ---------------------------------------------------*/
    if(iDMHform==1){
      for(ie=ne-2;ie>=0;ie--){
	ndmh[ie]+=ndmh[ie+1];
	edmh[ie]+=edmh[ie+1];
	ddmh[ie]+=ddmh[ie+1];
	for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
	  edmhpart[ie+ipart*ne]+=edmhpart[ie+1+ipart*ne];
	}
      }
    }

/*------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    for(ie=0;ie<ne;ie++){
      if(iflog==0){
	if(ntot>0){
	  fprintf(fp,"%g %g %g",edel*ie,edel*(ie+1),ddmh[ie]/dtot);
	}else{
	  fprintf(fp,"%g %g %g",edel*ie,edel*(ie+1),0.0);
	}
      }else{
	if(ntot>0){
	  fprintf(fp,"%g %g %g",
		  emin*exp(edel*ie),
		  emin*exp(edel*(ie+1)),
		  ddmh[ie]/dtot);
	}else{
	  fprintf(fp,"%g %g %g",
		  emin*exp(edel*ie),
		  emin*exp(edel*(ie+1)),
		  0.0);
	}
      }
      if(npart>0){
	if(edmh[ie]>0.0){
	  ediff=edmh[ie];
	  for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
	    fprintf(fp," %g",edmhpart[ie+ipart*ne]/edmh[ie]);
	    ediff-=edmhpart[ie+ipart*ne];
	  }
	  if(ediff>=0.0){
	    fprintf(fp," %g",ediff/edmh[ie]);
	  }else{
	    fprintf(fp," %g",0.0);
	  }
	}else{
	  for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
	    fprintf(fp," %g",0.0);
	  }
	  fprintf(fp," %g",0.0);
	}
      }
      fprintf(fp,"\n");
    }
    if(iDMHform==0){
      printf("Differential DMH\n");
    }else{
      printf("Cumulative DMH\n");
    }
    printf("Number of total voxels accepted         = %d\n",ntot);
    printf("Number of voxels not accepted by ROI    = %d\n",jout);
    if(ifzero==0){
      printf("Number of zero dose voxels (included)   = %d\n",jzero);
    }else{
      printf("Number of zero dose voxels (excluded)   = %d\n",jzero);
    }
    printf("Number of voxels lower than emin        = %d\n",jcut);
    printf("Number of voxels higher than emax       = %d\n",jhigh);
    if(ifROI>0){
      printf("ROI Volume (cm3) = %e\n",volROI[iROI]);
      printf("ROI Mass (g)     = %e\n",dtot/(double)ntot*volROI[iROI]);
    }else{
      printf("ROI Volume (cm3) = %d * (unit voxel volume)\n",ntot);
      printf("ROI Mass (g)     = %e * (unit voxel volume)\n",dtot);
    }
    if(ntot>0){
      printf("Absorbed dose in ROI (Gy) = %e\n",etot/dtot);
    }else{
      printf("Absorbed dose in ROI (Gy) = %e\n",0.0);
    }
    if(iflog==0){
      fprintf(fp,"# Linear\n");
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"# Log\n");
    }
    if(iDMHform==0){
      fprintf(fp,"# Differential DMH\n");
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"# Cumulative DMH\n");
    }
    fprintf(fp,"# Number of total voxels accepted         = %d\n",ntot);
    fprintf(fp,"# Number of voxels not accepted by ROI    = %d\n",jout);
    if(ifzero==0){
      fprintf(fp,"# Number of zero dose voxels (included)   = %d\n",jzero);
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"# Number of zero dose voxels (excluded)   = %d\n",jzero);
    }
    fprintf(fp,"# Number of voxels lower than emin        = %d\n",jcut);
    fprintf(fp,"# Number of voxels higher than emax       = %d\n",jhigh);
    if(ifROI>0){
      fprintf(fp,"# ROI Volume (cm3) = %e\n",volROI[iROI]);
      fprintf(fp,"# ROI Mass (g)     = %e\n",dtot/(double)ntot*volROI[iROI]);
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"# ROI Volume (cm3) = %d * (unit voxel volume)\n",ntot);
      fprintf(fp,"# ROI Mass (g)     = %e * (unit voxel volume)\n",dtot);
    }
    if(ntot>0){
      fprintf(fp,"# Absorbed dose in ROI (Gy) = %g\n",etot/dtot);
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"# Absorbed dose in ROI (Gy) = %g\n",0.0);
    }
    if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
  }
  free(data);
  free(ddata);
  free(iunivarray);
  free(densarray);
  free(ndmh);
  free(ddmh);
  free(edmh);
  free(jdata);
  if(npart>0){
    free(edmhpart);
    free(datapart);
    free(Frtpart);
  }
  if(ifROI>0){
    free(numROI);
    free(volROI);
    if(iROIoption==0)free(nameROI);
    free(idata);
  }

  printf("*** DMHCREATER successfully finished *********************\n");
  return(0);
}
/***************************************************************************/
void dsp_header()
{
  printf("***********************************************************\n");
  printf("*     PROGRAM DMHcreater                                  *\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("*        Created by T. Furuta @ JAEA,                     *\n");
  printf("*                      on 2026/02/27                      *\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("*---------------------------------------------------------*\n");
  printf("*                   Version = %.2f                        *\n",version);
  printf("*---------------------------------------------------------*\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("*     Purpose                                             *\n");
  printf("*        Create DMH from RT-dose files                    *\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("***********************************************************\n");
  return;
}
END_FILE

FILE: src/dvhcreater.c
BEGIN_FILE
/***************************************************************************/
/* PROGRAM DVHcreater                                                      */
/*                                                                         */
/*   Created by T. Furuta @ JAEA on 2022/03/20                             */
/*     under collaboration between JAEA and QST                            */
/*                                                                         */
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*                                                                         */
/*   Purpose                                                               */
/*        Create DVH from RT dose files                                    */
/*                                                                         */
/*   Last modified by T. Furuta on 2026/03/04                              */
/***************************************************************************/
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <float.h>
#include <math.h>
#include "dicomlib.h"
#include "utllib.h"
/********** Module variables ***********************************************/
int ifendian=0,imendian=0,imatch;
char Fout[1024];
float version=1.00;
void dsp_header(void);

/********** Interface functions ********************************************/

int main()
{
  char Frtdose[1024],Foutdir[1024],Fout[1024],Finter[1024],Fin[1024];
  char Cnum[1024];
  char *Frtpart=NULL;
  FILE *fp,*fp1;
  int i,j,ngrid[3],ngrid0[3],ndata,ndata0;
  int ie,ne,jhigh,jout,jcut,jzero,ntot;
  int ipart,npart,ifROI,iROIoption,iDVHform;
  int iflog,ifzero;
  int iROI,nROI;
  char *ind,*ind2;
  double emin,edel,emax,etot,xnorm;
  char dummy[1024],sign0[11]="DVHCREATER";
  char filename[1024];
  char croiinfofile[12]="roiinfo.dat";
  float ediff;
  float *data=NULL,*datapart=NULL;
  float *edvh=NULL,*edvhpart=NULL;
  int *idata=NULL,*jdata=NULL;
  int *ndvh=NULL;
  char *cpointer;
  int *numROI;
  double *volROI;
  char *nameROI;

/*--------- Header display -----------------------------------------------*/
  dsp_header();
/*--------- Input --------------------------------------------------------*/
  if(get_fname("Type DVHCEATER to run dvhcreater",dummy)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(strncmp(dummy,sign0,11)!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: signature DVHCREATER is not confirmed\n");
    printf(" This input may not be for dvhcreater\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(get_fname("Name of RTdose file with PATH for DVH",Frtdose)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_int("Number of additional RTdose files for partial DVH",&npart)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(npart>0){
    Frtpart=(char *)calloc(npart,sizeof(char)*1024);
  }
  for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
    memset(dummy,0,1024);
    if(get_fname("Name of RTdose file with PATH for partial DVH",dummy)!=0)exit(-1);
    memcpy(Frtpart+ipart*1024,dummy,1024);
  }
  if(get_fname("Directory for output (PHITSinput/)",Foutdir)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_fname("Directory for intermediate files (DATfiles/)",Finter)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_int("Consideration of ROI; 0:No 1:Yes",&ifROI)!=0)exit(-1);
  imendian=eval_imendian();
/*--------- Input2 -------------------------------------------------------*/
  if(get_int("Linear scale or log scale; 0:linear 1:log",&iflog)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_double("Min. limit of dose bin",&emin)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_double("Max. limit of dose bin",&emax)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_int("Number of energy bin",&ne)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_int("Zero dose voxel; 0:including 1:excluding",&ifzero)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_int("DVH format; 0:Differential 1:Cumulative",&iDVHform)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(iflog==1){
    if(emin<=0.0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Min. Dose %g needs to be larger than 0 for log scale\n",
	     emin);
      printf(" WARNING:: Min. Dose = 0.0001 * Max. Dose is adopted\n");
      emin=0.0001*emax;
    }
    edel=(log(emax)-log(emin))/(double)ne;
  }else{
    if(emin>0.0){
      printf(" WARNING:: Min. Dose = 0 is adopted for linear scale\n");
      emin=0.0;
    }
    edel=(emax-emin)/(double)ne;
  }
  ndvh=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*ne);
  edvh=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*ne);
/*--------- Read RTdose --------------------------------------------------*/
  if(open_file(&fp1,Frtdose,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);
  if(check_file(fp1,"RTDOSE")!=0)exit(-1);
  get_RTdoseheader(fp1,ngrid,&xnorm);
  ndata=ngrid[0]*ngrid[1]*ngrid[2];
  jdata=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*ndata);
  data=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*ndata);
  get_RTdosedata(fp1,ndata,xnorm,data);
  if(close_file(fp1)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(npart>0){
    edvhpart=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*ne*npart);
    datapart=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*ndata*npart);
    for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
      if(open_file(&fp1,Frtpart+ipart*1024,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);
      if(check_file(fp1,"RTDOSE")!=0)exit(-1);
      get_RTdoseheader(fp1,ngrid0,&xnorm);
      for(i=0;i<3;i++){
	if(ngrid0[i]!=ngrid[i]){
	  printf(" ERROR:: Inconsistent voxel dimension\n");
	  printf(" %d %d %d for %s\n",ngrid0[0],ngrid0[1],ngrid0[2],Frtpart+ipart*1024);
	  printf(" %d %d %d for %s\n",ngrid[0],ngrid[1],ngrid[2],Frtdose);
	  exit(-1);
	}
      }
      get_RTdosedata(fp1,ndata,xnorm,datapart+ipart*ndata);
      if(close_file(fp1)!=0)exit(-1);
    }
  }

/*--------- Read ROIvoxel ------------------------------------------------*/
  if(ifROI==1){
    memset(dummy,0,1024);
    strcpy(dummy,Finter);
    cpointer=strrchr(dummy,'/');
    memcpy(cpointer+1,croiinfofile,12);
    memset(Fin,0,1024);
    strcpy(Fin,dummy);
    if(open_file(&fp,Fin,"r")!=0)exit(-1);
    if(get_int_FP(fp,&iROIoption)!=0)exit(-1);
    if(iROIoption==0){
      if(get_int_FP(fp,&nROI)!=0)exit(-1);
      numROI=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*nROI);
      volROI=(double *)malloc(sizeof(double)*nROI);
      nameROI=(char *)calloc(nROI,sizeof(char)*1024);
      idata=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*ndata*nROI);
      for(i=0;i<nROI;i++){
	fscanf(fp,"%d %s %lf",numROI+i,nameROI+1024*i,volROI+i);
	printf("numROI=%d nameROI=%s volROI=%lf\n",numROI[i],nameROI+1024*i,volROI[i]);
      }
      if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);

      for(i=0;i<nROI;i++){
	memset(Fin,0,1024);
	sprintf(Fin,"%s",Foutdir);
	strcat(Fin,"ROIvoxel_\0");
	strcat(Fin,nameROI+1024*i);
	trim_str(Fin);
	strcat(Fin,".inp\0");
	if(open_file(&fp,Fin,"r")!=0)exit(-1);
	ndata0=count_voxel(fp);
	if(ndata0!=ndata){
	  printf(" ERROR:: Inconsistent voxel dimension\n");
	  printf(" %d for %s\n",ndata0,Fin);
	  printf(" %d for %s\n",ndata,Frtdose);
	  exit(-1);
	}
	if(get_voxel(fp,idata+i*ndata)!=0)exit(-1);
	if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
      }
    }else if(iROIoption==1){
      if(get_int_FP(fp,&nROI)!=0)exit(-1);
      numROI=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*nROI);
      volROI=(double *)malloc(sizeof(double)*nROI);
      idata=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*ndata);
      for(i=0;i<nROI;i++){
	fscanf(fp,"%d %lf",numROI+i,volROI+i);
	printf("numROI=%d volROI=%lf\n",numROI[i],volROI[i]);
      }
      if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
      memset(Fin,0,1024);
      sprintf(Fin,"%s",Foutdir);
      strcat(Fin,"ROIvoxel.inp\0");
      if(open_file(&fp,Fin,"r")!=0)exit(-1);
      ndata0=count_voxel(fp);
      if(ndata0!=ndata){
	printf(" ERROR:: Inconsistent voxel dimension\n");
	printf(" %d for %s\n",ndata0,Fin);
	printf(" %d for %s\n",ndata,Frtdose);
      }
      if(get_voxel(fp,idata)!=0)exit(-1);
      if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
    }else{
      printf(" ERROR:: iROIoption should be 0 or 1: %d\n",iROIoption);
      exit(-1);
    }
  }else{
    nROI=1;
  }
  for(iROI=0;iROI<nROI;iROI++){
/*--------- Compute DVH --------------------------------------------------*/
    if(ifROI==1)printf("numROI=%d\n",numROI[iROI]);
    for(j=0;j<ne;j++){
      ndvh[j]=0;
      edvh[j]=0.0;
    }
    if(npart>0){
      for(j=0;j<npart*ne;j++){
	edvhpart[j]=0.0;
      }
    }
    jhigh=0;
    jout=0;
    jcut=0;
    jzero=0;
    for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
      if(data[i]==0.0){
	j=-2;
      }else if(data[i]<emin){
	j=-1;
      }else{
	if(iflog==0){
	  j=(int)((data[i]-emin)/edel);
	}else{
	  j=(int)((log(data[i])-log(emin))/edel);
	}
      }
      if(ifROI>0){
	if(iROIoption==0){
	  if(idata[i+iROI*ndata]!=numROI[iROI])j=-3;
	}else if (iROIoption==1){
	  if(idata[i]!=numROI[iROI]) j=-3;
	}
      }
      if(j==-3){
	jout++;
	jdata[i]=-2;
      }else if(j==-2){
	jzero++;
	jdata[i]=-1;
      }else if(j==-1){
	jcut++;
	jdata[i]=0; // < emin is considered as j=0
      	ndvh[0]++;
      	edvh[0]+=data[i];
      }else if(j>=ne){
      	jhigh++;
      	jdata[i]=ne-1; // j>=ne is considered as j=ne-1
	ndvh[ne-1]++;
	edvh[ne-1]+=data[i];
      }else{
      	ndvh[j]++;
      	edvh[j]+=data[i];
      	jdata[i]=j;
      }
    }
    if(npart>0){
      for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
    	for(i=0;i<ndata;i++){
    	  j=jdata[i];
	  if(j>=0){
	    edvhpart[j+ipart*ne]+=datapart[i+ipart*ndata];
	  }
    	}
      }
    }
    if(ifzero==0)ndvh[0]+=jzero; // jzero is included in ndvh[0] for ifzero=0
/*--------- Set OutFile --------------------------------------------------*/
    memset(Fout,0,1024);
    sprintf(Fout,"%s",Foutdir);
    strcat(Fout,"dvh_\0");
    memset(dummy,0,1024);
    ind=strrchr(Frtdose,'/');
    ind2=strrchr(Frtdose,'\\');
    if(ind2>ind)ind=ind2;
    if(ind!=0)ind=ind+1;
    ind2=strrchr(ind,'.')-1;
    strncpy(dummy,ind,ind2-ind+1);
    strcat(Fout,dummy);
    if(nROI>1){
      strcat(Fout,"_\0");
      if(iROIoption==0){
	strcat(Fout,nameROI+1024*iROI);
      }else if(iROIoption==1){
	sprintf(Cnum,"%d",numROI[iROI]);
	strcat(Fout,Cnum);
      }
      trim_str(Fout);
    }
    strcat(Fout,".out\0");
    etot=0.0;
    ntot=0;
    for(ie=0;ie<ne;ie++){
      etot+=edvh[ie];
      ntot+=ndvh[ie];
    }
    if(open_file(&fp,Fout,"w")!=0)exit(-1);
    memcpy(dummy,Frtdose,1024);
    ind=strrchr(dummy,'/');
    ind2=strrchr(dummy,'\\');
    if(ind2>ind)ind=ind2;
    if(ind!=0)ind=ind+1;
    ind2=strrchr(ind,'.')-1;
    memset(filename,0,1024);
    strncpy(filename,ind,ind2-ind+1);
    fprintf(fp,"#emin     emax     DVH(%s) ",filename);
    if(npart>0){
      for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
	memcpy(dummy,Frtpart+ipart*1024,1024);
	ind=strrchr(dummy,'/');
	ind2=strrchr(dummy,'\\');
	if(ind2>ind)ind=ind2;
	if(ind!=0)ind=ind+1;
	ind2=strrchr(ind,'.')-1;
	memset(filename,0,1024);
	strncpy(filename,ind,ind2-ind+1);
	fprintf(fp," %s",filename);
      }
      fprintf(fp,"  Others\n");
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"\n");
    }
/*--------- Cumulative ---------------------------------------------------*/
    if(iDVHform==1){
      for(ie=ne-2;ie>=0;ie--){
	ndvh[ie]+=ndvh[ie+1];
	edvh[ie]+=edvh[ie+1];
	for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
	  edvhpart[ie+ipart*ne]+=edvhpart[ie+1+ipart*ne];
	}
      }
    }

/*------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    for(ie=0;ie<ne;ie++){
      if(iflog==0){
	if(ntot>0){
	  fprintf(fp,"%g %g %g",edel*ie,edel*(ie+1),ndvh[ie]/(double)ntot);
	}else{
	  fprintf(fp,"%g %g %g",edel*ie,edel*(ie+1),0.0);
	}
      }else{
	if(ntot>0){
	  fprintf(fp,"%g %g %g",
		  emin*exp(edel*ie),
		  emin*exp(edel*(ie+1)),
		  ndvh[ie]/(double)ntot);
	}else{
	  fprintf(fp,"%g %g %g",
		  emin*exp(edel*ie),
		  emin*exp(edel*(ie+1)),
		  0.0);
	}
      }
      if(npart>0){
	if(edvh[ie]>0.0){
	  ediff=edvh[ie];
	  for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
	    fprintf(fp," %g",edvhpart[ie+ipart*ne]/edvh[ie]);
	    ediff-=edvhpart[ie+ipart*ne];
	  }
	  if(ediff>=0.0){
	    fprintf(fp," %g",ediff/edvh[ie]);
	  }else{
	    fprintf(fp," %g",0.0);
	  }
	}else{
	  for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
	    fprintf(fp," %g",0.0);
	  }
	  fprintf(fp," %g",0.0);
	}
      }
      fprintf(fp,"\n");
    }
    if(iDVHform==0){
      printf("Differential DVH\n");
    }else{
      printf("Cumulative DVH\n");
    }
    printf("Number of total voxels accepted         = %d\n",ntot);
    printf("Number of voxels not accepted by ROI    = %d\n",jout);
    if(ifzero==0){
      printf("Number of zero dose voxels (included)   = %d\n",jzero);
    }else{
      printf("Number of zero dose voxels (excluded)   = %d\n",jzero);
    }
    printf("Number of voxels lower than emin        = %d\n",jcut);
    printf("Number of voxels higher than emax       = %d\n",jhigh);
    if(ntot>0){
      printf("Mean absorbed dose in each voxel = %e\n",etot/(double)ntot);
    }else{
      printf("Mean absorbed dose in each voxel = %e\n",0.0);
    }
    if(iflog==0){
      fprintf(fp,"# Linear\n");
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"# Log\n");
    }
    if(iDVHform==0){
      fprintf(fp,"# Differential DVH\n");
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"# Cumulative DVH\n");
    }
    fprintf(fp,"# Number of total voxels accepted         = %d\n",ntot);
    fprintf(fp,"# Number of voxels not accepted by ROI    = %d\n",jout);
    if(ifzero==0){
      fprintf(fp,"# Number of zero dose voxels (included)   = %d\n",jzero);
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"# Number of zero dose voxels (excluded)   = %d\n",jzero);
    }
    fprintf(fp,"# Number of voxels lower than emin        = %d\n",jcut);
    fprintf(fp,"# Number of voxels higher than emax       = %d\n",jhigh);
    if(ntot>0){
      fprintf(fp,"# Mean absorbed dose in each voxel (Gy) = %g\n",etot/(double)ntot);
    }else{
      fprintf(fp,"# Mean absorbed dose in each voxel (Gy) = %g\n",0.0);
    }
    if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
  }
  free(data);
  free(ndvh);
  free(edvh);
  free(jdata);
  if(npart>0){
    free(edvhpart);
    free(datapart);
    free(Frtpart);
  }
  if(ifROI>0){
    free(numROI);
    free(volROI);
    if(iROIoption==0)free(nameROI);
    free(idata);
  }

  printf("*** DVHCREATER successfully finished *********************\n");
  return(0);
}

FILE: src/fitbiomod.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
      module fitbio
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer,parameter :: maxpara=50 ! maximum number of parameter
      integer,parameter :: maxdata=1000000 ! maximum number of data
      integer,parameter :: maxiteration=50 ! maximum number of iteration
      integer,parameter :: mpara=2 ! real number of parameter
      integer :: mdata           ! real number of fitting data
      integer :: kfix(maxpara)   ! 0:free parameter, 1:fixed parameter
      integer :: icst(maxpara)   ! integer constant parameter
      real(8) :: ainit(maxpara)  ! initial values of the parameters
      real(8) :: acurr(maxpara)  ! current values of the parameters
      real(8) :: datx(maxdata),daty(maxdata)
      real(8) :: weight(maxdata) ! data used for the fitting
      real(8) :: dSda(maxpara)   ! dS/da for each differential a
      real(8) :: d2Sda2(maxpara,maxpara)  ! double differential d2S/da2
      real(8) :: ea(maxpara)     ! differential step for each parameter a
      real(8) :: cst(maxpara)    ! constant parameter (not fitting parameter)
      real(8) :: lambda          ! lambda value for Levenberg-Marquardt Method
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine FITdecaybio(ntiming,Tm,actfit,decaybio)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: ntiming
      real(8),intent(in) :: Tm(ntiming)
      real(8),intent(in) :: actfit(ntiming)
      real(8),intent(out) :: decaybio
      real(8),parameter :: athreshold=100.0d0 ! threshold activity
      integer :: it,ithigh,i1,i2,ierr
      real(8) :: acthigh

      mdata=0
      decaybio=0.0d0

! find maximum activation timing
      acthigh=0.0d0
      ithigh=0
      do it=1,ntiming
       if(actfit(it).gt.acthigh) then
        acthigh=actfit(it)
        ithigh=it
       endif
      enddo

! use data only after the maximum and above threshold
      do it=ithigh,ntiming
       if(actfit(it).gt.athreshold) then ! data exist
        mdata=mdata+1
        datx(mdata)=Tm(it)
        daty(mdata)=actfit(it)
        weight(mdata)=1.0       ! weight is fixed
       endif
      enddo

      if(mdata.ge.3)then        ! at least 3 data required
       i1=1
       i2=mdata
       acurr(1)=log(daty(i1)/daty(i2))/(datx(i2)-datx(i1))
       acurr(2)=daty(i1)/exp(-acurr(1)*datx(i1))
       if(mdata.ge.3) call leastsq(ierr)
       if(acurr(1).gt.0.and.acurr(2).gt.0) decaybio=acurr(1)
      endif

      return
      end
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      function func(x,a)  ! fitting function
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      real(8),intent(in) :: x,a(mpara)
      real(8) :: func
      func=a(2)*exp(-a(1)*x)  ! exponential
      return
      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      function getS(a)
! for this program, getS should be calculated based on integraged data
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      real(8),intent(in) :: a(mpara)
      real(8) :: getS
      integer id
      real(8) :: sum
      sum=0.0
      do id=1,mdata
       sum=sum+weight(id)*(daty(id)-func(datx(id),a))**2
      enddo
      getS=sum
      return
      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine leastsq(ierr)  ! control routine
! subroutines for least-square fitting
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: ierr
      integer,parameter :: maxtime=50 ! number of initial search parameter
      integer :: i,ip,mptmp

      ierr=0
c check the relation of mpara & mdata
      if(mpara.gt.mdata) then
       mptmp=mpara
       do i=1,mpara
        if(kfix(i).eq.1) mptmp=mptmp-1
       enddo
       if(mptmp.gt.mdata) then
        write(6,*) '#Fitting data is too small at ',mdata,
     &       ' compared with parameter at ',mpara
        ierr=1
        return
       endif
      endif

c Set Initial Parameter
      do ip=1,mpara
       ainit(ip)=acurr(ip)
      enddo

c Main calculation loop for direct method
      do i=1,maxtime
c       write(6,*) 'Initial A=',(acurr(ip1),ip1=1,mpara)
       lambda=0.01
       call newton(ierr)  ! least-square fitting by Newton method
c       call newtongauss(ierr) ! least-square fitting by Newton-Gauss method
       if(ierr.eq.0) exit  ! get converged solution
       call direct(ierr)   ! change initial parameters by using direct method
       if(ierr.eq.1) then
!        write(6,*) 'converged by direct method'
!        write(6,*) 'You must check the answer!!'
        ierr=2
        exit
       endif
      enddo
      if(i.eq.maxtime+1) then
!       write(*,*) 'maxtime is not enough!!!'
       ierr=1
       return
      endif

      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine newton(ierr)  ! by Newton method, ierr=0:converged; =1:diverged
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      integer,intent(out) :: ierr
      integer :: it,ip1,ip2
      real(8),parameter :: ealimit=1.0e-1
      real(8) :: Sold,easum

c Main Calculation Loop
      do it=1,maxiteration
       do ip1=1,mpara  ! get single differential values
        dSda(ip1)=getdSda(ip1)
       enddo
       do ip1=1,mpara  ! get double differential values
        do ip2=1,mpara
         d2Sda2(ip1,ip2)=getd2Sda2(ip1,ip2)
        enddo
       enddo
       call GaussJordan ! get solution ea(ip) for simultaneous equations
       easum=0.0
       Sold=getS(acurr)
c       write(6,*) 'Sold=',Sold
       do ip1=1,mpara
        acurr(ip1)=acurr(ip1)+ea(ip1) ! update current parameters
        if(acurr(ip1).ne.0.0) easum=easum+abs(ea(ip1)/acurr(ip1))
       enddo
       if(getS(acurr).gt.Sold) then  ! wrong direction, so try larger lambda
        lambda=lambda*10.0
        if(lambda.gt.1.0e1) then
!         write(6,*) 'lambda is too large'
         ierr=1
         return
        else  ! increase lambda and try again !!
c         write(6,*) 'lambda*10',lambda
         do ip1=1,mpara
          acurr(ip1)=acurr(ip1)-ea(ip1)
         enddo
        endif
       endif
       if(abs(easum).le.ealimit) exit ! differential is too small, so need not further iteration
      enddo
      if(abs(easum).eq.0.or.it.eq.maxiteration+1) then
       ierr=1  ! solution is diversed, so try again
      else
       ierr=0  ! solution is converged
      endif
!      write(6,*) 'Final S=',getS(acurr),' @it=',it
c      write(6,*) (acurr(ipa),ipa=1,mpara)
c      write(6,*) 'Final A=',(acurr(ip1),ip1=1,mpara)

      return
      end

c get S= Sigma((Yi-f(Xi)**2) ! function getS should be in main program
c      function getS(a)
c      include 'least.inc'
c      dimension a(mpara)
c      Sum=0.0
c      do id=1,mdata
c       Sum=Sum+weight(id)*(daty(id)-func(datx(id),a))**2
c      enddo
c      getS=Sum
c      return
c      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      function getdSda(ip1)
!     get dS/da
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      integer,intent(in) :: ip1
      real(8) :: getdSda
      integer :: ip
      real(8) :: da1
      real(8) :: a(mpara)       ! temporary use parameter for progression a
      real(8) :: step

      step=1.0e-5               ! initial step
      getdSda=0.0d0
      da1=0.0d0
      if(kfix(ip1).eq.1) return  ! for fixed parameter
      do ip=1,mpara  ! make temporary a progression
       if(ip.eq.ip1) then
        da1=step*acurr(ip)
        if(da1.eq.0.0d0) da1=step
        a(ip)=acurr(ip)+da1
       else
        a(ip)=acurr(ip)
       endif
      enddo

      getdSda=(getS(a)-getS(acurr))/da1
      return
      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      function getd2Sda2(ip1,ip2)
!     get d2S/da2
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      integer,intent(in) :: ip1,ip2
      real(8) :: getd2Sda2
      integer :: ip
      real(8) :: da1,da2
      real(8) :: a1(mpara)      ! ip1 and ip2 are changed
      real(8) :: a2(mpara) ! only ip1 is changed
      real(8) :: a3(mpara) ! only ip2 is changed
      real(8) :: step

      step=1.0e-5               ! initial step
      da1=0.0d0
      da2=0.0d0
 10   getd2Sda2=0.0

      if(kfix(ip1).eq.1.or.kfix(ip2).eq.1) return  ! for fixed parameter

      do ip=1,mpara ! first set all a data as default, then consider exceptions
       a1(ip)=acurr(ip)
       a2(ip)=acurr(ip)
       a3(ip)=acurr(ip)
       if(ip.eq.ip1) then
        da1=step*acurr(ip)
        if(da1.eq.0.0) da1=step
        a1(ip)=a1(ip)+da1
        a2(ip)=a2(ip)+da1
       endif
       if(ip.eq.ip2) then
        da2=step*acurr(ip)
        if(da2.eq.0.0) da2=step
        a1(ip)=a1(ip)+da2
        a3(ip)=a3(ip)+da2
       endif
      enddo

      getd2Sda2=(getS(a1)-getS(a2)-getS(a3)+getS(acurr))/(da1*da2)
      if(ip1.eq.ip2.and.getd2Sda2.eq.0.0) then ! double differential = 0, so try wide step
       step=step*10.0
       if(step.ge.1.0e-5) then
        getd2Sda2=getS(acurr)*1.0e-10
        return
       endif
       goto 10
      endif

      return
      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine GaussJordan ! S,C parameters are introduced in order to make program simple
!     get solution of coupled-equation by Gauss-Jordan method
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer :: ip,ip1,ip2,ip3,ifree,ifree2
      real(8) :: S(maxpara) ! right side of the equations
      real(8) :: C(maxpara,maxpara) ! coefficient
      real(8) :: divide,times

      do ip=1,mpara
       ea(ip)=0.0  ! Initialization
      enddo

      ifree=0  ! number of free parameter
      do ip1=1,mpara ! make temporary matrix
       if(kfix(ip1).eq.0) then ! ip1 is free parameter
        ifree=ifree+1
        ea(ifree)=0.0   ! Initialized
        S(ifree)=-dSda(ip1)
        ifree2=0
        do ip2=1,mpara
         if(kfix(ip2).eq.0) then ! ip2 is free parameter
          ifree2=ifree2+1
          C(ifree,ifree2)=d2Sda2(ip1,ip2)
          if(ifree.eq.ifree2) C(ifree,ifree2)=
     &         C(ifree,ifree2)*(1.0+lambda) ! Levenberg-Marquardt Method
         endif
        enddo
       endif
      enddo

      do ip1=1,ifree
c      make C(ip1,ip1)=1
       divide=C(ip1,ip1)
       if(divide.eq.0.0) return  ! double differential = 0, so end of iteration
       S(ip1)=S(ip1)/divide
       do ip2=1,ifree
        C(ip1,ip2)=C(ip1,ip2)/divide
       enddo
c      make C(ip2,ip1)=0 (for ip2.ne.ip1)
       do ip2=1,ifree
        if(ip2.ne.ip1) then
         times=C(ip2,ip1)
         S(ip2)=S(ip2)-times*S(ip1)
         do ip3=1,ifree
          C(ip2,ip3)=C(ip2,ip3)-times*C(ip1,ip3)
         enddo
        endif
       enddo
      enddo

      ifree2=0
      do ip=1,mpara
       if(kfix(ip).eq.0) then
        ifree2=ifree2+1
        ea(ip)=S(ifree2)
       endif
      enddo

      return
      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine direct(ierr)
!     change initial parameters by following the direct method
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: ierr

      integer :: ip1,ip2,icheck
      integer :: ksign(mpara) ! step: positive (+1) or negative (-1) or stay (0)
      real(8) :: a1(mpara) ! temporary used parameters
      real(8) :: dstep,Scurr,Splus,Smins

      dstep=0.01  ! direct method step
 10   do ip1=1,mpara
       a1(ip1)=ainit(ip1)  ! initialized all parameters
      enddo
      Scurr=getS(a1)  ! current S value
      icheck=0  ! icheck still 0 after following loop, parameters have not changed

      do ip2=1,mpara
       ksign(ip2)=0 ! initialized ksign
       if(kfix(ip2).eq.0) then ! ip2 is free parameter
        a1(ip2)=ainit(ip2)+dstep*ainit(ip2)
        Splus=getS(a1)
        a1(ip2)=ainit(ip2)-dstep*ainit(ip2)
        Smins=getS(a1)
        if(Splus.lt.Scurr.and.Splus.lt.Smins) ksign(ip2)=1  ! positive
        if(Smins.lt.Scurr.and.Smins.lt.Splus) ksign(ip2)=-1 ! negative
        a1(ip2)=ainit(ip2)  ! reset parameter
        if(ksign(ip2).ne.0) icheck=1
       endif
      enddo
      if(icheck.eq.0) then ! parameters have not changed ! try smaller step
       if(dstep.gt.0.01) then
        dstep=dstep/2.0
c        write(6,*) 'make dstep smaller in subroutine direct',dstep
        goto 10
       else
        ierr=1
        return
       endif
      endif

      do ip2=1,mpara
       ainit(ip2)=ainit(ip2)+ksign(ip2)*dstep*ainit(ip2)  ! update initial parameter
       acurr(ip2)=ainit(ip2)
      enddo

      ierr=0 ! no error occured in the program
      return
      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine leasterr(mpreal,sigp,Vpfinal)
!     obtain uncertainty of fitted parameter
!     subroutines for obtain parameter covariance matrix and
!     asymptotic standard parameter error
!     sigp: asymptotic standard parameter error
!     Vpfinal: =Vp, but dimension size is different
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: mpreal
      real(8),intent(out) :: sigp(mpara)
      real(8),intent(out) :: Vpfinal(maxpara,maxpara)
      integer :: ip,ip1,ip2,id,mp,mp1,mp2
      real(8) :: a1(mpara),a2(mpara),da
      real(8) :: Y(mdata,mpreal) ! Jacobian
      real(8) :: YTW(mpreal,mdata) ! T-matrix of Jacobian multiplied with weight of each data
      real(8) :: YTWY(mpreal,mpreal) ! J^T W J
      real(8) :: Vp(mpreal,mpreal) ! Parameter covariance matrix
      real(8),parameter :: step=0.01d0 ! delta of differential parameter

      Y(:,:)=0.0
      YTW(:,:)=0.0
      YTWY(:,:)=0.0
      Vp(:,:)=0.0
      Vpfinal(:,:)=0.0
      sigp(:)=0.0
      do ip=1,mpara
       a1(ip)=acurr(ip)
      enddo

      mp=0
      do ip1=1,mpara
       if(kfix(ip1).eq.0) then ! only for free parameter
        mp=mp+1
        do ip2=1,mpara
         if(ip1.eq.ip2) then ! take difference parameter
          da=a1(ip1)*step
          a2(ip2)=a1(ip2)+da
         else
          a2(ip2)=a1(ip2)
         endif
        enddo
        call getYElement(Y(1,mp),a1(1),a2(1),da)
       endif
       enddo

      do id=1,mdata
       do ip=1,mp ! mp: real number of free parameter
        YTW(ip,id)=Y(id,ip)*weight(id) ! Transformed matrix of Jacobian multiplied with weight
       enddo
      enddo

      call matrixseki(YTWY,YTW,Y,mp,mdata,mp)

      call inverse(YTWY,Vp,mp) ! obtain Vp: inverse matrix of J^T W J

      mp=0
      do ip=1,mpara
       if(kfix(ip).eq.0) then
        mp=mp+1
        sigp(ip)=sqrt(Vp(mp,mp))
       endif
      enddo

      mp1=0
      do ip1=1,mpara
       if(kfix(ip1).eq.0) then
        mp1=mp1+1
        mp2=0
        do ip2=1,mpara
         if(kfix(ip2).eq.0) then
          mp2=mp2+1
          Vpfinal(ip1,ip2)=Vp(mp1,mp2) ! Vpfinal is used for transfer data
         endif
        enddo
       endif
      enddo

      return
      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine getYelement(Y,a1,a2,da)
!     get Jacobian element
!     subroutines for obtain Jacobian matrix J
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      real(8),intent(out) :: Y(mdata)
      real(8),intent(in) :: a1(mpara) ! original parameter set
      real(8),intent(in) :: a2(mpara) ! differential parameter set
      real(8),intent(in) :: da
      integer :: id
      real(8) :: x

      do id=1,mdata
       x=datx(id)
       Y(id)=(func(x,a2)-func(x,a1))/da
      enddo

      return
      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine matrixseki(a,c1,c2,L,M,N)
! matrix multiplication
! a(L,N): answer matrix
! c1(L,M): matrix 1
! c2(M,N): matrix 2
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer L,M,N
      double precision a(L,N), c1(L,M), c2(M,N)
      double precision sum
      integer iL,iM,iN
      do iL=1,L
       do iN=1,N
        sum=0.0
        do iM=1,M
         sum=sum+c1(iL,iM)*c2(iM,iN)
        enddo
        A(iL,iN)=sum
       enddo
      enddo

      return
      end

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine inverse(a,c,n)
!============================================================
! Inverse matrix
! Method: Based on Doolittle LU factorization for Ax=b
! Alex G. December 2009
!-----------------------------------------------------------
! input ...
! a(n,n) - array of coefficients for matrix A
! n      - dimension
! output ...
! c(n,n) - inverse matrix of A
! comments ...
! the original matrix a(n,n) will be destroyed
! during the calculation
!===========================================================
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer n
      double precision a(n,n), c(n,n)
      double precision L(n,n), U(n,n), b(n), d(n), x(n)
      double precision coeff
      integer i, j, k

! step 0: initialization for matrices L and U and b
! Fortran 90/95 aloows such operations on matrices
      L=0.0
      U=0.0
      b=0.0

! step 1: forward elimination
      do k=1, n-1
         do i=k+1,n
            coeff=a(i,k)/a(k,k)
            L(i,k) = coeff
            do j=k+1,n
               a(i,j) = a(i,j)-coeff*a(k,j)
            end do
         end do
      end do

! Step 2: prepare L and U matrices
! L matrix is a matrix of the elimination coefficient
! + the diagonal elements are 1.0
      do i=1,n
        L(i,i) = 1.0
      end do
! U matrix is the upper triangular part of A
      do j=1,n
        do i=1,j
          U(i,j) = a(i,j)
        end do
      end do

! Step 3: compute columns of the inverse matrix C
      do k=1,n
        b(k)=1.0
        d(1) = b(1)
! Step 3a: Solve Ld=b using the forward substitution
        do i=2,n
          d(i)=b(i)
          do j=1,i-1
            d(i) = d(i) - L(i,j)*d(j)
          end do
        end do
! Step 3b: Solve Ux=d using the back substitution
        x(n)=d(n)/U(n,n)
        do i = n-1,1,-1
          x(i) = d(i)
          do j=n,i+1,-1
            x(i)=x(i)-U(i,j)*x(j)
          end do
          x(i) = x(i)/u(i,i)
        end do
! Step 3c: fill the solutions x(n) into column k of C
        do i=1,n
          c(i,k) = x(i)
        end do
        b(k)=0.0
      end do
      end subroutine inverse

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      end module fitbio
END_FILE
