*********************************************************************
*     PROGRAM InputCreater4PHITS                                    *
*                                                                   *
*         Created by T. Furuta on 2020/10/27                        *
*             Under collaboration between JAEA and NIRS             *
*                                                                   *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  FORTRAN files; "stdmod.f", "devicemodmod.f", "readmod.f"         *
*                 "createmod.f" are required                        *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                                                                   *
*     Purpose                                                       *
*         Create PHITS input file (phits.inp)                       *
*     Required files and a directry for run                         *
*         sourceinfo.dat                                            *
*         phantominfo.dat                                           *
*         tallyinfo.dat                                             *
*         [Additional files CT**.dat for CT image phantom option]   *
*                                                                   *
*     Outputs                                                       *
*         Input file for PHITS (phits.inp)                          *
*         Other files depending on DAT files                        *
*                                                                   *
*         Last modified by T. Furuta on 2026/01/22                  *
*********************************************************************
      PROGRAM InputCreater4PHITS ! Main program
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout
      use readfile, only:READinputs,READplandat,READz0,READpetdat
      use createfile, only:CREATEctinputs,
     &     CREATEphitsin,CREATEphitsinp,
     &     CREATEsourcePETvoxel,CREATEsourcePETintensity,
     &     CREATEdecaybioout,CREATEdensityout
      implicit none
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      real,parameter :: version=3.00
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      integer,parameter :: nimf=8,io=10
      integer :: iparam,isrc,ibeam,iphantom,iorg,ipet,isrcvoxel
      integer :: inum,numbeam
      integer :: itally(11)
      integer :: maxcas,maxbch,iparallel,nomp,nmpi
      integer :: ndimV(3),ndimS(12)
      real(8) :: dimV(18),dimS(9)
      character(LEN=200) :: Cdir,Cinter,Cparamfile,cdata
      character(LEN=2),allocatable :: ctaglist(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: dposlist(:,:),doselist(:),z0list(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: pdata(:,:,:,:),decaybiodata(:,:,:)
      real(8),allocatable :: totalsource(:)
      integer,allocatable :: nvoxels(:)

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Character initiallize
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Display headers
      call DSPheader(version)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Read input file (inputcreate4phits.inp)
      call READinputs(iparam,isrc,ibeam,iphantom,iorg,itally,ipet,
     &     isrcvoxel,maxcas,maxbch,iparallel,nomp,nmpi,
     &     numbeam,ndimV,ndimS,dimV,dimS,
     &     Cdir,Cinter,Cparamfile,cdata)
      allocate(ctaglist(numbeam),dposlist(3,numbeam),doselist(numbeam))
      allocate(z0list(numbeam))
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Copy CT inputs
      if(iphantom.eq.1)then
       call CREATEctinputs(Cinter,Cdir)
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Convert source file
      if(isrc.eq.1)then ! DICOM RT-Plan
       call READplandat(Cinter,numbeam,ctaglist,dposlist,doselist)
       call READz0(numbeam,z0list)
      else
       ctaglist(1)='NO'      ! dummy
       dposlist(1:3,1)=0.0d0 ! dummy
       doselist(1)=0.0d0     ! dummy
       z0list=0.0d0          ! dummy
       if(isrc.eq.2)then        !PET
        allocate(pdata(ndimS(4),ndimS(5),ndimS(6),0:ndimS(7)))
        allocate(decaybiodata(ndimS(4),ndimS(5),ndimS(6)))
        allocate(totalsource(0:ndimS(7)),nvoxels(0:ndimS(7)))
        call READpetdat(Cinter,ndimS,pdata,decaybiodata,totalsource)
        call CREATEsourcePETvoxel(Cdir,ndimV,ndimS,dimV,dimS,
     &       pdata,nvoxels)
        call CREATEsourcePETintensity(Cdir,ndimS(7),ipet,nvoxels,
     &       totalsource)
        call CREATEdecaybioout(Cdir,ndimV,ndimS,dimV,dimS,
     &       decaybiodata)
        call CREATEdensityout(Cdir,ndimV,dimV)
        deallocate(pdata,decaybiodata,totalsource,nvoxels)
       endif
      endif
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      call CREATEphitsin(Cdir,ctaglist(1))
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Create PHITS input
      do inum=1,numbeam
         call CREATEphitsinp(
     &      iparam,isrc,ibeam,iphantom,iorg,itally,ipet,
     &      isrcvoxel,maxcas,maxbch,iparallel,nomp,nmpi,
     &      Cdir,Cparamfile,cdata,ndimV,ndimS,dimV,dimS,
     &      dposlist(1,inum),doselist(inum),z0list(inum),ctaglist(inum))
      enddo
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(istdout,'(2a)')'***************************',
     &     '******************************************'
      write(istdout,*)' INPUTCREATER4PHITS successfully FINISHED !!'
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      deallocate(ctaglist,dposlist,doselist,z0list)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      stop
      end program InputCreater4PHITS

/***************************************************************************/
/*              C functions to deal with DICOM binary files                */
/*                                                                         */
/*                  Created by T. Furuta on 2013/10/10                     */
/*                     Under collaboration between JAEA and RIKEN          */
/*                                                                         */
/*                  Last modified by T. Furuta on 2014/05/09               */
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*   Main routine "ct2phits.f" and                                         */
/*      OS dependent c function "winlib.c" or "nonwinlib.c" are required   */
/***************************************************************************/
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include "dicomlib.h"
/********** Module variables ***********************************************/
int ifendian=0,imendian=0,imatch;
int nx,ny;
int nalloc,nstore,nhigh;
double zthick,xdel,ydel,zdel,zpos;
double xsh[3],xvec[3],yvec[3];
char Fout[1024];
/********** Prototype decllaration *****************************************/
void c_get_dimension_(int *,int *,double *,double *,double *,
		   double *,double *,double *,char *,long);
void c_get_position_(double *,char *,long);
void c_get_data_(double *,int *,char *, long);
void c_get_multidata_(double *,int *,char *, long);
void c_get_ctfiles_(int *, char *, char *,long);
void c_get_petfiles_(int *,int *,int *, char *, char *, char *, long);
void c_get_radioactivity(double *,int *,long);

/********** Interface functions ********************************************/
void c_get_dimension_(int *nx0,int *ny0,double *xdel0,double *ydel0,double *zdel0,
		   double *xsh0,double *xvec0,double *yvec0,
		   char *fname,long l)
{
  FILE *fp;
  if(open_file(&fp,fname,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);

  get_imagedimension(fp,&nx,&ny,&nalloc,
		     &xdel,&ydel,&zdel,
		     xsh,xvec,yvec);

  *nx0=nx;*ny0=ny;
  *xdel0=xdel;*ydel0=ydel;*zdel0=zdel;
  xsh0[0]=xsh[0];xsh0[1]=xsh[1],xsh0[2]=xsh[2];
  xvec0[0]=xvec[0];xvec0[1]=xvec[1],xvec0[2]=xvec[2];
  yvec0[0]=yvec[0];yvec0[1]=yvec[1],yvec0[2]=yvec[2];

  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
  return;
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void c_get_position_(double *zpos0,char *fname,long l)
{
  FILE *fp;
  if(open_file(&fp,fname,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);

  get_imageposition(fp,&zpos);

  *zpos0=zpos;

  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
  return;
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void c_get_data_(double *data,int *ndata,char *fname,long l)
{
  FILE *fp;
  int i,ierr;
  float *data0=NULL;
  if(*ndata!=nx*ny){
    printf(" ERROR:: Contradicting number of data in DICOM: %d %d\n",
	   nx*ny,*ndata);
  }
  if(open_file(&fp,fname,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);

  data0=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*(*ndata));
  ierr=get_CTimagedata(fp,*ndata,nalloc,data0);
  if(ierr!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: DICOM file ended while scanning data\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  for(i=0;i<*ndata;i++){
    data[i]=data0[i];
  }
  free(data0);
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
  return;
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void c_get_multidata_(double *data,int *ndata,char *fname,long l)
{
  FILE *fp;
  int i,ierr;
  float *data0=NULL;
  if(open_file(&fp,fname,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);

  data0=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*(*ndata));
  ierr=get_MULTIimagedata(fp,*ndata,nalloc,data0);
  if(ierr!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: DICOM file ended while scanning data\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  for(i=0;i<*ndata;i++){
    data[i]=data0[i];
  }
  free(data0);
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
  return;
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void c_get_radioactivity_(double *activity,int *halflife,char *fname,long l)
{
  get_radioactivity(fname,activity,halflife);
  return;
}

FILE: src/nonwinlib.c
BEGIN_FILE
/***************************************************************************/
/*              C functions to read filenames in DICOM directory           */
/*                             for non-Windows (Mac and Linux)             */
/*                                                                         */
/*                  Created by T. Furuta on 2014/02/12                     */
/*                     Under collaboration between JAEA and RIKEN          */
/*                                                                         */
/*                  Last modified by T. Furuta on 2023/08/24               */
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*                  Main routine "ct2phits.f" and                          */
/*                     c functions "dicomlib.c" are required               */
/***************************************************************************/
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include "dicomlib.h"
#include "utllib.h"
/********** Module variables ***********************************************/
extern int imendian;
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void c_get_ctfiles_(int *nlist, char *path, char *cmod, long l){
  int i,j,ir;
  FILE *fp;
  char buff[200];
  double sloc;
  struct dirent **namelist;

  if((fp=fopen("tmp.txt","w"))==NULL){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning temporary file: tmp.txt\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  ir=scandir(path, &namelist, NULL, alphasort);
  if(ir == -1){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning DICOM file directory: %s\n",path);
    exit(-1);
  }
  imendian=eval_imendian();
  j=0;
  for(i=0;i<ir;++i){
    if(strcmp(namelist[i]->d_name,".")&&strcmp(namelist[i]->d_name,"..")){
      memset(buff,0,200);
      strcpy(buff,path);
      strcat(buff,namelist[i]->d_name);
      if(get_sloc(buff,&sloc,cmod)==0){
	j++;
	fprintf(fp,"%s %lf\n",namelist[i]->d_name,sloc);
      }
    }
    free(namelist[i]);
  }
  free(namelist);
  *nlist=j;
  fclose(fp);

  return;
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void c_get_petfiles_(int *nslices, int *ntiming, int *imulti, char *path, char *cmod, char *cmod2, long l){
  int i,j,ir,nlist,nlist0,iduration,nframes;
  int iflag[2]={0,0};
  FILE *fp;
  char buff[200];
  double sloc,timing;
  struct dirent **namelist;

  if((fp=fopen("tmp.txt","w"))==NULL){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning temporary file: tmp.txt\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  ir=scandir(path, &namelist, NULL, alphasort);
  if(ir == -1){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning DICOM file directory: %s\n",path);
    exit(-1);
  }
  imendian=eval_imendian();
  j=0;
  *imulti=0;
  for(i=0;i<ir;++i){
    if(strcmp(namelist[i]->d_name,".")&&strcmp(namelist[i]->d_name,"..")){
      memset(buff,0,200);
      strcpy(buff,path);
      strcat(buff,namelist[i]->d_name);
      if(get_sloc_time(buff,&sloc,&timing,&iduration,cmod,iflag)==0){
	j++;
	fprintf(fp,"%s %lf %lf %d\n",namelist[i]->d_name,sloc,timing,iduration);
	if(j==1){
	  get_nslices(buff,nslices,&nlist0);
	  if(get_nframes(buff,&nframes)==0){
	    if(nframes>1)*imulti=1;
	  }
	}
      }
    }
    free(namelist[i]);
  }
  free(namelist);
  if(j==0){
    ir=scandir(path, &namelist, NULL, alphasort);
    for(i=0;i<ir;++i){
      if(strcmp(namelist[i]->d_name,".")&&strcmp(namelist[i]->d_name,"..")){
	memset(buff,0,200);
	strcpy(buff,path);
	strcat(buff,namelist[i]->d_name);
	if(get_sloc_time(buff,&sloc,&timing,&iduration,cmod2,iflag)==0){
	  j++;
	  fprintf(fp,"%s %lf %lf %d\n",namelist[i]->d_name,sloc,timing,iduration);
	  if(j==1){
	    get_nslices(buff,nslices,&nlist0);
	    if(get_nframes(buff,&nframes)==0){
	      if(nframes>1)*imulti=1;
	    }
	  }
	}
      }
      free(namelist[i]);
    }
    free(namelist);
  }
  nlist=j;
  if(nlist!=0){
    if(*imulti==1){
      if(nframes % (*nslices)!=0){
	printf(" ERROR:: # of frames is inconsistent\n");
	printf("         # of slices: %d, # of frames: %d\n",
	       *nslices,nframes);
	exit(-1);
      }
      *ntiming=nframes/(*nslices);
    }else{
      if(*nslices<=1){
	*nslices=nlist;
	printf(" WARNING:: ntiming=1 is assumed\n");
      }
      if(nlist0!=0){
	if(nlist!=nlist0){
	  printf(" ERROR:: # of files is inconsistent\n");
	  printf("         # of files required: %d, # of files existed: %d\n",
		 nlist0,nlist);
	  exit(-1);
	}
      }
      if(nlist % (*nslices)!=0){
	printf(" ERROR:: # of files is inconsistent\n");
	printf("         # of slices: %d, # of files existed: %d\n",
	       *nslices,nlist);
	exit(-1);
      }
      *ntiming=nlist/(*nslices);
    }
  }else{
    *nslices=0;
    *ntiming=0;
  }
  fclose(fp);
  return;
}
END_FILE

FILE: src/pet2phits.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
*     PROGRAM pet2phits                                             *
*                                                                   *
*         Created by T. Sato and T. Furuta on 2021/01/06            *
*         Under collaboration between JAEA and Osaka Univ Hospital  *
*                                                                   *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  C files; "dicomlib.c", "utllib.c", "interface.f",                *
*  OS dependent C files; "winlib.c" or "nonwinlib.c",               *
*  FORTRAN files; "stdmod.f", "readpetmod.f", "createpetmod.f"      *
*                 "fitbiomod.f" are required                        *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                                                                   *
*     Purpose                                                       *
*         Convert DICOM PET data to PHITS source input              *
*     Required files and a directry for run                         *
*         DICOM PET file directory                                  *
*     Outputs (DAT files)                                           *
*         Setting info (sourceinfo.dat)                             *
*         Becquerel data (bqdata.dat)                               *
*         Biological deacay data (decaybio.dat)                     *
*         Other intermediate files (pettmpparam.dat,pettmpdate.dat) *
*                                                                   *
*         Last modified by T. Furuta on 2026/02/27                  *
*********************************************************************
      PROGRAM pet2phits ! Main program
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout
      use readpet, only:READpetinputs,READheader,READmultiframeheader,
     &     READpetdata,READmultiframedata,READfilenames,READdirectory,
     &     READpetparam,READpettmpdata,READdecaybiodata,
     &     ALLOCATEfilenames,DEALLOCATEfilenames,
     &     ALLOCATEzloctime,DEALLOCATEzloctime
      use createpet, only:CREATEbqdata,CREATEpetparam,CREATEpettmpdata,
     &     CREATEdecaybiodata,CREATEsourceinfo
      implicit none
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      real,parameter :: version=4.00
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      integer :: nxnum,nynum,nznum
      integer :: nslices,ntiming
      integer :: ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax,izmin,izmax
      integer :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      integer :: ireaddir,iradflag(5),inorm
      integer :: nlist,ilist,ilist2,imulti
      integer :: it
      integer,allocatable :: izlist(:,:)
      real(8),allocatable :: tlist(:,:),decaybiodata(:,:,:)
      real(8),allocatable :: pdata(:,:,:,:),pidata(:,:,:)
      real(8),allocatable :: totalsource(:)
      real(8) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      real(8) :: xorg,yorg,zorg
      real(8) :: xsh(3),xvec(3),yvec(3),zvec(3)
      real(8) :: halflifePET,decayPET,halflifeRI,decayRI,fnorm
      real(8) :: activity,decaybioinp
      character(LEN=200) :: cRIname,Cinter,CRIlist
      logical :: iflaginv

      call DSPheader(version)

      call READpetinputs(iradflag,ireaddir,inorm,
     &     ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax,izmin,izmax,decaybioinp,
     &     CRIlist,cRIname,Cinter)

      call SETriparam(CRIlist,cRIname,halflifeRI)
      decayRI=log(2.0)/halflifeRI

      if(ireaddir.eq.0)then ! Read data from PET directory

       call READdirectory(izmax,nslices,ntiming,imulti)

       nznum=nslices
       if(imulti.eq.0)then
        nlist=nslices*ntiming
       else
        nlist=ntiming ! ??? # of files = ntiming ???
       endif

       call ALLOCATEfilenames(nlist)
       call ALLOCATEzloctime(nlist)

       call READfilenames(nlist)

       iflaginv=.false.
       if(imulti.eq.0)then
        allocate(izlist(nslices,ntiming),tlist(2,ntiming))
        call SETztlist(nlist,nslices,ntiming,izlist,tlist)
        ilist=izlist(izmin,1)
        ilist2=izlist(izmin+1,1)
        call READheader(ilist,ilist2,nxnum,nynum,xdel,ydel,zdel,
     &       xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec,activity,halflifePET)
       else
        allocate(izlist(1,ntiming),tlist(2,ntiming))
        call SETztlist(nlist,1,ntiming,izlist,tlist)
        ilist=izlist(1,1)
        call READmultiframeheader(ilist,nxnum,nynum,
     &       xdel,ydel,zdel,xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec,
     &       activity,halflifePET)
        if(zdel.lt.0.0d0)then
         iflaginv=.true.
         xsh(3)=xsh(3)+zdel*nznum
         zdel=abs(zdel)
        endif
       endif

       if(halflifePET.gt.0.0)then
        decayPET=log(2.0)/halflifePET
       else
        decayPET=decayRI
       endif
       ixnum=ixmax-ixmin+1
       iynum=iymax-iymin+1
       iznum=izmax-izmin+1
       allocate( pdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming) )
       pdata(:,:,:,:)=0.0d0

       do it=1,ntiming
        if(imulti.eq.0)then
         call READpetdata(ixmin,iymin,izmin,
     &        ixnum,iynum,iznum,nxnum,nynum,nznum,
     &        izlist(:,it),pdata(:,:,:,it))
        else
         call READmultiframedata(iflaginv,ixmin,iymin,izmin,
     &        ixnum,iynum,iznum,nxnum,nynum,nznum,
     &        izlist(:,it),pdata(:,:,:,it))
        endif
       enddo

       deallocate( izlist )
       call DEALLOCATEfilenames
       call DEALLOCATEzloctime

       allocate( decaybiodata(ixnum,iynum,iznum) )

       if(decaybioinp.lt.0.0d0)then
        call CALCdecaybiodata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,
     &       pdata,tlist,decaybiodata)
       else
        decaybiodata(1:ixnum,1:iynum,1:iznum)=decaybioinp
       endif

       xorg=(ixmin-1.5d0)*xdel
       yorg=(iymin-1.5d0)*ydel
       if(imulti.eq.0)then
        zorg=-0.5d0*zdel
       else
        zorg=(izmin-1.5d0)*zdel
       endif

       call CREATEpetparam(Cinter,
     &      ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,
     &      xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,
     &      activity,decayPET)

       call CREATEpettmpdata(Cinter,
     &      ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,tlist,pdata)

       call CREATEdecaybiodata(Cinter,ixnum,iynum,iznum,decaybiodata)

      else ! Read data from temporary files

       call READpetparam(Cinter,
     &      ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,
     &      xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,
     &      activity,decayPET)

       allocate( pdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming) )
       allocate( tlist(2,ntiming) )

       call READpettmpdata(Cinter,
     &      ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,tlist,pdata)

       allocate( decaybiodata(ixnum,iynum,iznum) )

       call READdecaybiodata(Cinter,ixnum,iynum,iznum,decaybiodata)

      endif

      allocate( pidata(ixnum,iynum,iznum),totalsource(0:ntiming) )

      if(inorm.eq.0.or.activity.eq.0.0)then
       fnorm=decayRI/decayPET*xdel*ydel*zdel
      else
       fnorm=(1.0/activity)*xdel*ydel*zdel
      endif

      call CALCbqdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,
     &     decayRI,decayPET,tlist,decaybiodata,fnorm,
     &     pdata,pidata,totalsource)

      call CREATEbqdata(Cinter,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,
     &     totalsource,pidata,pdata)

      deallocate( decaybiodata,pdata,pidata,totalsource,tlist )

      call CREATEsourceinfo(Cinter,cRIname,CRIlist,iradflag,
     &      ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,inorm,
     &      xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,decaybioinp)

      if(ireaddir.eq.0)then
       call DSPparam(nxnum,nynum,nznum,xdel,ydel,zdel,'ORIGINAL')
       call DSPparam(ixnum,iynum,iznum,xdel,ydel,zdel,'CLIPPED ')
      else
       call DSPparam(ixnum,iynum,iznum,xdel,ydel,zdel,'LOADED  ')
      endif

      write(istdout,'(2a)')'***************************',
     &     '******************************************'
      write(istdout,*)' PET2PHITS successfully FINISHED !!'

      stop
      end

*********************************************************************
      subroutine SETriparam(CRIlist,cRIname,halflife)
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none

      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: cRIname,CRIlist
      real(8),intent(out) :: halflife
      integer :: Nlen,Nrilen,ir

      integer :: Nrilist
      character(LEN=6),allocatable :: RInamelist(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: RIhalflife(:)

      open(20,file=CRIlist,status='old')
      read(20,*)Nrilist
      allocate( RInamelist(Nrilist),RIhalflife(Nrilist) )
      do ir=1,Nrilist
       read(20,*)RInamelist(ir),RIhalflife(ir)
      enddo
      Nlen=len_trim(cRIname)
      do ir=1,Nrilist
       Nrilen=len_trim(RInamelist(ir))
       if(Nrilen.eq.Nlen) then
        if(cRIname(1:Nlen).eq.RInamelist(ir)(1:Nrilen)) then
         halflife=RIhalflife(ir)
         exit
        endif
       endif
      enddo
      if(ir.gt.Nrilist) then
       write(istdout,*)'ERROR:: no halflife data for ',cRIname(1:Nlen)
       write(istdout,'(a)')'  Only following RIs are allowed'
       write(istdout,'(5x,2(a,","),a)')(RInamelist(ir),ir=1,Nrilist)
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      return
      end subroutine SETriparam

*********************************************************************
      subroutine SETztlist(nlist,nslices,ntiming,
     &     izlist,tlist)
*********************************************************************
      use readpet, only:Cfilenames,zloc,timing,iduration
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nlist,nslices,ntiming
      integer,intent(out) :: izlist(nslices,ntiming)
      real(8),intent(out) :: tlist(2,ntiming)
      integer,allocatable :: iii(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: ddd(:,:)
      character(200),allocatable :: ccc(:)
      integer :: iz,it

      allocate(iii(nlist),ddd(2,nlist),ccc(nlist))

      ddd(1,1:nlist)=zloc(1:nlist)
      ddd(2,1:nlist)=timing(1:nlist)
      iii(1:nlist)=iduration(1:nlist)
      ccc(1:nlist)=Cfilenames(1:nlist)
      call quicksort(ddd,iii,ccc,1,nlist)
      do it=1,ntiming
       tlist(1,it)=ddd(2,it)*0.001d0     ! convert ms to s
       tlist(2,it)=dble(iii(it))*0.001d0 ! convert ms to s
       do iz=1,nslices
        izlist(iz,it)=it+(iz-1)*ntiming
       enddo
      enddo
      Cfilenames(1:nlist)=ccc(1:nlist)
      deallocate(iii,ddd,ccc)

      return
      end subroutine SETztlist

************************************************************************
      recursive subroutine quicksort(ddd,iii,ccc,ist,iend)
************************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer,intent(inout) :: iii(*)
      real(8),intent(inout) :: ddd(2,*)
      character(200),intent(inout) :: ccc(*)
      integer,intent(in) :: ist,iend
      integer :: i,j
      integer :: iiit
      real(8) :: dddx(2),dddt(2)
      character(200) :: ccct
      dddx(1:2)=ddd(1:2,(ist+iend)/2)
      i=ist
      j=iend
      do
       do
        if(ddd(1,i).gt.dddx(1))then
         exit
        elseif(ddd(1,i).eq.dddx(1))then
         if(ddd(2,i).ge.dddx(2))then
          exit
         endif
        endif
        i=i+1
       enddo
       do
        if(ddd(1,j).lt.dddx(1))then
         exit
        elseif(ddd(1,j).eq.dddx(1))then
         if(ddd(2,j).le.dddx(2))then
          exit
         endif
        endif
        j=j-1
       enddo
       if(i.ge.j)exit
       dddt(1:2)=ddd(1:2,i)
       ddd(1:2,i)=ddd(1:2,j)
       ddd(1:2,j)=dddt(1:2)
       iiit=iii(i)
       iii(i)=iii(j)
       iii(j)=iiit
       ccct=ccc(i)
       ccc(i)=ccc(j)
       ccc(j)=ccct
       i=i+1
       j=j-1
      enddo
      if(ist.lt.i-1)call quicksort(ddd,iii,ccc,ist,i-1)
      if(j+1.lt.iend)call quicksort(ddd,iii,ccc,j+1,iend)
      end subroutine quicksort

*********************************************************************
      subroutine CALCdecaybiodata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,
     &     pdata,tlist,decaybiodata)
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      use fitbio, only:FITdecaybio
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      real(8),intent(in) :: pdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming)
      real(8),intent(in) :: tlist(2,ntiming)
      real(8),intent(out) :: decaybiodata(ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      real(8),allocatable :: Tm(:),decaybiomap(:,:,:)
      real(8),allocatable :: actfit(:)
      integer,allocatable :: imap(:,:,:)
      integer :: ix,iy,iz,it,isum
      integer :: ix1,iy1,iz1
      real(8) :: sum,decaybio
      integer,parameter :: naround=5,nthreshold=10
      integer :: iaround
!$    integer ipomp,npomp
!$    integer OMP_GET_NUM_THREADS,OMP_GET_THREAD_NUM

      if(ntiming.lt.3)then ! at least 3 time frame required for fitting
       write(istdout,*)'WARNING: fitting is skipped'
       write(istdout,*)'  0 biological decay constant is assumed'
       write(istdout,*)'  At least 3 time frame required for fitting'
       decaybiodata(1:ixnum,1:iynum,1:iznum)=0.0d0
       return
      endif

      allocate( Tm(ntiming) )
      allocate( decaybiomap(ixnum,iynum,iznum) )
      allocate( imap(ixnum,iynum,iznum) )
      allocate( actfit(ntiming) )
      decaybiodata(:,:,:)=0.0d0
      decaybiomap(:,:,:)=0.0d0
      imap(:,:,:)=0

      Tm(1:ntiming)=tlist(1,1:ntiming)

!-----Average over 5 neighbouring voxels and fit biological decay constant
      do iz=1,iznum
       do iy=1,iynum
        do ix=1,ixnum
         do it=1,ntiming
          sum=0.0d0
          isum=0
          do iz1=max(1,iz-naround),min(iznum,iz+naround)
           do iy1=max(1,iy-naround),min(iynum,iy+naround)
            do ix1=max(1,ix-naround),min(ixnum,ix+naround)
             sum=sum+pdata(ix1,iy1,iz1,it)
             isum=isum+1
            enddo
           enddo
          enddo
          actfit(it)=sum/dble(isum)
         enddo
         call FITdecaybio(ntiming,Tm,actfit,decaybio)
         decaybiomap(ix,iy,iz)=decaybio
         if(decaybio.gt.0.0d0)imap(ix,iy,iz)=1
        enddo
       enddo
       write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' Fitting iz = ',iz
      enddo

!-----Take mean among closest 10 voxels
!$OMP PARALLEL
!$OMP& private(ipomp,ix,iy,iz,ix1,iy1,iz1,iaround,isum,sum)
!$      npomp=OMP_GET_NUM_THREADS()
!$      ipomp=OMP_GET_THREAD_NUM()
!$      write(*,'(''OpenMP PARALLEL PROCESS'',
!$   &     i4,''/'',i4)') ipOMP+1,npomp
!$OMP DO SCHEDULE(dynamic)
      do iz=1,iznum
       do iy=1,iynum
        do ix=1,ixnum
         do iaround=1,1000
          sum=0.0d0
          isum=0
          do iz1=max(1,iz-iaround),min(iznum,iz+iaround)
           do iy1=max(1,iy-iaround),min(iynum,iy+iaround)
            do ix1=max(1,ix-iaround),min(ixnum,ix+iaround)
             sum=sum+decaybiomap(ix1,iy1,iz1)
             isum=isum+imap(ix1,iy1,iz1)
            enddo
           enddo
          enddo
          if(isum.gt.nthreshold)exit
         enddo
         decaybiodata(ix,iy,iz)=sum/dble(isum)
        enddo
       enddo
       write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' Averaging iz = ',iz
      enddo
!$OMP END DO
!$      write(*,'(''OpenMP FINALIZE'',
!$   &     i4,''/'',i4)') ipOMP+1,npomp
!$OMP END PARALLEL
      deallocate( Tm,decaybiomap,imap,actfit )
      return
      end subroutine CALCdecaybiodata

*********************************************************************
      subroutine CALCbqdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,
     &     decayRI,decayPET,tlist,decaybiodata,fnorm,
     &     pdata,pidata,totalsource)
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      real(8),intent(in) :: decayRI,decayPET,tlist(2,ntiming)
      real(8),intent(in) :: decaybiodata(ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      real(8),intent(in) :: fnorm
      real(8),intent(inout) :: pdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming)
      real(8),intent(out) :: pidata(ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      real(8),intent(out) :: totalsource(0:ntiming)
      real(8),allocatable :: Ts(:),Te(:),Tm(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: apara(:),bpara(:)
      integer :: ix,iy,iz,it
      real(8) :: sum,decaybio
      integer,parameter :: naround=5,nthreshold=10

      allocate( Ts(ntiming),Te(ntiming),Tm(0:ntiming) )
      allocate( apara(ntiming),bpara(ntiming) )

      Tm(0)=0.0d0 ! Tm(0) is injection timing, always 0
      do it=1,ntiming
       Ts(it)=tlist(1,it)-tlist(2,it)*0.5  ! start for each measurement
       Tm(it)=tlist(1,it)                  ! mid timing
       Te(it)=tlist(1,it)+tlist(2,it)*0.5  ! end timing
      enddo
      totalsource(1:ntiming)=0.0d0

      do iz =1,iznum
       do iy=1,iynum
        do ix=1,ixnum
         do it=1,ntiming
          if(it.eq.1) then ! first measurement
           if(Tm(1).gt.1.0d-10)then
            apara(it)=pdata(ix,iy,iz,it)/(decayPET*(Tm(it)-Tm(it-1)))
            bpara(it)=0.0d0 ! b should be fixed to 0
           else
            apara(it)=0.0d0
            bpara(it)=pdata(ix,iy,iz,it)/decayPET
           endif
          else
           apara(it)=(pdata(ix,iy,iz,it)-pdata(ix,iy,iz,it-1))/
     &     (decayPET*(Tm(it)-Tm(it-1)))
           bpara(it)=pdata(ix,iy,iz,it)/decayPET-apara(it)*Tm(it)
          endif
         enddo
         sum=0.0d0
         do it=1,ntiming
          pdata(ix,iy,iz,it)=decayRI*(apara(it)*Tm(it)+bpara(it))
     &         *exp(-decayRI*Tm(it))
          ! number of decay per sec, i.e. activity at timing(it)
          if(pdata(ix,iy,iz,it).lt.0.0) pdata(ix,iy,iz,it)=0.0
          totalsource(it)=totalsource(it)+pdata(ix,iy,iz,it)
          ! total activity per volume of pixel
          sum=sum+max(0.0,
     &    apara(it)*(exp(-decayRI*Tm(it-1))*(decayRI*Tm(it-1)+1)-
     &    exp(-decayRI*Tm(it))*(decayRI*Tm(it)+1))/decayRI+
     &    bpara(it)*(exp(-decayRI*Tm(it-1))-exp(-decayRI*Tm(it))))
         enddo
         decaybio=decaybiodata(ix,iy,iz)
         sum=sum+
     &   max(0.0,(apara(ntiming)*Tm(ntiming)+bpara(ntiming))
     &        *exp(-decayRI*Tm(ntiming))*decayRI/(decayRI+decaybio))
         ! remaining RI should decay in the same pixel
         pidata(ix,iy,iz)=sum ! integral decay / volume of pixel
         totalsource(0)=totalsource(0)+pidata(ix,iy,iz)
         ! total decay / volume of pixel
        enddo
       enddo
       write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' Computing Bq iz = ',iz
      enddo

      totalsource(:)=totalsource(:)*fnorm ! normalized to 1 MBq of RI
      deallocate( Ts,Te,Tm,apara,bpara )

      return
      end subroutine CALCbqdata

*********************************************************************
      subroutine DSPparam(nxnum,nynum,nznum,xdel,ydel,zdel,tag)
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nxnum,nynum,nznum
      real(8),intent(in) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      character(8),intent(in) :: tag

      write(istdout,'(3a)')'--------',tag,'--------'
      write(istdout,'(a,i5,a,i5,a,i5)')
     &     ' nx=',nxnum,' ny=',nynum,' nz=',nznum
      write(istdout,'(a,f12.5,a,f12.5,a,f12.5)')
     &     ' x=',xdel*nxnum,' y=',ydel*nynum,' z=',zdel*nznum
      return
      end subroutine DSPparam
*********************************************************************
      subroutine DSPmessageCG
*********************************************************************

     &     ' CLIPPED region may be modified by COASE GRANING'

     &     '******************************************'
      return
      end subroutine DSPmessageCG

FILE: src/phits2dicom.c
BEGIN_FILE
/***************************************************************************/
/* PROGRAM phits2dicom                                                     */
/*                                                                         */
/*   Created by T. Furuta @ JAEA,                                          */
/*        Y. Koba and S. Matsumoto @ NIRS                                  */
/*                on 2016/03/03                                            */
/*     under collaboration between JAEA and NIRS                           */
/*                                                                         */
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*                                                                         */
/*   Purpose                                                               */
/*        Convert 3D dose distribution calculated by PHITS                 */
/*        to data in DICOM RT-dose format                                  */
/*                                                                         */
/*   Last modified by T. Furuta on 2022/03/20                              */
/***************************************************************************/
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include "dicomlib.h"
#include "phitslib.h"
#include "utllib.h"
/********** Module variables ***********************************************/
int ifendian=0,imendian=0,imatch;
char Fout[1024];
float version=3.00;
void dsp_header(void);

/********** Interface functions ********************************************/

int main()
{
  char Frtdose[1024],Frtimage[1024],Fphitsdose[1024],Fphitsout[1024];
  char Fp2dinfo[1024];
  FILE *fp,*fp1,*fp2;
  double xval[6],xsh[3],fac,tdata,fnorm;
  int ifnorm;
  double xn[3],vnorm;
  int i,ngrid[3],ngridtot,ipart,npart,len;
  int jflag[3];
  char cver[256],cdate[256],ctime[256];
  char cpart[256];
  char dummy[1024],sign0[12]="PHITS2DICOM",cdcm[4]="dcm";
  char cfile[256],cfiles[1024];
  char cp2dfile[12]="p2dinfo.dat";
  float *data=NULL,*dmax=NULL;
  int *ipmax=NULL;
  int idebug=0;
  char *cpointer,*cpointer2,*token;

/*--------- Header display -----------------------------------------------*/
  dsp_header();
/*--------- Input --------------------------------------------------------*/
  if(get_fname("Type PHITS2DICOM to run phits2dicom",dummy)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(strncmp(dummy,sign0,11)!=0){
    printf(" ERROR:: signature PHITS2DICOM is not confirmed\n");
    printf(" This input may not be for phits2dicom\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(get_fname("Name of RTdose file with PATH",Frtdose)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_fname("Name of RTimage file with PATH",Frtimage)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_fname("Name of PHITS dose file with PATH",Fphitsdose)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_fname("Name of phits.out file with PATH",Fphitsout)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_fname("Directory for p2dinfo.dat (DATfiles/)",Fp2dinfo)!=0)exit(-1);
  imendian=eval_imendian();
/*--------- Input2 -------------------------------------------------------*/
  if(get_int("Normalization 0:As it is, 1:Max to 1, 2:By Norm Factor, 3:Dose at point",&ifnorm)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(ifnorm==2){
    if(get_double("Normalized factor",&fnorm)!=0)exit(-1);
  }else if(ifnorm==3){
    if(get_double3("Normalization point [mm]: x, y, z",xn)!=0)exit(-1);
    if(get_double("Normalized value for this point",&vnorm)!=0)exit(-1);
  }
/*--------- Set p2dinfo.dat File -----------------------------------------*/
  memset(dummy,0,1024);
  strcpy(dummy,Fp2dinfo);
  cpointer=strrchr(dummy,'/');
  memcpy(cpointer+1,cp2dfile,12);
  memset(Fp2dinfo,0,1024);
  strcpy(Fp2dinfo,dummy);
/*--------- Read RTdose --------------------------------------------------*/
  if(open_file(&fp1,Frtdose,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);
  if(check_file(fp1,"RTDOSE")!=0)exit(-1);
  if(close_file(fp1)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(idebug!=0){
    if(open_file(&fp1,Frtdose,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);
    printf("--- Original header ---------------------------------------\n");
    print_RTdoseheader(fp1);
    printf("-----------------------------------------------------------\n");
    if(close_file(fp1)!=0)exit(-1);
  }
/*--------- Read CTimage -------------------------------------------------*/
  if(open_file(&fp1,Frtimage,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);
  if(check_file(fp1,"CT")!=0)exit(-1);
  get_CTimageheader(fp1);
  if(close_file(fp1)!=0)exit(-1);
/*--------- Read phits.out -----------------------------------------------*/
  memset(cver,0,256);
  memset(cdate,0,256);
  memset(ctime,0,256);
  if(open_file(&fp,Fphitsout,"r")!=0)exit(-1);
  if(read_phitsout(fp,jflag,cver,cdate,ctime)!=0)exit(-1);
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
/*--------- Read phits dose file ------------------------------------------*/
  memset(cpart,0,256);
  if(open_file(&fp,Fphitsdose,"r")!=0)exit(-1);
  if(read_phitsheader(fp,xval,xsh,ngrid,&npart,cpart)!=0){
    printf("ERROR:: reading PHITS header in %s\n",Fphitsdose);
    exit(-1);
  }
  for(i=0;i<6;i++)xval[i]=10.0*xval[i]; /// converting cm to mm
  ngridtot=ngrid[0]*ngrid[1]*ngrid[2];
  data=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*ngridtot*npart);
  dmax=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*npart);
  ipmax=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*npart*3);
  if(data==NULL){
    printf("ERROR:: allocation of data\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(dmax==NULL){
    printf("ERROR:: allocation of dmax\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(ipmax==NULL){
    printf("ERROR:: allocation of ipmax\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  rewind(fp);
  if(read_phitsdata(fp,ngrid,npart,data,dmax,ipmax)!=0){
    printf("ERROR:: reading PHITS data in %s\n",Fphitsdose);
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
  /* if(open_file(&fp,"tmp.txt","w")!=0)exit(-1); */
  /* if(write_data(fp,ngrid,data)) */
  /* if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1); */
  printf("--- Created data ------------------------------------------\n");
  printf(" Data points:\n");
  printf("  nx = %d  ny = %d  nz = %d\n",ngrid[0],ngrid[1],ngrid[2]);
  printf("  npart = %d\n",npart);
  printf(" Data range [mm]:\n");
  printf("  x= %lf : %lf\n",xval[0],xval[1]);
  printf("  y= %lf : %lf\n",xval[2],xval[3]);
  printf("  z= %lf : %lf\n",xval[4],xval[5]);
  printf("-----------------------------------------------------------\n");

  printf("--- Normalization -----------------------------------------\n");
  memset(cfiles,0,1024);
  token=strtok(cpart,",");
  for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
/*--------- Set OutFile --------------------------------------------------*/
    memset(dummy,0,1024);
    strcpy(dummy,Fphitsdose);
    cpointer=strrchr(dummy,'.');
    cpointer2=strrchr(dummy,'/');
    if(npart>1){
      *(cpointer)='_';
      len=strlen(token);
      memcpy(cpointer+1,token,len);
      *(cpointer+len+1)='.';
      memcpy(cpointer+len+2,cdcm,4);
      memset(cfile,0,256);
      sprintf(cfile,"%s,",cpointer2+1);
      strcat(cfiles,cfile);
      token=strtok(NULL,",");
    }else{
      memcpy(cpointer+1,cdcm,4);
    }
    memset(Fout,0,1024);
    strcpy(Fout,dummy);
/*--------- Read RTdose --------------------------------------------------*/
    if(open_file(&fp1,Frtdose,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);
    if(open_file(&fp2,Fout,"wb")!=0)exit(-1);
    if(copy_binary(fp1,fp2)!=0)exit(-1);
    if(close_file(fp1)!=0)exit(-1);
    if(close_file(fp2)!=0)exit(-1);
/*--------- Create output ------------------------------------------------*/
    if(open_file(&fp1,Fout,"r+b")!=0)exit(-1);
    if(check_file(fp1,"RTDOSE")!=0)exit(-1);
    if(overwrite_RTdoseheader(fp1,ipart,xval,
			      xsh,ngrid,
			      *(dmax+ipart),ipmax+ipart*3,&fac,
			      ifnorm,data,xn,vnorm,
			      &tdata,&fnorm,
			      cver,cdate,ctime)!=0)exit(-1);
    if(overwrite_RTdosedata(fp1,fac,ngridtot,data+ipart*ngridtot)!=0)exit(-1);
    printf(" File = %s\n",cpointer2+1);
    printf(" Dose at x = %lf, y = %lf z = %lf [mm]:\n",xn[0],xn[1],xn[2]);
    printf("  %g is normalized to %g\n",tdata,fnorm*tdata);
    printf(" Normalization factor = %g\n",fnorm);
    printf("-----------------------------------------------------------\n");
    if(idebug!=0){
      rewind(fp1);
      printf("--- Created header ----------------------------------------\n");
      print_RTdoseheader(fp1);
      printf("-----------------------------------------------------------\n");
    }
    if(close_file(fp1)!=0)exit(-1);
  }
  free(data);
  if(open_file(&fp,Fp2dinfo,"a")!=0)exit(-1);
  fprintf(fp,"NormalizationFactor= %g\n",fnorm);
  fprintf(fp,"%d\n",npart);
  if(npart==1){
    fprintf(fp,"%s\n",cpointer2+1);
  }else{
    token=strtok(cfiles,",");
    for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
      fprintf(fp,"%s\n",token);
      token=strtok(NULL,",");
    }
  }
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);

  printf("*** PHITS2DICOM successfully finished *********************\n");
  return(0);
}
/***************************************************************************/
void dsp_header()
{
  printf("***********************************************************\n");
  printf("*     PROGRAM phits2dicom                                 *\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("*        Created by T. Furuta @ JAEA,                     *\n");
  printf("*              Y. Koba and S. Matsumoto @ NIRS            *\n");
  printf("*                      on 2016/03/03                      *\n");
  printf("*           under collaboration between JAEA and NIRS     *\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("*---------------------------------------------------------*\n");
  printf("*                   Version = %.2f                        *\n",version);
  printf("*---------------------------------------------------------*\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("*     Purpose                                             *\n");
  printf("*        Convert 3D dose distribution calculated by PHITS *\n");
  printf("*        to data in DICOM RT-dose format                  *\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("***********************************************************\n");
  return;
}
END_FILE

FILE: src/phitslib.c
BEGIN_FILE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include "phitslib.h"

/********** Prototype decllaration *****************************************/
int check_datastart(char *);
int read_axis(char *);
int read_mesh(char *);
int read_meshnum(char *,char *,int *);
int read_xyzparam(char *,char *,int *);
int read_part(char *,char *,int *);
int read_title(char *,double *);

/********** Module functions ***********************************************/
int write_data(FILE *fp, int *ngrid, float *data)
{
  int nx,ny,nz,i,k,ii;
  int imax,irest;
  nx=*ngrid;
  ny=*(ngrid+1);
  nz=*(ngrid+2);
  imax=nx*ny/10;
  irest=(nx*ny)%10;

  for(k=0;k<nz;k++){
    ii=k*nx*ny;
    for(i=0;i<imax;i++){
      fprintf(fp,"%g %g %g %g %g %g %g %g %g %g\n",
	      data[ii],data[ii+1],data[ii+2],data[ii+3],data[ii+4],
	      data[ii+5],data[ii+6],data[ii+7],data[ii+8],data[ii+9]);
      ii+=10;
    }
    if(irest>0){
      for(i=0;i<irest-1;i++){
	fprintf(fp,"%g ",data[ii+i]);
      }
      fprintf(fp,"%g\n",data[ii+irest]);
    }
  }
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int read_phitsdata(FILE *fp, int *ngrid, int npart, float *data, float *dmax, int *ipmax)
{
  int nx,ny,nz,i,j,k,i0,ipart;
  int imax,irest;
  float *tmpdata=NULL;
  char buff[256];
  char *token;

  nx=*ngrid;
  ny=*(ngrid+1);
  nz=*(ngrid+2);
  imax=nx*ny/10;
  for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
    dmax[ipart]=0.0E0;
  }
  irest=(nx*ny)%10;
  tmpdata=(float *)malloc(sizeof(float)*nx*ny);
  for(k=0;k<nz;k++){
    for(ipart=0;ipart<npart;ipart++){
      while(1){
	if(fgets(buff,sizeof(buff),fp)==NULL)return(-1);
	if(strncmp(buff," newpage:",9)==0||
	   strncmp(buff,"#newpage:",9)==0)break;
      }
      while(1){
	if(fgets(buff,sizeof(buff),fp)==NULL)return(-1);
	if(check_datastart(buff)==0)break;
      }
      for(i=0;i<imax;i++){
	if(fgets(buff,sizeof(buff),fp)==NULL)return(-1);
	token=strtok(buff," ");
	for(j=0;j<10;j++){
	  tmpdata[i*10+j]=atof(token);
	  token=strtok(NULL," ");
	}
      }
      if(irest>0){
	if(fgets(buff,sizeof(buff),fp)==NULL)return(-1);
	token=strtok(buff," ");
	for(j=0;j<irest;j++){
	  tmpdata[imax*10+j]=atof(token);
	  token=strtok(NULL," ");
	}
      }
      i0=k*nx*ny+ipart*nx*ny*nz;
      for(j=0;j<ny;j++){
	for(i=0;i<nx;i++){
	  data[i0+(ny-1-j)*nx+i]=tmpdata[j*nx+i];
	/* data[i0+j*nx+i]=tmpdata[j*nx+i]; */
	/* *dmax=fmaxf(tmpdata[j*nx+i],*dmax); */
	  if(tmpdata[j*nx+i]>dmax[ipart]){
	    dmax[ipart]=tmpdata[j*nx+i];
	    ipmax[ipart*3]=i;
	    ipmax[ipart*3+1]=ny-1-j;
	    ipmax[ipart*3+2]=k;
	  }
	}
      }
    }
  }
  free(tmpdata);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int read_phitsheader(FILE *fp, double *xval, double *xsh, int *ngrid, int *npart, char *cpart)
{
  char buff[256],buff0[256],value[256];
  int i,ierr,iflag,jflag[6]={0};
  int ipflag,len;
  char *token;
  char cxyz[2],cminmax[4];

  ipflag=0;
  while(fgets(buff,sizeof(buff),fp)!=NULL){
    memset(value,0,256);
    strcpy(buff0,buff);
    token=strtok(buff," ");
    switch(*token){
    case 'x':
      ierr=read_xyzparam(buff0,value,&iflag);
      if(ierr==0&&iflag>0){
	switch(iflag){
	case 1:
	  *xval=atof(value);
	  jflag[0]=1;
	  break;
	case 2:
	  *(xval+1)=atof(value);
	  jflag[1]=1;
	  break;
	}
      }
      break;
    case 'y':
      ierr=read_xyzparam(buff0,value,&iflag);
      if(ierr==0&&iflag>0){
	switch(iflag){
	case 1:
	  *(xval+2)=atof(value);
	  jflag[2]=1;
	  break;
	case 2:
	  *(xval+3)=atof(value);
	  jflag[3]=1;
	  break;
	}
      }
      break;
    case 'z':
      ierr=read_xyzparam(buff0,value,&iflag);
      if(ierr==0&&iflag>0){
	switch(iflag){
	case 1:
	  *(xval+4)=atof(value);
	  jflag[4]=1;
	  break;
	case 2:
	  *(xval+5)=atof(value);
	  jflag[5]=1;
	  break;
	}
      }
      break;
    case 'm':
      ierr=read_mesh(buff0);
      if(ierr==-1)return(-1);
      break;
    case 'a':
      ierr=read_axis(buff0);
      if(ierr==-1)return(-1);
      break;
    case 'n':
      ierr=read_meshnum(buff0,value,&iflag);
      if(ierr==-1)return(-1);
      if(ierr==0){
	switch(iflag){
	case 1:
	  *ngrid=atoi(value);
	case 2:
	  *(ngrid+1)=atoi(value);
	case 3:
	  *(ngrid+2)=atoi(value);
	}
      }
      break;
    case 't':
      ierr=read_title(buff0,xsh);
      if(ierr==-1)return(-1);
      break;
    case 'p':
      if(ipflag==0)ierr=read_part(buff0,value,npart);
      ipflag=1;
      if(ierr==-1)return(-1);
      if(ierr==0){
	len=strlen(value);
	strncpy(cpart,value,len);
      }
      break;
    case 'h':
      if(check_datastart(buff0)==0){
	//	return(0);
	ierr=1;
	for(i=0;i<6;i++) ierr *= jflag[i];
	if(ierr==0){
	  for(i=0;i<6;i++){
	    if(jflag[i]==0){
	      if(i%2==0){
		strcpy(cminmax,"min\0");
	      }else{
		strcpy(cminmax,"max\0");
	      }
	      switch(i/2){
	      case 0:
		strcpy(cxyz,"x\0");
	      case 1:
		strcpy(cxyz,"y\0");
	      case 2:
		strcpy(cxyz,"z\0");
	      }
	      printf("ERROR: missing %s%s in PHITS dose file\n",cxyz,cminmax);
	    }
	  }
	  return(-1);
	}
	return(0);
      }
      break;
    default:
      break;
    }
  }
  printf("ERROR:: PHITS file ended without sequential data (hc:)\n");
  return(-1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int read_phitsout(FILE *fp,int *jflag, char *cver, char *cdate, char *ctime)
{
  char buff[256],value[256];
  int len,len0;
  char *token;

  while(fgets(buff,sizeof(buff),fp)!=NULL){
    memset(value,0,256);
    token=strtok(buff," ");
    switch(*token){
    case '|':
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      if(token!=NULL){
	if(strncmp(token,"Version",7)==0){
	  token=strtok(NULL," ");
	  if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
	    token=strtok(NULL," ");
	    len=strlen(token);
	    strncpy(value,token,len);
	    *jflag=1;
	    strncpy(cver,value,len);
	  }
	}
      }
      break;
    case 'S':
      if(strncmp(token,"Starting",8)==0){
	token=strtok(NULL," ");
	if(token!=NULL){
	  if(strncmp(token,"Date",4)==0){
	    token=strtok(NULL," ");
	    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
	      token=strtok(NULL,"-");
	      len0=0;
	      len=strlen(token);
	      strncpy(value+len0,token,len);
	      token=strtok(NULL,"-");
	      len0+=len;
	      len=strlen(token);
	      strncpy(value+len0,token,len);
	      token=strtok(NULL," ");
	      len0+=len;
	      len=strlen(token);
	      strncpy(value+len0,token,len);
	      len0+=len;
	      *(jflag+1)=1;
	      strncpy(cdate,value,len0-1); // eliminating return code
	    }
	  }else if(strncmp(token,"Time",4)==0){
	    token=strtok(NULL," ");
	    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
	      token=strtok(NULL," ");
	      len0=0;
	      len=strlen(token)-1;
	      strncpy(value+len0,token,len);
	      token=strtok(NULL," ");
	      len0+=len;
	      len=strlen(token)-1;
	      strncpy(value+len0,token,len);
	      token=strtok(NULL," ");
	      len0+=len;
	      len=strlen(token);
	      strncpy(value+len0,token,len);
	      len0+=len;
	      *(jflag+2)=1;
	      strncpy(ctime,value,len0-1); // eliminating return code
	    }
	  }
	}
      }
      break;
    case '>':
      return(0);
      break;
    default:
      break;
    }
  }
  printf("ERROR:: phits.out ended without '>>> Input Echo'");
  return(-1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int check_datastart(char *buff)
{
  char *token;
  token=strtok(buff," ");
  if(strncmp(token,"hc:",3)==0){
    return(0);
  }
  return(1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int read_title(char *buff, double *xsh)
{
  char *token;
  char value[256];
  int len;
  memset(value,0,256);
  token=strtok(buff," ");
  if(strncmp(token,"title",5)==0){
    token=strtok(NULL," ");
    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
      token=strtok(NULL," "); // ImagePositionPatient
      if(strncmp(token,"(ImagePositionPatient",21)!=0){
	printf("ERROR:: ImagePositionPatient is missing in title of [T-Deposit]\n");
	return(-1);
      }
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      len=strlen(token);
      strncpy(value,token,len);
      *xsh=atof(value);
      memset(value,0,256);
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      len=strlen(token);
      strncpy(value,token,len);
      *(xsh+1)=atof(value);
      memset(value,0,256);
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      len=strlen(token);
      strncpy(value,token,len);
      *(xsh+2)=atof(value);
      return(0);
    }
    return(-1);
  }
  return(1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int read_meshnum(char *buff, char *value, int *iflag)
{
  char *token;
  int len;
  *iflag=0;
  token=strtok(buff," ");
  if(strncmp(token,"nx",2)==0){
    token=strtok(NULL," ");
    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      len=strlen(token);
      *iflag=1;
      strncpy(value,token,len);
      return(0);
    }
    return(-1);
  }else if(strncmp(token,"ny",2)==0){
    token=strtok(NULL," ");
    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      len=strlen(token);
      *iflag=2;
      strncpy(value,token,len);
      return(0);
    }
    return(-1);
  }else if(strncmp(token,"nz",2)==0){
    token=strtok(NULL," ");
    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      len=strlen(token);
      *iflag=3;
      strncpy(value,token,len);
      return(0);
    }
    return(-1);
  }
  return(1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int read_part(char *buff, char *value, int *npart)
{
  char *token;
  char mbuff[256];
  char underbar[2]="_\0",comma[2]=",\0";
  int iflag;
  iflag=0;
  *npart=0;
  memset(value,0,256);
  token=strtok(buff," \t\r\n");
  if(strncmp(token,"part",4)==0){
    token=strtok(NULL," \t\r\n");
    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
      memset(mbuff,0,256);
      while(token!=NULL){
	token=strtok(NULL," \t\r\n");
	if(token!=NULL){
	  if(strncmp(token,"(",1)==0){
	    iflag=1;
	  }else if(strncmp(token,")",1)==0){
	    *npart+=1;
	    iflag=0;
	    strcat(mbuff,comma);
	    strcat(value,mbuff);
	    memset(mbuff,0,256);
	  }else{
	    if(iflag){
	      if(iflag>1){
		strcat(mbuff,underbar);
	      }
	      strcat(mbuff,token);
	      iflag+=1;
	    }else{
	      *npart+=1;
	      sprintf(mbuff,"%s,",token);
	      strcat(value,mbuff);
	      memset(mbuff,0,256);
	    }
	  }
	}
      }
      return(0);
    }
    return(-1);
  }
  return(1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int read_axis(char *buff)
{
  char *token;
  token=strtok(buff," ");
  if(strncmp(token,"axis",4)==0){
    token=strtok(NULL," ");
    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      if(strncmp(token,"xy",2)!=0){
	printf("ERROR:: only axis=xy is allowed for PHITS output file\n");
	return(-1);
      }
      return(0);
    }
    return(-1);
  }
  return(1);
}

int read_mesh(char *buff)
{
  char *token;
  token=strtok(buff," ");
  if(strncmp(token,"mesh",4)==0){
    token=strtok(NULL," ");
    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      if(strncmp(token,"xyz",3)!=0){
	printf("ERROR:: only mesh=xyz is allowed for PHITS output file\n");
	return(-1);
      }
      return(0);
    }
    return(-1);
  }
  return(1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int read_xyzparam(char *buff, char *value, int *iflag)
{
  char *token;
  int len;
  token=strtok(buff," ");
  if(strncmp(token+1,"-type",5)==0){
    *iflag=0;
    token=strtok(NULL," ");
    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      len=strlen(token);
      strncpy(value,token,len);
      return(0);
    }
    return(-1);
  }else if(strncmp(token+1,"min",3)==0){
    *iflag=1;
    token=strtok(NULL," ");
    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      len=strlen(token);
      strncpy(value,token,len);
      return(0);
    }
    return(-1);
  }else if(strncmp(token+1,"max",3)==0){
    *iflag=2;
    token=strtok(NULL," ");
    if(strncmp(token,"=",1)==0){
      token=strtok(NULL," ");
      len=strlen(token);
      strncpy(value,token,len);
      return(0);
    }
    *iflag=0;
    return(-1);
  }
  return(1);
}

*********************************************************************
*     PROGRAM Plan2PHITS                                            *
*                                                                   *
*         Created by S. Hashimoto on 2017/07/31                     *
*             Under collaboration between JAEA and NIRS             *
*                                                                   *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                                                                   *
*     Purpose                                                       *
*         Create PLAN DAT files from intermediate files                *
*           of PlanReaser4PHITS                                     *
*     Required files and a directry for run                         *
*         Output files of planreader4phits                          *
*             (info-voxel,voxel,material,universe.inp)              *
*     Outputs                                                       *
*         Include files for phits.inp                               *
*         and several include files (***.inp)                       *
*                                                                   *
*         Last modified by T. Furuta on 2022/09/02                  *
*********************************************************************
      PROGRAM Plan2PHITS ! Main program
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout
      use readplan
      use deviceproperty
      use createplan
      implicit none
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      real,parameter :: version=1.00
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      integer,parameter :: ioa=20,iob=30
      integer :: i,j,imax,jmax,kmax,nchar,idref,numbeam
      integer :: npairMLC,ndimRC(2),npointBL
      character(LEN=200) :: Cdir,Cinter,cbeamID,cFrameID
      character(LEN=200) :: cmatRS,cmatFLC(2),cmatMLC
      character(LEN=200) :: cmatRC,cmatBL
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy
      character(LEN=2) :: Ctag
      logical :: iflagFLC
      real(8) :: dimGT(7),dimRS(5),dimFLC(12),dimMLC(3)
      real(8) :: dimRC(10),dimBL(4),dimPS(3)
      real(8) :: dpos(3),dose

*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Character initiallize
      write(cdir,'(200x)')
      write(cFrameID,'(200x)')
      write(cmatRS,'(200x)')
      write(cmatFLC,'(200x)')
      write(cmatMLC,'(200x)')
      write(cmatRC,'(200x)')
      write(cmatBL,'(200x)')
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Display headers
      call DSPheader(version)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Read input file (plan2phits.inp)
      call READplaninputs(Cdir,Cinter)
      call READnmatmax(nmatmax,nelemmax)
      call ALLOCATEmaterial
      nchar=index(Cinter,' ')-1
      open(ioa,file=Cinter(1:nchar)//'Plan.dat',status='old')
      read(ioa,*)cdummy
      read(ioa,*)imax
      numbeam=0
      do i=1,imax
       read(ioa,*)jmax
       read(ioa,*)kmax
       do j=1,jmax
        numbeam=numbeam+1
        read(ioa,*)idref
        read(ioa,*)dpos(1:3)
        read(ioa,*)dose
       enddo
      enddo
      rewind(ioa)
      read(ioa,*) cdummy        ! Reference Beam Data ID
      nchar=index(cdummy,' ')
      cFrameID(1:nchar)=cdummy(1:nchar)
      read(ioa,*)imax           ! Number of Fractions Group
      do i=1,imax
       read(ioa,*)jmax          ! Number of Beams
       read(ioa,*)kmax          ! Number of Fractions Planned
       do j=1,jmax
        read(ioa,*)idref
        read(ioa,*)dpos(1:3)
        read(ioa,*)dose
        write(Ctag,'(i2.2)')idref
        call READfilenames(Cinter,Ctag)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Read dimensionts to allocate
      call READdimension(npairMLC,ndimRC,npointBL,iflagFLC)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      call ALLOCATEmultileaf(npairMLC)
      call ALLOCATErangecompensator(ndimRC)
      call ALLOCATEblock(npointBL)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Read output files of PlanReader4PHITS & Image2PHITS
      call READplanfiles(npairMLC,ndimRC,npointBL,iflagFLC,
     &     Cdir,cbeamID,cmatRS,cmatFLC,cmatMLC,cmatRC,cmatBL,
     &     dimGT,dimRS,dimFLC,dimMLC,dimRC,dimBL,dimPS)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Create PHITS input
      call CREATEplaninp(
     &     npairMLC,ndimRC,npointBL,iflagFLC,Cdir,Ctag,
     &     cbeamID,cmatRS,cmatFLC,cmatMLC,cmatRC,cmatBL,
     &     dimGT,dimRS,dimFLC,dimMLC,dimRC,dimBL,dimPS)
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Deallocate
      call DEALLOCATEmultileaf
      call DEALLOCATErangecompensator
      call DEALLOCATEblock
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
       enddo
      enddo
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      close(ioa)
      call CREATEmatelems(Cdir)
      call DEALLOCATEmaterial
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      write(istdout,'(2a)')'***************************',
     &     '******************************************'
      write(istdout,*)' PLAN2PHITS successfully FINISHED !!'
*-----------------------------------------------------------------------

      stop
      end program Plan2PHITS
