string getOSdicomreaderEXE();

vector<string> split(const string &s, char delim) {
	vector<string> elems;
	stringstream ss(s);
	string item;
	while (getline(ss, item, delim)) {
		if (!item.empty()) {
			elems.push_back(item);
		}
	}
	return elems;
}

string digitString(int num, int digit) {

	ios::fmtflags curret_flag = std::cout.flags();

	ostringstream ss;
	ss << setw(digit) << setfill('0') << num;
	string s(ss.str());

	std::cout.flags(curret_flag);
	return s;
}

string digitString2(double num, int digit) {

	ios::fmtflags curret_flag = std::cout.flags();

	ostringstream ss;
	ss << fixed << setprecision(digit) << num;
	string s(ss.str());

	std::cout.flags(curret_flag);
	return s;
}

int DumpDICOMRTPlan(string DicomRTPlanFilePath)
{
	/////////////////////////////
	//                         //
	// Dump DIOCM RT Plan file //
	// *using dcmdump in DCMTK //
	//                         //
	/////////////////////////////

	cout << "2: Dump DIOCM RT-Plan file using dicomreader.exe." << endl;

	int ret;

	string systemExe;
	string DicomReaderEXE;

	DicomReaderEXE=getOSdicomreaderEXE();

	systemExe = DicomReaderEXE + DicomRTPlanFilePath + " > dump.dat";

	ret = system(systemExe.c_str());

	if (ret == 0)
	{
		cout << "   ... OK!" << endl << endl;
	}
	else
	{
		cout << "   ... Error: Cannot dump DICOM RT-Plan file." << endl;
		system("pause");
		exit(1);
	}

	return 0;

}

int ReadDumpFile()
{

	////////////////////////
	//                    //
	// Read DICOM RT-Plan //
	//                    //
	////////////////////////

	cout << "3: Read DICOM RT-Plan dump file." << endl;

	ifstream dumpFile;
	dumpFile.open("dump.dat", ios::in);

	// Read dumpfile

	string tagData;

	if (dumpFile.fail())
	{
		std::cerr << "   ... Fail to open dump file." << std::endl;
		system("pause");
		exit(1);
	}

	int rank = 0;
	//	int flagIonBeamSequence = 0;

	// Fraction Group Sequence frag (*NumberOfFraction<10)
	int fragFractionGroupSequence = 0;
	ReferencedBeamNumber.resize(10);
	BeamDoseSpecificationPoint.resize(10);
	BeamDose.resize(10);

	// Patient Setup Sequence frag
	int fragPatientSetupSequence = 0;

	// Ion Beam Sequence frag
	int fragIonBeamSequence = 0;

	// Range Compensator Sequence frag
	int fragRangeCompensatorSeqence = 0;

	// Beam Limiting Device Position Sequenece frag
	int fragBeamLimitingDevicePositionSequence = 0;
	// string BeamLimitingDeviceType;

	// Block  Sequence frag
	int fragIonBlockSequence = 0;

	// Ion Control Point Sequence frag (*Control point Index = 0 )
	//int fragIonControlPointSequence = 0;

	// Range Shifter Setting Sequence frag
	int fragRangeShifterSettingsSequence = 0;

	int rankBeforeSequence;

	while (getline(dumpFile, tagData))
	{

		string coment = "# ";
		if (tagData.size() > 0 && !(tagData.size() >= 1 && equal(coment.begin(), coment.end(), tagData.begin())))
		{
			// cout << tagData << endl;

			vector<string> element = split(tagData, ' ');
			// cout << "[0]" << element[0] << " [1]" << element[1] << " [2]" << element[2] << endl;

			string groupNumber = element[0].substr(1, 4);
			string elementNumber = element[0].substr(6, 4);
			string content,tmp;
			int i;

			i=element[2].length()-1;
			tmp=element[2].substr(i,1);
			if(equal(tmp.begin(),tmp.end(),"]"))i--;
			content = element[2].substr(1, i);

			if (groupNumber == "fffe" && elementNumber == "e000") rank++;
			if (groupNumber == "fffe" && elementNumber == "e0dd") rank--;

			// cout << "Rank:" << rank << ", GroupNumber:" << groupNumber << ", ElementNubmer:" << elementNumber << ", Content:" << content << endl << endl;

			// FrameOfReferenceUID
			if (element[0] == "(0020,0052)") FrameOfReferenceUID = content;

			///////////////////////////
			// FractionGroupSequence //
			///////////////////////////

			if (element[0] == "(300a,0070)")
			{
				fragFractionGroupSequence = 1;
			}

			if (fragFractionGroupSequence == 1)
			{
				// FractionGroupNumber
				if (element[0] == "(300a,0071)")
				{
					FractionGroupNumber.push_back(content);
				}
				// NunmberOfFractionsPlanned
				if (element[0] == "(300a,0078)") NumberOfFractionsPlanned.push_back(content);
				// NumberOfBeams
				if (element[0] == "(300a,0080)") NumberOfBeamsInFraction.push_back(content);
				// ReferencedBeamNumber
				if (element[0] == "(300c,0006)")
				{
					ReferencedBeamNumber[atoi(FractionGroupNumber.back().c_str())].push_back(content);

				}
				// BeamDoseSpecificationPoint
				if (element[0] == "(300a,0082)")
				{
					BeamDoseSpecificationPoint[atoi(FractionGroupNumber.back().c_str())].push_back(content);
				}
				// BeamDose
				if (element[0] == "(300a,0084)")
				{
					BeamDose[atoi(FractionGroupNumber.back().c_str())].push_back(content);
				}

				if (rank == 0 && element[0] != "(300a,0070)") fragFractionGroupSequence = 0;
			} // End FractionGroupSequence

			//////////////////////////
			// PatientSetupSequence //
			//////////////////////////

			if (element[0] == "(300a,0180)") fragPatientSetupSequence = 1;

			if (fragPatientSetupSequence == 1)
			{
				// IsocenerPosition
				if (element[0] == "(300a,012c)") IsocenterPosition.push_back(content);
				// PatientSetupNumber
				if (element[0] == "(300a,0182)") PatientSetupNumber.push_back(content);
				// TableTopVerticalSetupDisplacement
				if (element[0] == "(300a,01d2)") TableTopVerticalSetupDisplacement.push_back(content);
				// TableTopLongitudinalSetupDisplacement
				if (element[0] == "(300a,01d4)") TableTopLongitudinalSetupDisplacement.push_back(content);
				// TableTopLateralSetupDisplacemenet
				if (element[0] == "(300a,01d6)") TableTopLateralSetupDisplacement.push_back(content);

				if (rank == 0 && element[0] != "(300a,0180)") fragPatientSetupSequence = 0;
			} // End PatientSetupSequence

			/////////////////////
			// IonBeamSequence //
			/////////////////////

			if (element[0] == "(300a,03a2)") fragIonBeamSequence = 1;

			if (fragIonBeamSequence == 1)
			{
				// ReferenceBeamDataID (*Private element)
				if (element[0] == "(2111,101d)") ReferenceBeamDataID.push_back(content);
				// SourceAxisDistance
				if (element[0] == "(300a,00b4)") SourceAxisDistance.push_back(content);
				// BeamNumber
				if (element[0] == "(300a,00c0)") BeamNumber.push_back(content);

				// NumberOfCompensators
				if (element[0] == "(300a,00e0)") NumberOfCompensators.push_back(content);
				// NumberOfBlocks
				if (element[0] == "(300a,00f0)") NumberOfBlocks.push_back(content);

				// RangeCompensatorSequence
				if (element[0] == "(300a,02ea)")
				{
					fragRangeCompensatorSeqence = 1;
					rankBeforeSequence = rank;
				}
				if (fragRangeCompensatorSeqence == 1)
				{
					// CompensatorMaterialID
					if (element[0] == "(300a,00e1)") CompensatorMaterialID.push_back(content);
					// CompensatorNumber
					if (element[0] == "(300a,00e4)") CompensatorNumber.push_back(content);
					// CompensatorRows
					if (element[0] == "(300a,00e7)") CompensatorRows.push_back(content);
					// CompensatorColumns
					if (element[0] == "(300a,00e8)") CompensatorColumns.push_back(content);
					// CompensatorPixelSpacing
					if (element[0] == "(300a,00e9)") CompensatorPixelSpacing.push_back(content);
					// CompensatorPosition
					if (element[0] == "(300a,00ea)") CompensatorPosition.push_back(content);
					// CompensatorThicknessData
					if (element[0] == "(300a,00ec)") CompensatorThicknessData.push_back(content);
					// IsocenterToCompensatorTrayDistance
					if (element[0] == "(300a,02e4)") IsocenterToCompensatorTrayDistance.push_back(content);

					if (rank == rankBeforeSequence && element[0] != "(300a,02ea)") fragRangeCompensatorSeqence = 0;
				}// End RangeCOmpensatorSequence

				// VirtualSourceAxisDistances
				if (element[0] == "(300a,030a)") VirtualSourceAxisDistances.push_back(content);

				// NumberOfRangeShifters
				if (element[0] == "(300a,0312)") NumberOfRangeShifters.push_back(content);

				// BeamLimitingDevice
				if (element[0] == "(300a,00b8)") BeamLimitingDeviceType = content;

				if (element[0] == "(300a,00bb)" && BeamLimitingDeviceType == "ASYMX")ASYMXIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance.push_back(content);
				if (element[0] == "(300a,00bb)" && BeamLimitingDeviceType == "ASYMY")ASYMYIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance.push_back(content);
				if (element[0] == "(300a,00bb)" && BeamLimitingDeviceType == "MLCX") MLCXIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance.push_back(content);

				if (element[0] == "(300a,00bc)" && BeamLimitingDeviceType == "ASYMX") ASYMXNumberOfJawPairs.push_back(content);
				if (element[0] == "(300a,00bc)" && BeamLimitingDeviceType == "ASYMY") ASYMYNumberOfJawPairs.push_back(content);
				if (element[0] == "(300a,00bc)" && BeamLimitingDeviceType == "MLCX") MLCXNumberOfLeafPairs.push_back(content);

				if (element[0] == "(300a,00be)" && BeamLimitingDeviceType == "MLCX") MLCLeafPositionBoundaries.push_back(content);

				// IonBlockSequence
				if (element[0] == "(300a,03a6)")
				{
					fragIonBlockSequence = 1;
					rankBeforeSequence = rank;
				}

				if (fragIonBlockSequence == 1)
				{
					// BlockMaterialData
					if (element[0] == "(300a,00e1)") BlockMaterialID.push_back(content);
					// IsocenterToBlockTrayDistance
					if (element[0] == "(300a,00f7)") IsocenterToBlockTrayDistance.push_back(content);
					// BlockNumber
					if (element[0] == "(300a,00fc)") BlockNumber.push_back(content);
					// BlockThickness
					if (element[0] == "(300a,0100)") BlockThickness.push_back(content);
					// BlockNumberOfPoints
					if (element[0] == "(300a,0104)") BlockNumberOfPoints.push_back(content);
					// BlockData
					if (element[0] == "(300a,0106)") BlockData.push_back(content);

					if (rank == rankBeforeSequence && element[0] != "(300a,03a6)") fragIonBlockSequence = 0;
				}// End Ion Block Sequence

				///////////////////////////////////////////////////////
				// IonControlPointSequence (*Control Index = 0 only) //
				///////////////////////////////////////////////////////

				// ControlPointIndex
				if (element[0] == "(300a,0112)") ControlPointIndex = content;

				if (ControlPointIndex == "0")
				{

					// BeamLimitingDevicePositionSequence
					if (element[0] == "(300a,011a)")
					{
						fragBeamLimitingDevicePositionSequence = 1;
						rankBeforeSequence = rank;
					}
					if (fragBeamLimitingDevicePositionSequence == 1)
					{

						// BeamLimitingDevice
						if (element[0] == "(300a,00b8)") BeamLimitingDeviceType = content;

						if (element[0] == "(300a,011c)" && BeamLimitingDeviceType == "ASYMX") ASYMXJawPositions.push_back(content);
						if (element[0] == "(300a,011c)" && BeamLimitingDeviceType == "ASYMY") ASYMYJawPositions.push_back(content);
						if (element[0] == "(300a,011c)" && BeamLimitingDeviceType == "MLCX") MLCXLeafPositions.push_back(content);

						if (rank == rankBeforeSequence && element[0] != "(300a,011a)") fragBeamLimitingDevicePositionSequence = 0;
					}

					// GantryAngle
					if (element[0] == "(300a,011e)") GantryAngle.push_back(content);

					// BeamLimitingDeviceAngle
					if (element[0] == "(300a,0120)") BeamLimitingDeviceAngle.push_back(content);

					// PatientSupportAngle
					if (element[0] == "(300a,0122)") PatientSupportAngle.push_back(content);

					// GantryPitchAngle
					if (element[0] == "(300a,014a)") GantryPitchAngle.push_back(content);

					// RangeShifterSettingsSequence
					if (element[0] == "(300a,0360)")
					{
						fragRangeShifterSettingsSequence = 1;
						rankBeforeSequence = rank;
					}
					if (fragRangeShifterSettingsSequence == 1)
					{
						// RangeShifterMaterialID
						if (element[0] == "(300a,00e1)") RangeShifterMaterialID.push_back(content);
						if (element[0] == "(300a,0364)") IsocenterToRangeShifterDistance.push_back(content);
						if (element[0] == "(300a,0366)") RangeShifterWaterEquivalentThickness.push_back(content);

						if (rank == rankBeforeSequence && element[0] != "(300a,0360)") fragRangeShifterSettingsSequence = 0;
					}

				}

				if (element[0] == "(300c,006a)") ReferencedPatientSetupNumber.push_back(content);

				if (rank == 0 && element[0] != "(300a,03a2)") fragIonBeamSequence = 0;

			} // End IonBeamSequence

		}

	}

	dumpFile.close();

	remove("dump.dat");

	cout << "   ... OK!" << endl << endl;

	return 0;
}

int ReadFacilityInfo(string FacilityInfoFilePath)
{
	////////////////////////////
	//                        //
	// Read FacilitiyInfo.dat //
	//                        //
	////////////////////////////

	cout << "4: Read FacilityInfo file." << endl;

	ifstream facilityInfoFile;
	//facilityInfoFile.open("FacilityInfo.dat", ios::in);
	facilityInfoFile.open(FacilityInfoFilePath.c_str(), ios::in);

	if (!facilityInfoFile)
	{
		cout << "   ... Error: Cannot open FacilityInfo file(" << FacilityInfoFilePath << ")." << endl;
		system("pause");
		exit(1);
	}

	string tmp;
	vector<string> element;

	// Range Shifter Material ID, Relative Stopping Power
	getline(facilityInfoFile, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	RangeShifterMaterialIDFacilityInfo = element[0];
	RangeShifterMaterialRelativeStoppingPower = element[1];

	// Range Shifter Size x, y [mm]
	getline(facilityInfoFile, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	RangeShifterSize = element[0] + " " + element[1];

	// Range Compensator Material ID
	getline(facilityInfoFile, tmp);
	element= split(tmp, ' ');
	CompensatorMaterialIDFacilityInfo = element[0];
	CompensatorMaterialRelativeStoppingPower = element[1];

	// Range Compensator Size x, y ,z [mm]
	getline(facilityInfoFile, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	CompensatorSize = element[0] + " " + element[1] + " " + element[2];

	// Block Material ID
	getline(facilityInfoFile, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	BlockMaterialIDFacilityInfo = element[0];

	// Block Size x, y, z [mm]
	getline(facilityInfoFile, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	BlockSize = element[0] + " " + element[1] + " " + element[2];

	// Beam Limiting Device ASYMX/ASYMY Material ID
	getline(facilityInfoFile, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	ASYMXYMaterialID = element[0];

	// Beam Limiting Device ASYMX/ASYMY Size x, y, z [mm]
	getline(facilityInfoFile, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	ASYMXYSize = element[0] + " " + element[1] + " " + element[2];

	// Beam Limiting Device MLCX Material ID
	getline(facilityInfoFile, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	MLCXMaterialID = element[0];

	// Beam Limiting Device MLCX Size x, z [mm]
	getline(facilityInfoFile, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	MLCXLeafSize = element[0] + " " + element[1];

	facilityInfoFile.close();

	cout << "   ... OK!" << endl << endl;

	return 0;

}

int WriteIntermediateFile(string DatFilesDirPATH)
{
	///////////////////////////////
	//                           //
	// Write  Intermediate Files //
	//                           //
	///////////////////////////////

	cout << "5: Write Intermediate Files." << endl;

	// dat files directry

	struct stat statBuf;

	if (stat(DatFilesDirPATH.c_str(), &statBuf) != 0)
	  {
	    cout << " ...  Error: Specified directory does not exist (" << DatFilesDirPATH.c_str() << ")." << endl;
	    system("pause");
	    exit(1);
	  }

	int valueOfSetw = 20;
	int NumberOfBeams = 0;
	ofstream ofs;
	string fileName;
	string tmp;
	vector<string> item;

	////////////////////
	// Write Plan.dat //
	////////////////////

	fileName = DatFilesDirPATH + "/Plan.dat";
	cout << "    Write: " << fileName;
	ofs.open(fileName.c_str());

	int numberOfFractions = int(FractionGroupNumber.size());
	//int itemNumber = 0;

	// 1: Frame of Reference UID
	ofs << FrameOfReferenceUID << " # Frame of Reference UID" << endl;
	// 2: Number of Fractions
	ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << numberOfFractions << " # Number Of Fractions Group" << endl;

	for (int i = 0; i < numberOfFractions; i++)
	{
		// Fraction i: Number of Beams
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << NumberOfBeamsInFraction[i] << " # Fraction Group " << FractionGroupNumber[i] << " : Number of Beams" << endl;
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << NumberOfFractionsPlanned[i] << " # Fraction Group " << FractionGroupNumber[i] << " : Number of Fractions Planned" << endl;

		for (int j = 0; j < atoi(NumberOfBeamsInFraction[i].c_str()); j++)
		{
		        NumberOfBeams++;
			ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << ReferencedBeamNumber[atoi(FractionGroupNumber[i].c_str())][j] << " #   Beam " << j+1 << " : Reference Beam Number" << endl;
			item = split(BeamDoseSpecificationPoint[atoi(FractionGroupNumber[i].c_str())][j], '\\');
			tmp = item[0] + " " + item[1] + " " + item[2];
			ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << tmp << " #   Beam " << j+1 << " : Beam Dose Specification Point x, y, z [mm, mm, mm]" << endl;
			ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << BeamDose[atoi(FractionGroupNumber[i].c_str())][j] << " #   Beam " << j+1 << " : Beam Dose [Gy]" << endl;
		}

	}

	ofs.close();

	cout << "                     ... OK!" << endl;

	for (int i = 0; i < int(BeamNumber.size()) ; i++)
	{
		cout << "  BeamNumber:" << digitString(atoi(BeamNumber[i].c_str()), 2) << endl;

		// VirtualSourceAxisDistances
		double virtualSourceAxisDistanceX;
		double virtualSourceAxisDistanceY;

		item = split(VirtualSourceAxisDistances[i], '\\');
		virtualSourceAxisDistanceX = atof(item[0].c_str());
		virtualSourceAxisDistanceY = atof(item[1].c_str());

		double w1,w2, thickness;

		//////////////////////////////////
		// Write RangeCmpensator-##.dat //
		//////////////////////////////////

		fileName = DatFilesDirPATH + "/RangeCompensator-" + digitString( atoi(BeamNumber[i].c_str()), 2) + ".dat";
		cout << "    Write: " << fileName ;

		ofs.open(fileName.c_str());

		// 1: Material ID
	    //ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << CompensatorMaterialID[i] << "# Material ID" << endl;
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << CompensatorMaterialIDFacilityInfo << "# Material ID (FacilityInfo.dat)" << endl;
		// 2: Compensator Rows
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << CompensatorRows[i] << " # Compensator Rows" << endl;
		// 3: Compensator Columns
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << CompensatorColumns[i] << " # Compensator Columns" << endl;
		// 4: Compensator PixelSpacing
		item = split(CompensatorPixelSpacing[i], '\\' );
		//x = atof(item[0].c_str());//*(virtualSourceAxisDistanceX - atof(IsocenterToCompensatorTrayDistance[i].c_str())) / virtualSourceAxisDistanceX;
		//y = atof(item[1].c_str());//*(virtualSourceAxisDistanceY - atof(IsocenterToCompensatorTrayDistance[i].c_str())) / virtualSourceAxisDistanceY;
		//tmp = digitString2(x,1) + " " + digitString2(y,1);
		tmp = item[1] + " " + item[0]; // *20260616 koba
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << tmp << " # Compensator Pixel Spacing [mm]" << endl;
		// 5: Compensator Position
		item = split(CompensatorPosition[i], '\\');
		//x = atof(item[0].c_str());//*(virtualSourceAxisDistanceX - atof(IsocenterToCompensatorTrayDistance[i].c_str())) / virtualSourceAxisDistanceX;
		//y = atof(item[1].c_str());//*(virtualSourceAxisDistanceY - atof(IsocenterToCompensatorTrayDistance[i].c_str())) / virtualSourceAxisDistanceY;
		//tmp =  digitString2(x,1) + " " + digitString2(y,1);
		tmp = item[0] + " " + item[1]; // *20260616 koba
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << tmp << " # Compensator Position [mm] (x_limit, y_limit)" << endl;
		// 6: Compensator Size
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << CompensatorSize << " # Compensator Size x, y, z [mm]" << endl;
		// 7: Isocenter to Compensator Tray Distance
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << IsocenterToCompensatorTrayDistance[i] << " # Isocenter to Compensator Tray Distance [mm]" << endl;

		// * Beam Limiting Device Angle
		//ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << BeamLimitingDeviceAngle[i] << "# Beam Limiting Device Angle [deg.]" << endl;

		// 8: Compensator Thickness Data
		item = split(CompensatorThicknessData[i], '\\');

		for (int j = 0; j < atoi(CompensatorRows[i].c_str())*atoi(CompensatorColumns[i].c_str()); j++)
		{
			thickness = atof(item[j].c_str()) / atof(CompensatorMaterialRelativeStoppingPower.c_str());
			ofs << fixed << setprecision(1) << thickness << " ";
		}
		ofs << " # Compensator Thickness Data" << endl;
		ofs.close();

		cout << "      ... OK!" << endl;

		////////////////////////
		// Write Block-##.dat //
		////////////////////////

		fileName = DatFilesDirPATH + "/Block-" + digitString(atoi(BeamNumber[i].c_str()), 2) + ".dat";
		cout  << "    Write: " << fileName;

		ofs.open(fileName.c_str());

		// 1: Material ID
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << BlockMaterialIDFacilityInfo << " # Material ID (FacilityInfo.dat)" << endl;

		// 2: Block Number of Points
		if (NumberOfBlocks[i] == "0")
		{
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << 0 << " # No Block" << endl;
		}else{
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << BlockNumberOfPoints[i] << " # Block Number of Points" << endl;
		// 3: Block Size
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << BlockSize << " # Block Size x, y, z [mm]" << endl;
		// 4: Isocenter to Block Tray Distance
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << IsocenterToBlockTrayDistance[i] << " # Isocenter to Block Tray Distance [mm]" << endl;

		// * Beam Limiting Device Angle
		//ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << BeamLimitingDeviceAngle[i] << "# Beam Limiting Device Angle [deg.]" << endl;

		// 5:Block Data
		  item = split(BlockData[i], '\\');
		  for (int j = 0; j < atoi(BlockNumberOfPoints[i].c_str())*2 ; j+=2 )
		  {
		    //x = atof(item[j].c_str());//*(virtualSourceAxisDistanceX - atof(IsocenterToBlockTrayDistance[i].c_str())) / virtualSourceAxisDistanceX;
		    //y = atof(item[j+1].c_str());//*(virtualSourceAxisDistanceY - atof(IsocenterToBlockTrayDistance[i].c_str())) / virtualSourceAxisDistanceY;
		    //tmp = digitString2(x, 1) + " " + digitString2(y, 1);
		    tmp = item[j] + " " + item[j+1]; // *20260616 koba
		    ofs << tmp << " ";
		  }
		  ofs << " # Block Data" << endl;
		}
		ofs.close();

		cout << "                 ... OK!" << endl;

		//////////////////////
		// Write FLC-##.dat //
		//////////////////////

		fileName = DatFilesDirPATH + "/FLC-" + digitString(atoi(BeamNumber[i].c_str()), 2) + ".dat";
		cout << "    Write: " << fileName;
		ofs.open(fileName.c_str());

		if( ASYMXIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance.size() == 0 )
		{
		  ofs << "NO_FLC        # No FLC" << endl;
		}else{

		// * Beam Limiting Device Angle
		//ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << BeamLimitingDeviceAngle[i] << "# Beam Limiting Device Angle [deg.]" << endl;

		// * ASYMX
		  ofs << "ASYMX         # Type, ASYMX:FLC-X, ASYMY: FLC-Y" << endl;

		// 1: ASYMX/ASYMY Material ID (FacilityInfo.dat)
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << ASYMXYMaterialID << " # ASYMX/ASYMY Material ID (FacilityInfo.dat)" << endl;
		// 2:ASYMX Jaw Length, Thickness [mm]
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << ASYMXYSize << " # ASYMX Jaw Length, Thickness [mm]" << endl;
		// 3: ASYMX Isocenter To Beam Limiting Device Distance [mm]
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << ASYMXIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance[i] << " # ASYMX Isocenter To Beam Limiting Device Distance [mm]" << endl;
		// 4: ASYMX Jaw Positions [mm]
		  item = split(ASYMXJawPositions[i], '\\');
		  //w1 = atof(item[0].c_str());//*(virtualSourceAxisDistanceX - atof(ASYMXIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance[i].c_str())) / virtualSourceAxisDistanceX;
		  //w2 = atof(item[1].c_str());//*(virtualSourceAxisDistanceX - atof(ASYMXIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance[i].c_str())) / virtualSourceAxisDistanceX;
		  //tmp = digitString2(w1, 1) + " " + digitString2(w2, 1);
		  tmp = item[0] + " " + item[1]; // *20260616 koba
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << tmp << " # ASYMX Jaw Positions [mm]" << endl;

		// * ASYMX
		  ofs << "ASYMY         # Type, ASYMX:FLC-X, ASYMY: FLC-Y" << endl;

		// * ASYMY Material ID (FacilityInfo.dat)
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << ASYMXYMaterialID << " # ASYMX/ASYMY Material ID (FacilityInfo.dat)" << endl;

		// 5: ASYMY Jaw Length, Thickness [mm]
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << ASYMXYSize << " # Device Size Width, Length, Thickness [mm]" << endl;
		// 6: ASYMY Isocenter to Beam Limiting Device Distance [mm]
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << ASYMYIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance[i] << " # ASYMY Isocenter to Beam Limiting Device Distance [mm]" << endl;
		// 7: ASYMY Jaw Positions [mm]
		  item = split(ASYMYJawPositions[i], '\\');
		  //w1 = atof(item[0].c_str());//*(virtualSourceAxisDistanceY - atof(ASYMYIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance[i].c_str())) / virtualSourceAxisDistanceY;
		  //w2 = atof(item[1].c_str());//*(virtualSourceAxisDistanceY - atof(ASYMYIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance[i].c_str())) / virtualSourceAxisDistanceY;
		  //tmp = digitString2(w1, 1) + " " + digitString2(w2, 1);
		  tmp = item[0] + " " + item[1]; // *20260616 koba
		  ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << tmp << " # ASYMY Jaw Positions [mm]" << endl;

		}
		ofs.close();

		cout << "                   ... OK!" << endl;

		//////////////////////
		// Write MLC-##.dat //
		//////////////////////

		fileName = DatFilesDirPATH + "/MLC-" + digitString(atoi(BeamNumber[i].c_str()), 2) + ".dat";
		cout << "    Write: " << fileName;
		ofs.open(fileName.c_str());

		// * Beam Limiting Device Angle
		//ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << BeamLimitingDeviceAngle[i] << "# Beam Limiting Device Angle [deg.]" << endl;

		// 1: MLCX Material ID (FacilityInfo.dat)
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << MLCXMaterialID << " # MLC Material ID (FacilityInfo.dat)" << endl;
		// 2: MLCX Leaf Length, Thickness [mm]
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << MLCXLeafSize << " # MLC Leaf Length, Thickness [mm]" << endl;
		// 3: MLCX Isocenter to Beam Limiting Device Distance
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << MLCXIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance[i] << " # MLCX Isocenter to Beam Limiting Device Distance [mm]" << endl;
		// 4: MLCX Number of Leaf Pairs
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << MLCXNumberOfLeafPairs[i] << " # MLCX Number of Leaf Pairs" << endl;
		// 5: MLCX Leaf Position Boundaries [mm]
		item = split(MLCLeafPositionBoundaries[i], '\\');
		for (int j = 0; j < atoi(MLCXNumberOfLeafPairs[i].c_str()) + 1; j++)
		{
		  //y = atof(item[j].c_str());//*(atof(SourceAxisDistance[i].c_str()) - atof(MLCXIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance[i].c_str())) / atof(SourceAxisDistance[i].c_str());
		  //ofs << digitString2(y, 1) << " ";
		  ofs << item[j] << " "; // *20260616 koba
		}
		ofs << " # MLCX Leaf Position Boundaries [mm] (n = NumberOfLeafJawPairs + 1)" << endl;
		// 6: MLCX Leaf Positions [mm]
		item = split(MLCXLeafPositions[i], '\\');
		for (int j = 0; j < atoi(MLCXNumberOfLeafPairs[i].c_str()) * 2; j++)
		{
		  //x = atof(item[j].c_str());//*(atof(SourceAxisDistance[i].c_str()) - atof(MLCXIsocenterToLimitingDeviceDistance[i].c_str())) / atof(SourceAxisDistance[i].c_str());
		  //ofs << digitString2(x, 1) << " ";
		  ofs << item[j] << " "; // *20260616 koba
		}
		ofs << " # MLCX Leaf Positions [mm] (n = NumberOfLeafJawPairs x 2)" << endl;

		ofs.close();

		cout << "                   ... OK!" << endl;

		///////////////////////////////
		// Write RangeShifter-##.dat //
		///////////////////////////////

		fileName = DatFilesDirPATH + "/RangeShifter-" + digitString(atoi(BeamNumber[i].c_str()), 2) + ".dat";
		cout << "    Write: " << fileName;
		ofs.open(fileName.c_str());

		// 1: Range Shifter Material ID (FacilityInfo.dat)
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << RangeShifterMaterialIDFacilityInfo << " # Range Shifter Material ID (FacilityInfo.dat)" << endl;
		// 2: Range Shifter Size
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << RangeShifterSize << " # Range Shifter Size x, y [mm]" << endl;
		// 3: Isocenter to Range Shifter Distance
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << IsocenterToRangeShifterDistance[i] << " # Range Shifter Isocenter To Range Shifter Distance [mm]" << endl;

		// * Range Shifter Thickness
		//thickness = atof(RangeShifterWaterEquivalentThickness[i].c_str());
		//ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << fixed << setprecision(1) << thickness << " # Range Shifter Water Equivalent Thickness [mm]" << endl;
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << RangeShifterWaterEquivalentThickness[i] << " # Range Shifter Water Equivalent Thickness [mm]" << endl;

		// 4: Range Shifter Thickness
		thickness = atof(RangeShifterWaterEquivalentThickness[i].c_str()) / atof(RangeShifterMaterialRelativeStoppingPower.c_str());
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << fixed << setprecision(1) << thickness << " # Range Shifter Thickness [mm]" << endl;

		ofs.close();

		cout << "          ... OK!" << endl;

		///////////////////////
		// Write Port-##.dat //
		///////////////////////

		fileName = DatFilesDirPATH + "/Port-" + digitString(atoi(BeamNumber[i].c_str()), 2) + ".dat";
		//fileName = DatFilesDirPATH + "/ReferenceBeam-" + digitString(atoi(BeamNumber[i].c_str()), 2) + ".dat";
		cout << "    Write: " << fileName;
		ofs.open(fileName.c_str());

		// 1: Reference Beam Data ID
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << ReferenceBeamDataID[i] << " # Reference Beam Data ID" << endl;
		// 2: Gantry Angle
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << GantryAngle[i] << " # Gantry Angle [deg.]" << endl;
		// 3: Gantry Pitch Angle
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << GantryPitchAngle[i] << " # Gantry Pitch Angle [deg.]" << endl;
		// 4: Beam Limiting Device Angle
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << BeamLimitingDeviceAngle[i] << " # Beam Limiting Device Angle [deg.]" << endl;
		// 5: Patient Support Angle
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << PatientSupportAngle[i] << " # Patient Support Angle [deg.]" << endl;
		// 6: Source Axis Distance
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << SourceAxisDistance[i] << " # Source Axis Distance [mm]" << endl;
		// 7: Virtual Source Axis Distances
		w1=virtualSourceAxisDistanceX;
		w2=virtualSourceAxisDistanceY;
		tmp = digitString2(w1, 1) + " " + digitString2(w2, 1);
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << tmp << " # Virtual Source Axis Distances [mm]" << endl;

		ofs.close();

		cout << "                  ... OK!" << endl;

		///////////////////////////////
		// Write PatientSetup-##.dat //
		///////////////////////////////

		fileName = DatFilesDirPATH + "/PatientSetup-" + digitString(atoi(BeamNumber[i].c_str()), 2) + ".dat";
		cout << "    Write: " << fileName;
		ofs.open(fileName.c_str());

		int setupNumber = atoi(ReferencedPatientSetupNumber[i].c_str());
		int itemNumber = 0;

		for (int j = 0; j < int(PatientSetupNumber.size()); j++)
		{
			if ( atoi(PatientSetupNumber[j].c_str()) == setupNumber) itemNumber = j;
		}

		// 1: Table Top Vertical Setup Displacement
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << TableTopVerticalSetupDisplacement[itemNumber] << " # Table Top Vertical Setup Displacement [mm]" << endl;
		// 2: Table Top Longitudinal Setup Displacement
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << TableTopLongitudinalSetupDisplacement[itemNumber] << " # Table Top Longitudinal Setup Displacement [mm]" << endl;
		// 3: Table Top Lateral Setup Displacement
		ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << TableTopLateralSetupDisplacement[itemNumber] << " # Table Top Lateral Setup Displacement [mm]" << endl;

		ofs.close();

		cout << "          ... OK!" << endl;

	}

	//////////////////////////
	// Write sourceinfo.dat //
	//////////////////////////

	fileName = DatFilesDirPATH + "/sourceinfo.dat";
	cout << "    Write: " << fileName;
	ofs.open(fileName.c_str());

	// 1: RT-Plan source signature
	ofs << "1" << endl;
	// 2: Frame of Reference UID
	ofs << FrameOfReferenceUID << " # Frame of Reference UID" << endl;
	// 3: Number of Total Beams
	ofs << setw(valueOfSetw) << left << NumberOfBeams << " # Number of Total Beams" << endl;

	ofs.close();

	cout << "               ... OK!" << endl;

	return 0;
}

{

	cout << "////////////////////////////////////////////" << endl;
	cout << "//                                        //" << endl;
	cout << "//  PlanReader4PHITS in DICOM2PHITS       //" << endl;
	cout << "//                 version 1.00           //" << endl;
	cout << "//                 2022/09/02             //" << endl;
	cout << "//                                        //" << endl;
	cout << "////////////////////////////////////////////" << endl << endl;

	// Read inp File

	cout << "1: Read inp File." << endl;
	//cout << argv[1] << endl;

	string tmp;
	vector<string> element;

	string FacilityInfoFilePath;
	string DicomRTPlanFilePath;
	string DatFilesDirPATH;

	// 1: Signature of PlanReader4PHITS input
	//	getline(inpFile, tmp);
	getline(cin, tmp);
	string coment = "PLANREADER4PHITS";

	if (tmp.size() < 1 || !(equal(coment.begin(), coment.end(), tmp.begin())))
	{
		cout << " ... input file error!" << endl;
		system("pause");
		exit(1);
	}
	// 2:  FacilityInfo.dat file with PATH
	getline(cin, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	FacilityInfoFilePath = element[0];
	cout << "     FacilityInfo File PATH               : " << FacilityInfoFilePath << endl;
	// 3: DICOM RT-Plan file with PATH
	getline(cin, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	DicomRTPlanFilePath = element[0];
	cout << "     DICOM RT-Plan File PATH              : " << DicomRTPlanFilePath << endl;
	// 4: Intermediate dat files directry PATH
	getline(cin, tmp);
	element = split(tmp, ' ');
	DatFilesDirPATH = element[0];
	int len;
	len=DatFilesDirPATH.size();
	if(DatFilesDirPATH[len-1]=='/')
	  {
	    DatFilesDirPATH.pop_back();
	  }
	cout << "     Intermediate dat files directry PATH : " << DatFilesDirPATH << endl;

	cout << "   ... OK!" << endl << endl;

	DumpDICOMRTPlan(DicomRTPlanFilePath);

	ReadDumpFile();

	ReadFacilityInfo(FacilityInfoFilePath);

	WriteIntermediateFile(DatFilesDirPATH);

	cout << "////////////////////////////////////////////" << endl;
	cout << " PlanReader4PHITS successfully FINISHED !!  " << endl;
	cout << "////////////////////////////////////////////" << endl << endl;

	//system("pause");

    return 0;
}

FILE: src/psfsplitter.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
*     PROGRAM PSFsplitter                                           *
*                                                                   *
*         Created by T. Furuta on 2022/09/02                        *
*                                                                   *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*     Version 1.00                                                  *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                                                                   *
*     Purpose                                                       *
*         Collect existing phase space files(PSF) and re-distribute *
*         to match MPI parallelization numbers
*                                                                   *
*         Last modified by T. Furuta on 2020/09/02                  *
*********************************************************************
      PROGRAM PSFsplitter
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer :: ndata,nmpi,ifile,nfile,i,j,impi,jpsf
      integer :: istat
      real :: rdata(20)
      character(LEN=200) :: outdir,outfile,cdummy
      character(LEN=200),allocatable :: filename(:),outfiles(:)
      character(LEN=3) :: cnum

      write(*,*)'Type PSFSPLITTER to run psfsplitter'
      read(*,*)cdummy
      if(cdummy(1:11).ne.'PSFSPLITTER')then
       write(*,*)
     &      'ERROR:: signature PSFSPLITTER is not confirmed'
       write(*,*)'This input may not be for psfsplitter'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      write(*,*)'jpsf mode ? 1:without wt 2:with wt'
      read(*,*)jpsf
      ndata=5+jpsf
      write(*,*)'Number of Input Files'
      read(*,*)nfile
      allocate( filename(nfile) )
      do ifile=1,nfile
       write(*,'(a,i2,a)')' Input filename',ifile,' ?'
       read(*,*)filename(ifile)
      enddo
      write(*,*)'Output file directory ?'
      read(*,*)outdir
      write(*,*)'Output file name ?'
      read(*,*)outfile
      write(*,*)'Number of MPI parallel processes ?'
      read(*,*)nmpi
      allocate( outfiles(nmpi) )

      if(nmpi.gt.1)then
       do impi=1,nmpi
        write(cnum,'(i3.3)')impi
        outfiles(impi)=trim(outdir)//'/'//trim(outfile)//'.'//cnum
        open(20+impi,file=outfiles(impi),status='unknown',
     &       form='unformatted')
       enddo
      else
       outfiles(1)=trim(outdir)//'/'//trim(outfile)
       open(21,file=outfiles(1),status='unknown',form='unformatted')
      endif
      j=0
      do ifile=1,nfile
       write(*,'(3a)')' Reading file= ',trim(filename(ifile)),'....'
       open(10,file=filename(ifile),status='old',form='unformatted')
       istat=0
       do while(istat.ne.-1)
        read(10,iostat=istat)(rdata(i),i=1,ndata)
        if(istat.eq.0)then
         j=j+1
         impi=mod(j,nmpi)+1
         write(20+impi)(rdata(i),i=1,ndata)
        endif
       enddo
       close(10)
      enddo
      if(nmpi.gt.1)then
       do impi=1,nmpi
        close(20+impi)
       enddo
      else
       close(21)
      endif

      write(*,*)'Total Number of Particles = ',j
      write(*,'(2a)')'***************************',
     &     '******************************************'
      write(*,*)' PSFSPLITTER successfully FINISHED !!'
      write(*,*)

      stop
      end program PSFsplitter
*********************************************************************
END_FILE

FILE: src/readctmod.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
      module readct
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200) :: Cpath,Cdir
      integer :: Npath,Ndir,Nfile
      character(LEN=200),allocatable :: Cfilenames(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: zloc(:)
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READctinputs(ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax,izmin,izmax,
     &     nxc,nyc,nzc,izstep,iorg,icolor,Cconvtable,Cinter)
      use stdinout, only:istdin,istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax,izmin,izmax
      integer,intent(out) :: nxc,nyc,nzc
      integer,intent(out) :: izstep,iorg,icolor
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: Cconvtable,Cinter
      character(LEN=1024) :: dummy
      integer :: ios

      write(istdout,*)'Type CT2PHITS to run ct2phits'
      read(istdin,'(a)') dummy
      if(dummy(1:8).ne.'CT2PHITS')then
       write(istdout,*)'ERROR:: signature CT2PHITS is not confirmed'
       write(istdout,*)'This input may not be for ct2phits'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'File for conversion of voxel data'
      read(istdin,*)Cconvtable
      write(istdout,*)'DICOM file directory'
      read(istdin,*)Cdir
      Ndir=len_trim(Cdir)
      write(istdout,*)'Directory for creating intermediate files'
      read(istdin,*)Cinter
      write(istdout,*)'Minimum slice number, Maximum slice number'
      read(istdin,*)izmin,izmax
      if(izmin.lt.1.or.izmax.lt.1)then
       write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nzmin and Nzmax should be >= 1'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      izstep=1
      if(izmin.gt.izmax)then
       izstep=izmax
       izmax=izmin
       izmin=izstep
       izstep=-1
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'Clipping: Nxmin,Nxmax,Nymin,Nymax'
      read(istdin,*)ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax
      if(ixmin.lt.1)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nxmin should be >= 1'
        call exit(-1)
      elseif(ixmin.gt.ixmax)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nxmin should be <= Nxmax'
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      if(iymin.lt.1)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nymin should be >= 1'
        call exit(-1)
      elseif(iymin.gt.iymax)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nymin should be <= Nymax'
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'Coase graning: Nxc, Nyc, Nzc'
      read(istdin,*)nxc,nyc,nzc
      if(nxc.lt.0.or.nyc.lt.0.or.nzc.lt.0)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nxc, Nyc, Nzc should be >= 1'
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'Coordinates 0:zero at center 1:DICOM system'
      read(istdin,*)iorg
      if(iorg.lt.-1.or.iorg.gt.1)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: choose coordinates',
     &      ' 0:Zero at center 1:DICOM system'
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'Color Option 0:rainbow 1:gray scale'
      read(istdin,*,iostat=ios)icolor
      if(ios.ne.0)icolor=0
      if(icolor.lt.0.or.icolor.gt.1)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: choose color option',
     &      ' 0:rainbow 1:gray scale'
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      return
      end subroutine READctinputs
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine SETreadfile(iz)
      integer,intent(in) :: iz
      character(LEN=1),parameter :: NULL=CHAR(0)
      Nfile=len_trim(Cfilenames(iz))
      Npath=Ndir+Nfile+1
      Cpath(1:Npath)=Cdir(1:Ndir)//Cfilenames(iz)(1:Nfile)//NULL

      return
      end subroutine SETreadfile
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READheader(izmin,izmin2,nxnum,nynum,xdel,ydel,zdel,
     &     xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec)
*     SliceThickness
*     SpacingBetweenSlices (not necessary)
*     Image Position Patient
*     Image Orientation Patient
*     Rows
*     Columns
*     PixelSpacing
*     Bits Allocated
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: izmin,izmin2
      integer,intent(out) :: nxnum,nynum
      real(8),intent(out) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      real(8),intent(out) :: xsh(3),xvec(3),yvec(3),zvec(3)
      real(8) :: zpos

      call SETreadfile(izmin)
      call c_get_dimension(nxnum,nynum,xdel,ydel,zdel,
     &     xsh,xvec,yvec,Cpath)
      call SETreadfile(izmin2)
      call c_get_position(zpos,Cpath)
      xdel=xdel*0.1d0
      ydel=ydel*0.1d0
cFURUTA20240814      zdel=zdel*0.1d0
      zdel=abs(zpos-xsh(3))*0.1d0 !FURUTA20240814
      xsh(1:3)=xsh(1:3)*0.1d0
      zvec(1)=xvec(2)*yvec(3)-xvec(3)*yvec(2)
      zvec(2)=xvec(3)*yvec(1)-xvec(1)*yvec(3)
      zvec(3)=xvec(1)*yvec(2)-xvec(2)*yvec(1)
      return
      end subroutine READheader
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READdirectory(izmax0,nlist)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: izmax0
      integer,intent(out) :: nlist
      character(LEN=200) :: Cpath
      character(LEN=3) :: Cmod
      character(LEN=1),parameter :: NULL=CHAR(0)

      Npath=Ndir+1
      Cpath(1:Npath)=Cdir(1:Ndir)//NULL
      Cmod(1:3)="CT"//NULL
      call c_get_ctfiles(nlist,Cpath,Cmod)

      if(nlist.le.0)then
        write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &       ' ERROR: no CT image file is found in ',Cdir(1:Ndir)
        call exit(-1)
      elseif(nlist.lt.izmax0)then
        write(istdout,'(a,i5)')
     &       ' ERROR: maximum slice number should be <= ',nlist
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      return
      end subroutine READdirectory
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READfilenames(nlist)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nlist
      integer :: i

      open(20,file='tmp.txt',status='old')
      if(nlist.le.0)then
        write(istdout,'(2a)')' ERROR: no file is found in ',Cdir(1:Ndir)
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      do i=1,nlist
        read(20,*)Cfilenames(i),zloc(i)
      enddo
      close(20,status='delete')

      return
      end subroutine READfilenames
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine ALLOCATEfilenames(nlist)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nlist
      allocate(Cfilenames(nlist))
      return
      end subroutine ALLOCATEfilenames
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine DEALLOCATEfilenames
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      deallocate(Cfilenames)
      return
      end subroutine DEALLOCATEfilenames
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine ALLOCATEzloc(nlist)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nlist
      allocate(zloc(nlist))
      return
      end subroutine ALLOCATEzloc
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine DEALLOCATEzloc
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      deallocate(zloc)
      return
      end subroutine DEALLOCATEzloc
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      end module readct
END_FILE

FILE: src/readmod.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
      module readfile
*********************************************************************
      implicit none

      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READinputs(iparam,isrc,ibeam,iphantom,iorg,itally,ipet,
     &     isrcvoxel,maxcas,maxbch,iparallel,nomp,nmpi,
     &     numbeam,ndimV,ndimS,dimV,dimS,
     &     Cdir,Cinter,Cparamfile,cdata)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: iparam,isrc,ibeam,iphantom,iorg,itally(11)
      integer,intent(out) :: ipet
      integer,intent(out) :: maxcas,maxbch,iparallel,nomp,nmpi
      integer,intent(out) :: numbeam,ndimV(3),ndimS(12)
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimV(18),dimS(9)
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: Cdir,Cinter,cdata
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: nchar,ntall,i,isrcvoxel,ios
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy,Cparamfile,filename
      character(LEN=200) :: cFrameID

      iorg=1 ! iphantom=0
      ipet=0 ! PET instance
      isrcvoxel=0 ! maxcas=(# of src voxels) PET source option
      write(Cdir,'(200x)')
      write(Cinter,'(200x)')
      write(Cparamfile,'(200x)')
      write(cFrameID,'(200x)')
      write(istdout,*)
     &     'Type INPUTCREATER4PHITS to run inputcreater4phits'
      read(istdin,*)cdummy
      if(cdummy(1:18).ne.'INPUTCREATER4PHITS')then
         write(istdout,*)
     &        'ERROR:: signature INPUTCREATER4PHITS is not confirmed'
       write(istdout,*)'This input may not be for inputcreater4phits'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'Directory for intermediate files (DATfiles/)'
      read(istdin,*)cdummy
      nchar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
      Cinter=cdummy(1:nchar)
      write(istdout,*)'Directory for PHITS inputs (PHITSinput/)'
      read(istdin,*)cdummy
      nchar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
      Cdir=cdummy(1:nchar)
      write(istdout,*)'PHITS parameter option: ',
     &     '0;Selected according to source option, 1;Custom'
      read(istdin,*)iparam
      if(iparam.lt.0.or.iparam.gt.1)then
       write(istdout,*)'ERROR: choose option ',
     &      '0;Selected according to source option, or 1;Custom'
       call exit(-1)
      elseif(iparam.eq.1)then
       write(istdout,*)'File for PHITS parameter'
       read(istdin,*)cdummy
       nchar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
       Cparamfile(1:nchar)=cdummy(1:nchar)
      endif

      write(istdout,*)'Maxcas, Maxbatch'
      read(istdin,*)maxcas,maxbch
      write(istdout,*)'Parallel Setting: ',
     &     '0;without parallelization, 1;with parallelization'
      read(istdin,*)iparallel
      nomp=1
      nmpi=1
      if(iparallel.eq.1)then
         write(istdout,*)'NOMP:Number of OpenMP threads ',
     &        'NMPI:Number of MPI processes'
         read(istdin,*)nomp,nmpi
      endif
      if(nomp.eq.1.and.nmpi.le.1)then
         iparallel=0
         nmpi=1
      endif
      filename=trim(Cinter)//'sourceinfo.dat'
      open(io,file=filename,status='old',err=901)
      read(io,*)isrc
      if(isrc.eq.0)then ! Simple source
       call READsourceinfoSimple(io,ibeam,dimS)
       numbeam=1
      elseif(isrc.eq.1)then ! DICOM RT-Plan
       read(io,'(a)')cFrameID
       cdata=cFrameID
       read(io,*)numbeam
       ibeam=2
      elseif(isrc.eq.2)then     ! PET
       write(istdout,*)'iPET:PET source instance',
     &      ' (0:Time-integrated source)'
       read(istdin,*)ipet
       write(istdout,*)'Setting maxcas=(# of src voxels)',
     &      ' (0:No 1:Yes)'
       read(istdin,*,iostat=ios)isrcvoxel
       if(ios.ne.0)isrcvoxel=0
       call READsourceinfoPET(io,cdata,ndimS,dimS)
       if(ipet.lt.0.or.ipet.gt.ndimS(7))then
        write(istdout,'(a,a,i3,a,i3)')
     &       'ERROR: Invalid PET source instance ',
     &       'iPET =',ipet,' needs to be 0<= >=',ndimS(7)
        call exit(-1)
       endif
       ibeam=1
       numbeam=1
      else
       write(istdout,'(3a)')'ERROR: Invalid source option in ',
     &      'FILE=sourceinfo.dat in ',trim(Cinter)
       write(istdout,'(a,i2)')'       Source option = ',isrc
       write(istdout,'(a)')'       should be within 0 - 1'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      close(io)

      filename=trim(Cinter)//'phantominfo.dat'
      open(io,file=filename,status='old',err=902)
      read(io,*)iphantom
      if(iphantom.eq.0)then
       if(isrc.eq.2)then
        write(istdout,'(3a)')'ERROR: PET source is only compatible ',
     &       'with CT image target'
        write(istdout,'(a,i2)')'       Target option = ',iphantom
        write(istdout,'(a)')'       should be = 1'
        call exit(-1)
       endif
       call READphantominfoWater(io,ndimV,dimV)
      elseif(iphantom.eq.1)then
       call READphantominfoImage(io,iorg,ndimV,dimV)
      else
       write(istdout,'(3a)')'ERROR: Invalid phantom option in ',
     &      'FILE=phantominfo.dat in ',trim(Cinter)
       write(istdout,'(a,i2)')'       Phantom option = ',iphantom
       write(istdout,'(a)')'       should be within 0 - 1'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      close(io)

      if(isrc.eq.1)then
       ntall=4+7
      else
       ntall=4
      endif
      filename=trim(Cinter)//'tallyinfo.dat'
      open(io,file=filename,status='old',err=903)
      read(io,*,err=904)(itally(i),i=1,ntall)
      close(io)

      return

 901  write(istdout,'(2a)')'ERROR: FILE=sourceinfo.dat is missing in ',
     &     trim(Cinter)
      call exit(-1)
      return
 902  write(istdout,'(2a)')'ERROR: FILE=phantominfo.dat is missing in ',
     &     trim(Cinter)
      call exit(-1)
      return
 903  write(istdout,'(2a)')'WARNING: FILE=tallyinfo.dat is missing in ',
     &     trim(Cinter)
      write(istdout,'(a)')' Default tallies are applied'
      do i=1,ntall
       itally(i)=1
      enddo
      return
 904  write(istdout,'(a)')
     &     'ERROR: format of FILE=tallyinfo.dat incompatible'
      write(istdout,'(a,i2,a)')'       Expecting ',ntall,' numbers'
      call exit(-1)
      return

      end subroutine READinputs

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READsourceinfoSimple(io,ibeam,dimS)
* read sourceinfo.dat for simple source
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimS(9)
      integer,intent(out) :: ibeam
      real(8) :: sizex,sizey,offsetx,offsety,sdist
      real(8) :: hangle,vangle
      read(io,*)ibeam
      read(io,*)sizex,sizey
      read(io,*)offsetx,offsety
      read(io,*)sdist
      read(io,*)hangle,vangle
      dimS(1)=sizex/10.0d0      ! mm -> cm
      dimS(2)=sizey/10.0d0      ! mm -> cm
      dimS(3)=offsetx/10.0d0    ! mm -> cm
      dimS(4)=offsety/10.0d0    ! mm -> cm
      dimS(5)=sdist/10.0d0      ! mm -> cm
      dimS(6)=hangle
      dimS(7)=vangle
      return
      end subroutine READsourceinfoSimple
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READsourceinfoPET(io,cdata,ndimS,dimS)
* read sourceinfo.dat for PET source
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cdata
      integer,intent(out) :: ndimS(12)
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimS(9)
      character(LEN=200) :: cRIname
      integer :: iradflag(5)
      integer :: ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      real(8) :: xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh(3)
      write(cRIname,'(200x)')
      read(io,*)cRIname
      read(io,*)iradflag(1:5)
      read(io,*)ixmin,iymin,izmin
      read(io,*)ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      read(io,*)xdel,ydel,zdel
      read(io,*)xorg,yorg,zorg
      read(io,*)xsh(1:3)
      cdata=cRIname
      ndimS(1)=ixmin
      ndimS(2)=iymin
      ndimS(3)=izmin
      ndimS(4)=ixnum
      ndimS(5)=iynum
      ndimS(6)=iznum
      ndimS(7)=ntiming
      ndimS(8:12)=iradflag(1:5)
      dimS(1)=xdel
      dimS(2)=ydel
      dimS(3)=zdel
      dimS(4)=xorg
      dimS(5)=yorg
      dimS(6)=zorg
      dimS(7:9)=xsh(1:3)
      return
      end subroutine READsourceinfoPET
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READphantominfoWater(io,ndimV,dimV)
* read phantominfo.dat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io
      integer,intent(out) :: ndimV(3)
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimV(18)
      integer :: i,nx,ny,nz
      real(8) :: xlen,ylen,zlen,dep
      real(8) :: dx,dy,dz
      real(8) :: xsh,ysh,zsh
      read(io,*)xlen,ylen,zlen
      read(io,*)dep
      read(io,*)xsh,ysh,zsh
      read(io,*)nx,ny,nz
      ndimV(1)=nx
      ndimV(2)=ny
      ndimV(3)=nz
      dx=xlen/dble(nx)*0.1d0 ! mm->cm
      dy=ylen/dble(ny)*0.1d0 ! mm->cm
      dz=zlen/dble(nz)*0.1d0 ! mm->cm
      dimV(1)=dx
      dimV(2)=dy
      dimV(3)=dz
      dimV(4)=-0.05d0*xlen ! mm->cm
      dimV(5)=-0.05d0*ylen ! mm->cm
      dimV(6)=-0.1d0*dep ! mm->cm
      dimV(7)=xsh*0.1d0 ! mm->cm
      dimV(8)=ysh*0.1d0 ! mm->cm
      dimV(9)=zsh*0.1d0 ! mm->cm
      do i=10,18
       dimV(i)=0.0d0
      enddo
      return
      end subroutine READphantominfoWater
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READphantominfoImage(io,iorg,ndimV,dimV)
* read phantominfo.dat

      integer,intent(out) :: ndimV(3),iorg

      ndimV(3)=iznum
      dimV(1)=xdel
      dimV(2)=ydel
      dimV(3)=zdel

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READplandat(Cinter,numbeam,ctaglist,dposlist,doselist)
* read plan.dat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: numbeam
      character(LEN=2),intent(out) :: ctaglist(numbeam)
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy,filename
      real(8),intent(out) :: dposlist(3,numbeam),doselist(numbeam)
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: i,j,inum,idref
      integer :: imax,jmax,kmax
      character(LEN=2) :: Ctag
      real(8) :: dpos(3),dose
      filename=trim(Cinter)//'Plan.dat'
      open(io,file=filename,status='old')
      read(io,*)cdummy
      read(io,*)imax
      inum=0
      do i=1,imax
       read(io,*)jmax
       read(io,*)kmax
       do j=1,jmax
        inum=inum+1
        read(io,*)idref
        read(io,*)dpos(1:3)
        read(io,*)dose
        write(Ctag,'(i2.2)')idref
        ctaglist(inum)=Ctag
        dposlist(1:3,inum)=dpos(1:3)
        doselist(inum)=dose
       enddo
      enddo
      end subroutine READplandat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READz0(numbeam,z0list)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: numbeam
      real(8),intent(out) :: z0list(numbeam)
      integer :: inum
      do inum=1,numbeam
       write(istdout,*)'z position for beam =',inum
       read(istdin,*)z0list(inum)
      enddo
      end subroutine READz0
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READpetdat(Cinter,ndimS,pdata,decaybiodata,totalsource)
* read bqdata.dat and decaybio.dat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: ndimS(12)
      real(8),intent(out)::pdata(ndimS(4),ndimS(5),ndimS(6),0:ndimS(7))
      real(8),intent(out) :: decaybiodata(ndimS(4),ndimS(5),ndimS(6))
      real(8),intent(out) :: totalsource(0:ndimS(7))
      integer,parameter :: io=20
      integer :: ix,iy,iz,i,ii,it
      integer :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      character(LEN=200) :: filename
      ixnum=ndimS(4)
      iynum=ndimS(5)
      iznum=ndimS(6)
      ntiming=ndimS(7)
      filename=trim(Cinter)//'bqdata.dat'
      open(io,file=filename,status='old',err=901)
      do it=0,ntiming
       read(io,*)totalsource(it)
      enddo
      do it=0,ntiming ! pidata + pdata
       do iz=1,iznum
        do iy=1,iynum
         do i=1,ixnum,10
          ii=min(i+9,ixnum)
          read(io,*)(pdata(ix,iy,iz,it),ix=i,ii)
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      close(io)
      filename=trim(Cinter)//'decaybio.dat'
      open(io,file=filename,status='old',err=902)
      do iz=1,iznum
       do iy=1,iynum
        do i=1,ixnum,10
         ii=min(i+9,ixnum)
         read(io,*)(decaybiodata(ix,iy,iz),ix=i,ii)
        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      close(io)
      return

 901  write(istdout,'(2a)')'ERROR: FILE=bqdata.dat is missing in ',
     &     trim(Cinter)
      call exit(-1)
      return
 902  write(istdout,'(2a)')'ERROR: FILE=decaybio.dat is missing in ',
     &     trim(Cinter)
      call exit(-1)
      return
      end subroutine READpetdat

*********************************************************************
      module readpet
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200) :: Cpath,Cdir
      integer :: Npath,Ndir,Nfile
      character(LEN=200),allocatable :: Cfilenames(:)
      integer,allocatable :: iduration(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: zloc(:),timing(:)
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READpetinputs(iradflag,ireaddir,inorm,
     &     ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax,izmin,izmax,decaybioinp,
     &     CRIlist,cRIname,Cinter)
      use stdinout, only:istdin,istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax,izmin,izmax
      integer,intent(out) :: ireaddir,iradflag(5),inorm
      real(8),intent(out) :: decaybioinp
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cRIname,Cinter,CRIlist
      character(LEN=1024) :: dummy

      write(istdout,*)'Type PET2PHITS to run pet2phits'
      read(istdin,'(a)') dummy
      if(dummy(1:9).ne.'PET2PHITS')then
       write(istdout,*)'ERROR:: signature PET2PHITS is not confirmed'
       write(istdout,*)'This input may not be for pet2phits'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'File for RI list'
      read(istdin,*)CRIlist
      write(istdout,*)'RI name'
      read(istdin,*)cRIname
      write(istdout,*)'Radiation type: ',
     &     'all, photon, electron, positron, alpha',
     &     ' (0:OFF, 1:ON)'
      read(istdin,*)iradflag(1:5)
      if(iradflag(1).eq.1)then
       if(iradflag(2)+iradflag(3)+iradflag(4)+iradflag(5).gt.0)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR:: radiation type ALL should be set alone'
        call exit(-1)
       endif
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'Directory for creating intermediate files'
      read(istdin,*)Cinter
      write(istdout,*)'PET files 0: from directory 1: temporary file'
      read(istdin,*)ireaddir
      if(ireaddir.eq.0)then
       write(istdout,*)'PET file directory'
       read(istdin,*)Cdir
       Ndir=len_trim(Cdir)
       write(istdout,*)'Minimum slice number, Maximum slice number'
       read(istdin,*)izmin,izmax
       if(izmin.lt.1.or.izmax.lt.1)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nzmin and Nzmax should be >= 1'
        call exit(-1)
       endif
       if(izmin.gt.izmax)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nzmax should be <= Nzmin'
        call exit(-1)
       endif
       write(istdout,*)'Clipping: Nxmin,Nxmax,Nymin,Nymax'
       read(istdin,*)ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax
       if(ixmin.lt.1)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nxmin should be >= 1'
        call exit(-1)
       elseif(ixmin.gt.ixmax)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nxmin should be <= Nxmax'
        call exit(-1)
       endif
       if(iymin.lt.1)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nymin should be >= 1'
        call exit(-1)
       elseif(iymin.gt.iymax)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: Nymin should be <= Nymax'
        call exit(-1)
       endif
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'Biological decay constant',
     &     ' (<0: fitting from data)'
      read(istdin,*)decaybioinp
      write(istdout,*)'Normalization option, 0:as it is 1:per MBq'
      read(istdin,*)inorm

      return
      end subroutine READpetinputs
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine SETreadfile(ilist)
      integer,intent(in) :: ilist
      character(LEN=1),parameter :: NULL=CHAR(0)
      Nfile=len_trim(Cfilenames(ilist))
      Npath=Ndir+Nfile+1
      Cpath(1:Npath)=Cdir(1:Ndir)//Cfilenames(ilist)(1:Nfile)//NULL

      return
      end subroutine SETreadfile
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READheader(izmin,izmin2,nxnum,nynum,xdel,ydel,zdel,
     &     xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec,activity,halflifePET)
*     SliceThickness
*     SpacingBetweenSlices (not necessary)
*     Image Position Patient
*     Image Orientation Patient
*     Rows
*     Columns
*     PixelSpacing
*     Bits Allocated
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: izmin,izmin2
      integer,intent(out) :: nxnum,nynum
      real(8),intent(out) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      real(8),intent(out) :: xsh(3),xvec(3),yvec(3),zvec(3)
      real(8),intent(out) :: activity,halflifePET
      integer :: ihalf
      real(8) :: zpos

      call SETreadfile(izmin)
      call c_get_dimension(nxnum,nynum,xdel,ydel,zdel,
     &     xsh,xvec,yvec,Cpath)
      call c_get_radioactivity(activity,ihalf,Cpath)
      call SETreadfile(izmin2)
      call c_get_position(zpos,Cpath)
      xdel=xdel*0.1d0
      ydel=ydel*0.1d0
cFURUTA20240814      zdel=zdel*0.1d0
      zdel=abs(zpos-xsh(3))*0.1d0 !FURUTA20240814
      xsh(1:3)=xsh(1:3)*0.1d0
      zvec(1)=xvec(2)*yvec(3)-xvec(3)*yvec(2)
      zvec(2)=xvec(3)*yvec(1)-xvec(1)*yvec(3)
      zvec(3)=xvec(1)*yvec(2)-xvec(2)*yvec(1)
      activity=activity*1.0e-6 ! activity in MBq
      halflifePET=dble(ihalf)
      return
      end subroutine READheader
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READmultiframeheader(iz,nxnum,nynum,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec,
     &     activity,halflifePET)
*     SliceThickness
*     SpacingBetweenSlices (not necessary)
*     Image Position Patient
*     Image Orientation Patient
*     Rows
*     Columns
*     PixelSpacing
*     Bits Allocated
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: iz
      integer,intent(out) :: nxnum,nynum
      real(8),intent(out) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      real(8),intent(out) :: xsh(3),xvec(3),yvec(3),zvec(3)
      real(8),intent(out) :: activity,halflifePET
      integer :: ihalf

      call SETreadfile(iz)
      call c_get_dimension(nxnum,nynum,xdel,ydel,zdel,
     &     xsh,xvec,yvec,Cpath)
      call c_get_radioactivity(activity,ihalf,Cpath)
      xdel=xdel*0.1d0
      ydel=ydel*0.1d0
      zdel=zdel*0.1d0
      xsh(1:3)=xsh(1:3)*0.1d0
      zvec(1)=xvec(2)*yvec(3)-xvec(3)*yvec(2)
      zvec(2)=xvec(3)*yvec(1)-xvec(1)*yvec(3)
      zvec(3)=xvec(1)*yvec(2)-xvec(2)*yvec(1)
      activity=activity*1.0e-6 ! activity in MBq
      halflifePET=dble(ihalf)
      return
      end subroutine READmultiframeheader
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READpetdata(ixmin,iymin,izmin,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,nxnum,nynum,nznum,izlist,pdata)
*     RescaleIntercept
*     RescaleSlope
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: ixmin,iymin,izmin
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      integer,intent(in) :: nxnum,nynum,nznum,izlist(nznum)
      real(8),intent(out) :: pdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      integer :: ixmax,iymax,izmax
      integer :: ix,iy,iz,ilist
      integer :: k,ntot
      real(8),allocatable:: hdata(:)

      ixmax=ixmin+ixnum-1
      iymax=iymin+iynum-1
      izmax=izmin+iznum-1
      if(ixmax.gt.nxnum)then
       write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' ERROR: Nxmax should be <= ',nxnum
       call exit(-1)
      elseif(iymax.gt.nynum)then
       write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' ERROR: Nymax should be <= ',nynum
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      ntot=nxnum*nynum
      allocate( hdata(ntot) )
      do iz=izmin,izmax
       ilist=izlist(iz)
       write(*,'(2a)')' Loading file = ',Cfilenames(ilist)(1:Nfile)
       call SETreadfile(ilist)
       call c_get_data(hdata,ntot,Cpath)
       do iy=1,nynum
        do ix=1,nxnum
         if(ix.ge.ixmin.and.ix.le.ixmax.and.
     &        iy.ge.iymin.and.iy.le.iymax)then
          k=(iy-1)*nxnum+ix
          pdata((ix-ixmin)+1,(iy-iymin)+1,(iz-izmin)+1)=hdata(k)
         endif
        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      deallocate( hdata )
      return

      end subroutine READpetdata
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READmultiframedata(iflaginv,ixmin,iymin,izmin,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,nxnum,nynum,nznum,izlist,pdata)
*     RescaleIntercept
*     RescaleSlope
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      logical,intent(in) :: iflaginv
      integer,intent(in) :: ixmin,iymin,izmin
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      integer,intent(in) :: nxnum,nynum,nznum,izlist(nznum)
      real(8),intent(out) :: pdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      integer :: ixmax,iymax,izmax
      integer :: ix,iy,iz,ilist
      integer :: k,ntot
      real(8),allocatable:: hdata(:)

      ixmax=ixmin+ixnum-1
      iymax=iymin+iynum-1
      izmax=izmin+iznum-1
      if(ixmax.gt.nxnum)then
       write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' ERROR: Nxmax should be <= ',nxnum
       call exit(-1)
      elseif(iymax.gt.nynum)then
       write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' ERROR: Nymax should be <= ',nynum
       call exit(-1)
      elseif(izmax.gt.nznum)then
       write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' ERROR: Nzmax should be <= ',nznum
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      ntot=nxnum*nynum*nznum
      allocate( hdata(ntot) )

      ilist=izlist(1)
      write(*,'(2a)')' Loading file = ',Cfilenames(ilist)(1:Nfile)
      call SETreadfile(1)
      call c_get_multidata(hdata,ntot,Cpath)

      if(.not.iflaginv)then
       do iz=1,nznum
        do iy=1,nynum
         do ix=1,nxnum
          if(ix.ge.ixmin.and.ix.le.ixmax.and.
     &         iy.ge.iymin.and.iy.le.iymax.and.
     &         iz.ge.izmin.and.iz.le.izmax)then
           k=(iz-1)*nynum*nxnum+(iy-1)*nxnum+ix
           pdata((ix-ixmin)+1,(iy-iymin)+1,(iz-izmin)+1)=hdata(k)
          endif
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
      else
       do iz=1,nznum
        do iy=1,nynum
         do ix=1,nxnum
          if(ix.ge.ixmin.and.ix.le.ixmax.and.
     &         iy.ge.iymin.and.iy.le.iymax.and.
     &         iz.ge.izmin.and.iz.le.izmax)then
           k=(nznum-iz)*nynum*nxnum+(iy-1)*nxnum+ix
           pdata((ix-ixmin)+1,(iy-iymin)+1,(iz-izmin)+1)=hdata(k)
          endif
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
      endif
      deallocate( hdata )
      return

      end subroutine READmultiframedata
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READdirectory(izmax,nslices,ntiming,imulti)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: izmax
      integer,intent(out) :: ntiming,nslices,imulti
      character(LEN=200) :: Cpath
      character(LEN=3) :: Cmod,Cmod2
      character(LEN=1),parameter :: NULL=CHAR(0)

      Npath=Ndir+1
      Cpath(1:Npath)=Cdir(1:Ndir)//NULL
      Cmod(1:3)="PT"//NULL
      Cmod2(1:3)="NM"//NULL
      call c_get_petfiles(nslices,ntiming,imulti,Cpath,Cmod,Cmod2)

      if(nslices.le.0)then
        write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &       ' ERROR: no PET image file is found in ',Cdir(1:Ndir)
        call exit(-1)
      elseif(nslices.lt.izmax)then
        write(istdout,'(a,i5)')
     &       ' ERROR: maximum slice number should be <= ',nslices
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      return
      end subroutine READdirectory
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READfilenames(nlist)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nlist
      integer :: i

      open(20,file='tmp.txt',status='old')
      if(nlist.le.0)then
        write(istdout,'(2a)')' ERROR: no file is found in ',Cdir(1:Ndir)
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      do i=1,nlist
        read(20,*)Cfilenames(i),zloc(i),timing(i),iduration(i)
      enddo
      close(20,status='delete')

      return
      end subroutine READfilenames
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READpetparam(Cinter,
     &     ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,
     &     xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh,
     &     activity,decayPET)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(out) :: ixmin,iymin,izmin
      integer,intent(out) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      real(8),intent(out) :: xdel,ydel,zdel,xorg,yorg,zorg,xsh(3)
      real(8),intent(out) :: activity,decayPET
      integer :: iend
      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(20,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'pettmpparam.dat',status='old')
      read(20,*)ixmin,iymin,izmin,ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      read(20,*)xdel,ydel,zdel
      read(20,*)xorg,yorg,zorg
      read(20,*)xsh(1:3)
      read(20,*)activity,decayPET
      close(20)
      return
      end subroutine READpetparam
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READpettmpdata(Cinter,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming,tlist,pdata)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming
      real(8),intent(out) :: pdata(ixnum,iynum,iznum,ntiming)
      real(8),intent(out) :: tlist(2,ntiming)
      integer :: ix,iy,iz,i,ii,iend,it
      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(20,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'pettmpdata.dat',status='old')
      do it=1,ntiming
       read(20,*)tlist(1:2,it)
      enddo

      do it=1,ntiming
       do iz=1,iznum
        do iy=1,iynum
         do i=1,ixnum,10
          ii=min(i+9,ixnum)
          read(20,*)(pdata(ix,iy,iz,it),ix=i,ii)
         enddo
        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      close(20)
      return
      end subroutine READpettmpdata
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READdecaybiodata(Cinter,ixnum,iynum,iznum,decaybiodata)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      real(8),intent(out) :: decaybiodata(ixnum,iynum,iznum)

      iend=len_trim(Cinter)
      open(20,file=Cinter(1:iend)//'decaybio.dat',status='old')
      do iz=1,iznum
       do iy=1,iynum
        do i=1,ixnum,10
         ii=min(i+9,ixnum)
         read(20,*)(decaybiodata(ix,iy,iz),ix=i,ii)
        enddo
       enddo
      enddo
      close(20)
      return
      end subroutine READdecaybiodata
