*********************************************************************
      module readplan
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer,parameter :: nlist=7
      character(LEN=200) :: Cfilenames(nlist)
      character(LEN=200) :: Cmatfile
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READplaninputs(Cdir,Cinter)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: Cdir,Cinter
      integer :: nchar
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy

      write(istdout,*)'Type PLAN2PHITS to run plan2phits'
      read(istdin,'(a)') cdummy
      if(cdummy(1:10).ne.'PLAN2PHITS')then
       write(istdout,*)'ERROR:: signature PLAN2PHITS is not confirmed'
       write(istdout,*)'This input may not be for plan2phits'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'Directory for planinfo.dat file (DATfiles/)'
      read(istdin,*)cdummy
      nchar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
      Cinter=cdummy(1:nchar)
      write(istdout,*)'File for Material (Material.dat)'
      read(istdin,*)cdummy
      nchar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
      Cmatfile(1:nchar)=cdummy(1:nchar)
      write(istdout,*)'Directory for PHITS inputs (PHITSinput/)'
      read(istdin,*)cdummy
      nchar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
      Cdir=cdummy(1:nchar)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      return
      end subroutine READplaninputs

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READfilenames(Cinter,Ctag)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      character(LEN=2),intent(in) :: Ctag
      integer nchar,i

      do i=1,nlist
       write(Cfilenames(i),'(200x)')
      enddo
      nchar=index(Cinter,' ')-1
      Cfilenames(1)=Cinter(1:nchar)//'Port-'//Ctag//'.dat'
      Cfilenames(2)=Cinter(1:nchar)//'RangeShifter-'//Ctag//'.dat'
      Cfilenames(3)=Cinter(1:nchar)//'FLC-'//Ctag//'.dat'
      Cfilenames(4)=Cinter(1:nchar)//'MLC-'//Ctag//'.dat'
      Cfilenames(5)=Cinter(1:nchar)//'RangeCompensator-'//Ctag//'.dat'
      Cfilenames(6)=Cinter(1:nchar)//'Block-'//Ctag//'.dat'
      Cfilenames(7)=Cinter(1:nchar)//'PatientSetup-'//Ctag//'.dat'

      end subroutine READfilenames
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READdimension(npairMLC,ndimRC,npointBL,iflagFLC)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: npairMLC,ndimRC(2),npointBL
      logical,intent(out) :: iflagFLC
      call READnpairMLC(npairMLC)
      call READndimRC(ndimRC)
      call READnpointBL(npointBL)
      call READasymxFLC(iflagFLC)
      return
      end subroutine READdimension

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READplanfiles(npairMLC,ndimRC,npointBL,iflagFLC,
     &     Cdir,cbeamID,cmatRS,cmatFLC,cmatMLC,cmatRC,cmatBL,
     &     dimGT,dimRS,dimFLC,dimMLC,dimRC,dimBL,dimPS)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use deviceproperty
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: npairMLC,ndimRC(2),npointBL
      logical,intent(in) :: iflagFLC
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cbeamID
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cmatRS,cmatFLC(2),cmatMLC
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cmatRC,cmatBL
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimGT(7),dimRS(5),dimFLC(12),dimMLC(3)
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimRC(10),dimBL(4),dimPS(3)
      real(8) :: sourcedist,sourceXdist,sourceYdist
      call READmaterialdat(Cdir)
      call READportdat(cbeamID,dimGT)
      sourcedist=dimGT(5)
      sourceXdist=dimGT(6)
      sourceYdist=dimGT(7)
      call READrangeshifterdat(cmatRS,dimRS)
      if(iflagFLC)then
       call READfourleafdat(sourceXdist,sourceYdist,
     &      cmatFLC,dimFLC)
      endif
      call READmultileafdat(npairMLC,sourcedist,
     &     cmatMLC,dimMLC,bdataMLC,pdataMLC)
      if(ndimRC(1).gt.0)then
       call READrangecompensatordat(ndimRC,sourceXdist,sourceYdist,
     &      cmatRC,dimRC,hdataRC)
      endif
      if(npointBL.gt.0)then
       call READblockdat(npointBL,sourceXdist,sourceYdist,
     &      cmatBL,dimBL,xdataBL,ydataBL)
      endif
      call READpatientsetupdat(dimPS)
      return
      end subroutine READplanfiles

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READnmatmax(nmatmax,nelemmax)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: nmatmax,nelemmax
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: ichar,iend,istat,iline
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy
      open(io,file=Cmatfile,status='old')
      read(io,'(a200)')cdummy
      if(cdummy(1:1).ne.'#')then
       write(istdout,*)'Error: file format incompatible; ',Cmatfile
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      ichar=index(cdummy,'=')+1
      if(ichar.eq.0)then
       write(istdout,*)'Error: file format incompatible; ',Cmatfile
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      cdummy=cdummy(ichar:200)
      cdummy=adjustl(cdummy)
      ichar=1
      iend=index(cdummy,' ')-1
      read(cdummy,*)nmatmax
      istat=0
      iline=0
      do while(istat.ne.-1)
       read(io,'(a)',iostat=istat)cdummy
       iline=iline+1
      enddo
      close(io)
      nelemmax=iline
      return
      end subroutine READnmatmax

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READnpairMLC(npairMLC)
* read BeamLimitingDeviceMLC.dat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: npairMLC
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: i
      character(LEN=200) cdummy
      open(io,file=Cfilenames(4),status='old')
      do i=1,3
       read(io,*) cdummy
      enddo
      read(io,*) npairMLC ! Number Of Leaf Jaw Pairs
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine READnpairMLC

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READndimRC(ndimRC)
* read RangeCompensator.dat (Bolus)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: ndimRC(2)
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy
      open(io,file=Cfilenames(5),status='old')
      read(io,*) cdummy
      read(io,*) ndimRC(1) ! Num. of Compensator Rows corresponding to y-axis
      read(io,*) ndimRC(2) ! Num. of Compensator Columns corresponding to x-axis
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine READndimRC

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READnpointBL(npointBL)
* read Block.dat (Patient collimator)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: npointBL
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy
      open(io,file=Cfilenames(6),status='old')
      read(io,*) cdummy
      read(io,*) npointBL ! Block Number Of Points
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine READnpointBL

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READasymxFLC(iflagFLC)
* read FLC.dat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      logical,intent(out) :: iflagFLC
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy
      open(io,file=Cfilenames(3),status='old')
      read(io,*) cdummy
      if(cdummy(1:6).eq.'NO_FLC')then
       iflagFLC=.false.
      else
       iflagFLC=.true.
      endif
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine READasymxFLC

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READmaterialdat(Cdir)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      use deviceproperty
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cdir
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: istat,ichar,imat,iend,iline
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy
      istat=0
      iline=0
      imat=0
      iend=len_trim(Cdir)
      open(io,file=Cmatfile,status='old')
      do while(istat.ne.-1)
       read(io,'(a)',iostat=istat)cdummy
       if(cdummy(1:1).ne.'#')then
        iline=iline+1
        celemlines(iline)(1:200)=cdummy(1:200)
        if(cdummy(1:1).eq.'$')then
         imat=imat+1
         ielemst(imat)=iline
         imatflag(imat)=.false.
         cdummy=cdummy(2:200)
         cdummy=adjustl(cdummy)
         ichar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
         cmatname(imat)(1:ichar)=cdummy(1:ichar) ! Material name
         cdummy=cdummy(ichar+1:200)
         cdummy=adjustl(cdummy)
         iend=index(cdummy,' ')-1
         read(cdummy(1:iend),*)densmat(imat) ! Material density
         cdummy=cdummy(iend+1:200)
         cdummy=adjustl(cdummy)
         iend=index(cdummy,' ')-1 ! g/cm3
         cdummy=cdummy(iend+1:200)
         cdummy=adjustl(cdummy)
         iend=index(cdummy,' ')-1
         read(cdummy(1:iend),*)cname(imat) ! Name for MatNameColor
         cdummy=cdummy(iend+1:200)
         cdummy=adjustl(cdummy)
         iend=index(cdummy,' ')-1
         read(cdummy(1:iend),*)ccolor(imat) ! Color for MatNameColor
        elseif(cdummy(1:1).eq.'m'.or.cdummy(1:1).eq.'M')then
         if(cdummy(2:2).eq.'a'.or.cdummy(2:2).eq.'A')then
          ichar=index(cdummy,'[')+1
          cdummy=cdummy(ichar:200)
          cdummy=adjustl(cdummy)
          iend=index(cdummy,']')-1
          read(cdummy(1:iend),*)matnum(imat)
         else
          read(cdummy(2:4),*) matnum(imat) ! Material number
         endif
        end if
       end if
      end do
      if(imat.ne.nmatmax)then
       write(istdout,*)'Error: # of materials (nmatmax) is',
     &      ' not consistent',imat,nmatmax
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      ielemst(nmatmax+1)=iline+1
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine READmaterialdat

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READportdat(cbeamID,dimGT)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cbeamID
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimGT(7)
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy
      integer :: iend
      real(8) :: angleGantry,anglePitch,angleBLD,anglePS
      real(8) :: sourcedist,sourceXdist,sourceYdist
      open(io,file=Cfilenames(1),status='old')
      read(io,*) cdummy
      iend=index(cdummy,' ')
      write(cbeamID,'(200x)')
      cbeamID(1:iend)=cdummy(1:iend) ! Reference Beam Data ID
      read(io,*) angleGantry ! Gantry Angle [deg]
      read(io,*) anglePitch  ! Gantry Pitch Angle [deg]
      read(io,*) angleBLD    ! Beam Limiting Device Angle [deg]
      read(io,*) anglePS     ! Patient Support Angle [deg]
      read(io,*) sourcedist  ! Source Axis Distance [mm]
      read(io,*) sourceXdist,sourceYdist ! Virtual Source Axis DIstances [mm]
      dimGT(1)=angleGantry
      dimGT(2)=anglePitch
      dimGT(3)=angleBLD
      dimGT(4)=anglePS
      dimGT(5)=sourcedist/10d0  !cm
      dimGT(6)=sourceXdist/10d0 !cm
      dimGT(7)=sourceYdist/10d0 !cm
      close(io)
      return
      end subroutine READportdat

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READrangeshifterdat(cmatRS,dimRS)
* read RangeShifter.dat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use deviceproperty, only:SEARCHmatID
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cmatRS
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimRS(5)
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: matID,ichar,ierr
      real(8) :: density,xsizeRS,ysizeRS,distanceRS,WEthickRS,thickRS
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy

      open(io,file=Cfilenames(2),status='old')
      read(io,*) cdummy
      ichar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
      cmatRS(1:ichar+1)=cdummy(1:ichar)//' ' ! Material ID for Range Shifter
      call SEARCHmatID(cmatRS,matID,density,ierr)
      if(ierr.ne.0)then
       write(*,*)'Error: no data for Material ID of Range Shifter'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      read(io,*) xsizeRS, ysizeRS ! Range Shifter Size x, y [mm]
      read(io,*) distanceRS ! Isocenter To Range Shifter Distance [mm]
      read(io,*) WEthickRS ! Range Shifter Water Equivalent Thickness [mm]
      read(io,*) thickRS ! Range Shifter Thickness [mm]
      close(io)
* mm -> cm
      dimRS(1) = xsizeRS/10d0
      dimRS(2) = ysizeRS/10d0
      dimRS(3) = distanceRS/10d0
      dimRS(4) = WEthickRS/10d0
      dimRS(5) = thickRS/10d0
      return
      end subroutine READrangeshifterdat

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READfourleafdat(sourceXdist,sourceYdist,
     &     cmatFLC,dimFLC)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use deviceproperty, only:SEARCHmatID
      implicit none
      real(8),intent(in) :: sourceXdist,sourceYdist
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cmatFLC(2)
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimFLC(12)
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: i,matID,ichar,ierr
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy,ctype
      real(8) :: density
      real(8) :: xwidthFLC,xlengthFLC,xthickFLC,xdistanceFLC
      real(8) :: xpositionFLC1,xpositionFLC2
      real(8) :: ywidthFLC,ylengthFLC,ythickFLC,ydistanceFLC
      real(8) :: ypositionFLC1,ypositionFLC2
      logical iflag(2)

      open(io,file=Cfilenames(3),status='old')
      iflag(1:2)=.false.
* do-loop for FLC-X and FLC-Y
      do i = 1, 2
       read(io,*) cdummy
       ichar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
       ctype(1:ichar+1)=cdummy(1:ichar)//' ' ! Type, ASYMX:FLC-X, ASYMY: FLC-Y
       if(ctype(1:ichar).eq.'ASYMX') then
        read(io,*) cdummy
        ichar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
        cmatFLC(1)(1:ichar+1)=cdummy(1:ichar)//' ' ! Material ID for FLC-X
        call SEARCHmatID(cmatFLC(1),matID,density,ierr)
        if(ierr.ne.0)then
         write(*,*)'Error: no data for Material ID of FLC'
         call exit(-1)
        endif
        read(io,*) xwidthFLC, xlengthFLC, xthickFLC ! Device Size Width, Length, Thickness [mm]
        read(io,*) xdistanceFLC ! Isocenter To Beam Limiting Device Distance
        read(io,*) xpositionFLC1, xpositionFLC2 ! Leaf Jaw Positions [mm]
        iflag(1)=.true.
       elseif(ctype(1:ichar).eq.'ASYMY') then
        read(io,*) cdummy
        ichar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
        cmatFLC(2)(1:ichar+1)=cdummy(1:ichar)//' ' ! Material ID for FLC-Y
        call SEARCHmatID(cmatFLC(2),matID,density,ierr)
        if(ierr.ne.0)then
         write(*,*)'Error: no data for Material ID of FLC'
         call exit(-1)
        endif
        read(io,*) ywidthFLC, ylengthFLC, ythickFLC ! Device Size Width, Length, Thickness [mm]
        read(io,*) ydistanceFLC ! Isocenter To Beam Limiting Device Distance
        read(io,*) ypositionFLC1, ypositionFLC2 ! Leaf Jaw Positions [mm]
        iflag(2)=.true.
       end if
      end do
      close(io)
      if (.not.iflag(1).or..not.iflag(2)) then
       write(*,*) 'Error: reading ', Cfilenames(3)
       call exit(-1)
      end if
* mm -> cm
      dimFLC(1)=xwidthFLC/10d0
      dimFLC(2)=ywidthFLC/10d0
      dimFLC(3)=xlengthFLC/10d0
      dimFLC(4)=ylengthFLC/10d0
      dimFLC(5)=xthickFLC/10d0
      dimFLC(6)=ythickFLC/10d0
      dimFLC(7)=xdistanceFLC/10d0
      dimFLC(8)=ydistanceFLC/10d0
      dimFLC(9)=-xpositionFLC1/10d0
      dimFLC(10)=ypositionFLC1/10d0
      dimFLC(11)=-xpositionFLC2/10d0
      dimFLC(12)=ypositionFLC2/10d0
* scale at isocenter -> real deivice scale
      dimFLC(9)=dimFLC(9)*(sourceXdist-dimFLC(7))/sourceXdist
      dimFLC(10)=dimFLC(10)*(sourceYdist-dimFLC(8))/sourceYdist
      dimFLC(11)=dimFLC(11)*(sourceXdist-dimFLC(7))/sourceXdist
      dimFLC(12)=dimFLC(12)*(sourceYdist-dimFLC(8))/sourceYdist
      return
      end subroutine READfourleafdat

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READmultileafdat(npairMLC,sourcedist,
     &     cmatMLC,dimMLC,bdataMLC,pdataMLC)
* read BeamLimitingDeviceMLC.dat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      use deviceproperty, only:SEARCHmatID
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: npairMLC
      real(8),intent(in) :: sourcedist
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cmatMLC
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimMLC(3)
      real(8),intent(out) :: bdataMLC(npairMLC+1),pdataMLC(npairMLC*2)
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: i,n,ichar,matID,ierr
      character(LEN=200) cdummy
      real(8) :: density,xlengthMLC,zthickMLC,zpositionMLC

      open(io,file=Cfilenames(4),status='old')
      read(io,*) cdummy
      ichar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
      cmatMLC(1:ichar+1)=cdummy(1:ichar)//' ' ! Material ID for MLC
      call SEARCHmatID(cmatMLC,matID,density,ierr)
      if(ierr.ne.0)then
       write(*,*)'Error: no data for Material ID of MLC'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      read(io,*) xlengthMLC, zthickMLC ! Leaf Length, Thickness [mm]
      read(io,*) zpositionMLC ! Isocenter To Beam Limiting Device Distance [mm]
      read(io,*) n ! Number Of Leaf Jaw Pairs
      if(n.ne.npairMLC)then
       write(istdout,*)'Error: mismatch npairMLC ',n,npairMLC
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      read(io,*)
     &     (bdataMLC(i),i=1,n+1)
      read(io,*)
     &     (pdataMLC(i),i=1,n*2)
      close(io)
* mm -> cm
      dimMLC(1) = xlengthMLC/10d0
      dimMLC(2) = zthickMLC/10d0
      dimMLC(3) = zpositionMLC/10d0
      do i=1,n+1
         bdataMLC(i) = bdataMLC(i)/10d0
      end do
      do i=1,n*2
         pdataMLC(i) = -pdataMLC(i)/10d0
      end do
* scale at isocenter -> real deivice scale
      do i=1,n+1
       bdataMLC(i) = bdataMLC(i)*(sourcedist-dimMLC(3))/sourcedist
      enddo
      do i=1,n*2
       pdataMLC(i) = pdataMLC(i)*(sourcedist-dimMLC(3))/sourcedist
      end do
      return
      end subroutine READmultileafdat

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READrangecompensatordat(ndimRC,sourceXdist,sourceYdist,
     &     cmatRC,dimRC,hdataRC)
* read RangeCompensator.dat (Bolus)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      use deviceproperty, only:SEARCHmatID
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: ndimRC(2)
      real(8),intent(in) :: sourceXdist,sourceYdist
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cmatRC
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimRC(10),hdataRC(ndimRC(2),ndimRC(1))
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: matID,n(2),i,j,ichar,ierr
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy
      real(8) :: density
      real(8) :: xPSRC,yPSRC,xminRC,ymaxRC,xsizeRC,ysizeRC,zsizeRC
      real(8) :: zdistanceRC,zminRC

      open(io,file=Cfilenames(5),status='old')
      read(io,*) cdummy
      ichar = index(cdummy,' ')-1
      cmatRC(1:ichar+1)=cdummy(1:ichar)//' ' ! Material ID for Range Compensator
      call SEARCHmatID(cmatRC,matID,density,ierr)
      if(ierr.ne.0)then
       write(*,*)'Error: no data for Material ID of Range Compensator'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      read(io,*) n(1) ! Num. of Compensator Rows corresponding to y-axis
      read(io,*) n(2) ! Num. of Compensator Columns corresponding to x-axis
      if(n(1).ne.ndimRC(1).or.n(2).ne.ndimRC(2))then
       write(istdout,*)'Error: mismatch ndimRC',n(1),n(2),
     &      ndimRC(1),ndimRC(2)
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      read(io,*) xPSRC, yPSRC ! Compensator Pixel Spacing [mm]
      read(io,*) xminRC, ymaxRC ! Compensator Position [mm] (x_limit, y_limit)
      read(io,*) xsizeRC, ysizeRC, zsizeRC ! Compensator Size x, y, z [mm]
      read(io,*) zdistanceRC ! Isocenter To Compensator Tray Distance [mm]
      read(io,*) ((hdataRC(i,j),i=1,n(2)),j=1,n(1))
      close(io)
* mm -> cm
      dimRC(1) = xPSRC/10d0
      dimRC(2) = yPSRC/10d0
      dimRC(3) = -xminRC/10d0 ! x -> -x
      dimRC(4) = ymaxRC/10d0
      dimRC(5) = xsizeRC/10d0
      dimRC(6) = ysizeRC/10d0
      dimRC(7) = zdistanceRC/10d0
      dimRC(10) = zsizeRC/10d0
* scale at isocenter -> real deivice scale
      dimRC(1) = dimRC(1)*(sourceXdist-dimRC(7))/sourceXdist
      dimRC(2) = dimRC(2)*(sourceYdist-dimRC(7))/sourceYdist
      dimRC(3) = dimRC(3)*(sourceXdist-dimRC(7))/sourceXdist
      dimRC(4) = dimRC(4)*(sourceYdist-dimRC(7))/sourceYdist

      dimRC(8) = -dimRC(7) ! zmaxRC
      zminRC   = -dimRC(7)
      do j=1,ndimRC(1)
       do i=1,ndimRC(2)
       hdataRC(i,j) = hdataRC(i,j)/10d0
       zminRC=min(zminRC,-dimRC(7)-hdataRC(i,j))
      end do
      end do
      dimRC(9)= zminRC
      return
      end subroutine READrangecompensatordat

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READblockdat(npointBL,sourceXdist,sourceYdist,
     &     cmatBL,dimBL,xdataBL,ydataBL)
* read Block.dat (Patient collimator)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout
      use deviceproperty, only: SEARCHmatID
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: npointBL
      real(8),intent(in) :: sourceXdist,sourceYdist
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: cmatBL
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimBL(4)
      real(8),intent(out) :: xdataBL(npointBL),ydataBL(npointBL)
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: i,matID,n,ichar,ierr
      character(LEN=200) :: cdummy
      real(8) :: density,xsizeBL,ysizeBL,zsizeBL,zdistanceBL

      open(io,file=Cfilenames(6),status='old')
      read(io,*) cdummy
      ichar=index(cdummy,' ')-1
      cmatBL(1:ichar+1)=cdummy(1:ichar)//' ' ! Material ID for Block
      call SEARCHmatID(cmatBL,matID,density,ierr)
      if(ierr.ne.0)then
       write(*,*)'Error: no data for Material ID of Block'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      read(io,*) n ! Block Number Of Points
      if(n.ne.npointBL)then
       write(istdout,*)'Error: mismatch npointBL',n,npointBL
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      read(io,*) xsizeBL,ysizeBL,zsizeBL ! Block Size x, y, z [mm]
      read(io,*) zdistanceBL ! Isocenter To Block Tray Distance [mm]
      read(io,*) (xdataBL(i),ydataBL(i),i=1,npointBL)
      close(io)
! mm -> cm
      dimBL(1)=xsizeBL/10d0
      dimBL(2)=ysizeBL/10d0
      dimBL(3)=zsizeBL/10d0
      dimBL(4)=zdistanceBL/10d0
      do i= 1,npointBL
       xdataBL(i) = -xdataBL(i)/10d0 ! x -> -x
       ydataBL(i) = ydataBL(i)/10d0
      end do
* scale at isocenter -> real deivice scale
      do i=1,npointBL
       xdataBL(i) = xdataBL(i)*(sourceXdist-dimBL(4))/sourceXdist
       ydataBL(i) = ydataBL(i)*(sourceYdist-dimBL(4))/sourceYdist
      enddo
      return
      end subroutine READblockdat

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READpatientsetupdat(dimPS)
* read PatientSetup.dat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimPS(3)
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      real(8) :: Vert,fLong,fLat
      open(io,file=Cfilenames(7),status='old')
      read(io,*) Vert ! Vert, Table Top Vertical Setup Displacement [mm]
      read(io,*) fLong ! Long, Table Top Longitudinal Setup Displacement [mm]
      read(io,*) fLat ! Lat, Table Top Lateral Setup Displacement [mm]
      close(io)
! mm -> cm
      dimPS(1)=Vert/10d0
      dimPS(2)=fLong/10d0
      dimPS(3)=fLat/10d0
      return
      end subroutine READpatientsetupdat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      end module readplan
END_FILE

FILE: src/readroimod.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
      module readroi
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),allocatable :: Cfilenames(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: zloc(:)
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READroiinputs(imode,Cpath,Cinput,Cinter)
      use stdinout, only:istdin,istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(out) :: imode
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: Cpath
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: Cinput,Cinter
      character(LEN=1024) :: dummy
      character(LEN=1),parameter :: NULL=CHAR(0)
      integer :: Npath,Ninput,Ninter

      write(istdout,*)'Type ROI2PHITS to run roi2phits'
      read(istdin,'(a)') dummy
      if(dummy(1:9).ne.'ROI2PHITS')then
       write(istdout,*)'ERROR:: signature ROI2PHITS is not confirmed'
       write(istdout,*)'This input may not be for roi2phits'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      read(istdin,*)imode
      if(imode.eq.0)then
       write(istdout,*)'Name of RTstructure file with PATH'
       read(istdin,*)Cpath
      elseif(imode.eq.1)then
       write(istdout,*)'ROI DICOM file directory'
       read(istdin,*)Cpath
      endif
      write(istdout,*)'Directory for creating PHITS inputs'
      read(istdin,*)Cinput
      write(istdout,*)'Directory for creating intermediate files'
      read(istdin,*)Cinter

      Npath=len_trim(Cpath)
      Ninput=len_trim(Cinput)
      Ninter=len_trim(Cinter)
      Cpath(1:Npath+1)=Cpath(1:Npath)//NULL
      Cinput(1:Ninput+1)=Cinput(1:Ninput)//NULL
      Cinter(1:Ninter+1)=Cinter(1:Ninter)//NULL

      return
      end subroutine READroiinputs
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READphantominfo(Cinter,imode,ndimV,dimV,
     &     ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax,izmin,izmax,
     &     nxc,nyc,nzc,izstep,iorg)
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: imode
      integer,intent(out) :: ndimV(3)
      integer,intent(out) :: ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax,izmin,izmax
      integer,intent(out) :: nxc,nyc,nzc
      integer,intent(out) :: izstep,iorg
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimV(18)
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: i,Ninter,ioption
      character(LEN=1024) :: dummy

C.....Read data from phantominfo.dat---------------------------------
      Ninter=len_trim(Cinter)-1
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:Ninter)//'phantominfo.dat',
     &     status='old',err=900)

      read(io,*,err=910)ioption
      if(ioption.ne.1)then
       write(istdout,*)'ERROR:: Water Phantom option is not compatible'
       write(istdout,*)'Only DICOM image file is allowed'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      if(imode.eq.0)then
       read(io,*,err=910)ndimV(1),ndimV(2),ndimV(3)
       read(io,*,err=910)dimV(1),dimV(2),dimV(3)
       read(io,*,err=910)dimV(4),dimV(5),dimV(6)
       read(io,*,err=910)dimV(7),dimV(8),dimV(9)
       read(io,*,err=910)dimV(10),dimV(11),dimV(12)
       read(io,*,err=910)dimV(13),dimV(14),dimV(15)
       read(io,*,err=910)dimV(16),dimV(17),dimV(18)
       read(io,*,err=910)iorg
      elseif(imode.eq.1)then
       do i=1,11                ! Skip lines
        read(io,'(a)')dummy
       enddo
       read(io,*,err=910)izmin,izmax
       izstep=1
       if(izmin.gt.izmax)then
        izstep=izmax
        izmax=izmin
        izmin=izstep
        izstep=-1
       endif
       read(io,*,err=910)ixmin,ixmax,iymin,iymax
       read(io,*,err=910)nxc,nyc,nzc
       read(io,*,err=910)iorg
      endif
      close(io)
C.....-----------------------------------------------------------------
      return
 900  continue
      write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &     ' ERROR: phantominfo.dat is not found in ',Cinter(1:Ninter)
      call exit(-1)
 910  continue
      write(istdout,'(a)')
     &     ' ERROR: format of phantominfo.dat is not compatible'
      call exit(-1)
      end subroutine READphantominfo
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine SETreadfile(Cpath,iz,Cfilepath)
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cpath
      integer,intent(in) :: iz
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: Cfilepath
      character(LEN=1),parameter :: NULL=CHAR(0)
      integer :: Npath,Nfile,n
      Npath=len_trim(Cpath)-1
      Nfile=len_trim(Cfilenames(iz))
      n=Npath+Nfile+1
      Cfilepath(1:n)=Cpath(1:Npath)//Cfilenames(iz)(1:Nfile)//NULL

      return
      end subroutine SETreadfile
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READheader(Cpath,izmin,nxnum,nynum,xdel,ydel,zdel,
     &     xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec)
*     SliceThickness
*     SpacingBetweenSlices (not necessary)
*     Image Position Patient
*     Image Orientation Patient
*     Rows
*     Columns
*     PixelSpacing
*     Bits Allocated
*     RescaleIntercept
*     RescaleSlope
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cpath
      integer,intent(in) :: izmin
      integer,intent(out) :: nxnum,nynum
      real(8),intent(out) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      real(8),intent(out) :: xsh(3),xvec(3),yvec(3),zvec(3)
      character(LEN=200) :: Cfilepath

      call SETreadfile(Cpath,izmin,Cfilepath)
      call c_get_dimension(nxnum,nynum,xdel,ydel,zdel,
     &     xsh,xvec,yvec,Cfilepath)
      xdel=xdel*0.1d0
      ydel=ydel*0.1d0
      zdel=abs(zdel)*0.1d0
      xsh(1:3)=xsh(1:3)*0.1d0
      zvec(1)=xvec(2)*yvec(3)-xvec(3)*yvec(2)
      zvec(2)=xvec(3)*yvec(1)-xvec(1)*yvec(3)
      zvec(3)=xvec(1)*yvec(2)-xvec(2)*yvec(1)

      return
      end subroutine READheader
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READdirectory(Cpath,izmax0,nlist)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cpath
      integer,intent(in) :: izmax0
      integer,intent(out) :: nlist
      character(LEN=3) :: Cmod
      character(LEN=1),parameter :: NULL=CHAR(0)

      Cmod(1:3)="CT"//NULL
      call c_get_ctfiles(nlist,Cpath,Cmod)

      if(nlist.le.0)then
        write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &       ' ERROR: no CT image file is found in ',trim(Cpath)
        call exit(-1)
      elseif(nlist.lt.izmax0)then
       write(istdout,'(a,i5)')
     &      ' ERROR: ROI slice number = ',nlist
       write(istdout,'(a,i5)')
     &      ' should be >= used CT slice number = ',izmax0
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      return
      end subroutine READdirectory
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READfilenames(Cpath,nlist)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cpath
      integer,intent(in) :: nlist
      integer :: i

      open(20,file='tmp.txt',status='old')
      if(nlist.le.0)then
        write(istdout,'(2a)')' ERROR: no file is found in ',trim(Cpath)
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      do i=1,nlist
        read(20,*)Cfilenames(i),zloc(i)
      enddo
      close(20,status='delete')

      return
      end subroutine READfilenames
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine ALLOCATEfilenames(nlist)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nlist
      allocate(Cfilenames(nlist))
      return
      end subroutine ALLOCATEfilenames
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine DEALLOCATEfilenames
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      deallocate(Cfilenames)
      return
      end subroutine DEALLOCATEfilenames
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine ALLOCATEzloc(nlist)
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nlist
      allocate(zloc(nlist))
      return
      end subroutine ALLOCATEzloc
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine DEALLOCATEzloc
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      implicit none
      deallocate(zloc)
      return
      end subroutine DEALLOCATEzloc
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      end module readroi
END_FILE

FILE: src/roi2phits.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
*     PROGRAM roi2phits                                             *
*                                                                   *
*         Created by T. Sato and T. Furuta on 2021/02/16            *
*                                                                   *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*  C functions "dicomlib.c" and "roi2phitscmod.c" and               *
*  OS dependent C function "winlib.c" or "nonwinlib.c" are required *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                                                                   *
*     Purpose                                                       *
*         Create ROI voxels from RT-structure file                  *
*                                                                   *
*         Last modified by T. Furuta on 2026/01/22                  *
*********************************************************************
      PROGRAM roi2phits ! Main program
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout
      use readroi, only:READroiinputs,READphantominfo,
     &     READheader,READfilenames,
     &     READdirectory,ALLOCATEfilenames,DEALLOCATEfilenames,
     &     ALLOCATEzloc,DEALLOCATEzloc
      use createroi, only:INIT_idROI,FIN_idROI,CREATEroiinfo,
     &     CREATEfillROI
      implicit none
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      real,parameter :: version=2.00
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      integer :: imode
      integer :: nxnum,nynum,nznum
      integer :: nxc,nyc,nzc
      integer :: ixmin0,ixmax0,iymin0,iymax0,izmin0,izmax0
      integer :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,ixnum0,iynum0,iznum0
      integer :: izmin,izmax
      integer :: izstep,iorg
      integer :: nlist
      integer :: ndimV(3)
      integer,allocatable :: mat(:,:,:),zlist(:)
      real(8) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      real(8) :: xsh(3),xvec(3),yvec(3),zvec(3)
      real(8) :: xdel0,ydel0,zdel0
      real(8) :: dimV(18)
      character(LEN=200) :: Cinput,Cinter,Cpath
      logical :: cgflag

      call DSPheader(version)

      call READroiinputs(imode,Cpath,Cinput,Cinter)

      call READphantominfo(Cinter,imode,ndimV,dimV,
     &     ixmin0,ixmax0,iymin0,iymax0,izmin0,izmax0,
     &     nxc,nyc,nzc,izstep,iorg)

      if(imode.eq.0)then

       call c_roi2phitsmod(ndimV,dimV,Cinput,Cinter,Cpath)

      elseif(imode.eq.1)then

       ixnum0=ixmax0-ixmin0+1
       iynum0=iymax0-iymin0+1
       iznum0=izmax0-izmin0+1

       call READdirectory(Cpath,izmax0,nlist)
       nznum=nlist

       call ALLOCATEfilenames(nlist)
       call ALLOCATEzloc(nlist)

       call READfilenames(Cpath,nlist)

       allocate(zlist(nznum))
       call SETzlist(izmin0,nznum,zlist)

       call READheader(Cpath,izmin0,nxnum,nynum,xdel0,ydel0,zdel0,
     &      xsh,xvec,yvec,zvec)

       call SETcoarse(nxc,nyc,nzc,
     &      ixnum0,iynum0,iznum0,ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &      xdel0,ydel0,zdel0,xdel,ydel,zdel,cgflag)

       call SETzdirec(izstep,iorg,iznum0,izmin,izmax,zdel)

       allocate( mat(ixnum,iynum,iznum) )
       mat(:,:,:)=0

       call INIT_idROI
       call READCONV(Cpath,
     &      ixmin0,iymin0,ixnum0,iynum0,izmin,izmax,
     &      ixnum,iynum,iznum,nxc,nyc,nzc,izstep,nxnum,nynum,
     &      nznum,zlist,mat)
       call CREATEroiinfo(Cinter,xdel*ydel*zdel)
       call CREATEfillROI(Cinput,ixnum,iynum,iznum,mat)
       deallocate( mat,zlist)
       call FIN_idROI

       call DEALLOCATEfilenames
       call DEALLOCATEzloc

       call DSPparam(nxnum,nynum,nznum,xdel0,ydel0,zdel0,'ORIGINAL')

       call DSPparam(ixnum0,iynum0,iznum0,xdel0,ydel0,zdel0,'CLIPPED ')

       if(cgflag)then
        call DSPmessageCG
        call DSPparam(ixnum,iynum,iznum,xdel,ydel,zdel,'COASED  ')
       endif

      else
       write(istdout,*)'ERROR:: imode should be 0:RTstructure or 1:Mask'
       call exit(-1)
      endif

      write(istdout,'(2a)')'***************************',
     &     '******************************************'
      write(istdout,*)' ROI2PHITS successfully FINISHED !!'

      stop
      end

*********************************************************************
      subroutine SETzlist(izmin0,nznum,zlist)
*********************************************************************
      use readroi, only:Cfilenames,zloc
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: izmin0,nznum
      integer,intent(out) :: zlist(nznum)
      integer :: iz,iz0,izmax0
      character(200) Ctmp
      real(8) ztmp

      do iz=1,nznum-1
        do iz0=iz,nznum
          if(zloc(iz0)<zloc(iz))then
            Ctmp=Cfilenames(iz)
            Cfilenames(iz)=Cfilenames(iz0)
            Cfilenames(iz0)=Ctmp
            ztmp=zloc(iz)
            zloc(iz)=zloc(iz0)
            zloc(iz0)=ztmp
          endif
        enddo
      enddo
      izmax0=izmin0+nznum-1
      iz=0
      do iz0=izmin0,izmax0
        iz=iz+1
        zlist(iz)=iz0
      enddo

      return
      end subroutine SETzlist

*********************************************************************
      subroutine SETcoarse(nxc,nyc,nzc,
     &     ixnum0,iynum0,iznum0,ixnum,iynum,iznum,
     &     xdel0,ydel0,zdel0,xdel,ydel,zdel,cgflag)
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: nxc,nyc,nzc
      integer,intent(inout) :: ixnum0,iynum0,iznum0
      integer,intent(out) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum
      real(8),intent(inout) :: xdel0,ydel0,zdel0
      real(8),intent(out) :: xdel,ydel,zdel
      logical,intent(out) :: cgflag
      if(nxc.gt.ixnum0)then
        write(istdout,'(a)')' ERROR: nxc is greter than PIXEL rows'
        write(istdout,'(a,i5,a,i5)')' nxc= ',nxc,'  nxnum=',ixnum0
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      if(nyc.gt.iynum0)then
        write(istdout,'(a)')' ERROR: nyc is greter than PIXEL columns'
        write(istdout,'(a,i5,a,i5)')' nyc= ',nyc,'  nynum=',iynum0
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      if(nzc.gt.iznum0)then
       write(istdout,'(a)')' ERROR: nzc is greter than # of DICOM files'
        write(istdout,'(a,i5,a,i5)')' nzc= ',nzc,'  nznum=',iznum0
        call exit(-1)
      endif

      if(nxc.ne.1.or.nyc.ne.1.or.nzc.ne.1)then
         cgflag=.true.
      else
         cgflag=.false.
      endif
      ixnum=ixnum0/nxc
      ixnum0=ixnum*nxc
      xdel=xdel0*nxc
      iynum=iynum0/nyc
      iynum0=iynum*nxc
      ydel=ydel0*nyc
      iznum=iznum0/nzc
      iznum0=iznum*nzc
      zdel=zdel0*nzc
      return
      end subroutine SETcoarse
*********************************************************************
      subroutine SETzdirec(izstep,iorg,iznum,izmin,izmax,zdel)
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      integer,intent(inout) :: izstep
      integer,intent(in) :: iznum,iorg
      integer,intent(out) :: izmin,izmax
      real(8),intent(inout) :: zdel

      if(iorg.eq.0)then
        if(zdel.lt.0.0d0)then
         write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &        '**************************************************',
     &        '*******************'
          write(istdout,*)
     &        ' CAUTION: DICOM param SpacingBetweenSlices was set minus'
          write(istdout,*)
     &         ' CAUTION: Z direction is reversed'
          write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &         '**************************************************',
     &         '*******************'
          izstep=izstep*(-1)
          zdel=abs(zdel)
        endif
        if(izstep.eq.1)then
          izmin=1
          izmax=iznum
        elseif(izstep.eq.-1)then
         write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &        '**************************************************',
     &        '*******************'
          write(istdout,*)
     &        ' CAUTION: z direction set in descending order',
     &        ' of the slice number'
          write(istdout,'(2a)')
     &         '**************************************************',
     &         '*******************'
          izmin=iznum
          izmax=1
        else
          write(istdout,*)
     &         ' ERROR: Z direction should be +1 or -1 :: ',izstep
          call exit(-1)
        endif
      else
        izstep=1
        izmin=1
        izmax=iznum
      endif
      return
      end subroutine SETzdirec

*********************************************************************
      subroutine READCONV(Cpath,
     &     ixmin0,iymin0,ixnum0,iynum0,izmin,izmax,
     &     ixnum,iynum,iznum,nxc,nyc,nzc,izstep,nxnum,nynum,
     &     nznum,zlist,mat)
*     RescaleIntercept
*     RescaleSlope
*********************************************************************
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      use readroi, only:SETreadfile,Cfilenames
      use createroi,only:nROI,nbankROI,idROI,ivolROI
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cpath
      integer,intent(in) :: ixmin0,iymin0
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum0,iynum0
      integer,intent(in) :: izmin,izmax
      integer,intent(in) :: ixnum,iynum,iznum,izstep
      integer,intent(in) :: nxnum,nynum,nxc,nyc,nzc
      integer,intent(in) :: nznum,zlist(nznum)
      integer,intent(out) :: mat(ixnum,iynum,iznum)
      integer :: ixmax0,iymax0
      integer :: i,ix,iy,iz,ix0,iy0,iz0
      integer :: k,ntot,matnum,iROI,id,ic,imax
      character(LEN=200) :: Cfilepath
      real(8),allocatable:: hudata(:)
      integer,allocatable:: icount(:,:,:),ic2id(:,:,:),nc(:,:)
      integer,allocatable:: idROItmp(:),ivolROItmp(:)
      logical :: iflag

      ixmax0=ixmin0+ixnum0-1
      iymax0=iymin0+iynum0-1
      if(ixmax0.gt.nxnum)then
        write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' ERROR: Nxmax should be <= ',nxnum
        call exit(-1)
      elseif(iymax0.gt.nynum)then
        write(istdout,'(a,i4)')' ERROR: Nymax should be <= ',nynum
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      ntot=nxnum*nynum
      allocate( hudata(nxnum*nynum) )
      allocate( icount(nxc*nyc*nzc,ixnum,iynum) )
      allocate( ic2id(nxc*nyc*nzc,ixnum,iynum) )
      allocate( nc(ixnum,iynum) )
      icount(:,:,:)=0
      ic2id(:,:,:)=0
      nc(:,:)=0
      iz0=0
      matnum=0
      do i=izmin,izmax,izstep
       iz=zlist(i)
       write(*,'(2a)')' Loading file = ',trim(Cfilenames(iz))
       call SETreadfile(Cpath,iz,Cfilepath)
       call c_get_data(hudata,ntot,Cfilepath)
       do iy=1,nynum
        do ix=1,nxnum
         k=(iy-1)*nxnum+ix
         if(ix.ge.ixmin0.and.ix.le.ixmax0.and.
     &        iy.ge.iymin0.and.iy.le.iymax0)then
          ix0=(ix-ixmin0)/nxc+1
          iy0=(iy-iymin0)/nyc+1
          id=int(hudata(k))
          do ic=1,nc(ix0,iy0)
           if(id.eq.ic2id(ic,ix0,iy0))exit
          enddo
          if(ic.gt.nc(ix0,iy0))then
           nc(ix0,iy0)=nc(ix0,iy0)+1
           ic2id(nc(ix0,iy0),ix0,iy0)=id
          endif
          icount(ic,ix0,iy0)=icount(ic,ix0,iy0)+1
         endif
        enddo
       enddo
       if(mod(izstep*(i-izmin)+1,nzc).eq.0)then
        iz0=iz0+1
        do iy0=1,iynum
         do ix0=1,ixnum
          do ic=1,nc(ix0,iy0)
           if(icount(ic,ix0,iy0).gt.imax)then
            matnum=ic2id(ic,ix0,iy0)
            imax=icount(ic,ix0,iy0)
           elseif(icount(ic,ix0,iy0).eq.imax)then
            if(ic2id(ic,ix0,iy0).gt.matnum)then
             matnum=ic2id(ic,ix0,iy0)
            endif
           endif
          enddo
          iflag=.false.
          do iROI=1,nROI
           if(idROI(iROI).eq.matnum)then
            ivolROI(iROI)=ivolROI(iROI)+1
            iflag=.true.
            exit
           endif
          enddo
          if(.not.iflag)then
           nROI=nROI+1
           if(nROI.gt.nbankROI)then
            allocate( idROItmp(nbankROI),ivolROItmp(nbankROI) )
            idROItmp(1:nbankROI)=idROI(1:nbankROI)
            ivolROItmp(1:nbankROI)=ivolROI(1:nbankROI)
            deallocate( idROI,ivolROI )
            nbankROI=nbankROI+10
            allocate( idROI(nbankROI),ivolROI(nbankROI) )
            idROI(1:nROI-1)=idROItmp(1:nROI-1)
            ivolROI(1:nROI-1)=ivolROItmp(1:nROI-1)
            deallocate( idROItmp,ivolROItmp)
           endif
           idROI(nROI)=matnum
           ivolROI(nROI)=1
          endif
          mat(ix0,iy0,iz0) = matnum
          imax=0
         enddo
        enddo
        icount(:,:,:)=0
        ic2id(:,:,:)=0
        nc(:,:)=0
       endif
      enddo
      deallocate( hudata,icount,ic2id,nc )
      return
      end subroutine READCONV

*********************************************************************
      subroutine DSPparam(nxnum,nynum,nznum,xdel,ydel,zdel,tag)
*********************************************************************

BEGIN_FILE
/***************************************************************************/
/*              C functions for ROI2PHITS                                  */
/*                                                                         */
/*                  Created by T. Furuta on 2021/12/03                     */
/*                     Under collaboration between JAEA and QST            */
/*                                                                         */
/*                  Last modified by T. Furuta on 2021/12/03               */
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*   Main routine "roi2phits.f"                                            */
/***************************************************************************/
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <float.h>
#include <math.h>
#include "dicomlib.h"
#include "utllib.h"
/********** Module variables ***********************************************/
float version=1.00;
extern int imendian;
void c_roi2phitsmod_(int *,double *,char *,char *,char *,long);
void dsp_header(void);
void compute_ROIvoxel(int,int *,double *,int *,int *,double *,int *);
void latencode(int,int,int *,int,int *,int *);
/********** Interface functions ********************************************/

void c_roi2phitsmod_(int *ndimV, double *dimV, char *Cinput, char *Cinter, char *Cpath, long l)
{
  char Fst[1024],Foutdir[1024],Finter[1024],Cfile[1024],Cname[1024];
  FILE *fp;
  int i,j,latot,latot2;
  //int ndimV[3];
  int nROI,nslice,npoint,isum;
  int *numROI,*indslice,*indpoint;
  //double dimV[18];
  double dV;
  double *volROI,*pdata;
  int *idata,*jdata;
  char *nameROI;

  sprintf(Foutdir,"%s",Cinput);
  sprintf(Finter,"%s",Cinter);
  sprintf(Fst,"%s",Cpath);
  for(i=0;i<9;i++){
    dimV[i]=dimV[i]*10.0; // cm -> mm
  }
  imendian=eval_imendian();
  dV=dimV[0]*dimV[1]*dimV[2];
/*--------- Read RTstructure ---------------------------------------------*/
  if(open_file(&fp,Fst,"rb")!=0)exit(-1);
  if(check_file(fp,"RTSTRUCT")!=0)exit(-1);
  if(get_RTstructureheader(fp,&nROI,&nslice,&npoint)!=0)exit(-1);
  numROI=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*nROI);
  volROI=(double *)malloc(sizeof(double)*nROI);
  nameROI=(char *)calloc(nROI,sizeof(char)*1024);
  indslice=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*nROI);
  indpoint=(int *)malloc(sizeof(int)*nslice);
  pdata=(double *)malloc(sizeof(double)*npoint*3);
  rewind(fp);
  get_RTstructuredata(fp,nROI,
		      numROI,volROI,nameROI,indslice,indpoint,pdata);
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
/*--------- Compute ROI voxel ---------------------------------------------*/
  idata=(int *)calloc(nROI*ndimV[0]*ndimV[1]*ndimV[2],sizeof(int));
  compute_ROIvoxel(nROI,ndimV,dimV,
		   indslice,indpoint,pdata,
		   idata);
/*--------- Create roiinfo.dat -------------------------------------------*/
  memset(Cfile,0,1024);
  sprintf(Cfile,"%s",Finter);
  strcat(Cfile,"roiinfo.dat\0");
  if(open_file(&fp,Cfile,"w")!=0)exit(-1);
  fprintf(fp,"%d\n",0);
  fprintf(fp,"%d\n",nROI);
  for(i=0;i<nROI;i++){
    memset(Cname,0,1024);
    sprintf(Cname,"%s",nameROI+1024*i);
    trim_str(Cname);
    replace_space(Cname);
    fprintf(fp,"%d %s %lf\n",numROI[i],Cname,volROI[i]);
  }
  if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
/*--------- Create ROIvoxel.inp ------------------------------------------*/
  latot=ndimV[0]*ndimV[1]*ndimV[2];
  jdata=(int *)calloc(latot,sizeof(int));
  for(i=0;i<nROI;i++){
    latencode(i*latot,latot,idata,numROI[i],&latot2,jdata);
    memset(Cfile,0,1024);
    sprintf(Cfile,"%s",Foutdir);
    strcat(Cfile,"ROIvoxel_\0");
    memset(Cname,0,1024);
    sprintf(Cname,"%s",nameROI+1024*i);
    trim_str(Cname);
    replace_space(Cname);
    strcat(Cfile,Cname);
    strcat(Cfile,".inp\0");
    if(open_file(&fp,Cfile,"w")!=0)exit(-1);
    for(j=0;j<latot2;j++){
      fprintf(fp,"%d ",jdata[j]);
      if(j%10==9)fprintf(fp,"\n");
    }
    isum=0;
    for(j=0;j<latot;j++){
      if(idata[j+i*latot]!=0){
	isum++;
      }
    }
    printf("iROI = %d ROI number = %d name = %s\n",
	   i,numROI[i],Cname);
    printf(" Volume: computed = %lf expected = %lf\n",
	   dV*isum*0.001,volROI[i]);
    if(close_file(fp)!=0)exit(-1);
  }

  return;
}
/***************************************************************************/
void compute_ROIvoxel(int nROI,int *ndimV,double *dimV,
		      int *indslice,int *indpoint,double *pdata,
		      int *idata)
{
  double x,y,z,x0,y0,z0,dx,dy,dz,dslice,xj,yj,xjp1,yjp1,vt;
  int nx,ny,nz,ir,ix,iy,iz,i,j,iss,ise,ips,ipe,icount,iflag;
  int ir0,iz0,iy0;

  nx=ndimV[0];
  ny=ndimV[1];
  nz=ndimV[2];
  x0=dimV[6]+dimV[3];
  y0=dimV[7]+dimV[4];
  z0=dimV[8]+dimV[5];
  dx=dimV[0];
  dy=dimV[1];
  dz=dimV[2];
  dslice=fabs(pdata[indpoint[0]*3+2]-pdata[2]); // slice thickness
  for(ir=0;ir<nROI;ir++){ // ROI loop
    printf("Computing iROI = %d\n",ir);
    ir0=ir*nz*ny*nx; // ROI voxel start index
    if(ir==0){
      iss=0;
    }else{
      iss=indslice[ir-1]; // slice start index
    }
    ise=indslice[ir];     // slice end index
    for(iz=0;iz<nz;iz++){ // z loop
      iz0=iz*ny*nx;
      z=z0+(iz+0.5)*dz;
      iflag=0;
      for(i=iss;i<ise;i++){ // slice loop
	if(i==0){
	  ips=0;
	}else{
	  ips=indpoint[i-1]; // point start index
	}
	ipe=indpoint[i];     // point end index
	if(pdata[ips*3+2]-0.5*dslice<z && pdata[ips*3+2]+0.5*dslice>=z){
	  iflag=1;
	  for(iy=0;iy<ny;iy++){ // y loop
	    iy0=iy*nx;
	    y=y0+(iy+0.5)*dy;
	    for(ix=0;ix<nx;ix++){ // x loop
	      x=x0+(ix+0.5)*dx;
	      icount=0;
	      for(j=ips;j<ipe;j++){ // point loop
		xj=pdata[j*3];
		yj=pdata[j*3+1];
		if(j+1<ipe){
		  xjp1=pdata[(j+1)*3];
		  yjp1=pdata[(j+1)*3+1];
		}else{
		  xjp1=pdata[ips*3];
		  yjp1=pdata[ips*3+1];
		}
		if( ((yj<=y)&&(yjp1>y))
		    || ((yj>y)&&(yjp1<=y)) ){
		  vt=(y-yj)/(yjp1-yj);
		  if(x<xj+vt*(xjp1-xj)){
		    ++icount;
		  }
		}
	      }
	      if(icount%2==1){
		++idata[ir0+iz0+iy0+ix];
	      }
	    }
	  }
	}
      }
      if(iflag==0){
	for(iy=0;iy<ny;iy++){
	  iy0=iy*nx;
	  for(ix=0;ix<nx;ix++){
	    idata[ir0+iz0+iy0+ix]=0;
	  }
	}
      }
    }
  }
  for(i=0;i<nROI*nx*ny*nz;i++){ // inside of even closed lines = outside
    idata[i]=idata[i]%2;
  }
}
/***************************************************************************/
void latencode(int ind,int latot,int *lattmp,int numROI, int *latot2,int *lattmp2)
{
  int i,icount,jcount,latold;
  latold=lattmp[ind];
  if(lattmp[ind]==0){
    lattmp2[0]=0;
  }else{
    lattmp2[0]=numROI;
  }
  icount=0;
  jcount=0;
  for(i=1;i<latot;i++){
    if(lattmp[ind+i]==latold){
      ++icount;
    }else{
      if(icount>0){
	++jcount;
	lattmp2[jcount]=-icount;
      }
      ++jcount;
      if(lattmp[ind+i]==0){
	lattmp2[jcount]=0;
      }else{
	lattmp2[jcount]=numROI;
      }
      latold=lattmp[ind+i];
      icount=0;
    }
  }
  if(icount>0){
    ++jcount;
    lattmp2[jcount]=-icount;
  }
  *latot2=jcount+1;
}
/***************************************************************************/
void dsp_header()
{
  printf("***********************************************************\n");
  printf("*     PROGRAM streader                                    *\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("*        Created by T. Furuta @ JAEA,                     *\n");
  printf("*                      on 2021/02/16                      *\n");
  printf("*           under collaboration between JAEA and NIRS     *\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("*---------------------------------------------------------*\n");
  printf("*                   Version = %.2f                        *\n",version);
  printf("*---------------------------------------------------------*\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("*     Purpose                                             *\n");
  printf("*        Create ROI voxels from RT-structure file         *\n");
  printf("*                                                         *\n");
  printf("***********************************************************\n");
  return;
}

*********************************************************************
      module surflist
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer,allocatable :: isurflist(:,:),jslist(:)
      logical,allocatable :: ipflag(:)
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
************************************************************************
      subroutine ALLOCATEsurflist(n)
************************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      allocate( isurflist(n,n),ipflag(n),jslist(n) )
      return
      end subroutine ALLOCATEsurflist
************************************************************************
      subroutine DEALLOCATEsurflist
************************************************************************
      implicit none
      deallocate( isurflist,ipflag,jslist )
      return
      end subroutine DEALLOCATEsurflist
************************************************************************
      subroutine INITsurflist(n)
************************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: n
      isurflist(1:n,1:n)=0
      ipflag(1:n)=.true.
      return
      end subroutine INITsurflist
************************************************************************
      subroutine CHECKsurflist(i0,j0,isurf)
************************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: i0,j0
      integer,intent(out) :: isurf
      integer :: i,j,k
      i=i0
      j=j0
      if(i.gt.j)then
       k=i
       i=j
       j=k
      endif
      isurf=isurflist(i,j)
      return
      end subroutine CHECKsurflist
************************************************************************
      subroutine REGISTERsurflist(i0,j0,isurf)
************************************************************************
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: i0,j0,isurf
      integer :: i,j,k
      i=i0
      j=j0
      if(i.gt.j)then
       k=i
       i=j
       j=k
      endif
      isurflist(i,j)=isurf
      return
      end subroutine REGISTERsurflist

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      end module surflist

FILE: src/tablemod.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
      module readtable
*********************************************************************
      implicit none
      character(200) Ccomment
      integer :: Nuniv,Ncomm
      integer,allocatable :: Nelement(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: CTthld(:)
      real(8),allocatable :: rho(:)
      character(100),allocatable :: Clines(:)
      real(8) :: Wlower,Wupper
      contains
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READhvtable(Cconvtable)
      use stdinout, only:istdout
      implicit none
      character(200),intent(in) :: Cconvtable
      integer :: Nconvtable
      integer :: iuniv,i
      integer :: io,itotal,iline
      character(1) :: hash
      logical Fex

      io=10
      Nconvtable=len_trim(Cconvtable)
      inquire(file=Cconvtable(1:Nconvtable),exist=Fex)
      if(.not.Fex)then
        write(istdout,*)'ERROR: missing HumanVoxelTable.data'
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      open(io,file=Cconvtable(1:Nconvtable))
      read(io,'(a)')Ccomment

      Ncomm=index(Ccomment,'!',back=.true.)-1
      if(Ncomm.eq.0)Ncomm=len_trim(Ccomment)
      write(istdout,'(2a)')'***************************',
     &     '******************************************'
      write(istdout,'(a)')'Using'
      write(istdout,'(2a)')'  ',Ccomment(1:Ncomm)
      write(istdout,'(2a)')'***************************',
     &     '******************************************'
      read(io,*)Nuniv
      allocate( Nelement(Nuniv),CTthld(Nuniv),rho(Nuniv) )
      do iuniv=1,Nuniv
        read(io,*)CTthld(iuniv),rho(iuniv),Nelement(iuniv)
      enddo
      read(io,*)Wupper

      Wlower=CTthld(1)

      itotal=sum(Nelement(1:Nuniv))
      allocate( Clines(itotal) )

      iline=0
      do iuniv=1,Nuniv
        read(io,*)hash
        if(hash.ne.'#')then
          write(istdout,'(a,i5)')
     &         ' ERROR: HumanVoxelTable.data format is wrong in Univ=',
     &         iuniv
          call exit(-1)
        endif
        do i=1,Nelement(iuniv)
          iline=iline+1
          read(io,'(a)')Clines(iline)
        enddo
      enddo
      if(iline.ne.itotal)then
        write(istdout,*)
     &       'ERROR: HumanVoxelTable.data mismatch in line numbers'
        call exit(-1)
      endif
      return
      end subroutine READhvtable
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CT2mat(x,matnum,Flow,Fup,CTmin,CTmax)
      implicit none
      real(8),intent(in) :: x
      integer,intent(out) :: matnum
      logical,intent(inout) :: Flow,Fup
      integer :: ilow,ihigh,imid
      real(8) :: CTmin,CTmax

      if(x.lt.Wlower)then
        if(.not.Flow)then
          Flow=.true.
          CTmin=x
        else
          CTmin=min(CTmin,x)
        endif
        matnum=1
        return
      elseif(x.gt.Wupper)then
        if(.not.Fup)then
          Fup=.true.
          CTmax=x
        else
          CTmax=max(CTmax,x)
        endif
        matnum=Nuniv
      else
        ilow=0
        ihigh=Nuniv+1
        do
          if(ihigh-ilow.le.1)exit
          imid=(ihigh+ilow)/2
          if(x.ge.CTthld(imid))then
            ilow=imid
          else
            ihigh=imid
          endif
        enddo
        matnum=ilow
      endif
      return
      end subroutine CT2mat
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      end module readtable
END_FILE

FILE: src/utllib.c
BEGIN_FILE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "utllib.h"
/********** Module functions ***********************************************/
int get_fname(char *cmess,char *fname)
{
  char dummy[1024];
  char s1[]=" \n";
  char *tok;
  int len;
  printf("%s\n",cmess);
  if(fgets(dummy,1024,stdin)==NULL)return(-1);
  tok=strtok(dummy,s1);
  len=strlen(tok);
  memset(fname,0,1024);
  strncpy(fname,tok,len);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_int(char *cmess,int *idata)
{
  char dummy[1024];
  char s1[]=" \n";
  char *tok;
  printf("%s\n",cmess);
  if(fgets(dummy,1024,stdin)==NULL)return(-1);
  tok=strtok(dummy,s1);
  *idata=atoi(tok);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_double(char *cmess,double *data)
{
  char dummy[1024];
  char s1[]=" \n";
  char *tok;
  printf("%s\n",cmess);
  if(fgets(dummy,1024,stdin)==NULL)return(-1);
  tok=strtok(dummy,s1);
  *data=atof(tok);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_double3(char *cmess,double *data)
{
  char dummy[1024];
  char s1[]=" \n";
  char *tok;
  printf("%s\n",cmess);
  if(fgets(dummy,1024,stdin)==NULL)return(-1);
  data[0]=strtod(dummy,&tok);
  data[1]=strtod(tok+1,&tok);
  tok=strtok(tok+1,s1);
  data[2]=atof(tok);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_int_FP(FILE *fp,int *idata)
{
  char dummy[1024];
  char s1[]=" \n";
  char *tok;
  if(fgets(dummy,1024,fp)==NULL)return(-1);
  tok=strtok(dummy,s1);
  *idata=atoi(tok);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_int3_FP(FILE *fp,int *idata)
{
  char dummy[1024];
  char s1[]=" \n";
  char *tok;
  if(fgets(dummy,1024,fp)==NULL)return(-1);
  idata[0]=strtod(dummy,&tok);
  idata[1]=strtod(tok+1,&tok);
  tok=strtok(tok+1,s1);
  idata[2]=atoi(tok);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_double3_FP(FILE *fp,double *data)
{
  char dummy[1024];
  char s1[]=" \n";
  char *tok;
  if(fgets(dummy,1024,fp)==NULL)return(-1);
  data[0]=strtod(dummy,&tok);
  data[1]=strtod(tok+1,&tok);
  tok=strtok(tok+1,s1);
  data[2]=atof(tok);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int count_voxel(FILE *fp)
{
  int i,num;
  i=0;
  while(fscanf(fp,"%d",&num)==1){
    if(num<0){
      i+=-num;
    }else{
      i++;
    }
  }
  rewind(fp);
  return(i);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_voxel(FILE *fp,int *idata)
{
  int i,j,num,numold;
  i=0;
  numold=0;
  while(fscanf(fp,"%d",&num)==1){
    if(num<0){
      for(j=0;j<-num;j++){
	idata[i+j]=numold;
      }
      i+=-num;
    }else{
      idata[i]=num;
      numold=num;
      i++;
    }
  }
  rewind(fp);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_voxelmass(FILE *fp,int nuniv, int *iuniv, double *dens, double *ddata)
{
  int i,j,num;
  double dd;
  i=0;
  dd=0.0;
  while(fscanf(fp,"%d",&num)==1){
    if(num<0){
      for(j=0;j<-num;j++){
	ddata[i+j]=dd;
      }
      i+=-num;
    }else{
      j=get_univ(nuniv,iuniv,num);
      if(j==-1)return(-1);
      dd=dens[j];
      ddata[i]=dd;
      i++;
    }
  }
  rewind(fp);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_univ(int nuniv, int *iuniv, int num)
{
  int i;
  for(i=0;i<nuniv;i++){
    if(iuniv[i]==num){
      return(i);
    }
  }
  printf("ERROR: universe ID %d was not found in CTuniverse.dat\n",num);
  return(-1);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int eval_imendian()
{
  int x=1;
  if( *(char *)&x){
    return(1); //Little Endian
  }else{
    return(-1); //Big Endian
  }
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int get_phantominfo(FILE *fp,int *iorg,int *ndimV, double *dimV)
{
  if(get_int3_FP(fp,ndimV)!=0)return(-1);
  if(get_double3_FP(fp,dimV)!=0)return(-1);
  if(get_double3_FP(fp,dimV+3)!=0)return(-1);
  if(get_double3_FP(fp,dimV+6)!=0)return(-1);
  if(get_double3_FP(fp,dimV+9)!=0)return(-1);
  if(get_double3_FP(fp,dimV+12)!=0)return(-1);
  if(get_double3_FP(fp,dimV+15)!=0)return(-1);
  if(get_int_FP(fp,iorg)!=0)return(-1);
  return(0);
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int trim_str(char *str){
  int i;
  int icount=0;
  if(str==NULL){
    return(-1);
  }
  i=strlen(str);
  while(--i>=0&&str[i]==' ')icount++;
  str[i+1]='\0';
  i=0;
  while(str[i]!='\0'&&str[i]==' ')i++;
  memmove(str,&str[i],strlen(&str[i])+1);
  return i+icount;
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
int replace_space(char *str){
  int i,n;
  if(str==NULL){
    return(-1);
  }
  n=strlen(str);
  for(i=0;i<n;i++){
    if(*(str+i)==' ')str[i]='_';
  }
  return n;
}

FILE: src/voxelidmodifier.f
BEGIN_FILE
*********************************************************************
*     PROGRAM Voxel-ID Modifier                                     *
*                                                                   *
*         Created by T. Furuta on 2023/01/19                        *
*                                                                   *
*-------------------------------------------------------------------*
*                                                                   *
*     Purpose                                                       *
*         Modify CT voxels ID using ROI voxels                      *
*                                                                   *
*         Last modified by T. Furuta on 2023/08/17                  *
*********************************************************************
      PROGRAM voxelidmodifier ! Main program
      implicit none
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      character(LEN=200) :: Cpath
      character(LEN=200) :: Cinter
      integer :: ntag
      integer :: ndimV(3)
      integer :: ndata
      real(8) :: dimV(18)
      integer,allocatable :: idata0(:),idata1(:),idata2(:)

      call READinputs(Cpath,Cinter,ntag)

      call READphantominfo(Cinter,ndimV,dimV)

      ndata=ndimV(1)*ndimV(2)*ndimV(3)
      allocate( idata0(ndata),idata1(ndata),idata2(ndata) )

      call READvoxeldata(Cinter,Cpath,ndata,idata0,idata1)

      call MODIFYvoxel(ndata,ntag,idata0,idata1,idata2)

      call CREATEvoxel(Cinter,ndata,idata2)

      deallocate( idata0,idata1,idata2 )

      write(*,'(2a)')'***************************',
     &     '******************************************'
      write(*,*)' VOXEL-ID MODIFIER successfully FINISHED !!'

      stop
      end

*********************************************************************

!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READinputs(Cpath,Cinter,ntag)
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: Cpath
      character(LEN=200),intent(out) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(out) :: ntag
      character(LEN=1024) :: dummy
      character(LEN=1),parameter :: NULL=CHAR(0)
      integer :: Npath,Ninter

      write(*,*)'Type VOXELIDMODIFIER to run voxelmod'
      read(*,'(a)') dummy
      if(dummy(1:15).ne.'VOXELIDMODIFIER')then
       write(*,*)
     &      'ERROR:: signature VOXELIDMODIFIER is not confirmed'
       write(*,*)'This input may not be for Voxel-ID Modifier'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      write(*,*)'Name of ROI voxel file with PATH'
      read(*,*)Cpath
      write(*,*)'Directory for creating intermediate files'
      read(*,*)Cinter
      write(*,*)'Universe number of modified voxels'
      read(*,*)ntag

      Npath=len_trim(Cpath)
      Ninter=len_trim(Cinter)
      Cpath(1:Npath+1)=Cpath(1:Npath)//NULL
      Cinter(1:Ninter+1)=Cinter(1:Ninter)//NULL

      return
      end subroutine READinputs
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READphantominfo(Cinter,ndimV,dimV)
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(out) :: ndimV(3)
      real(8),intent(out) :: dimV(18)
      integer,parameter :: io=10
      integer :: Ninter,ioption,iorg

C.....Read data from phantominfo.dat---------------------------------
      Ninter=len_trim(Cinter)-1
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:Ninter)//'phantominfo.dat',
     &     status='old',err=900)
      read(io,*,err=910)ioption
      if(ioption.ne.1)then
       write(*,*)'ERROR:: Water Phantom option is not compatible'
       write(*,*)'Only DICOM image file is allowed'
       call exit(-1)
      endif
      read(io,*,err=910)ndimV(1),ndimV(2),ndimV(3)
      read(io,*,err=910)dimV(1),dimV(2),dimV(3)
      read(io,*,err=910)dimV(4),dimV(5),dimV(6)
      read(io,*,err=910)dimV(7),dimV(8),dimV(9)
      read(io,*,err=910)dimV(10),dimV(11),dimV(12)
      read(io,*,err=910)dimV(13),dimV(14),dimV(15)
      read(io,*,err=910)dimV(16),dimV(17),dimV(18)
      read(io,*,err=910)iorg
      close(io)
C.....-----------------------------------------------------------------
      return
 900  continue
      write(*,'(2a)')
     &     ' ERROR: phantominfo.dat is not found in ',Cinter(1:Ninter)
      call exit(-1)
 910  continue
      write(*,'(a)')
     &     ' ERROR: format of phantominfo.dat is not compatible'
      call exit(-1)
      end subroutine READphantominfo
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READvoxeldata(Cinter,Cpath,ndata,idata0,idata1)
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter,Cpath
      integer,intent(in) :: ndata
      integer,intent(out) :: idata0(ndata),idata1(ndata)
      integer :: Ninter
      integer,parameter :: io=10,io2=20
      Ninter=len_trim(Cinter)-1
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:Ninter)//'CTvoxel.dat',
     &     status='old',err=900)
      open(io2,file=Cinter(1:Ninter)//'CTvoxel_org.dat')
      call COPYvoxel(io,io2)
      close(io2)
      rewind(io)
      call READvoxel(io,ndata,idata0)
      close(io)
      open(io,file=Cpath,status='old',err=901)
      call READvoxel(io,ndata,idata1)
      close(io)
      return
 900  continue
      write(*,'(2a)')
     &     ' ERROR: CTvoxel.dat is not found in ',Cinter(1:Ninter)
      call exit(-1)
 901  continue
      write(*,'(a)')
     &     ' ERROR: ROI file: ',trim(Cpath),' is not found'
      call exit(-1)
      end subroutine READvoxeldata
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine COPYvoxel(io,io2)
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io,io2
      character(LEN=200) :: dummy
      do
       read(io,'(a200)',end=999)dummy
       write(io2,'(a)')trim(dummy)
      enddo
 999  continue
      return
      end subroutine COPYvoxel
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READnum(i0,i3,dummy,inum)
      implicit none
      integer,intent(inout) :: i0,i3
      integer :: i,i1,i2
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: dummy
      integer,intent(out) :: inum
      do i=i0,i3
       if(dummy(i:i).ne.' ')then
        i1=i
        exit
       endif
      enddo
      do i=i1,i3
       if(dummy(i:i).eq.' ')then
        i2=i-1
        exit
       endif
      enddo
      if(i.ge.i3)i2=i3
      read(dummy(i1:i2),*)inum
      i0=i2+1
      end subroutine READnum
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine READvoxel(io,ndata,idata)
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: io,ndata
      integer,intent(out) :: idata(ndata)
      integer :: inum,i0,i3
      integer :: i,j,numold
      character(LEN=200) :: dummy

      i=0
      do
       read(io,'(a200)',end=999)dummy
       i0=1
       i3=len_trim(dummy)
       do
        call READnum(i0,i3,dummy,inum)
        if(inum.lt.0)then
         do j=1,-inum
          idata(i+j)=numold
         enddo
         i=i-inum
        else
         i=i+1
         idata(i)=inum
         numold=inum
        endif
        if(i0.ge.i3)exit
       enddo
      enddo
 999  continue
      return
      end subroutine READvoxel
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine MODIFYvoxel(ndata,ntag,idata0,idata1,idata2)
      implicit none
      integer,intent(in) :: ndata,ntag
      integer,intent(in) :: idata0(ndata),idata1(ndata)
      integer,intent(out) :: idata2(ndata)
      integer :: i
      do i=1,ndata
       if(idata1(i).gt.0)then
        idata2(i)=ntag
       else
        idata2(i)=idata0(i)
       endif
      enddo
      return
      end subroutine MODIFYvoxel
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
      subroutine CREATEvoxel(Cinter,ndata,idata)
      implicit none
      character(LEN=200),intent(in) :: Cinter
      integer,intent(in) :: ndata
      integer,intent(in) :: idata(ndata)
      integer,allocatable :: idatax(:)
      integer :: Ninter,nline,nrest,numold,icount,jcount,nmax
      integer :: i,j,iline
      integer,parameter :: io=10

      Ninter=len_trim(Cinter)-1
      open(io,file=Cinter(1:Ninter)//'CTvoxel.dat')
      allocate( idatax(ndata) )
      numold=idata(1)
      idatax(1)=idata(1)
      icount=0
      jcount=1
      do i=2,ndata
       if(idata(i).eq.numold)then
        icount=icount+1
       else
        if(icount.gt.0)then
         jcount=jcount+1
         idatax(jcount)=-icount
        endif
        jcount=jcount+1
        idatax(jcount)=idata(i)
        numold=idata(i)
        icount=0
       endif
      enddo
      if(icount.gt.0)then
       jcount=jcount+1
       idatax(jcount)=-icount
      endif
      nmax=jcount
      nline=nmax/10
      do iline=1,nline
       write(io,'(6x,10(x,I10))')(idatax((iline-1)*10+j),j=1,10)
      enddo
      nrest=mod(nmax,10)
      if(nrest.gt.0)then
       write(io,'(6x,10(x,I10))')(idatax(nline*10+j),j=1,nrest)
      endif
      close(io)
      deallocate(idatax)
      return
      end subroutine CREATEvoxel
!----------------------------------------------------------------------
END_FILE

BEGIN_FILE
/***************************************************************************/
/*              C functions to read filenames in DICOM directory           */
/*                             for windows                                 */
/*                                                                         */
/*                  Created by T. Furuta on 2014/02/12                     */
/*                     Under collaboration between JAEA and RIKEN          */
/*                                                                         */
/*                  Last modified by T. Furuta on 2023/08/24               */
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
/*                  Main routine "ct2phits.f" and                          */
/*                     c functions "dicomlib.c" are required               */
/***************************************************************************/
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <windows.h>
#include "dicomlib.h"
#include "utllib.h"
#define nline 200
/********** Module variables ***********************************************/
extern int imendian;
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void c_get_ctfiles_(int *nlist, char *path, char *cmod, long l){
  int i;
  FILE *fp;
  char buff[nline],buff2[nline];
  char *star="*";
  double sloc;
  WIN32_FIND_DATA ffd;
  HANDLE h;

  if((fp=fopen("tmp.txt","w"))==NULL){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning temporary file: tmp.txt\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  imendian=eval_imendian();
  memset(buff2,0,nline);
  strcpy(buff2,path);
  strcat(buff2,star);
  h=FindFirstFile(buff2,&ffd);
  i=0;
  if(h!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE){
    do{
      if(strcmp(ffd.cFileName,".")&&strcmp(ffd.cFileName,"..")){
	memset(buff,0,nline);
	strcpy(buff,path);
	strcat(buff,ffd.cFileName);
	if(get_sloc(buff,&sloc,cmod)==0){
	  fprintf(fp,"%s %lf\n",ffd.cFileName,sloc);
	  i++;
	}
      }
    }while(FindNextFile(h,&ffd));
    FindClose(h);
  }else{
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning DICOM file directory: %s\n",path);
    exit(-1);
  }
  *nlist=i;
  fclose(fp);

  return;
}
/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
void c_get_petfiles_(int *nslices, int *ntiming, int *imulti, char *path, char *cmod, char *cmod2, long l){
  int i,nlist,nlist0,iduration,nframes;
  int iflag[2]={0,0};
  FILE *fp;
  char buff[nline],buff2[nline];
  char *star="*";
  double sloc,timing;
  WIN32_FIND_DATA ffd;
  HANDLE h;

  if((fp=fopen("tmp.txt","w"))==NULL){
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning temporary file: tmp.txt\n");
    exit(-1);
  }
  imendian=eval_imendian();
  memset(buff2,0,nline);
  strcpy(buff2,path);
  strcat(buff2,star);
  h=FindFirstFile(buff2,&ffd);
  i=0;
  *imulti=0;
  if(h!=INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE){
    do{
      if(strcmp(ffd.cFileName,".")&&strcmp(ffd.cFileName,"..")){
	memset(buff,0,nline);
	strcpy(buff,path);
	strcat(buff,ffd.cFileName);
	if(get_sloc_time(buff,&sloc,&timing,&iduration,cmod,iflag)==0){
	  i++;
	  fprintf(fp,"%s %lf %lf %d\n",ffd.cFileName,sloc,timing,iduration);
	  if(i==1){
	    get_nslices(buff,nslices,&nlist0);
	    if(get_nframes(buff,&nframes)==0){
	      if(nframes>1)*imulti=1;
	    }
	  }
	}
      }
    }while(FindNextFile(h,&ffd));
    FindClose(h);
  }else{
    printf(" ERROR:: Openning DICOM file directory: %s\n",path);
    exit(-1);
  }
  if(i==0){
    h=FindFirstFile(buff2,&ffd);
    do{
      if(strcmp(ffd.cFileName,".")&&strcmp(ffd.cFileName,"..")){
	memset(buff,0,nline);
	strcpy(buff,path);
	strcat(buff,ffd.cFileName);
	if(get_sloc_time(buff,&sloc,&timing,&iduration,cmod2,iflag)==0){
	  i++;
	  fprintf(fp,"%s %lf %lf %d\n",ffd.cFileName,sloc,timing,iduration);
	  if(i==1){
	    get_nslices(buff,nslices,&nlist0);
	    if(get_nframes(buff,&nframes)==0){
	      if(nframes>1)*imulti=1;
	    }
	  }
	}
      }
    }while(FindNextFile(h,&ffd));
    FindClose(h);
  }
  nlist=i;
  if(nlist!=0){
    if(*imulti==1){
      if(nframes % (*nslices)!=0){
	printf(" ERROR:: # of frames is inconsistent\n");
	printf("         # of slices: %d, # of frames: %d\n",
	       *nslices,nframes);
	exit(-1);
      }
      *ntiming=nframes/(*nslices);
    }else{
      if(*nslices<=1){
	*nslices=nlist;
	printf(" WARNING:: ntiming=1 is assumed\n");
      }
      if(nlist0!=0){
	if(nlist!=nlist0){
	  printf(" ERROR:: # of files is inconsistent\n");
	  printf("         # of files required: %d, # of files existed: %d\n",
		 nlist0,nlist);
	  exit(-1);
	}
      }
      if(nlist % (*nslices)!=0){
	printf(" ERROR:: # of files is inconsistent\n");
	printf("         # of slices: %d, # of files existed: %d\n",
	       *nslices,nlist);
	exit(-1);
      }
      *ntiming=nlist/(*nslices);
    }
  }else{
    *nslices=0;
    *ntiming=0;
  }
  fclose(fp);
  return;
}
