!           dhet : dE (default) * user defined factor                  *
!                                                                      *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
! Calculate dose-weighted dose-mean-nucleus specific energy by T.Sato 2020/10/18
! Reference: T.Sato and Furusawa Radiat. Res. 178, 341-56 (2012)
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
parameter ( mfc = 100 )
common /rval1/ cval(mfc), aval(mfc)
data rn/6.20/      ! radius of cell nucleus in um
data unitL2z/0.0/  ! convert LET(keV/um) to Dose(Gy) when crossing at the center
data rho/1.0/      ! density of nucleus (g/cm3)
data ifirst/0/  ! check first time or not
!$OMP CRITICAL
if(ifirst.eq.0) then ! initialization
  ifirst = 1
  if(cval(82).gt.1e-10.and.cval(82).lt.1e5) rn=cval(82) ! rn (um)
  unitL2z=2*rn*1.602e-16/(rho*4.0/3.0*acos(-1.0)*rn**3*1e-15)
endif
!$OMP END CRITICAL
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!        default:  dE = eini - efin
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
zd=3.0/4.0*dedx*unitL2z
dhet=(eini-efin)*zd ! dose mean specific energy
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
return
end
END_FILE

FILE: smk_tat/src/usranatal.f90
BEGIN_FILE
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
subroutine usranatal(jmax,rdata,answer,rerr)
!                                                                      *
!        sample subroutine for user defined anatally                   *
!        input :                                                       *
!           jmax : number of tally output files                        *
!           rdata(2,jmax) : 1 for tally data, 2 for relative error     *
!                                                                      *
!        output :                                                      *
!           answer : output data                                       *
!           rerr   : relative error of output data                     *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
parameter ( mfc = 100 )
integer jmax
real(8) :: rdata(2,jmax)
common /rval1/ cval(mfc), aval(mfc) ! you can use parameter defined in PHITS input file
if(cval(99).gt.1.0e-10) then
  call smk_tat(jmax,rdata,answer,rerr) ! c99 is defined
else
  call weighted_sum(jmax,rdata,answer,rerr) ! c99[0] or not defined
endif
return
end
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
subroutine weighted_sum(jmax,rdata,answer,rerr)
!                                                                      *
!        input :                                                       *
!           jmax : number of tally output files                        *
!           rdata(2,jmax) : 1 for tally data, 2 for relative error     *
!                                                                      *
!        output :                                                      *
!           answer : weighted sum                                      *
!           rerr   : relative error of weighted sum                    *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
parameter ( mfc = 100 )
integer jmax
real(8) :: rdata(2,jmax)
common /rval1/ cval(mfc), aval(mfc) ! you can use parameter defined in PHITS input file
sum1=0.0
sum2=0.0
do j=1,jmax
  if(j.gt.98) then
    write(*,'(''only up to 98 files can be analyzed in the '',&
    &  '' default setting in usranatal.f'')')
  endif
  sum1=sum1+cval(j)*rdata(1,j)
  sum2=sum2+(cval(j)*rdata(1,j)*rdata(2,j))**2
enddo
if(sum1.gt.0) then
  answer=sum1
  rerr=sqrt(sum2)/sum1
else
  answer=0.0
  rerr=0.0
endif
return
end
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
subroutine smk_tat(jmax,rdata,answer,rerr)
!                                                                      *
!        outout photo isoeffective dose for TAT based on SMK model    *
!        input :                                                       *
!           jmax : number of tally output files                        *
!           rdata(2,jmax) : 1 for tally data, 2 for relative error     *
!                                                                      *
!        output :                                                      *
!           answer : photon isoeffective dose                          *
!           rerr   : relative error of output data                     *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
parameter (ncomp = 2) ! number of dose component
parameter ( mfc = 100 )
parameter (nGauss=200) ! number of bin for drug density Gaussian
parameter (nmax = 32768)   ! number of data for FFT (should be 2*nmaxsqrt**2)
parameter (nzbin= 16384)   ! number of zbin (should be nmax/2)
parameter (nmaxsqrt = 128) ! for FFT
common /restart/ resc2(1) ! use only resc2(1)
common /rval1/ cval(mfc), aval(mfc) ! you can use parameter defined in PHITS input file
integer jmax
real(8) :: rdata(2,jmax) ! input tally data
real(8) :: zdeach(ncomp+1)  ! dose-mean domain specific energy, ncomp+1 for boron data depending on drug heterogeneity
real(8) :: zseach(ncomp+1)  ! saturation corrected specific energy
real(8) :: zneach(ncomp+1)  ! dose-mean nucleus specific energy
real(8) :: zfeach(ncomp+1)  ! frequency-mean nucleus specific energy = (8/9)*zn for mu-randomness, (45/64)*zn for i-randomness
real(8) :: DnRatio(ncomp+1) ! nuclear dose ratio (D_nuclear / D_kerma
integer :: irandomness(ncomp+1) ! -1: do not consider heterogeneity, 0: mu-randomness, 1: i-randomness
real(8) :: xGauss(0:nGauss),GaussDist(0:nGauss) ! Drug density Gaussian distribution
real(8) :: zhig(0:nzbin) ! zbin
real(8) :: Fzdz(0:nzbin) ! probability density of cell-nucleus dose
real(8) :: ram(0:ncomp+1)   ! mean number of hit for each compoenent, ram(0) is total number of hit
save xGauss,GaussDist,zhig,zfeach
! for FFT
integer n, ip(0 : nmaxsqrt + 1)
real*8 a(0 : nmax), w(0 : nmax * 5 / 4 - 1), t(0 : nmax / 2)
real*8 Fz1(0 : nmax) ! f_1
real*8 Fzn(0 : nmax) ! f_n
real*8 FT1(0 : nmax) ! F{F_1}
real*8 FTn(0 : nmax) ! F{F_n}
! Uniformly distributed drug in the order of electron, alpha extracellular and intracellular doses.
data irandomness/-1,0,0/ ! -1: do not consider heterogeneity, 0: mu-randomness, 1: i-randomness
data zdeach/2.90,92.2,92.2/  ! dose-mean domain specific energy
data zseach/2.90,47.4,47.4/  ! same as zd because y0 is too high
data zneach/1.45e-4,0.191,0.191/    ! dose mean nucleus specific energy
data DnRatio/1.0,0.440,0.554/ ! microscopic dose correction factor (D_nuclear / D_kerma)*N for BPA
data Aref/0.313/    ! Alpha for reference treatment, taken from T.Sato & Y. Furusawa Radiat. Res. 178, 341-356 (2012)
data a0/0.156/      ! Alpha0 parameter (Gy-1)
data b0/0.0607/     ! Beta0 parameter, taken from T.Sato & Y. Furusawa Radiat. Res. 178, 341-356 (2012)
data Xfrac/1000.0/  ! Gy/Fraction for reference treatment, more than 100 indicate RBE-weighted dose
data scale/1.0/     ! scaling factor of dose
data g0/1.5/        ! recovery constant (h-1)
data hlife/7.214/   ! Half-life (h) of RI (At211)
data sigma/0.0/    ! sigma for drug density
data imode/1/      ! FFT SMK (=1), Taylor-expansion SMK (=2), z*-based MK (=3)
data zwid/5.0d-3/  ! zbin width
save Gfact         ! G parameter for considering dose rate effect
save Bref          ! beta for reference treatment, generally equal to b0 so no default value
data ifirst/0/
!$OMP CRITICAL
if(ifirst.eq.0) then ! initialization
  ifirst=1
  if(jmax.ne.ncomp) then
    write(*,*) 'Number of tally output files should be same as ',&
    &  'number of dose component =',ncomp
    stop
  endif
  do j=1,ncomp+1
    if(cval(j*10+1).gt.1e-10.and.cval(j*10+1).lt.1e5) &
    &  zdeach(j)=cval(j*10+1)     ! zd (Gy) for c11,c21,c31
    if(cval(j*10+2).gt.1e-10.and.cval(j*10+2).lt.1e5) &
    &  zseach(j)=cval(j*10+2)     ! z* (Gy) for c12,c22,c32
    if(cval(j*10+3).gt.1e-10.and.cval(j*10+3).lt.1e5) &
    &  zneach(j)=cval(j*10+3)     ! zn (Gy) for c13,c23,c33
    if(irandomness(j).le.0) then   ! mu-randomness (or randomness is not considered)
      zfeach(j)=zneach(j)*8.0d0/9.0d0 ! frequency-mean nucleus specific energy
    else  ! i-randomness
      zneach(j)=zneach(j)*32.0/45.0 ! convert (zn) for u-randomness to (zn) for i-randomness
      zfeach(j)=zneach(j)*45.0/64.0 ! frequency-mean nucleus specific energy
    endif
    if(cval(j*10+4).gt.1e-10.and.cval(j*10+4).lt.1e5) &
    &  DnRatio(j)=cval(j*10+4)     ! DnRatio (Gy) for c14,c24,c34
  enddo
  if(abs(cval(90)).gt.1e-10.and.abs(cval(90)).lt.1e20) then
    scale=abs(cval(90)) ! Scaling factor of dose
    if(cval(90).lt.0.0.and.rdata(1,1).ne.0) scale=scale/rdata(1,1)  ! negative value indicate use 1st data for normalization
  endif
  if(cval(91).gt.1e-10.and.cval(91).lt.1e5) a0=cval(91)     ! a0 (Gy-1)
  if(cval(92).gt.1e-10.and.cval(92).lt.1e5) b0=cval(92)     ! b0 (Gy-2)
  if(cval(93).gt.1e-10.and.cval(93).lt.1e5) Aref=cval(93)   ! Alpha for reference treatment (Gy-1)
  if(cval(94).eq.0.or.(cval(94).gt.1e-10.and.cval(94).lt.1e5)) then
    Bref=cval(94)   ! beta for reference treatment (Gy-1)
  else
    Bref=b0 ! basically same as b0
  endif
  if(cval(95).gt.1e-10.and.cval(95).lt.1e5) Xfrac=cval(95)  ! Gy/Fraction for reference treatment
  if(cval(96).gt.1e-10.and.cval(96).lt.1e5) sigma=cval(96)  ! sigma for drug density
  if(cval(97).gt.1e-10.and.cval(97).lt.1e5) g0=cval(97)     ! mu (h-1)
  if(cval(98).gt.1e-10.and.cval(98).lt.1e5) hlife=cval(98)  ! half-life of RI (h), including biological decay
  if(cval(99).gt.1e-10.and.cval(99).lt.1e5) imode=nint(cval(99))  ! FFT SMK (=1), Taylor-expansion SMK (=2), z*-based MK (=3)
!  set up for drug distribution
  GaussDist(:)=0.0
  do ig=0,nGauss
    xGauss(ig)=ig*2.0d0/nGauss  ! x from 0 to 2.0
  enddo
  if(sigma.ne.0.0) then ! Gaussian distribution
    sum=0.0
    do ig=0,nGauss
      tmp=(xGauss(ig)-1.0d0)**2/(2*sigma**2)
      if(tmp.lt.-log(1.0e-3)) GaussDist(ig)=exp(-tmp)
      sum=sum+GaussDist(ig)
    enddo
    do ig=0,nGauss
      GaussDist(ig)=GaussDist(ig)/sum
    enddo
  else
    GaussDist(nGauss/2)=1.0 ! Delta function
  endif
! set up for zbin
  do iz=0,nzbin
    zhig(iz)=iz*zwid ! 0.01 Gy step, up to 81.92 Gy
  enddo
endif
!$OMP END CRITICAL
!---------- end of initialization --------------------------------------------
answer=0.0
rerr=0.0
D1=0.0  ! total nucleus dose
D2=0.0 ! square of total dose error
do j=1,ncomp
  Ratio=DnRatio(j)
  if(j.eq.ncomp) Ratio=Ratio+DnRatio(j+1) ! for boron dose, sum of inner and extra-cellular dose ratio
  D1=D1+rdata(1,j)*Ratio
  D2=D2+(rdata(1,j)*rdata(2,j)*Ratio)**2
enddo
if(D1.eq.0.0) return ! no dose at all
if(hlife.eq.0) then
  Gfact=1.0d0
else
!       decayBio=rdata(1,3)*3600.0 ! biological decay constant (/h)
!       decayBio=decayBio*resc2(1) ! rdata(1,3) has been changed because of different resc2 in anatally
  decayBio=0.0 ! currently, biological decay constant should be included in hlife parameter
  decayRI=log(2.0)/hlife        ! physical decay constant (/h)
  Gfact=(decayBio+decayRI)/(g0+decayBio+decayRI)
endif
rerr=sqrt(D2)/D1  ! relative error is assumed to be same as that of total dose
SF=0.0 ! total survival fraction
do ig=0,nGauss
  if(GaussDist(ig).ne.0) then
    D=0.0 ! dose in nucleus (not kerma dose)
    Dhetero=0.0 ! heterogenous dose in nucleus
    zd=0.0
    zs=0.0
    zn=0.0
    zf=0.0
    ram(:)=0.0 ! number of hit
    do j=1,ncomp+1
      if(j.ne.ncomp+1) then ! beta & alpha extra-cellular dose
        Ratio=DnRatio(j)
      else ! boron dose
        Ratio=DnRatio(j)*xGauss(ig)
      endif
      zd=zd+rdata(1,min(ncomp,j))*zdeach(j)*Ratio
      zs=zs+rdata(1,min(ncomp,j))*zseach(j)*Ratio
      zn=zn+rdata(1,min(ncomp,j))*zneach(j)*Ratio
      D=D+rdata(1,min(ncomp,j))*Ratio
      if(irandomness(j).ge.0) then ! dose heterogeneity must be considered
        Dhetero=Dhetero+rdata(1,min(ncomp,j))*Ratio
        ram(j)=rdata(1,min(ncomp,j))/zfeach(j)*Ratio
        ram(0)=ram(0)+ram(j)
      endif
    enddo
    if(D.eq.0.0) then
      Slog=0.0 !
    else
      zd=zd/D  ! dose-mean domain specific energy
      zs=zs/D  ! saturation-corrected speicific energy
      zn=zn/D  ! dose-mean nuclear speicific energy
      asmk=a0+b0*zs ! Alpha_smk
      bsmk=b0*(zs/zd)*Gfact ! Beta_smk
      if(imode.ge.2.or.ram(0).eq.0.0) then ! Taylor-expansion or z*-based mode
        D=D*scale ! consider scaling factor
        Slog=-asmk*D-bsmk*D**2
        if(imode.eq.2) Slog=Slog+ &! Taylor-expansion mode &
        &    log(1.0+D*(-bsmk+0.5*(asmk+2*bsmk*D)**2)*zn) ! additional term of SMK model
      else ! FFT mode
        Fzdz(:)=0.0 ! set up f1(z)
        do j=1,ncomp+1
          if(irandomness(j).eq.0) then ! mu-randomness
            izmax=int(zneach(j)/zwid*4.0/3.0)+1
            sum=0.0
            do iz=1,izmax
              sum=sum+iz*1.0d0/izmax
            enddo
!            tmp=ram(j)/ram(0)/((izmax+1)*izmax/2)
            do iz=1,izmax
              Fzdz(iz)=Fzdz(iz)+ram(j)/ram(0)*(iz*1.0d0/izmax)/sum
            enddo
          elseif(irandomness(j).eq.1) then ! i-randomness
            izmax=int(zneach(j)/zwid*15.0/8.0)+1
            sum=0.0
            do iz=1,izmax
              sum=sum+(1.0d0-((iz*1.0d0/izmax)**2))
            enddo
            do iz=1,izmax
              Fzdz(iz)=Fzdz(iz)+ram(j)/ram(0)* &
              &       (1.0d0-(iz*1.0d0/izmax)**2)/sum
            enddo
          endif
        enddo
        sum1=0.0
        sum2=0.0
        do iz=0,nzbin ! normalized and re-evaluate ram(0)
          sum1=sum1+Fzdz(iz)
          sum2=sum2+Fzdz(iz)*zhig(iz)
        enddo
        Fzdz(:)=Fzdz(:)/sum1
        zf=sum2/sum1
        ram(0)=Dhetero/zf ! re-evaluate ram(0) because zf could be changed slightly
        D=D*scale         ! consider scaling factor
        Dhetero=Dhetero*scale ! consider scaling factor
        ram(0)=ram(0)*scale ! mean number of events is also proportional to scale factor
! Poisson and FFT analysis
        nPmax=10000
        n=nmax ! always max
        ip(0) = 0
        Fzn(:)=0.0
        do m=0,n-1,2
          Fzn(m)=Fzdz(m/2)
        enddo
        Fzdz(:)=0.0  ! from now, Fzdz is used for integral probability density
        Fzdz(0)=Poisson(ram(0),0)
        do k=1,nPmax
          P=Poisson(ram(0),k)
          do m=0,n-1,2
            Fzdz(m/2)=Fzdz(m/2)+P*Fzn(m) ! add f_k(z)
          enddo
          if(k.gt.ram(0).and.P.lt.1.0e-10) exit  ! not necessary anymore
          a(:)=Fzn(:)
          call rdft(n, 1, a, ip, w) ! FFT
          if(k.eq.1) FT1(:)=a(:)
          do m=0,n-1,2
            FTn(m)=a(m)*FT1(m)-a(m+1)*FT1(m+1)
            FTn(m+1)=a(m)*FT1(m+1)+a(m+1)*FT1(m)
          enddo
          a(:)=FTn(:)
          call rdft(n, -1, a, ip, w) ! Inverse FFT
          sum1=0.0
          do m=0,n-1,2
            Fzn(m)=a(m)/(n/2)
            if(Fzn(m).lt.1.0e-10) Fzn(m)=0.0 ! ignore too small value
            sum1=sum1+Fzn(m)
            Fzn(m+1)=0.0  ! ignore imaginary part for next calculation
          enddo
          Fzn(:)=Fzn(:)/sum1 ! f_k+1(z), normalized to 1.0
          if(Fzn(n-1).ne.0.0) then
            write(*,*) 'nzbin in usranatal.f is not enough at k=',k
            stop
          endif
        enddo
        if(k.eq.nPmax+1) then
          write(*,*) 'nPmax in usranatal.f is not enough'
          stop
        endif
        SFcell=0.0
        sum1=0.0
        sum2=0.0
        do iz=0,nzbin
          z=zhig(iz)+(D-Dhetero) ! add fixed photon component
          if(Fzdz(iz).ne.0) then
            SFcell=SFcell+Fzdz(iz)*exp(-asmk*z-bsmk*z**2)
            sum1=sum1+Fzdz(iz)
            sum2=sum2+Fzdz(iz)*z
          endif
        enddo
        SFcell=SFcell/sum1  ! normalized to 1.0
        Slog=log(SFcell)
      endif
    endif
    SF=SF+exp(Slog)*GaussDist(ig)  ! Total survival fraction
  endif
enddo
if(Xfrac.ge.100) then ! RBE-weighted dose
  answer=(-Aref+sqrt(Aref**2-4*Bref*log(SF)))/(2*Bref)
else ! EQDX
  answer=-log(SF)/(Aref+Bref*Xfrac)
endif
return
end
! ****************************************************
function Poisson(ram,k)  ! Possion distribution
! ****************************************************
implicit integer (i-m)
implicit real*8 (a-h, o-z)
data rammax/50.0/
data kmax/50/
if((ram.lt.k.and.ram.gt.50.0).or.(ram.gt.rammax.or.k.gt.kmax)) then ! Gauss distribution approximation
  x=k+0.5
  Poisson=exp(-((x-ram)**2/(2*ram)))/sqrt(2.0*acos(-1.0)*ram)
else
  dk=1
  do i=1,k
    dk=dk*i
  enddo
  Poisson=ram**k*exp(-ram)/dk
endif
if(Poisson.lt.1.0e-5) Poisson=0.0
return
end
!*******************************************************************************
!    Fast Fourier Transform
!    Reference:
!    * Masatake MORI, Makoto NATORI, Tatuo TORII: Suchikeisan,
!      Iwanamikouzajyouhoukagaku18, Iwanami, 1982 (Japanese)
!    * Henri J. Nussbaumer: Fast Fourier Transform and Convolution
!      Algorithms, Springer Verlag, 1982
!    * C. S. Burrus, Notes on the FFT (with large FFT paper list)
!      http://www-dsp.rice.edu/research/fft/fftnote.asc
!    Copyright(C) 1996-2001 Takuya OOURA
!    download: http://momonga.t.u-tokyo.ac.jp/~ooura/fft.html
!    You may use, copy, modify this code for any purpose and
!    without fee. You may distribute this ORIGINAL package.
!*******************************************************************************
subroutine rdft(n, isgn, a, ip, w)
integer n, isgn, ip(0 : *), nw, nc
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), w(0 : *), xi
nw = ip(0)
if (n .gt. 4 * nw) then
  nw = n / 4
  call makewt(nw, ip, w)
end if
nc = ip(1)
if (n .gt. 4 * nc) then
  nc = n / 4
  call makect(nc, ip, w(nw))
end if
if (isgn .ge. 0) then
  if (n .gt. 4) then
    call bitrv2(n, ip(2), a)
    call cftfsub(n, a, w)
    call rftfsub(n, a, nc, w(nw))
  else if (n .eq. 4) then
    call cftfsub(n, a, w)
  end if
  xi = a(0) - a(1)
  a(0) = a(0) + a(1)
  a(1) = xi
else
  a(1) = 0.5d0 * (a(0) - a(1))
  a(0) = a(0) - a(1)
  if (n .gt. 4) then
    call rftbsub(n, a, nc, w(nw))
    call bitrv2(n, ip(2), a)
    call cftbsub(n, a, w)
  else if (n .eq. 4) then
    call cftfsub(n, a, w)
  end if
end if
end
!
! -------- initializing routines --------
!
subroutine makewt(nw, ip, w)
integer nw, ip(0 : *), j, nwh
real*8 w(0 : nw - 1), delta, x, y
ip(0) = nw
ip(1) = 1
if (nw .gt. 2) then
  nwh = nw / 2
  delta = atan(1.0d0) / nwh
  w(0) = 1
  w(1) = 0
  w(nwh) = cos(delta * nwh)
  w(nwh + 1) = w(nwh)
  if (nwh .gt. 2) then
    do j = 2, nwh - 2, 2
      x = cos(delta * j)
      y = sin(delta * j)
      w(j) = x
      w(j + 1) = y
      w(nw - j) = y
      w(nw - j + 1) = x
    end do
    call bitrv2(nw, ip(2), w)
  end if
end if
end
!
subroutine makect(nc, ip, c)
integer nc, ip(0 : *), j, nch
real*8 c(0 : nc - 1), delta
ip(1) = nc
if (nc .gt. 1) then
  nch = nc / 2
  delta = atan(1.0d0) / nch
  c(0) = cos(delta * nch)
  c(nch) = 0.5d0 * c(0)
  do j = 1, nch - 1
    c(j) = 0.5d0 * cos(delta * j)
    c(nc - j) = 0.5d0 * sin(delta * j)
  end do
end if
end
!
! -------- child routines --------
!
subroutine bitrv2(n, ip, a)
integer n, ip(0 : *), j, j1, k, k1, l, m, m2
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), xr, xi, yr, yi
ip(0) = 0
l = n
m = 1
do while (8 * m .lt. l)
  l = l / 2
  do j = 0, m - 1
    ip(m + j) = ip(j) + l
  end do
  m = m * 2
end do
m2 = 2 * m
if (8 * m .eq. l) then
  do k = 0, m - 1
    do j = 0, k - 1
      j1 = 2 * j + ip(k)
      k1 = 2 * k + ip(j)
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
      j1 = j1 + m2
      k1 = k1 + 2 * m2
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
      j1 = j1 + m2
      k1 = k1 - m2
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
      j1 = j1 + m2
      k1 = k1 + 2 * m2
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
    end do
    j1 = 2 * k + m2 + ip(k)
    k1 = j1 + m2
    xr = a(j1)
    xi = a(j1 + 1)
    yr = a(k1)
    yi = a(k1 + 1)
    a(j1) = yr
    a(j1 + 1) = yi
    a(k1) = xr
    a(k1 + 1) = xi
  end do
else
  do k = 1, m - 1
    do j = 0, k - 1
      j1 = 2 * j + ip(k)
      k1 = 2 * k + ip(j)
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
      j1 = j1 + m2
      k1 = k1 + m2
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
    end do
  end do
end if
end
!
subroutine bitrv2conj(n, ip, a)
integer n, ip(0 : *), j, j1, k, k1, l, m, m2
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), xr, xi, yr, yi
ip(0) = 0
l = n
m = 1
do while (8 * m .lt. l)
  l = l / 2
  do j = 0, m - 1
    ip(m + j) = ip(j) + l
  end do
  m = m * 2
end do
m2 = 2 * m
if (8 * m .eq. l) then
  do k = 0, m - 1
    do j = 0, k - 1
      j1 = 2 * j + ip(k)
      k1 = 2 * k + ip(j)
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = -a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = -a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
      j1 = j1 + m2
      k1 = k1 + 2 * m2
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = -a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = -a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
      j1 = j1 + m2
      k1 = k1 - m2
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = -a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = -a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
      j1 = j1 + m2
      k1 = k1 + 2 * m2
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = -a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = -a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
    end do
    k1 = 2 * k + ip(k)
    a(k1 + 1) = -a(k1 + 1)
    j1 = k1 + m2
    k1 = j1 + m2
    xr = a(j1)
    xi = -a(j1 + 1)
    yr = a(k1)
    yi = -a(k1 + 1)
    a(j1) = yr
    a(j1 + 1) = yi
    a(k1) = xr
    a(k1 + 1) = xi
    k1 = k1 + m2
    a(k1 + 1) = -a(k1 + 1)
  end do
else
  a(1) = -a(1)
  a(m2 + 1) = -a(m2 + 1)
  do k = 1, m - 1
    do j = 0, k - 1
      j1 = 2 * j + ip(k)
      k1 = 2 * k + ip(j)
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = -a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = -a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
      j1 = j1 + m2
      k1 = k1 + m2
      xr = a(j1)
      xi = -a(j1 + 1)
      yr = a(k1)
      yi = -a(k1 + 1)
      a(j1) = yr
      a(j1 + 1) = yi
      a(k1) = xr
      a(k1 + 1) = xi
    end do
    k1 = 2 * k + ip(k)
    a(k1 + 1) = -a(k1 + 1)
    a(k1 + m2 + 1) = -a(k1 + m2 + 1)
  end do
end if
end
!
subroutine cftfsub(n, a, w)
integer n, j, j1, j2, j3, l
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), w(0 : *)
real*8 x0r, x0i, x1r, x1i, x2r, x2i, x3r, x3i
l = 2
if (n .gt. 8) then
  call cft1st(n, a, w)
  l = 8
  do while (4 * l .lt. n)
    call cftmdl(n, l, a, w)
    l = 4 * l
  end do
end if
if (4 * l .eq. n) then
  do j = 0, l - 2, 2
    j1 = j + l
    j2 = j1 + l
    j3 = j2 + l
    x0r = a(j) + a(j1)
    x0i = a(j + 1) + a(j1 + 1)
    x1r = a(j) - a(j1)
    x1i = a(j + 1) - a(j1 + 1)
    x2r = a(j2) + a(j3)
    x2i = a(j2 + 1) + a(j3 + 1)
    x3r = a(j2) - a(j3)
    x3i = a(j2 + 1) - a(j3 + 1)
    a(j) = x0r + x2r
    a(j + 1) = x0i + x2i
    a(j2) = x0r - x2r
    a(j2 + 1) = x0i - x2i
    a(j1) = x1r - x3i
    a(j1 + 1) = x1i + x3r
    a(j3) = x1r + x3i
    a(j3 + 1) = x1i - x3r
  end do
else
  do j = 0, l - 2, 2
    j1 = j + l
    x0r = a(j) - a(j1)
    x0i = a(j + 1) - a(j1 + 1)
    a(j) = a(j) + a(j1)
    a(j + 1) = a(j + 1) + a(j1 + 1)
    a(j1) = x0r
    a(j1 + 1) = x0i
  end do
end if
end
!
subroutine cftbsub(n, a, w)
integer n, j, j1, j2, j3, l
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), w(0 : *)
real*8 x0r, x0i, x1r, x1i, x2r, x2i, x3r, x3i
l = 2
if (n .gt. 8) then
  call cft1st(n, a, w)
  l = 8
  do while (4 * l .lt. n)
    call cftmdl(n, l, a, w)
    l = 4 * l
  end do
end if
if (4 * l .eq. n) then
  do j = 0, l - 2, 2
    j1 = j + l
    j2 = j1 + l
    j3 = j2 + l
    x0r = a(j) + a(j1)
    x0i = -a(j + 1) - a(j1 + 1)
    x1r = a(j) - a(j1)
    x1i = -a(j + 1) + a(j1 + 1)
    x2r = a(j2) + a(j3)
    x2i = a(j2 + 1) + a(j3 + 1)
    x3r = a(j2) - a(j3)
    x3i = a(j2 + 1) - a(j3 + 1)
    a(j) = x0r + x2r
    a(j + 1) = x0i - x2i
    a(j2) = x0r - x2r
    a(j2 + 1) = x0i + x2i
    a(j1) = x1r - x3i
    a(j1 + 1) = x1i - x3r
    a(j3) = x1r + x3i
    a(j3 + 1) = x1i + x3r
  end do
else
  do j = 0, l - 2, 2
    j1 = j + l
    x0r = a(j) - a(j1)
    x0i = -a(j + 1) + a(j1 + 1)
    a(j) = a(j) + a(j1)
    a(j + 1) = -a(j + 1) - a(j1 + 1)
    a(j1) = x0r
    a(j1 + 1) = x0i
  end do
end if
end
!
subroutine cft1st(n, a, w)
integer n, j, k1, k2
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), w(0 : *)
real*8 wk1r, wk1i, wk2r, wk2i, wk3r, wk3i
real*8 x0r, x0i, x1r, x1i, x2r, x2i, x3r, x3i
x0r = a(0) + a(2)
x0i = a(1) + a(3)
x1r = a(0) - a(2)
x1i = a(1) - a(3)
x2r = a(4) + a(6)
x2i = a(5) + a(7)
x3r = a(4) - a(6)
x3i = a(5) - a(7)
a(0) = x0r + x2r
a(1) = x0i + x2i
a(4) = x0r - x2r
a(5) = x0i - x2i
a(2) = x1r - x3i
a(3) = x1i + x3r
a(6) = x1r + x3i
a(7) = x1i - x3r
wk1r = w(2)
x0r = a(8) + a(10)
x0i = a(9) + a(11)
x1r = a(8) - a(10)
x1i = a(9) - a(11)
x2r = a(12) + a(14)
x2i = a(13) + a(15)
x3r = a(12) - a(14)
x3i = a(13) - a(15)
a(8) = x0r + x2r
a(9) = x0i + x2i
a(12) = x2i - x0i
a(13) = x0r - x2r
x0r = x1r - x3i
x0i = x1i + x3r
a(10) = wk1r * (x0r - x0i)
a(11) = wk1r * (x0r + x0i)
x0r = x3i + x1r
x0i = x3r - x1i
a(14) = wk1r * (x0i - x0r)
a(15) = wk1r * (x0i + x0r)
k1 = 0
do j = 16, n - 16, 16
  k1 = k1 + 2
  k2 = 2 * k1
  wk2r = w(k1)
  wk2i = w(k1 + 1)
  wk1r = w(k2)
  wk1i = w(k2 + 1)
  wk3r = wk1r - 2 * wk2i * wk1i
  wk3i = 2 * wk2i * wk1r - wk1i
  x0r = a(j) + a(j + 2)
  x0i = a(j + 1) + a(j + 3)
  x1r = a(j) - a(j + 2)
  x1i = a(j + 1) - a(j + 3)
  x2r = a(j + 4) + a(j + 6)
  x2i = a(j + 5) + a(j + 7)
  x3r = a(j + 4) - a(j + 6)
  x3i = a(j + 5) - a(j + 7)
  a(j) = x0r + x2r
  a(j + 1) = x0i + x2i
  x0r = x0r - x2r
  x0i = x0i - x2i
  a(j + 4) = wk2r * x0r - wk2i * x0i
  a(j + 5) = wk2r * x0i + wk2i * x0r
  x0r = x1r - x3i
  x0i = x1i + x3r
  a(j + 2) = wk1r * x0r - wk1i * x0i
  a(j + 3) = wk1r * x0i + wk1i * x0r
  x0r = x1r + x3i
  x0i = x1i - x3r
  a(j + 6) = wk3r * x0r - wk3i * x0i
  a(j + 7) = wk3r * x0i + wk3i * x0r
  wk1r = w(k2 + 2)
  wk1i = w(k2 + 3)
  wk3r = wk1r - 2 * wk2r * wk1i
  wk3i = 2 * wk2r * wk1r - wk1i
  x0r = a(j + 8) + a(j + 10)
  x0i = a(j + 9) + a(j + 11)
  x1r = a(j + 8) - a(j + 10)
  x1i = a(j + 9) - a(j + 11)
  x2r = a(j + 12) + a(j + 14)
  x2i = a(j + 13) + a(j + 15)
  x3r = a(j + 12) - a(j + 14)
  x3i = a(j + 13) - a(j + 15)
  a(j + 8) = x0r + x2r
  a(j + 9) = x0i + x2i
  x0r = x0r - x2r
  x0i = x0i - x2i
  a(j + 12) = -wk2i * x0r - wk2r * x0i
  a(j + 13) = -wk2i * x0i + wk2r * x0r
  x0r = x1r - x3i
  x0i = x1i + x3r
  a(j + 10) = wk1r * x0r - wk1i * x0i
  a(j + 11) = wk1r * x0i + wk1i * x0r
  x0r = x1r + x3i
  x0i = x1i - x3r
  a(j + 14) = wk3r * x0r - wk3i * x0i
  a(j + 15) = wk3r * x0i + wk3i * x0r
end do
end
!
subroutine cftmdl(n, l, a, w)
integer n, l, j, j1, j2, j3, k, k1, k2, m, m2
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), w(0 : *)
real*8 wk1r, wk1i, wk2r, wk2i, wk3r, wk3i
real*8 x0r, x0i, x1r, x1i, x2r, x2i, x3r, x3i
m = 4 * l
do j = 0, l - 2, 2
  j1 = j + l
  j2 = j1 + l
  j3 = j2 + l
  x0r = a(j) + a(j1)
  x0i = a(j + 1) + a(j1 + 1)
  x1r = a(j) - a(j1)
  x1i = a(j + 1) - a(j1 + 1)
  x2r = a(j2) + a(j3)
  x2i = a(j2 + 1) + a(j3 + 1)
  x3r = a(j2) - a(j3)
  x3i = a(j2 + 1) - a(j3 + 1)
  a(j) = x0r + x2r
  a(j + 1) = x0i + x2i
  a(j2) = x0r - x2r
  a(j2 + 1) = x0i - x2i
  a(j1) = x1r - x3i
  a(j1 + 1) = x1i + x3r
  a(j3) = x1r + x3i
  a(j3 + 1) = x1i - x3r
end do
wk1r = w(2)
do j = m, l + m - 2, 2
  j1 = j + l
  j2 = j1 + l
  j3 = j2 + l
  x0r = a(j) + a(j1)
  x0i = a(j + 1) + a(j1 + 1)
  x1r = a(j) - a(j1)
  x1i = a(j + 1) - a(j1 + 1)
  x2r = a(j2) + a(j3)
  x2i = a(j2 + 1) + a(j3 + 1)
  x3r = a(j2) - a(j3)
  x3i = a(j2 + 1) - a(j3 + 1)
  a(j) = x0r + x2r
  a(j + 1) = x0i + x2i
  a(j2) = x2i - x0i
  a(j2 + 1) = x0r - x2r
  x0r = x1r - x3i
  x0i = x1i + x3r
  a(j1) = wk1r * (x0r - x0i)
  a(j1 + 1) = wk1r * (x0r + x0i)
  x0r = x3i + x1r
  x0i = x3r - x1i
  a(j3) = wk1r * (x0i - x0r)
  a(j3 + 1) = wk1r * (x0i + x0r)
end do
k1 = 0
m2 = 2 * m
do k = m2, n - m2, m2
  k1 = k1 + 2
  k2 = 2 * k1
  wk2r = w(k1)
  wk2i = w(k1 + 1)
  wk1r = w(k2)
  wk1i = w(k2 + 1)
  wk3r = wk1r - 2 * wk2i * wk1i
  wk3i = 2 * wk2i * wk1r - wk1i
  do j = k, l + k - 2, 2
    j1 = j + l
    j2 = j1 + l
    j3 = j2 + l
    x0r = a(j) + a(j1)
    x0i = a(j + 1) + a(j1 + 1)
    x1r = a(j) - a(j1)
    x1i = a(j + 1) - a(j1 + 1)
    x2r = a(j2) + a(j3)
    x2i = a(j2 + 1) + a(j3 + 1)
    x3r = a(j2) - a(j3)
    x3i = a(j2 + 1) - a(j3 + 1)
    a(j) = x0r + x2r
    a(j + 1) = x0i + x2i
    x0r = x0r - x2r
    x0i = x0i - x2i
    a(j2) = wk2r * x0r - wk2i * x0i
    a(j2 + 1) = wk2r * x0i + wk2i * x0r
    x0r = x1r - x3i
    x0i = x1i + x3r
    a(j1) = wk1r * x0r - wk1i * x0i
    a(j1 + 1) = wk1r * x0i + wk1i * x0r
    x0r = x1r + x3i
    x0i = x1i - x3r
    a(j3) = wk3r * x0r - wk3i * x0i
    a(j3 + 1) = wk3r * x0i + wk3i * x0r
  end do
  wk1r = w(k2 + 2)
  wk1i = w(k2 + 3)
  wk3r = wk1r - 2 * wk2r * wk1i
  wk3i = 2 * wk2r * wk1r - wk1i
  do j = k + m, l + (k + m) - 2, 2
    j1 = j + l
    j2 = j1 + l
    j3 = j2 + l
    x0r = a(j) + a(j1)
    x0i = a(j + 1) + a(j1 + 1)
    x1r = a(j) - a(j1)
    x1i = a(j + 1) - a(j1 + 1)
    x2r = a(j2) + a(j3)
    x2i = a(j2 + 1) + a(j3 + 1)
    x3r = a(j2) - a(j3)
    x3i = a(j2 + 1) - a(j3 + 1)
    a(j) = x0r + x2r
    a(j + 1) = x0i + x2i
    x0r = x0r - x2r
    x0i = x0i - x2i
    a(j2) = -wk2i * x0r - wk2r * x0i
    a(j2 + 1) = -wk2i * x0i + wk2r * x0r
    x0r = x1r - x3i
    x0i = x1i + x3r
    a(j1) = wk1r * x0r - wk1i * x0i
    a(j1 + 1) = wk1r * x0i + wk1i * x0r
    x0r = x1r + x3i
    x0i = x1i - x3r
    a(j3) = wk3r * x0r - wk3i * x0i
    a(j3 + 1) = wk3r * x0i + wk3i * x0r
  end do
end do
end
!
subroutine rftfsub(n, a, nc, c)
integer n, nc, j, k, kk, ks, m
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), c(0 : nc - 1), wkr, wki, xr, xi, yr, yi
m = n / 2
ks = 2 * nc / m
kk = 0
do j = 2, m - 2, 2
  k = n - j
  kk = kk + ks
  wkr = 0.5d0 - c(nc - kk)
  wki = c(kk)
  xr = a(j) - a(k)
  xi = a(j + 1) + a(k + 1)
  yr = wkr * xr - wki * xi
  yi = wkr * xi + wki * xr
  a(j) = a(j) - yr
  a(j + 1) = a(j + 1) - yi
  a(k) = a(k) + yr
  a(k + 1) = a(k + 1) - yi
end do
end
!
subroutine rftbsub(n, a, nc, c)
integer n, nc, j, k, kk, ks, m
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), c(0 : nc - 1), wkr, wki, xr, xi, yr, yi
a(1) = -a(1)
m = n / 2
ks = 2 * nc / m
kk = 0
do j = 2, m - 2, 2
  k = n - j
  kk = kk + ks
  wkr = 0.5d0 - c(nc - kk)
  wki = c(kk)
  xr = a(j) - a(k)
  xi = a(j + 1) + a(k + 1)
  yr = wkr * xr + wki * xi
  yi = wkr * xi - wki * xr
  a(j) = a(j) - yr
  a(j + 1) = yi - a(j + 1)
  a(k) = a(k) + yr
  a(k + 1) = yi - a(k + 1)
end do
a(m + 1) = -a(m + 1)
end
!
subroutine dctsub(n, a, nc, c)
integer n, nc, j, k, kk, ks, m
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), c(0 : nc - 1), wkr, wki, xr
m = n / 2
ks = nc / n
kk = 0
do j = 1, m - 1
  k = n - j
  kk = kk + ks
  wkr = c(kk) - c(nc - kk)
  wki = c(kk) + c(nc - kk)
  xr = wki * a(j) - wkr * a(k)
  a(j) = wkr * a(j) + wki * a(k)
  a(k) = xr
end do
a(m) = c(0) * a(m)
end
!
subroutine dstsub(n, a, nc, c)
integer n, nc, j, k, kk, ks, m
real*8 a(0 : n - 1), c(0 : nc - 1), wkr, wki, xr
m = n / 2
ks = nc / n
kk = 0
do j = 1, m - 1
  k = n - j
  kk = kk + ks
  wkr = c(kk) - c(nc - kk)
  wki = c(kk) + c(nc - kk)
  xr = wki * a(k) - wkr * a(j)
  a(k) = wkr * a(k) + wki * a(j)
  a(j) = xr
end do
a(m) = c(0) * a(m)
end

BEGIN_BASIC_TEXT
Examples of usrtally.f and [t-userdefined]
[t-userdefined] is very useful when you would like to deduce physical quantities that cannot be directly calculated by the implemented tallies of PHITS. It also enables users to output the particle transport information in the format of other codes such as ROOT. In order to use "usrtally.f", users must revise it and re-compile PHITS by themselves, but it is very difficult to revise the program without the detailed knowledge of the PHITS source code. Thus, we provide examples of "usrtally.f" that work similar to several tallies such as [t-deposit], [t-cross], [t-product] and [t-interact].
The procedure for using these examples are as follows:
copy "usrtally.f" in the zip file to that in "src" folder, and recompile PHITS.
execute the re-compiled PHITS using "usrtally.inp" in each folder, and check the equivalence between the last value written in "userdefined.out" and the result of each tally.
revise "usrtally.f" and "usrtally.inp" for your own purpose
Details of each "usrtally.f" are written in readme-en.docx in each folder. If you have any request to develop other examples of "usrtally.f", please let us know.
Important notice!
usrtally.f developed before PHITS version 3.22 may not be compatible with the later version because of the change of memory usage in PHITS. In that case, you have to revise your usrtally.f as follows:
1.Delete (or comment out) the definitions below:
common /ipomp0/ipomp,npomp
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/ipomp0/)
2.Change the definition of common/randtp/ as below:
integer*8 :: iransb64 ! S.H. xorshift (2020.2.6)
common /randtp/ rijk,rans,ranb, iransb64
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/randtp/)
3.Replace (no) by (no,ipomp+1), e.g.
e(no) -> e(no,ipomp+1)
xc(no) -> xc(no,ipomp+1)
Notes on Using OpenMP
When performing parallel computation with OpenMP options, make sure to carefully check whether any newly added variables in usrtally.f should be declared as THREADPRIVATE (or as PRIVATE/SHARED/REDUCTION, etc.). The subroutine usrtally is called from analyz.f, but immediately before the call, an !$OMP CRITICAL section is placed to ensure that multiple threads do not execute the contents of usrtally simultaneously. If higher parallel performance is required, you may remove the CRITICAL section around the call site and instead implement proper thread-safety measures inside usrtally.f itself (e.g., by specifying variable attributes, using REDUCTION, or applying minimal CRITICAL/ATOMIC/LOCK constructs where needed). Be sure to confirm that no data races or order dependencies occur when removing the CRITICAL section.
END_BASIC_TEXT

FILE: readme-jp.docx
BEGIN_BASIC_TEXT
ユーザー定義タリー[t-userdefined]の使い方に関する例題
ユーザー定義タリー[t-userdefined]は、通常のタリーでは得ることができない様々な物理量をタリーする機能です。ユーザー定義タリーを使うためには,各ユーザーが,自分の目的に合わせてusrtally.fファイルを変更し,PHITSを再コンパイルする必要があります。ただし,その変更には,FORTRANとPHITSの変数に関する知識が必要なため,ユーザーが自力で行うことは極めて困難でした。そこで,いくつかのタリーと似たような機能を持ち,かつそれに関連するイベント情報を全て書き出すusrtally.fの例題を作りましたので,ぜひご活用下さい。
使い方の手順は以下の通りです。
各フォルダのusrtally.fをsrcフォルダにあるusrtally.fと入れ替えて再コンパイル
各フォルダのusrtally.inpを再コンパイルしたPHITSで実行し,userdefined.outの最後に出力された値とサンプルタリー結果が一致することを確認する(サンプルタリーがある場合)
usrtally.fやusrtally.inpを自分の目的に合わせて変更する。
詳細は,各フォルダのreadme-jp.docxをご参照下さい。また,これら以外にも作ってほしい例題がありましたら,PHITS事務局までご連絡下さい。
注意点!
PHITS 3.22以降、メモリの使用方法が変更になったため、過去に作ったusrtally.fが動作しない可能性があります。その際は、以下の手順に従ってプログラムを修正してください。
1.以下の定義文を削除
common /ipomp0/ipomp,npomp
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/ipomp0/)
2.commonブロック randtpを使っている場合は、以下のように変更。
integer*8 :: iransb64 ! S.H. xorshift (2020.2.6)
common /randtp/ rijk,rans,ranb, iransb64
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/randtp/)
3.引数(no)を(no,ipomp+1)に置換。以下、その例を示す。
e(no) -> e(no,ipomp+1)
xc(no) -> xc(no,ipomp+1)
OpenMP使用時の注意!
OpenMP のオプションで並列計算を行う場合は、usrtally.f を修正する際に、追加した変数を THREADPRIVATE にすべきか(あるいは PRIVATE/SHARED/REDUCTION などの属性にすべきか)を十分に確認してください。サブルーチンusrtallyはanalyz.fから呼び出されますが、その直前に !$OMP CRITICAL 区間を設けており、複数のスレッドが同時に usrtally 内の処理を実行しないようにしています。より高い並列性能が必要な場合は、呼び出し側の CRITICAL 区間を外し、代わりに usrtally.f 内で適切にスレッド安全化(例:変数属性の明示、REDUCTION の利用、必要最小限の CRITICAL/ATOMIC/LOCK の使用)を施してください。CRITICAL を外す場合は、データ競合や順序依存が生じないことを必ず確認してください。
END_BASIC_TEXT

FILE: ChemCode/ChemCode.bat
BEGIN_FILE
@echo off
REM ***********************************************************************************
REM Chemical simulation system in the PHITS code (PHITS-Chem code) (version 1.00)
REM ***********************************************************************************

REM: Usage: ChemCode.bat %1 %2
REM: %1: phits input file name (D = "phits.inp")
REM: %2: phits input file name (D = "chemmode.f90")

REM *********************************************************************************

    echo Chemical estimation system in PHITS started

    set TMP_TIME=%time: =0%
    rem executable batch file
    set phits_bat="c:\phits\bin\phits.bat"
    set FLAG=-fbounds-check -O3 -Wuninitialized -ffpe-trap=invalid,zero,overflow -fbacktrace -g
    set aname=ChemCode
    set bname=ChemCode_fopenmp
    set input1=%1
	set input2=%2

REM === Delete *,mod and *,exe ==============
    if exist *.mod (
        del *.mod
    )
    )
	if exist *.exe (
        del *.exe
    )
	if exist *.out (
        del *.out
    )
	if exist *.eps (
        del *.eps
    )
REM === OpenMP ==============================
REM    set /P OMPNUM=" How many CPU do you want to use for chemical simulation?:  "
REM    set j=%OMPNUM%
    set j=1
	set OMP_NUM_THREADS=%j%
	set h=2

REM === Compile using gfortran ==============
    if %OMP_NUM_THREADS% geq %h% (
    gfortran -fopenmp %input2% -o %bname% %FLAG%
	rem echo OpenMP
	)
	if %OMP_NUM_THREADS% lss %h% (
    gfortran  %input2% -o %aname% %FLAG%
	rem echo Single
	)
    if %ERRORLEVEL% NEQ 0 goto FAILURE
REM    echo There is no complied file, so complied

REM === Success =============================
    :SUCCESS
    echo "compile success"

REM	)

REM === Main calculation ====================

    set /P NUM=" How many times do you loop?:  "
    set i=%NUM%

    for /l %%n in (1,1,%i%) do (
	echo:
	if exist *.d (
        del *.d
    )
    echo loop number: %%n
    echo ------------------------------------------------------------
    echo  PHITS track-structure calculation
    echo ------------------------------------------------------------
    call %phits_bat% %input1%

    echo:
    echo ------------------------------------------------------------
    echo  Chemical simulation
    echo ------------------------------------------------------------

    if %OMP_NUM_THREADS% geq %h% (
    %bname%
	)
	if %OMP_NUM_THREADS% lss %h% (
    %aname%
	)

	)
    echo:

REM === Make Directry ===
    set dirname=output_%DATE:/=%_%TMP_TIME:~0,2%%TMP_TIME:~3,2%
    if not exist %dirname% (
    mkdir %dirname%
    )

    del log.out
    del *temp.out
    del *.d
    del *.exe

REM === Move output data(*.csv) =============
	if exist *.out (
    	copy /-Y *.out %dirname%\
    	del *.out
    )
    if exist *.eps (
    	copy /-Y *.eps %dirname%\
    	del *.eps
    )

    if exist *.csv (
        copy /-Y *.csv %dirname%\
        del *.csv
    )

REM === Delete *.mod and *.exe ==============
    if exist *.mod (
        del *.mod
    )
    echo calculation finished
    goto END

REM === Failure ============================
    :FAILURE
    echo compile error stopped
    :END

REM *********************************************************************************
END_FILE

FILE: ChemCode/ChemCode.sh
BEGIN_FILE
#!/bin/sh
# ***********************************************************************************
# Chemical simulation system in the PHITS code (PHITS-Chem code) (version 1.00)
# ***********************************************************************************

#: Usage: ChemCode.bat %1 %2
#: %1: phits input file name (D = "phits.inp")
#: %2: phits input file name (D = "chemmode.f90")

# ***********************************************************************************

echo " Chemical estimation system in PHITS started"

# executable batch file
phits_sh=${PHITSPATH}/bin/phits.sh
phitsinput=$1
tsmodeinput=$2

# === Delete *.mod and *.exe ==============

FILE=*.mod
if [ -e $FILE ]; then
   rm *.mod
fi
FILE=*.d
if [ -e $FILE ]; then
  rm *.d
fi
FILE=*.out
if [ -e $FILE ]; then
  rm *.out
fi

# === OpenMP ==============================

#read -p " How many CPU do you want to use for chemical simulation?:  " OMP_NUM
OMP_NUM=1
OMP_NUM_THREADS="$OMP_NUM"

# === Compile using gfortran ==============

num1=2
if [ $OMP_NUM -ge $num1 ]; then
#echo "OpenMP used"
gfortran -fopenmp $2
#-o chemcode_fopenmp.exe
fi
if [ $OMP_NUM -lt $num1 ]; then
gfortran $2
#-o chemcode.exe
#echo "single used"
fi

FILE=a.out
if [ ! -e $FILE ]; then
   echo "compile error stopped"
elif [ -e $FILE ]; then
#   echo " There is no complied file, so complied"

# === Main calculation ====================
declare -i COUNTER
declare -i MONITOR
read -p " How many times do you loop?:  " NUM
COUNTER=0
MONITOR=1
while [ "$COUNTER" -lt "$NUM" ]; do
echo ""
FILE=*.d
if [ -e $FILE ]; then
  rm *.d
fi
echo " loop number: ${MONITOR}"
echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
echo " PHITS track-structure calculation"
echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
$phits_sh ${phitsinput}
echo ""
echo "------------------------------------------------------------"
echo " Chemical simulation"
echo "------------------------------------------------------------"

if [ $OMP_NUM -ge $num1 ]; then
#./chemcode_fopenmp.exe
./a.out
fi
if [ $OMP_NUM -lt $num1 ]; then
#./chemcode.exe
./a.out
fi

COUNTER=COUNTER+1
MONITOR=MONITOR+1
done

# === Make Directory and Copy==============

name=output_`date "+%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"`
mkdir ${name}

rm a.out
rm *temp.out
rm log.out

cp -r *.out ${name}
cp -r *.eps ${name}
#cp -r *.csv ${name}

# === Delete *,mod and *,exe ==============
rm *.d
rm *.mod
rm *.out
rm *.eps
#rm *.csv
echo
echo " calculation finished"

fi
# ** END ***************************************************************************
END_FILE

FILE: ChemCode/chemmode.f90
BEGIN_FILE
!////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
!
!  Chemical code for simulating radical production and diffusion
!
!  Purpose: To simulate chemical processes
!  Note: Please input the primary & secondary info. into "data.d (IntAct: 10-15)
!
!////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
!
! Models: Step1, Read the "event.d" obtained by the PHITS calculation ver.3.33~
!         Step2, Count the number of interactions and summarize the track info.
!         Step3, Calculate the kinetics of radicals produced along track
!
!////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    include'mod/modrandom.f90'
    include'mod/modPhysicoChem.f90'
    include'mod/modChemical.f90'
    include'mod/modhead.f90'

   program main
      use mtmod
      use modWLTPhysicoChem
      use modWLTChemical
      use modheader
      implicit none

      integer :: cas,bat,itype,kf,cell
      real(8) :: eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt,miene,miene2,sume
      integer :: ndata,ncas,nbat,nprl,nprl2,totprl
      integer :: cevent
      integer,allocatable :: ievent(:)
      integer :: cnt,cnt2,cnt3,cnt4,cnt5,cntp,cntpp,neve,moni,bchcnt
      real    :: t1,t2
      integer :: seed
      integer :: access,status
      character(16) :: f,linebuf

      real(8) :: KE,ckine,mckine,totene
      integer :: tID,PDG
      real(8),allocatable :: cpos(:,:),csube(:)
      integer,allocatable :: ctype(:)
      integer,allocatable :: phytyp(:)
      integer,allocatable :: regid(:) !240410 Matsuya
      integer :: nion,nexc,ndea,nvib,npho,nrot,natint,nmol

      integer :: nrd88(99,100),Otyp

      character(100) :: fn_CHEM(10)
      real(8) :: iot(13),ps(2),natty(4)

      integer :: nbin
      integer :: track4d,outRD !240410 Matsuya

!<<<<<<<<< User setting parameters >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

     ! [Seed for random number]
        seed = 4537       ! seed for random number
     ! [Tracking time]
        te = 1000000      ! (D=1000) tracking time [psec]
     ! [Model for chemical code]
        BRtyp = 1         ! 1:PHITS model; 2:User model;
        DCtyp = 1         ! 1:PHITS model; 2:User model;
        RRtyp = 1         ! 1:PHITS model; 2:User model;
     ! [Model for radical scavenger]
        slov  =  0        ! 0:off; 1:SBS; 2:lifetime
        styp  = 14        ! 14:Tris; 15:DMSO;
        ScCap = 1.0d8     ! Scavenging Capacity: < 1.0d10 [s-1]
     ! [animation]
        track4d = 0       ! 0: animation off; 1: animation on
        outRD = 2         ! 1(default): OH,eaq,H2,H2O2  2: all radicals
     ! [nbin]
        nbin = 20         ! Number of segments in space partitioning
     ! [Monitor]
        moni = 1          ! Number of particles users want to monitor in concole

!<<<<<<<<< END user setting >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

       if(te.gt.100000.or.slov.gt.0.and.ScCap.ge.1.0d8)then
       print '(1x,A)',&
       'WARMING :  this setting requires very long calculation time'
       end if

      !---Cell Chemical database-----------------------------
         fn_CHEM(1) = "mod/DiffusionCoefficients.csv"
         fn_CHEM(2) = "mod/ReactionRadius.csv"
         fn_CHEM(3) = "mod/BranchingRatio.csv"

      !---Open file------------------------------------------
          open(100,file='event.d',status='old')
          f = 'log.out'
          status = access(f, ' ')
          if( status .ne. 0 )then
          open(120,file='log.out')
          open(110,file='phits_tsmode.out')
          open(150,file='tsmode_temp.out')
          open(160,file='yield_temp.out')
          open(210,file='chem_dyna.out')
          open(250,file='chem_temp.out')
          call inichem(seed,te,BRtyp,DCtyp,RRtyp,slov,styp,ScCap)
          call iniPhysicoChem(Otyp,fn_CHEM)
          call iniChemical(Otyp,fn_CHEM,styp)!231227yy add styp
          call inichem2
          bchcnt = 1
          nprl = 0
          miene = 0.000d0
          write(120,*) bchcnt
          write(120,*) nprl
          write(120,'(ES12.3)') miene
          write(120,*)'>>>> Loop; particle; sum of deposited energy'
          close(120)
          write(160,'(14ES10.3)') 0.d0,0.d0,0.d0,0.d0,0.d0,0.d0,0.d0,0.d0 &
                ,0.d0,0.d0,0.d0,0.d0,0.d0,0.d0
          end if
          if( status .eq. 0 )then
          open(150,file='tsmode_temp.out',status='old')
          open(110,file='phits_tsmode.out',status='old')
          call inichem(seed,te,BRtyp,DCtyp,RRtyp,slov,styp,ScCap)
          call iniPhysicoChem(Otyp,fn_CHEM)
          call iniChemical(Otyp,fn_CHEM,styp)
          call inichem2
          do
          ! ** if you want to change output data, please modify below ******
              read(150,*,end=3500) ckine,KE,iot(1),iot(2),iot(3),iot(4)
              write(110,'(ES11.3,5ES12.3)') ckine,KE,iot(1),iot(2),iot(3),iot(4)
          ! ****************************************************************
          end do
          3500 continue
          close(110)
          close(150)
          open(120,file='log.out',status='old')
          read(120,*) cnt
          read(120,*) cnt2
          read(120,*) eold
          bchcnt = cnt + 1
          nprl2 = cnt2
          miene = eold
          ! total energy deposition
          totene = miene * 1.0d6     ! MeV -> eV
          close(120)
          open(120,file='log.out',status='replace')
          write(120,*) bchcnt
          write(120,*) nprl2
          write(120,'(ES12.3)') miene
          write(120,*)'>>>> Loop; particle; mean in-energy'
          close(120)
          open(110,file='phits_tsmode.out',status='old',position='append')
          open(150,file='tsmode_temp.out',status='old',position='append')
          open(160,file='yield_temp.out',status='old')
          end if
          ! bchcnt = 1: new calculation, bchcnt > 1: restart

      !---Scavenger mode--------------------------------
          fg_solvent = slov            ! 0:off 1:SBS, 2:life-span
          molar = ScCap/k              ! scavenger density [M: mol/dm3]
          h2length = 50.0d0            ! (D=50.0d0)[nm]
          h2Volume = h2length**3       ! [nm3]
          !molar -> h2num
          h2num = int(h2length*h2length*h2length*0.602*molar)    !

      !---Initialization of counter--------------------------
         cnt   = 0          ! counter #1
         cnt2  = 0          ! counter #2
         cnt3  = 0          ! counter #3
         ndata = 0          ! all interactions per track
         natint= 0          ! ion and e-exc per track
         nprl  = 0
         Otyp  = 0          ! 13: check for developer
      !------------------------------------------------------
         call TRACE(nbat,ncas,ndata,nprl)
         allocate(ievent(nprl))
         call EVENT(nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent)
         call sgrnd(seed)
         cnt5=0    ! counter #5
      !------------------------------------------------------

         call cpu_time(t1)

!<<<< Please modify the below description if you want >>>>
!<<<<<<<<< Main loop for analysing track >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
      do cnt=1,nbat           ! analysis for each bat
      do cnt2=1,ncas          ! analysis for each cas
         cnt3 = cnt3 + 1

		 if(track4d==1)then   ! for 4dtrack_chem
	        open(350,file='4dtrack_chem_temp.out') ! 2024-04-11 Matsuya
         end if

         if(mod(cnt3,moni)==0)then
             print '(1x,A,i8,1x,A,1x,i8,1x,A)',&
                   '  track[ ',cnt3,'/',nprl,' ]'
         end if
         cevent=ievent(cnt3)  ! number of event (bat=cnt, cas=cnt2)
         if(cevent.gt.0)then
             cnt5 = cnt5 + 1
         else
             cycle
         endif

         allocate(cpos(3,cevent))
         allocate(csube(cevent))
         allocate(ctype(cevent))
         allocate(phytyp(cevent))
         allocate(regid(cevent))  !240410 Matsuya
         phytyp=0
         !allocate((cevent))

         call prePhysicoChem(Otyp)
         call preChemical(Otyp)

     !<---- Call analytical subroutine ------------------------------------------

         call PRED(cevent,cpos,ctype,csube,ckine,KE,PDG,phytyp,regid)

         !if(PDG.gt.11)then
         !   print*, 'WARMING :  this code was varidated only for electron'
         !end if
         if(mod(cnt3,moni)==0)then
             if(PDG==11)then
                print '(5x,A,es12.3,1x,A)',&
                '  incident energy =',ckine/1.0d6,'MeV electron'
             end if
             if(PDG==2212)then
                print '(5x,A,es12.3,1x,A)',&
                '  incident energy =',ckine/1.0d6,'MeV proton'
                !print*, 'WARMING :  charge exchanging is not considered'
             end if
             if(PDG==1000002)then
                print '(5x,A,es12.3,1x,A)',&
                '  incident energy =',ckine/1.0d6,'MeV deuteron'
                !print*, 'WARMING :  charge exchanging is not considered'
             end if
             if(PDG.gt.1000002)then
                print '(5x,A,es12.3,1x,A)',&
                '  incident energy =',ckine/1.0d6,'MeV heavy ions'
                !print*, 'WARMING :  charge exchanging is not considered'
             end if
             !if(PDG>2000004)then
             !   print '(5x,A,es12.3,1x,A)',&
             !   '  incident energy =',ckine/1.0d6,'MeV heavy ion'
             !   !print*, 'WARMING :  charge exchanging is not considered'
             !end if
                print '(5x,A,es12.3,1x,A)',&
                '  deposited energy =',KE/ckine*100.0d0,'  %'
         end if
         totene = totene + KE
         if(cevent.gt.0)then
         call PhysicoChem(Otyp,ckine,bchcnt,cnt,cnt2,cnt3,cevent,cpos,phytyp,csube,regid,KE)
         deallocate(cpos,csube,ctype,phytyp)
         call Add_solvent(styp)
         call Chemical(cnt3,nrd88,KE,totene,te,cnt3,seed,DCtyp,RRtyp,nbin,track4d,natty,outRD)
         call output1(bchcnt,cnt,cnt2,ckine,KE,natty)
         call PhysicoChemDataClear
         endif
     !---------------------------------------------------------------------------

         if(cevent.gt.0)then
         if(mod(cnt3,moni)==0)then
         call cpu_time(t2)
         print '(7x,A,1x,es10.3,3x,A)', '>>> cpu time:',t2-t1,'sec'
         call cpu_time(t1)
         end if
         endif

		 if(track4d==1)then            ! for 4dtrack_chem
            call sort_4dtrack(cnt3,nprl2)
	        close(350,status="delete") ! 2024-04-11 Matsuya
         end if

     end do
     end do
     call meanpartene(nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent,totprl,sume)
     call endchem(PDG,te)

     deallocate(ievent)

!<<<<<<<<< END main loop for analysing track >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

!=== Note of parameters =========================================================
! cevent : number of interactions per track
! ctype  : event ID (10: ion, 11: e-exc, 12:dea, 13: vib, 14: phonon,)
! cpos   : interaction position (x,y,z) (nm)
! csub   : deposited energy (eV)
! KE     : incident particle energy
!================================================================================

!<<<<<<<<< Update log file >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

      open(120,file='log.out',status='old')
      read(120,*) cnt
      read(120,*) cnt2
      read(120,'(ES12.3)') eold
      bchcnt = cnt
      nprl2 = cnt2 + totprl
      miene = totene / 1.0d6   ! eV -> MeV
      close(120)
      open(120,file='log.out',status='replace')
      write(120,*) bchcnt
      write(120,*) nprl2
      write(120,'(ES12.3)') miene
      write(120,*)'>>>> Loop; particle; mean in-energy'
      close(120)

!<<<<<<<<< END Update log file >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

      print*, ">>> chemical simulation completed"

      close(100)
      close(110)
      close(160)
      close(350)

   end program main

! <<<The below algorithms for reading output data by the PHITS calculation >>>
!================================================================================
!    CHECK OUTPUT DATA BY PHITS (nbat,ncas,ndata,nprl)
!================================================================================

!***************************************************************
   subroutine TRACE(nbat,ncas,ndata,nprl)
!   for detecting the particle number and event per particle
!   output  ncas,nbat,nprl,ndata
!***************************************************************

      integer:: cas,bat,itype,kf,cell
      real(8):: eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
      real(8):: sexc,sold,snew,sx,sy,sz
      integer:: cnt,cnt2,cnt3
      integer,intent(out):: ncas,nbat,nprl,ndata

      ndata=0
      ncas=0
      nbat=0

      print *, ">>> Reading the physical data...."

      do
         ndata=ndata+1
         read (100,*,end=1000) cas,bat,itype,kf,cell,eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
         sexc=eexc*1.d6
         sold=eold*1.d6
         snew=enew*1.d6
         sx=x*1.d7
         sy=y*1.d7
         sz=z*1.d7
         ncas=cas                           ! maxcas in the PHITS calculation
         nbat=bat                           ! batch in the PHITS calculation
         nprl=ncas*nbat                     ! Number of total particles
      end do

   1000 continue
      print '(1x,A,i7)', ">>> total incident particle = ",nprl
      rewind(100)

   end subroutine

!***************************************************************
   subroutine EVENT(nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent)
!   for obtaining the number of event per track
!   input   nprl,ncas,nbat
!   output  ievent(nprl)
!***************************************************************

      integer:: cas,bat,itype,kf,cell
      real(8):: eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
      integer:: cnt,cnt2,cnt3
      integer,intent(in):: nprl,ncas,nbat
      integer:: nevent(nbat,ncas)
      integer,intent(out):: ievent(nprl)

      nevent=0

      do
         read (100,*,end=998) cas,bat,itype,kf,cell,eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
         nevent(bat,cas)=nevent(bat,cas)+1  ! Record the number of event per track
      end do

   998 continue
      rewind(100)

      cnt3=0

      if(nbat<1.or.ncas<1)stop 'nbat<1.or.ncas<1'
      do cnt=1,nbat
         do cnt2=1,ncas
            cnt3 = cnt3+1
            ievent(cnt3) = nevent(cnt,cnt2) ! Record the number of event per track
         end do
      end do

   end subroutine

!***************************************************************
   subroutine meanpartene(nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent,totprl,sume)
!   for calculating mean kinetic energy of charged particle
!   input   nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent(nprl)
!   output  totprl, sume
!***************************************************************

      integer,intent(in):: nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent(nprl)
      integer,intent(out):: totprl
      real(8),intent(out):: sume
      integer:: cnt,cnt2,cnt3,cnt4,cnt5,cas,bat,itype,kf,cell
      real(8):: eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt,KE

      sume=0.d0
      cnt4=0
      cnt5=0
      totprl=0

      rewind(100)
      do cnt=1,nbat       ! number of batch
      do cnt2=1,ncas      ! number of cas
         cnt4=cnt4+1
         if(ievent(cnt4)>0)then
         cnt5=cnt5+1      ! counter for analyzed particle
         do cnt3=1,ievent(cnt4)
            read (100,*,end=996) cas,bat,itype,kf,cell,eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
            if(cnt3==1)then
               KE=eold
               sume=sume+KE
            end if
         end do
         end if
      end do
      end do

   996 continue
      rewind(100)
      totprl = cnt5
      sume = sume! * dble(totprl)

   end subroutine

!================================================================================
!    PARTIAL READ OF PHITS DATA ccas,cbat,ncas,tID,cpos,ctype,csube,KE)
!================================================================================

!***************************************************************
   subroutine PRED(cevent,cpos,ctype,csube,ckine,KE,PDG,cphytyp,regid)
!   for obtaining the event information (coordinate,energy) per particle
!   input   cevent
!   output  cpos,csube,KE,ckine,ctype(cevent),PDG,cphytyp,regid
!***************************************************************

      integer:: cas,bat,itype,kf,cell,cnt4,lcnt
      real(8):: eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt

      integer,intent(in):: cevent
      real(8),intent(out):: cpos(3,cevent),csube(cevent),KE,ckine
      integer,intent(out):: ctype(cevent),PDG
      integer:: nion,nexc,ndea,nmol

      integer,intent(out):: cphytyp(cevent) ! ID for chemical code
      integer,intent(out):: regid(cevent)   ! 4dtrack

      integer:: bcevent
      integer:: nvib,npho,nrot
      real(8):: dvib,dpho,drot,dion,dexc,ddea

      !*** initialization *************************************
      cnt4=0
      nion=0        ! ionization (number)
      nexc=0        ! electronic excitaion (number)
      ndea=0        ! desociative electron attachment (number)
      nvib=0        ! vibrational excitaion (number)
      npho=0        ! phonon excitaion (number)
      nrot=0        ! rotational excitaion (number)
      nmol=0        ! molecular excitaion (number)
      dion=0.d0     ! ionization (energy)
      dexc=0.d0     ! electronic excitaion (energy)
      ddea=0.d0     ! desociative electron attachment (energy)
      dvib=0.d0     ! vibrational excitaion (energy)
      dpho=0.d0     ! phonon excitaion (energy)
      drot=0.d0     ! rotational excitaion (energy)
      sumE=0.d0
      KE=0.d0       ! energy deposited in cell ts-activated
      ckine=0.d0    ! incident particle energy
      PDG=0
      enew_min=100.0d0!
      !********************************************************
      bat0=0
      cphytyp=0
      if(cevent>0)then
         do cnt4=1,cevent
            read (100,*,end=2000) cas,bat,itype,kf,cell,eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
            cpos(1,cnt4) = x*1.0d7       ! cm -> nm
            cpos(2,cnt4) = y*1.0d7       ! cm -> nm
            cpos(3,cnt4) = z*1.0d7       ! cm -> nm
            ctype(cnt4)  = itype         ! 10:ion 11:exc 12:att 13-15:xxx exc
            csube(cnt4)  = eexc*1.0d6    ! MeV -> eV
            regid(cnt4)  = cell          ! region ID (cell ID in the PHITS code)  !240410 Matsuya
            KE = KE + abs(csube(cnt4))   ! calculation of deposited energy target reg
            if(wgt.lt.1.0)then
               KE = KE + enew * 1.0d6
            end if
            if(cnt4==1)then              ! detection of kf-code
               if(PDG<kf)then
                 PDG = kf
               end if
            end if
            if(itype.ne.0)then
               if(eold>ckine)then
                  ckine = eold * 1.0d6
               end if
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4)==10.or.ctype(cnt4)==17.or.ctype(cnt4)==22)then
               nion=nion+1          ! counter of ionization
               dion=dion+csube(cnt4)
                             cphytyp(cnt4)=21     ! for chemical code
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4)==11)then
               nexc=nexc+1          ! counter of electronic excitaion
               dexc=dexc+csube(cnt4)
               if(csube(cnt4)<=8.5d0)then           ! A1B1
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=4
               else if(csube(cnt4)<=10.1d0)then     ! B1A1
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=5
               else if(csube(cnt4)<=10.9d0)then     ! 1b1ionization
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=21
               else if(csube(cnt4)<=11.26d0)then    ! Rydberg(A+B)excitation
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=6
               else if(csube(cnt4)<=11.93d0)then    ! Rydberg(C+D)excitation
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=6
               else if(csube(cnt4)<=13.5d0)then     ! 3a1ionization
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=21
               else if(csube(cnt4)<=14.1d0)then     ! Diffuse band excitation
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=7
               else if(csube(cnt4)<=17.0d0)then     ! 1b2ionization
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=21
               else if(csube(cnt4)<=21.4d0)then     ! Cllective excitation
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=21
               else if(csube(cnt4)<=26.3d0)then     ! 2a1ionization
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=21
               else if(csube(cnt4)<=53.0d0)then     ! 1a1ionization
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=21
               else
                  cphytyp(cnt4)=-1
               end if
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4)==12)then      ! counter of desociative electron attachment
               ndea=ndea+1
               ddea=ddea+csube(cnt4)
               cphytyp(cnt4)=31          ! for chemical code
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4)==13)then      ! counter of vibrational excitation
               nvib=nvib+1
               dvib=dvib+csube(cnt4)
               cphytyp(cnt4)=0           ! for chemical code
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4)==14)then      ! counter of photon excitation
               npho=npho+1
               dpho=dpho+csube(cnt4)
               cphytyp(cnt4)=0           ! for chemical code
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4)==15)then      ! counter of rotational excitation
               nrot=nrot+1
               drot=drot+csube(cnt4)
               cphytyp(cnt4)=0           ! for chemical code
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4).ge.99)then    ! eaq-
               cphytyp(cnt4)=99          ! for chemical code
               neaq=neaq+1
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4)==18)then      ! excitation for KURBUC
               cphytyp(cnt4)=18
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4)==23)then      ! excitation for ITSART
               cphytyp(cnt4)=18
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4)==19.or.ctype(cnt4)==24)then      ! ele cap for ion
               cphytyp(cnt4)=19          ! for chemical code
            end if
            if(ctype(cnt4)==20.or.ctype(cnt4)==25)then      ! ele stp for ion
               cphytyp(cnt4)=20          ! for chemical code
            end if
         end do
      end if
   2000 continue

   end subroutine

!***************************************************************
   subroutine output1(i1,i2,i3,ckine,KE,natty)
!   input   pcnt: Particle ID handling in the PHITS-Chem code
!   format: readable for phig3d.exe
!***************************************************************

      integer,intent(in):: i1,i2,i3
      real(8),intent(in):: ckine,KE,natty(4)

      write(150,'(ES11.3,5ES12.3)')ckine,KE,natty(1),natty(2),natty(3),natty(4)
      write(110,'(ES11.3,5ES12.3)')ckine,KE,natty(1),natty(2),natty(3),natty(4)

   end subroutine

!***************************************************************
   subroutine sort_4dtrack(pcnt,nprl2)
!   input   pcnt: Particle ID handling in the PHITS-Chem code
!           nprl2: Particle ID handling in the PHITS-Chem code
!   format: readable for phig3d.exe
!***************************************************************

      integer,intent(in):: pcnt,nprl2
      integer:: scnt,maxibf,icnt,jcnt,kcnt
      integer:: iso(10)
	  real(8):: rso(10)
      integer,allocatable:: iboxso(:,:,:)
	  real(8),allocatable:: rboxso(:,:,:)
	  real(8):: currtcnt
	  integer:: ctcnt,ictcnt
	  character(4)::rdname
	  character(18)::bfname
	  character(16) :: f
      character(4)::crdcode
	  !integer :: rdcode

      f = '4dtrack_chem.out'
      status = access(f, ' ')
      if( status .ne. 0 )then
         open(310,file='4dtrack_chem.out',status='new')
         write(310,'(A)') 'GSTA-FREE-TIME'
         write(310,'(A)') 'MEND'
         write(310,'(I0,I6)') 0,1
	  else
         open(310,file='4dtrack_chem.out',status='old')
		 do
		 read(310,*,end=4300)
		 end do
         4300 continue
		 backspace(310)
	     write(310,'(I0,I6)') 0,pcnt+nprl2
	  end if

      scnt = 0
	  maxibf = 0
	  ctcnt = 0
	  icnt = 0
	  jcnt = 0
	  kcnt = 0
	  currtcnt = 0
	  ictcnt = 0
	  rdcolor = 0
	  !rdcode = 0
      rewind(350)

	  do  ! number of data line
		!print*,scnt
        read(350,*,end=4400) iso(1),rso(1),rso(2),rso(3),iso(2) &
	                        ,iso(3),rso(4),rso(5)
	    scnt = scnt + 1
        if(iso(2).gt.maxibf)then
           maxibf = iso(2)
        end if
        if(rso(5).gt.currtcnt)then
           currtcnt = rso(5)
		   ctcnt = ctcnt + 1
        end if
      end do
      4400 continue
      rewind(350)

	  currtcnt = 0
	  allocate(iboxso(maxibf,ctcnt,3)) ! iso(1),iso(3)
	  allocate(rboxso(maxibf,ctcnt,4)) ! rso(1),rso(2),rso(3),rso(5)

      do jcnt = 1, scnt
        read(350,*,end=4500) iso(1),rso(1),rso(2),rso(3),iso(2) &
	                        ,iso(3),rso(4),rso(5)
        if(rso(5).gt.currtcnt)then
           currtcnt = rso(5)
		   ictcnt = ictcnt + 1
        end if
		iboxso(iso(2),ictcnt,1) = iso(1)
		iboxso(iso(2),ictcnt,2) = iso(2)
		iboxso(iso(2),ictcnt,3) = iso(3)
        rboxso(iso(2),ictcnt,1) = rso(1)
        rboxso(iso(2),ictcnt,2) = rso(2)
        rboxso(iso(2),ictcnt,3) = rso(3)
        rboxso(iso(2),ictcnt,4) = rso(5)
      end do
      4500 continue

	  do icnt = 1, maxibf
	    do jcnt = 1,ctcnt
		if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1).gt.0)then
		   !kcnt = kcnt + 1
		   if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==1)then
		      rdname = '  OH'
              !rdcode =   11
			  crdcode = 'rd01'
           end if
		   if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==2)then
		      rdname = ' eaq-'
			  !rdcode =  -11
              crdcode = 'rd02'
           end if
		   if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==5)then
		      rdname = '  H2'
			  !rdcode =   22
              crdcode = 'rd05'
           end if
		   if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==6)then
		      rdname = 'H2O2'
			  !rdcode =   13
              crdcode = 'rd06'
           end if
           if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==3)then
              rdname = '   H'
              crdcode = 'rd03'
           end if
           if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==4)then
              rdname = 'H3O+'
              crdcode = 'rd04'
           end if
           if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==7)then
              rdname = ' HO2'
              crdcode = 'rd07'
           end if
           if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==8)then
              rdname = '  O2'
              crdcode = 'rd08'
           end if
           if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==9)then
              rdname = ' OH-'
              crdcode = 'rd09'
           end if
           if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==10)then
              rdname = ' O2-'
              crdcode = 'rd10'
           end if
           if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==11)then
              rdname = 'HO2-'
              crdcode = 'rd11'
           end if
           if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==12)then
              rdname = '   O'
              crdcode = 'rd12'
           end if
           if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1)==13)then
              rdname = '  O-'
              crdcode = 'rd13'
           end if
           if(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,2).gt.0)then
              kcnt = kcnt + 1
           if(kcnt.eq.1)then
              bfname = 'buffer start point'
              if(rboxso(icnt,jcnt,4).gt.0.0d0)then
              write(310,'(A5,4es15.6,i6,2es15.6,A6,I7,2I5,I4,A19)') crdcode & !iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1) &
              ,rboxso(icnt,jcnt,1),rboxso(icnt,jcnt,2),rboxso(icnt,jcnt,3),real(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,2)) &
              ,iboxso(icnt,jcnt,3),1.0d0,rboxso(icnt,jcnt,4),rdname,icnt,14,18,iboxso(icnt,jcnt,3),bfname
              end if
	       else
		      bfname = 'write end point   '
              if(rboxso(icnt,jcnt,4).gt.0.0d0)then
              write(310,'(A5,4es15.6,i6,2es15.6,A6,I7,2I5,I4,A19,I3)') crdcode & !iboxso(icnt,jcnt,1) &
              ,rboxso(icnt,jcnt,1),rboxso(icnt,jcnt,2),rboxso(icnt,jcnt,3),real(iboxso(icnt,jcnt,2)) &
              ,iboxso(icnt,jcnt,3),1.0d0,rboxso(icnt,jcnt,4),rdname,icnt,14,18,iboxso(icnt,jcnt,3) &
              ,bfname,iboxso(icnt,jcnt,3)
              end if
           end if
           end if

		end if
        end do
		if(kcnt.gt.0)then
           write(310,'(I0)') -1
		   if(icnt.eq.maxibf)then
              write(310,'(I0,I3)') 9,-1
		   end if
		end if
		kcnt = 0
	  end do

	  close(310)

   end subroutine

!////END/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
END_FILE

BEGIN_FILE
Species,PHITS,User

H3O+,9.3,9.3
H2,5,5
H2O2,2.3,2.3
HO2,2,2
O2,2.4,2.4
OH-,5,5
O2-,2.1,2.1
HO2-,1.4,1.4
O,2,2
O-,2.8,2.8
tris,1,1
DMSO,1.1,1.1
H2O,0,0
END_FILE
