BEGIN_FILE
!///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
!
!  modChemical.f90        ver.1.000
!     developed by Y. Yoshii (Hokkaido University of Science)
!                & Y. Matsuya (Hokkaido University & JAEA)
!     last update: 2023/08/22
!
!///////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

    module modWLTChemical
        implicit none

        private
        public  :: iniChemical, endChemical
        public  :: preChemical, postChemical
        public  :: Chemical
        public  :: inichem3

        integer :: tcnt        ! step

        integer :: rdnum00,h2num00
        integer :: rdnum
        integer,allocatable :: rdtyp(:)
        real(8),allocatable :: rdpos(:,:)
        integer,allocatable :: rdgrp(:)
        integer,allocatable :: rdgen(:)
        integer,allocatable :: rdlifetime(:)
        integer,allocatable :: rdregid(:) ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
        integer,allocatable :: rdid(:)    ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
        integer :: mxcgrp
        integer :: mxrdid                 ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
        integer :: nrd(99)

        !"DiffusionCoefficients.csv"
        integer,public :: DCtyp
        integer :: nDC
        real(8) :: DiffusionCoef(99),ramda(99)
        character(4) ::chaDC(99)

        !"ReactionRadius.csv"
        integer,public :: RRtyp
        integer :: nRR
        real(8) :: ReactionRadiusA(99),ReactionRadiusA2(99)
        integer :: product(99),product2(99),product3(99)
        integer :: reaction(99,5)
        integer :: reactionB(0:99,0:99)
        real(8) :: posDD1(99),posDD2(99)
        character(4) ::chaRR(99,5)
        character(8) ::chaRRn(99)

        integer,public :: te

        !for solvent    #sol
        integer :: h2num
        integer,allocatable :: h2typ(:)
        real(8),allocatable :: h2pos(:,:)
        integer :: nh2(99)
        real(8) :: probws

        integer,public :: fg_solvent
        real(8),public :: k            ! 231229 Matsuya
        integer,public :: styp,slov    ! 231229 Matsuya
        real(8) :: wbin(3),slen(3),bmin(3),bmax(3)

        !bucket
        integer,allocatable :: bfst(:),blst(:),nxt(:)

        !4dtrack
        integer :: track4d_chem,track4d_outRD  ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya

    contains
        subroutine iniChemical(Otyp,fn,styp0)                !!fix231227yy
            integer,intent(in) :: Otyp
            character(100),intent(in) :: fn(10)
            integer,intent(in),optional :: styp0             !!fix231227yy
            integer :: cnt,cnt2,cnt3
            character(4)::bcha(10)
            real(8) :: breal(10)
            real(8) :: bDC(99,100)
            real(8) :: bRC(99,100)
            real(8) :: rearad(39)

            styp=styp0                    !!fix231227yy
            !read "DiffusionCoefficients.csv"
            !write(110,*)
            write(110,*) '[ Echo chemical parameters of radical diffusion]'
            !write(110,*)"modWLTChemical"

            open (10,file=fn(1),status='old')
            read(10,*)
            nDC=0
            breal=0.0d0
            do cnt=1,99
                read(10,*,end=100)bcha(1),breal(1),breal(2)
                if(breal(DCtyp)>0.0)then
                    nDC=nDC+1
                    chaDC(nDC)=bcha(1)
                    bDC(nDC,1:2)=breal(1:2)
                end if
            end do
100            close(10)
        !--
            !write(110,*)"DiffusionCoefficients.csv"
            write(110,'(1x,A,11x,I10,A)') ' DCtyp   =  ',DCtyp,'        # (D=1) 1:PHITS model; 2:User model'
            write(110,'(A)') ' _______________________________________________________________________________'
            write(110,*)
            DiffusionCoef=0.0d0
            do cnt=1,nDC
                DiffusionCoef(cnt)=bDC(cnt,DCtyp)
                ramda(cnt)=rmsd(DiffusionCoef(cnt))
                write(110,'(1x,A5,A5,ES12.3,7x,A)') chaDC(cnt),':   ',DiffusionCoef(cnt),'(x 10^-9 m^2 s^-1)'
            end do
            write(110,'(A)') ' _______________________________________________________________________________'
            write(110,*)

            !read "ReactionRadius.csv"
            chaRRn="no data"
            open (10,file=fn(2),status='old')
            read(10,*)
            nRR=0
            do cnt=1,99
                read(10,*,end=200)bcha(1),bcha(2),bcha(3),bcha(4),bcha(5),bcha(6),breal(1),breal(2)
                rearad(cnt) = breal(RRtyp)
                if(breal(RRtyp)>0.0d0)then
                    nRR=nRR+1
                    chaRR(nRR,1:5)=bcha(2:6)
                    bRC(nRR,1:2)=breal(1:2)
                    chaRRn(nRR)=chaRR(nRR,1)//chaRR(nRR,2)
                end if
            end do
200            close(10)
        !--
            reaction=0
            do cnt3=1,nRR
                do cnt2=1,5
                    do cnt=1,nDC
                        if(chaRR(cnt3,cnt2)==chaDC(cnt))reaction(cnt3,cnt2)=cnt
                    end do
                end do
            end do

            do cnt=1,nRR
                reactionB(reaction(cnt,1),reaction(cnt,2))=cnt
                reactionB(reaction(cnt,2),reaction(cnt,1))=cnt
            end do

            !write(110,*)"ReactionRadius.csv"
            !write(110,*)
            write(110,*) '[ Echo chemical parameters of reaction rate constants]'
            !write(110,*)"RRtyp:,",RRtyp
            write(110,'(1x,A,11x,I10,A)') ' RRtyp   =  ',RRtyp,'        # (D=1) 1:PHITS model; 2:User model'
            write(110,'(A)') ' _______________________________________________________________________________'
            write(110,*)
            do cnt=1,nRR
                if(reaction(cnt,1)==0.or.reaction(cnt,2)==0)then
                    ReactionRadiusA(cnt)=0.2564    !e-aq + H2O -> OH + OH-
                else
                    ReactionRadiusA(cnt)=bRC(cnt,RRtyp)*100/    &
                    (6.022*4.0*3.14159265359*(DiffusionCoef(reaction(cnt,1))+DiffusionCoef(reaction(cnt,2))))
                end if
                !print*,cnt,chaRR(cnt,1),chaRR(cnt,2),chaRR(cnt,3),chaRR(cnt,4),chaRR(cnt,5),ReactionRadiusA(cnt),bRC(cnt,RRtyp)
                !write(110,*)chaRR(cnt,1:5),',',ReactionRadiusA(cnt)
                !write(110,'(1x,6A5,E12.3)') chaRR(cnt,1),chaRR(cnt,2),chaRR(cnt,3),chaRR(cnt,4),&
                !                            chaRR(cnt,5),':',ReactionRadiusA(cnt)
            end do
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + OH   -> H2O2               :   ',rearad(1),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' eaq- + eaq- -> H2   + OH-   + OH- :   ',rearad(2),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H    + H    -> H2                 :   ',rearad(3),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + eaq- -> OH-                :   ',rearad(4),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + H    -> H2O                :   ',rearad(5),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H3O+ + OH-  -> H2O                :   ',rearad(6),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H    + H2O2 -> OH                 :   ',rearad(7),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' eaq- + H3O+ -> H                  :   ',rearad(8),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' eaq- + H    -> H2   + OH          :   ',rearad(9),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' eaq- + H2O2 -> OH-  + OH          :   ',rearad(10),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' eaq- + O2   -> O2-                :   ',rearad(11),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' eaq- + O2-  -> OH-  + HO2-        :   ',rearad(12),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' eaq- + HO2  -> HO2-               :   ',rearad(13),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H    + O    -> OH                 :   ',rearad(14),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H    + O2   -> HO2                :   ',rearad(15),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H    + O2-  -> HO2-               :   ',rearad(16),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H    + HO2  -> H2O2               :   ',rearad(17),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H3O+ + O2-  -> HO2                :   ',rearad(18),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' O    + O    -> O2                 :   ',rearad(19),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + O    -> HO2                :   ',rearad(20),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' O    + HO2  -> OH   + O2          :   ',rearad(21),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + O2-  -> O2   + OH-         :   ',rearad(22),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + HO2  -> O2                 :   ',rearad(23),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + OH-  -> O-                 :   ',rearad(24),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H    + OH-  -> eaq-               :   ',rearad(25),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + H2O2 -> HO2                :   ',rearad(26),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + O-   -> HO2-               :   ',rearad(27),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + HO2- -> HO2  + OH-         :   ',rearad(28),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' eaq- + HO2- -> OH-  + OH-   + H2  :   ',rearad(29),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' eaq- + O-   -> OH-  + OH-         :   ',rearad(30),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H    + O-   -> OH-                :   ',rearad(31),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H3O+ + O-   -> OH                 :   ',rearad(32),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' H3O+ + HO2- -> H2O2               :   ',rearad(33),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + tris -> Scavenged          :   ',rearad(34),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + DMSO -> Scavenged          :   ',rearad(35),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' OH   + H2   -> H                  :   ',rearad(36),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' eaq- + H2O  -> OH   + OH-         :   ',rearad(37),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' HO2  + HO2  -> H2O2 + O2          :   ',rearad(38),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(1x,A,ES12.3,A)') ' HO2  + O2   -> O2   + HO2         :   ',rearad(39),'    (10^10 dm^3 mol^-1 s^-1)'
            write(110,'(A)') ' _______________________________________________________________________________'
            write(110,*)

            ! 231229 Revised by Matsuya
            ! === determine the k value of OH radical scavenger ==============
                k = 0.0d0                    ! initialization
                if(styp==14)then
                   k = rearad(34)*1.0d10     ! tris+OH: read the reaction rate
                end if
                if(styp==15)then
                   k = rearad(35)*1.0d10     ! DMSO+OH: read the reaction rate
                end if
            ! ================================================================

            do cnt=1,nRR
                !print*,cnt,reaction(cnt,1),reaction(cnt,2),reaction(cnt,3),reaction(cnt,4),reaction(cnt,5)
                !ReactionRadiusA2(cnt)=ReactionRadiusA(cnt)*ReactionRadiusA(cnt)          ! Geant4-DNA model
                ReactionRadiusA2(cnt)=ReactionRadiusA(cnt)*ReactionRadiusA(cnt)*4.0d0    ! KURBUC model by Uehara et al (2007)
                ! The reaction takes place if the distance between the reactants is smaller then 2a.
            end do

            ! location of reaction sites (Bolch et al. (1988) ORNL_TM-10851)
            do cnt=1,nRR
                if(reaction(cnt,2).ne.0)then
                    posDD1(cnt)=constDD(DiffusionCoef(reaction(cnt,1)),DiffusionCoef(reaction(cnt,2)))
                    posDD2(cnt)=constDD(DiffusionCoef(reaction(cnt,2)),DiffusionCoef(reaction(cnt,1)))
                else
                    posDD1(cnt)=1.0d0
                    posDD2(cnt)=0.0d0
                end if
            end do
            !print*,Otyp   ! check for developer
            !OPEN(830,FILE='830_mod_chem_nevent_output.csv')
            !write(830,*)'psec,OH,eaq-,H,H3O+,H2,H2O2,HO2,O2,OH-,O2-,HO2-'
            !OPEN(831,FILE='831_mod_chem_rctevent_output.csv')
            !write(831,*)'psec,reactant1,reactant2,product1,product2,product3,Rctyp,grp(i),grp(j),gen(i),gen(j),i,j,posi,posj'
        end subroutine
        !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
        subroutine endChemical(Otyp)
            integer,intent(in) :: Otyp
            integer :: cnt

            if(mod(Otyp,10).ne.3)return
            !close(830)
            !close(831)
            if(Otyp.ne.13)return
            close(810)
        end subroutine

        subroutine preChemical(Otyp)
            integer,intent(in) :: Otyp
        end subroutine

        subroutine postChemical(Otyp)
            integer,intent(in) :: Otyp
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   Main algorithms of chemical processes
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine Chemical(bch,nrd88,cKE,totene,te,npart,seed,DCtyp,RRtyp,nbin,track4d,natty,outRD)
            use modWLTPhysicoChem
            use mtmod
            integer,intent(in)::bch,te,npart,seed,DCtyp,RRtyp,track4d,outRD ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            integer,intent(in),optional::nbin
            integer,intent(out)::nrd88(99,100)
            real(8),intent(in):: cKE,totene
            real(8),intent(out):: natty(4)
            integer :: cnt,cnt2,cnt3
            integer :: i,j,ibf,nloop,nprl2
            real(8) :: cpos(3),topt(100),iop(13),iop1
            real(8) :: totgvnrd88(13,100),tgk(0:13,100),monigv(2)

            integer :: nCRflg, CRflg(3,rdnum0*2)
            integer :: nCRflgh, CRflgh(3,rdnum0*2)
            integer :: n830=0,CDA=2

            integer :: Rctyp
            real(8) :: aeff,DC,cs,tt,fs,wt

            character(8) :: date
            character(10) :: time
            character(5) :: zone
            integer(4) :: values(8)

            track4d_chem = track4d
            track4d_outRD = outRD

            ! >>> read the previous condition and results >>>>>>>>>>>>>
            open(120,file='log.out',status='old')
            read(120,*) cnt
            nloop = cnt
            read(120,*) cnt2
            nprl2 = cnt2 + npart
            close(120)
            !Matsuya 2021-11-08
            !topt = 0.d0
            totgvnrd88 = 0.d0
            if(npart==1 .and. nloop==1)then
                open(210,file='chem_dyna.out')
                open(250,file='chem_temp.out')
                !call inichem3(te,seed,BRtyp,DCtyp,RRtyp)
                close(250)
            else
                open(210,file='chem_dyna.out',status='old')
                open(250,file='chem_temp.out',status='old')
                cnt = 0
                do
                cnt = cnt + 1
                read (250,*,end=4500) iop1,iop(1),iop(2) &
                    ,iop(3),iop(4),iop(5),iop(6),iop(7),iop(8),iop(9),iop(10),iop(11),iop(12),iop(13)
                topt(cnt) = iop1
                totgvnrd88(1,cnt) = iop(1)
                totgvnrd88(2,cnt) = iop(2)
                totgvnrd88(3,cnt) = iop(3)
                totgvnrd88(4,cnt) = iop(4)
                totgvnrd88(5,cnt) = iop(5)
                totgvnrd88(6,cnt) = iop(6)
                totgvnrd88(7,cnt) = iop(7)
                totgvnrd88(8,cnt) = iop(8)
                totgvnrd88(9,cnt) = iop(9)
                totgvnrd88(10,cnt) = iop(10)
                totgvnrd88(11,cnt) = iop(11)
                totgvnrd88(12,cnt) = iop(12)
                totgvnrd88(13,cnt) = iop(13)
                end do
                4500 continue
                close(250)
            endif

            n830=1
            !PhysicoChemical stage -> chemical stage
            rdnum00=rdnum0
            rdnum=rdnum0

            allocate(rdtyp(rdnum00*2))
            allocate(rdpos(3,rdnum00*2))
            allocate(rdgrp(rdnum00*2))
            allocate(rdgen(rdnum00*2))
            allocate(rdlifetime(rdnum00*2))
            allocate(rdregid(rdnum00*2))  ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            allocate(rdid(rdnum00*2))     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdtyp = rdtyp0
            rdgrp = rdgrp0
            rdgen = rdgen0
            rdpos = rdpos0
            nrd = nrd0
            rdregid = rdregid0   ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdid = rdid0         ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			mxrdid = mxrdid0     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            deallocate(rdtyp0,rdpos0,rdgrp0,rdgen0,rdregid0,rdid0)
                                 ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya

            if(fg_solvent==1)then    ! radical scavenger
                h2num00=h2num0
                h2num=h2num0
                allocate(h2typ(h2num00*2))
                allocate(h2pos(3,h2num00*2))
                h2typ=h2typ0    !2024-05-10 Yoshii
                h2pos=h2pos0    !2024-05-10 Yoshii
                nh2=nh20
            end if
            deallocate(h2typ0,h2pos0,h2grp0,h2gen0)

            ! OH + Tris
            if(fg_solvent==2)then
                Rctyp=reactionB(1,styp)                           ! (OH + tris14) or (OH + DMSO15)   !fix231227yy
                aeff=ReactionRadiusA(Rctyp)*2.0*1.0d-9            ! [m]fix221121yy 10d-11 -> 1.0d-9
                DC=(DiffusionCoef(1)+DiffusionCoef(styp))*1.0d-9  ! [m2/s] DA + DB        !fix231227yy
                cs=molar                                          ! [M] [mol/dm3]
                tt=1.0d-12                                        ! [s]
                fs=FSTM(tt,aeff,DC,cs)
                do cnt=1,rdnum
                    if(rdtyp(cnt)==1)then
                        wt=grnd()                                 ! 231223
                        rdlifetime(cnt)=int(SCTM(wt,aeff,DC,cs))
                        if (rdlifetime(cnt)<1)rdlifetime(cnt)=1   !240508Yoshii
                    else
                        rdlifetime(cnt)=0
                    end if
                end do
            end if

            if(fg_solvent==3)then
                Rctyp=reactionB(1,styp)                           ! (OH + Tris14) or (OH + DMSO15)   !fix231227yy
                aeff=ReactionRadiusA(Rctyp)*2.0*1.0d-9            ! [m]fix221121yy 10d-11 -> 1.0d-9
                DC=(DiffusionCoef(1)+DiffusionCoef(styp))*1.0d-9  ! [m2/s] DA + DB
                cs=molar                                          ! [M] [mol/dm3] dm3 = 1/10^3 m3
                tt=1.0d-12                                        ! [s]
                probws=FSTM(tt,aeff,DC,cs)
            end if

            tcnt=1
            call BrownMotion_ALL                                  ! Brownian motions
            if (CDA==1)then
                call CollisionDetection_ALL(nCRflg,CRflg)         ! Collision Detection
            else
                call CollisionDetection_ALL_bucket(nbin,nCRflg,CRflg)
            end if
            call ChemicalReaction_ALL(nCRflg,CRflg)               ! Generation and Corruption
            call Save830(tcnt,n830,nrd88,cKE,totene,te,nprl2,nloop,totgvnrd88,tgk,natty)

            !---monitor of G value and the status---------
                call date_and_time(date,time,zone,values)
                print '(7x,A,I12,A,f6.1,A,I4,A,I2.2,A,I2.2,A,I2.2,A,I2.2,A,I2.2)', &
                'time[',tcnt,' ] psec ',real(tcnt)/real(te)*100d0,'% :  date = ', &
                values(1),'-',values(2),'-',values(3), &
                ' :  time = ',values(5),'-',values(6),'-',values(7)
                !print '(25x,A,ES12.3,3x,A,ES12.3)', 'G value:  OH ',natty(1),' eaq ',natty(2)
            !---------------------------------------------

            if(fg_solvent==1)then
                call BrownMotion_solvent                                           ! Brownian motions    ! scavenger
                call CollisionDetection_solvent(nCRflg,CRflg,nCRflgh,CRflgh)       ! Collision Detection ! scavenger
                call ChemicalReaction_solvent(nCRflg,CRflg,nCRflgh,CRflgh)         ! Generation and Corruption ! scavenger
            end if

            if(fg_solvent==2.or.fg_solvent==3)then                                 ! OH + Tris
                call ChemicalReaction_solvent2(tcnt)                               ! Generation and Corruption    ! scavenger
            end if

            !mainLoop
            do tcnt=2,te+1
                call BrownMotion_ALL                                               ! Brownian motions
                if (CDA==1)then
                    call CollisionDetection_ALL(nCRflg,CRflg)                      ! Collision Detection
                else
                    call CollisionDetection_ALL_bucket(nbin,nCRflg,CRflg)
                end if
                call ChemicalReaction_ALL(nCRflg,CRflg)                            ! Generation and Corruption

                if(fg_solvent==1)then
                    call BrownMotion_solvent                                       ! Brownian motions    ! scavenger
                    call CollisionDetection_solvent(nCRflg,CRflg,nCRflgh,CRflgh)   ! Collision Detection ! scavenger
                    call ChemicalReaction_solvent(nCRflg,CRflg,nCRflgh,CRflgh)     ! Generation and Corruption ! scavenger
                end if

                if(fg_solvent==2.or.fg_solvent==3)then                             ! OH + Tris
                    call ChemicalReaction_solvent2(tcnt)                           ! Generation and Corruption ! scavenger
                end if

                ibf=int(dlog10(dble(tcnt)))
                if(mod(tcnt,10**ibf)==0)then
                    n830=n830+1
                    call Save830(tcnt,n830,nrd88,cKE,totene,te,nprl2,nloop,totgvnrd88,tgk,natty)
                    !statistics
                end if

                !---monitor of G value and the status---------
                if(mod(tcnt,1000)==0)then
                if(tcnt.gt.2)then
                   do cnt= 1,2
                      if(nrd(cnt)==0)then
                         monigv(cnt) = 0.d0
                      else
                         monigv(cnt) = real(nrd(cnt))/cKE * 100.d0
                      end if
                   end do
                   !print '(4x,ES12.3,A,ES12.3,3x,A,ES12.3)', real(tcnt),' psec    G value:  OH ',monigv(1),' eaq ',monigv(2)
                   call date_and_time(date,time,zone,values)
                   print '(7x,A,I12,A,f6.1,A,I4,A,I2.2,A,I2.2,A,I2.2,A,I2.2,A,I2.2)', &
                   'time[',tcnt,' ] psec ',real(tcnt)/real(te)*100d0,'% :  date = ', &
                    values(1),'-',values(2),'-',values(3), &
                   ' :  time = ',values(5),'-',values(6),'-',values(7)
                     !print '(25x,A,ES12.3,3x,A,ES12.3)','G value:  OH ',monigv(1),' eaq ',monigv(2)
                endif
                endif
                !---------------------------------------------
            end do

            deallocate(rdtyp,rdpos,rdgrp,rdgen,rdlifetime,rdregid,rdid)   !2024-04-12 Matsuya

            !Matsuya 2021-11-08
            open(250,file='chem_temp.out')
            !do cnt = 2,n830
            do cnt = 1,n830
            if(cKE.gt.0.0d0)then
            write(250,'(14ES12.3)')tgk(0,cnt),tgk(1,cnt),tgk(2,cnt)    &
                    ,tgk(3,cnt),tgk(4,cnt),tgk(5,cnt),tgk(6,cnt) &
                    ,tgk(7,cnt),tgk(8,cnt),tgk(9,cnt),tgk(10,cnt) &
                    ,tgk(11,cnt),tgk(12,cnt),tgk(13,cnt)
            endif
            end do

            if(npart==1 .and. nloop==1)then
                open(210,file='chem_dyna.out')
            else
                open(210,file='chem_dyna.out',status='old')
            end if
            call inichem3(te,seed,BRtyp,DCtyp,RRtyp)
            do cnt = 1,n830
            if(cKE.gt.0.0d0)then
            write(210,'(14ES12.3)')tgk(0,cnt),tgk(1,cnt),tgk(2,cnt)    &
                    ,tgk(3,cnt),tgk(4,cnt),tgk(5,cnt),tgk(6,cnt) &
                    ,tgk(7,cnt),tgk(8,cnt),tgk(9,cnt),tgk(10,cnt) &
                    ,tgk(11,cnt),tgk(12,cnt),tgk(13,cnt)
            endif
            end do
            close(210)
            close(250)

        end subroutine

        subroutine CollisionDetection_ALL(nCRflg,CRflg)
            integer,intent(out) :: nCRflg, CRflg(3,rdnum00)
            integer :: i,j,Rctyp
            integer :: dflg(rdnum00*2)
            real(8) :: dis2

            dflg=0
            nCRflg=0
            CRflg=0
            do i=1,rdnum-1
                if(dflg(i)==1)cycle
                do j=i+1,rdnum
                    if(i==j)cycle
                    if(dflg(j)==1)cycle
                    Rctyp=reactionB(rdtyp(i),rdtyp(j))
                    if(Rctyp==0)cycle
                    if(ReactionRadiusA(Rctyp)*2.0<(rdpos(1,i)-rdpos(1,j)))cycle
                    dis2=distance2(rdpos(1,i),rdpos(2,i),rdpos(3,i), &
                                    rdpos(1,j),rdpos(2,j),rdpos(3,j))
                    if(ReactionRadiusA2(Rctyp)>dis2)then
                        nCRflg=nCRflg+1
                        dflg(i)=1
                        dflg(j)=1
                        CRflg(1,nCRflg)=i
                        CRflg(2,nCRflg)=j
                        CRflg(3,nCRflg)=Rctyp
                    endif
                    if(dflg(i)==1)exit
                end do
            end do
        end subroutine

        !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
        subroutine CollisionDetection_ALL_bucket(nbin,nCRflg,CRflg)
            integer,intent(in) :: nbin
            integer,intent(out) :: nCRflg, CRflg(3,rdnum00)
            integer :: i,j,Rctyp
            integer :: dflg(rdnum00*2)
            real(8) :: dis2

            integer :: cnt,cnt2,cnt3,cnt4
            integer :: ix,iy,iz,ib
            integer :: jx,jy,jz,jb
            real(8) :: vx,vy,vz

            integer :: nbin3
            nbin3=nbin*nbin*nbin

            do cnt=1,3
                bmin(cnt)=huge(rdpos)
                bmax(cnt)=tiny(rdpos)
                do cnt2=1,rdnum
                    if(bmin(cnt)>rdpos(cnt,cnt2))bmin(cnt)=rdpos(cnt,cnt2)
                    if(bmax(cnt)<rdpos(cnt,cnt2))bmax(cnt)=rdpos(cnt,cnt2)
                end do

                slen(cnt)=bmax(cnt)-bmin(cnt)+1.0
                wbin(cnt)=slen(cnt)/nbin
            end do

            call BucketList(rdnum,rdpos,nbin,nbin3,wbin,bmin)

            dflg=0
            nCRflg=0
            CRflg=0
    !$omp parallel
    !$omp do private(i,j,ix,iy,iz,ib,jx,jy,jz,jb,vx,vy,vz,Rctyp,dis2)
            do cnt=1,rdnum
                i=cnt
                if(i==-1)cycle        !box
                if(dflg(i)==1)cycle

                ix = int((rdpos(1,i)-bmin(1))/wbin(1))
                iy = int((rdpos(2,i)-bmin(2))/wbin(2))
                iz = int((rdpos(3,i)-bmin(3))/wbin(3))
                ib = iz*nbin*nbin + iy*nbin + ix
                do jz=iz,iz+1
                    if(jz>=nbin)cycle
                do jy=iy,iy+1
                    if(jy>=nbin)cycle
                do jx=ix,ix+1
                    if(jx>=nbin)cycle
                    jb = jz*nbin*nbin + jy*nbin + jx
                    if(jb>nbin3)then
                        print*,"Error[jb>nbin3] jb:",jb,"nbin3:",nbin3
                    else
                        j = bfst(jb)
                        do
                            if(j==-1)then
                                exit                 !empty bucket
                            else
                                if(dflg(j)==1)then
                                    j=nxt(j)
                                    cycle
                                end if
                                Rctyp=reactionB(rdtyp(i),rdtyp(j))
                                if(Rctyp==0)then
                                    j=nxt(j)
                                    cycle
                                end if
                                vx = rdpos(1,i)
                                vy = rdpos(2,i)
                                vz = rdpos(3,i)
                                vx = vx-rdpos(1,j)    !split
                                vy = vy-rdpos(2,j)    !split
                                vz = vz-rdpos(3,j)    !split
                                dis2=vx*vx + vy*vy + vz*vz
                                if(ReactionRadiusA2(Rctyp)>dis2)then        !
                                    if(dis2==0.0)then
                                        j=nxt(j)
                                        cycle
                                    end if
                                    nCRflg=nCRflg+1
                                    dflg(i)=1
                                    dflg(j)=1
                                    CRflg(1,nCRflg)=i
                                    CRflg(2,nCRflg)=j
                                    CRflg(3,nCRflg)=Rctyp
                                endif
                                j = nxt(j)
                            end if
                        end do
                    end if
                end do
                end do
                end do
            end do
    !$omp end do
    !$omp end parallel
            deallocate(bfst)
            deallocate(blst)
            deallocate(nxt)

        end subroutine
        !-----------------------------------------------------------------------
        subroutine BucketList(n,pos,nbin,nbin3,wbin,bmin)
            integer,intent(in) :: n
            real(8),intent(in) :: pos(3,n)
            integer,intent(in) :: nbin,nbin3
            real(8),intent(in) :: wbin(3),bmin(3)
            integer :: cnt
            integer :: ix,iy,iz,ib, j

            allocate(bfst(0:nbin*nbin*nbin))
            allocate(blst(0:nbin*nbin*nbin))
            allocate(nxt(n))

            bfst = -1
            blst = -1
            nxt = -1

            do cnt=1,n
                ix = int((rdpos(1,cnt)-bmin(1))/wbin(1))
                iy = int((rdpos(2,cnt)-bmin(2))/wbin(2))
                iz = int((rdpos(3,cnt)-bmin(3))/wbin(3))
                ib = iz*nbin*nbin+ iy*nbin + ix
                if(ib<0.or.ib>nbin3)then
                    print*,"Error[ib]",ix,iy,iz,ib,nbin3
                else
                    j = blst(ib)
                    blst(ib) = cnt
                    if(j == -1)then
                        bfst(ib) = cnt
                    else
                        nxt(j) = cnt
                    end if
                end if

            end do
        end subroutine
        !------------------------------------------------------------------------
        subroutine ChemicalReaction_ALL(nCRflg,CRflg)
            use mtmod
            use modWLTPhysicoChem
            integer,intent(in) :: nCRflg, CRflg(3,nCRflg)
            integer :: cnt,cnt2,i,j,Rctyp,ij(nCRflg*2),flag(rdnum00*2),nn,nn2,nn3
            real(8) :: cpos(3)
            integer :: cgrp,cgen
			integer :: cregid,crdid !2024-04-10 Matsuya
            integer :: brdtyp(rdnum00*2),brdgrp(rdnum00*2),brdgen(rdnum00*2),brdlifetime(rdnum00*2)
            real(8) :: brdpos(3,rdnum00*2)
			integer :: brdregid(rdnum00*2),brdid(rdnum00*2) !2024-04-10 Matsuya

            real(8) :: aeff,cs,DC,fs,tt,wt

            brdtyp=0
            brdgrp=0
            brdgen=0
            brdpos=0.0
			brdregid=0 !2024-04-10 Matsuya
			brdid=0    !2024-04-10 Matsuya
			crdid=0    !2024-04-10 Matsuya
            brdlifetime=0
            nn=0

            do cnt=1,nCRflg
                i=CRflg(1,cnt)
                j=CRflg(2,cnt)
                Rctyp=CRflg(3,cnt)
                call Save831(tcnt,Rctyp,i,j,rdpos(1,i),rdpos(1,j))
                !location of reaction sites (Bolch et al. (1988) ORNL_TM-10851)
                cpos(1)=rdpos(1,i)*posDD1(Rctyp)+rdpos(1,j)*posDD2(Rctyp)
                cpos(2)=rdpos(2,i)*posDD1(Rctyp)+rdpos(2,j)*posDD2(Rctyp)
                cpos(3)=rdpos(3,i)*posDD1(Rctyp)+rdpos(3,j)*posDD2(Rctyp)

                if(rdgrp(i)==rdgrp(j))then
                    cgrp=rdgrp(i)
					cregid=rdregid(i)  !2024-04-10 Matsuya
					mxrdid=mxrdid+1    !2024-04-10 Matsuya
					crdid=mxrdid       !2024-04-10 Matsuya
                else
                    mxcgrp=mxcgrp+1
					mxrdid=mxrdid+1    !2024-04-10 Matsuya
                    cgrp=mxcgrp
					crdid=mxrdid       !2024-04-10 Matsuya
                end if

                if(rdgen(i)>rdgen(j))then
                    cgen=rdgen(i)+1
					cregid=rdregid(i)  !2024-05-01 Matsuya
                else
                    cgen=rdgen(j)+1
					cregid=rdregid(i)  !2024-05-01 Matsuya
                end if

                ! generated chemical products -> buffer
                do cnt2=3,5
                    if(reaction(Rctyp,cnt2)>0)then
                        nn=nn+1
                        brdtyp(nn)=reaction(Rctyp,cnt2)
                        brdgrp(nn)=cgrp
                        brdgen(nn)=cgen
                        brdpos(1,nn)=cpos(1)
                        brdpos(2,nn)=cpos(2)
                        brdpos(3,nn)=cpos(3)
						brdid(nn)=crdid      !2024-04-10 Matsuya
						brdregid(nn)=cregid  !2024-05-01 Matsuya

                        ! OH + Tris
                        if(fg_solvent==2)then
                            Rctyp=reactionB(1,styp)                    ! (OH + tris14) or (OH + DMSO15)            !!fix231227yy
                            aeff=ReactionRadiusA(Rctyp)*2.0*1.0d-9            ![m]fix221121yy 10d-11 -> 1.0d-9
                            DC=(DiffusionCoef(1)+DiffusionCoef(styp))*1.0d-9    ![m2/s] DA + DB            !!fix231227yy
                            cs=molar                                          ![M] [mol/dm3]
                            tt=1.0d-12                                        ![s]
                            wt=grnd()                                             !231223
                            brdlifetime(nn)=int(SCTM(wt,aeff,DC,cs))+tcnt       !240508Yoshii
                            if (brdlifetime(nn)<1+tcnt)brdlifetime(nn)=1+tcnt   !240508Yoshii
                        end if

                    end if
                end do
            end do

            !
            nn2=0    !nn2=nCRflg*2
            do cnt=1,nCRflg
                nn2=nn2+1
                ij(nn2)=CRflg(1,cnt)
                nn2=nn2+1
                ij(nn2)=CRflg(2,cnt)
            end do

            flag=0
            do cnt=1,nn2
                flag(ij(cnt))=1
            end do

            ! generated chemical products -> buffer
            nn3=nn
            do cnt=1,rdnum
                if(flag(cnt)==1)cycle
                nn3=nn3+1
                brdtyp(nn3)=rdtyp(cnt)
                brdgrp(nn3)=rdgrp(cnt)
                brdgen(nn3)=rdgen(cnt)
                brdpos(1,nn3)=rdpos(1,cnt)
                brdpos(2,nn3)=rdpos(2,cnt)
                brdpos(3,nn3)=rdpos(3,cnt)
				brdregid(nn3)=rdregid(cnt) ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
				brdid(nn3)=rdid(cnt)       ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
                ! OH + Tris
                if(fg_solvent==2)brdlifetime(nn3)=rdlifetime(cnt)
            end do

            !buffer -> back
            rdnum=nn3
            do cnt=1,rdnum
                rdtyp(cnt)=brdtyp(cnt)
                rdgrp(cnt)=brdgrp(cnt)
                rdgen(cnt)=brdgen(cnt)
                rdpos(1,cnt)=brdpos(1,cnt)
                rdpos(2,cnt)=brdpos(2,cnt)
                rdpos(3,cnt)=brdpos(3,cnt)
			    !brdregid(cnt)=rdregid(cnt) ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
				!brdid(cnt)=rdid(cnt)       ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
				rdregid(cnt)=brdregid(cnt)  ! 2024-04-30 Yoshii
				rdid(cnt)=brdid(cnt)        ! 2024-04-30 Yoshii
                ! OH + Tris
                if(fg_solvent==2)rdlifetime(cnt)=brdlifetime(cnt)
            end do
        end subroutine

        subroutine BrownMotion_ALL
            integer :: cnt,i,ibf,cnt2
            real(8) :: sd

            do i=1,rdnum
                ibf=rdtyp(i)
                sd=0.0
                call BrownMotion(rdpos(1,i),rdpos(2,i),rdpos(3,i),ramda(ibf),sd)

            ! **************************************************
            !   4dtrack 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			!   to write the coordinate and radical ID
			! **************************************************
                if(track4d_chem.eq.1)then
    				cnt2=int(dlog10(dble(tcnt)))
                    if(mod(tcnt,10**cnt2)==0)then
                        !if(mod(tcnt,1000)==0)then
                        if(track4d_outRD.eq.2)then
                            if(rdid(i).gt.0)then
                            write(350,'(i10,3es15.6,2i8,2es15.6)') ibf,rdpos(1,i)*1.0d-7 &
                                 ,rdpos(2,i)*1.0d-7,rdpos(3,i)*1.0d-7,rdid(i),rdregid(i) &
                                 ,1.0d0,real(tcnt)/1000.d0
                            end if
                        else
            				if(ibf.eq.1.or.ibf.eq.2.or.ibf.eq.5.or.ibf.eq.6)then
                                if(rdid(i).gt.0)then
                                write(350,'(i10,3es15.6,2i8,2es15.6)') ibf,rdpos(1,i)*1.0d-7 &
                                     ,rdpos(2,i)*1.0d-7,rdpos(3,i)*1.0d-7,rdid(i),rdregid(i) &
                                     ,1.0d0,real(tcnt)/1000.d0
                                end if
                            end if
                        end if
                    end if
                end if
            ! **************************************************
			!   end 4d track output
			! **************************************************

            end do
        end subroutine

        subroutine inichem3(te,seed,BRtyp,DCtyp,RRtyp)
            integer,intent(in)::te,seed,BRtyp,DCtyp,RRtyp
            integer:: ss

            ss = 1   ! step size (constant value = 1 psec)

            write(210,*) '#[ Chemical code ]'
            write(210,'(1x,A)') '    title = Chemical simulation based on PHITS ts-mode'
            write(210,'(1x,A,1x,i7,A)') '#   step  =  ',ss,'    # (fixed value) step size [psec]'
            write(210,'(1x,A,1x,I7,A)') '#     te  =  ',te,'    # (D=10000) tracking time [psec]'
            write(210,'(1x,A,1x,I7,A)') '#   seed  =  ',seed,'    # (D=4537) random number'
            write(210,'(1x,A,1x,I7,A)') '#   BRtyp =  ',BRtyp,'    # (D=1) radical difusion (1: PHITS model; 2: User model)'
            write(210,'(1x,A,1x,I7,A)') '#   DCtyp =  ',DCtyp,'    # (D=1) radical difusion (1: PHITS model; 2: User model)'
            write(210,'(1x,A,1x,I7,A)') '#   RRtyp =  ',RRtyp,'    # (D=1) reaction radius (1: PHITS model; 2: User model)'
            write(210,*)
            write(210,*) '#------------------------------------------------------------------------------'
            write(210,*) '#newpage'
              write(210,*) 'x: [psec]'
            write(210,*) 'y: G value [/100 eV]'
            write(210,*) 'p: xlog ylin afac(0.8) form(0.9)'
            write(210,*)
            write(210,'(A,A10,13A12)')'h:','x','y(OH)','y(eaq-)','ny(H)','ny(H3O+)','y(H2)','y(H2O2)' &
                     ,'ny(HO2)','ny(O2)','ny(OH-)','ny(O2-)','ny(HO2-)','ny(O)','ny(O-)'
            write(210,'(14A12)')'#psec','OH','eaq-','H','H3O+','H2','H2O2','HO2','O2','OH-','O2-','HO2-','ny(O)','ny(O-)'
        end subroutine

        subroutine Save830(tcnt,n830,nrd88,cKE,totene,te,npart,nloop,totgvnrd88,tgk,natty)
            integer,intent(in) :: tcnt,n830,te,npart,nloop
            real(8),intent(in) :: cKE,totene
            integer,intent(out):: nrd88(99,100)
            real(8),intent(out):: natty(4)

            integer :: cnt,ibf
            real(8):: gvnrd88(13),icnt,itg(13),e(2),g(13)
            integer :: cnt1,rtcnt,i(3)
            real(8),intent(in) :: totgvnrd88(13,100)
            real(8),intent(out) :: tgk(0:13,100)

            ! Counting radical number
            nrd=0
            do cnt=1,rdnum
                nrd(rdtyp(cnt))=nrd(rdtyp(cnt))+1
            end do

            do cnt= 1,13
                if(nrd(cnt)==0)then
                    gvnrd88(cnt) = 0.d0
                else
                    gvnrd88(cnt) = real(nrd(cnt))/cKE * 100.d0
                end if
            end do

            rtcnt = tcnt -1

            ! for checking!
            if(tcnt.eq.1.0d0)then ! for check
                !print '(4x,ES12.3,A,ES12.3,3x,A,ES12.3)', real(tcnt),' psec    G value:  OH ',gvnrd88(1),' eaq ',gvnrd88(2)
                natty(1) = gvnrd88(1)
                natty(2) = gvnrd88(2)
                natty(3) = gvnrd88(5)
                natty(4) = gvnrd88(6)
            endif
            if(mod(tcnt,1000)==0)then
            if(tcnt.gt.2)then
                !print '(4x,ES12.3,A,ES12.3,3x,A,ES12.3)', real(tcnt),' psec    G value:  OH ',gvnrd88(1),' eaq ',gvnrd88(2)
            endif
            endif

            tgk(1,n830) = totgvnrd88(1,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(1) * cKE
            tgk(2,n830) = totgvnrd88(2,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(2) * cKE
            tgk(3,n830) = totgvnrd88(3,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(3) * cKE
            tgk(4,n830) = totgvnrd88(4,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(4) * cKE
            tgk(5,n830) = totgvnrd88(5,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(5) * cKE
            tgk(6,n830) = totgvnrd88(6,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(6) * cKE
            tgk(7,n830) = totgvnrd88(7,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(7) * cKE
            tgk(8,n830) = totgvnrd88(8,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(8) * cKE
            tgk(9,n830) = totgvnrd88(9,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(9) * cKE
            tgk(10,n830) = totgvnrd88(10,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(10) * cKE
            tgk(11,n830) = totgvnrd88(11,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(11) * cKE
            tgk(12,n830) = totgvnrd88(12,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(12) * cKE
            tgk(13,n830) = totgvnrd88(13,n830) * (totene - cKE) + gvnrd88(13) * cKE

            tgk(1,n830) = tgk(1,n830) / totene
            tgk(2,n830) = tgk(2,n830) / totene
            tgk(3,n830) = tgk(3,n830) / totene
            tgk(4,n830) = tgk(4,n830) / totene
            tgk(5,n830) = tgk(5,n830) / totene
            tgk(6,n830) = tgk(6,n830) / totene
            tgk(7,n830) = tgk(7,n830) / totene
            tgk(8,n830) = tgk(8,n830) / totene
            tgk(9,n830) = tgk(9,n830) / totene
            tgk(10,n830) = tgk(10,n830) / totene
            tgk(11,n830) = tgk(11,n830) / totene
            tgk(12,n830) = tgk(12,n830) / totene
            tgk(13,n830) = tgk(13,n830) / totene

            tgk(0,n830) = real(tcnt)

            ! for initial yield in phits_tsmode.out (by Matsuya 2022-08-21)---------------
            if(tcnt.eq.1)then
            rewind(160)
            write(160,'(14ES10.3)') tgk(0,n830),tgk(1,n830),tgk(2,n830),tgk(3,n830),tgk(4,n830),tgk(5,n830) &
            ,tgk(6,n830),tgk(7,n830),tgk(8,n830),tgk(9,n830),tgk(10,n830),tgk(11,n830),tgk(12,n830),tgk(13,n830)
            end if
            ! for primary yield in phits_tsmode.out (by Matsuya 2022-08-21)---------------
            if(tcnt.eq.1000000)then
            write(160,'(14ES10.3)') tgk(0,n830),tgk(1,n830),tgk(2,n830),tgk(3,n830),tgk(4,n830),tgk(5,n830) &
            ,tgk(6,n830),tgk(7,n830),tgk(8,n830),tgk(9,n830),tgk(10,n830),tgk(11,n830),tgk(12,n830),tgk(13,n830)
            end if
            !-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

            nrd88(:,n830)=nrd
        end subroutine

        subroutine Save831(tcnt,Rctyp,i,j,posi,posj)
            integer,intent(in) :: tcnt,Rctyp
            integer,intent(in) :: i,j
            real(8),intent(in) :: posi,posj
            !print*,"831",tcnt,chaRR(Rctyp,1),chaRR(Rctyp,2),chaRR(Rctyp,3),chaRR(Rctyp,4),chaRR(Rctyp,5)
            !write(831,*)tcnt,',',chaRR(Rctyp,1),',',chaRR(Rctyp,2),',',chaRR(Rctyp,3),',',chaRR(Rctyp,4),',',chaRR(Rctyp,5)    &
            !    ,',',Rctyp,',',rdgrp(i),',',rdgrp(j),',',rdgen(i),',',rdgen(j),',',i,',',j,',',posi,',',posj
        end subroutine

        !***********************************************
        real(8) function distance2(x,y,z,x2,y2,z2)
            implicit none
            real(8)::x,y,z,x2,y2,z2,sx,sy,sz
            sx=x2-x
            sy=y2-y
            sz=z2-z
            distance2=sx*sx+sy*sy+sz*sz
        end function

        !***********************************************
        real(8) function rmsd(d1)
            real(8) :: d1
            real(8) :: d,t
            d=d1*1.0e-9
            t=1.0d0*1.0e-12
            rmsd=sqrt(6.0d0*d*t)*1.0e9
        end function

        !***********************************************
        real(8) function constDD(d1,d2)
            real(8) :: d1,d2
            real(8) :: sqrtd1,sqrtd2,t
            sqrtd1=sqrt(d1*1.0e-9)
            sqrtd2=sqrt(d2*1.0e-9)
            !print*,d1,d2,sqrtd1,sqrtd2
            constDD=sqrtd2/(sqrtd1+sqrtd2)
        end function

        !***********************************************
        SUBROUTINE BrownMotion(x1,y1,z1,d1,sd)
            use mtmod
            real(8),intent(inout) :: x1,y1,z1
            real(8),intent(in) :: d1,sd
            real(8) :: swx,swy,swz,sinthe,pi2rn,d
            real(8) :: PAI=3.14159265
            real(8) :: PAI2=6.28318531

            !BoxMuller's method !https://mathtrain.jp/boxmuller
            d=d1+sd*(sqrt(-2.0*log(grnd()))*sin(PAI2*grnd()))

            swz=grnd()*2.0-1.0
            sinthe=sqrt(1.0-swz*swz)
            pi2rn=pai2*grnd()
            swx=sinthe*cos(pi2rn)
            swy=sinthe*sin(pi2rn)
            x1=x1+swx*d1
            y1=y1+swy*d1
            z1=z1+swz*d1
        END SUBROUTINE BrownMotion

        real(8) function h2conc(hnum)    ! scavenger mode
            use modWLTPhysicoChem
            integer,intent(in) :: hnum
            real(8) ::molecularweight
            molecularweight=2.016        !H2     2.016g/mol
            molecularweight=31.99        !O2    31.99 g/mol
            molecularweight=121.14       !Tris 121.14 g/mol
            molecularweight=78.13        !DMSO  78.13 g/mol
            h2conc=molecularweight/0.602*h2num/h2Volume
        end function

        real(8) function kmolar2SC(k,molar)    ! scavenger mode
            real(8),intent(in) ::k, molar
            kmolar2SC=k*molar
        end function

        real(8) function kSC2molar(k,SC)       ! scavenger mode
            real(8),intent(in) ::k, SC
            kSC2molar=SC/k
        end function

        real(8) function cubemolar2num(h2length,molar)    ! scavenger mode
            real(8),intent(in) ::h2length,molar
            cubemolar2num=h2length*h2length*h2length*0.602*molar
        end function

        real(8) function nummolar2length(hnum,molar)      ! scavenger mode
            real(8),intent(in) ::hnum,molar
            nummolar2length=(0.602*molar/hnum)**(1.0/3.0)
        end function

        subroutine CollisionDetection_solvent(nCRflg,CRflg,nCRflgh,CRflgh)    ! scavenger mode
            use modWLTPhysicoChem
            integer,intent(out) :: nCRflg, CRflg(3,rdnum00*2),nCRflgh, CRflgh(3,rdnum00*2)
            integer :: i,j,Rctyp
            integer :: dflg(rdnum00*2),dflgh(h2num)
            real(8) :: dis2
            real(8) :: rdx,rdy,rdz

            dflg=0
            dflgh=0
            nCRflg=0
            nCRflgh=0

            do i=1,rdnum            ! radicals
                if(dflg(i)==1)cycle
                rdx=(dmod(rdpos(1,i),h2length))
                rdy=(dmod(rdpos(2,i),h2length))
                rdz=(dmod(rdpos(3,i),h2length))

                if(rdx<0)rdx=dabs(rdx)
                if(rdy<0)rdy=dabs(rdy)
                if(rdz<0)rdz=dabs(rdz)

                do j=1,h2num        ! solvent
                    if(dflgh(j)==1)cycle
                    Rctyp=reactionB(rdtyp(i),h2typ(j))
                    if(Rctyp==0)cycle
                    if(ReactionRadiusA(Rctyp)*2.0<(rdx-h2pos(1,j)))cycle
                    dis2=distance2(rdx,rdy,rdz,h2pos(1,j),h2pos(2,j),h2pos(3,j))
                    if(ReactionRadiusA2(Rctyp)>dis2)then
                        nCRflg=nCRflg+1
                        nCRflgh=nCRflgh+1
                        dflg(i)=1
                        dflgh(j)=1
                        CRflg(1,nCRflg)=i
                        CRflgh(1,nCRflgh)=j
                        CRflg(3,nCRflg)=Rctyp

                        ! sol_write for scaveger model
                        !write(999,*)"|",tcnt,"|",i,"|",j,"|",rdtyp(i),"|",h2typ(j),"|",Rctyp,"|",dis2,"|"
                    endif
                    if(dflg(i)==1)exit
                end do
            end do
        end subroutine

        subroutine ChemicalReaction_solvent(nCRflg,CRflg,nCRflgh,CRflgh)    !###sol
            integer,intent(in) :: nCRflg, CRflg(3,rdnum00*2),nCRflgh, CRflgh(3,rdnum00*2)
            integer :: cnt,cnt2,i,j,Rctyp,ij(rdnum00*2),flag(rdnum00*2),ijh(h2num00*2),flagh(h2num00*2),nn,nn2,nn3
            real(8) :: cpos(3)
            integer :: cgrp,cgen
			integer :: cregid,crdid  ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
            integer :: brdtyp(rdnum00*2),brdgrp(rdnum00*2),brdgen(rdnum00*2)
            real(8) :: brdpos(3,rdnum00*2)
            integer :: brdtyph(h2num00*2),brdgrph(h2num00*2),brdgenh(h2num00*2)
            real(8) :: brdposh(3,h2num00*2)
			integer :: brdregid(rdnum00*2),brdid(rdnum00*2) ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya

            brdtyp=0
            brdgrp=0
            brdgen=0
            brdpos=0.0
			brdregid=0
			brdid=0

            nn=0
            do cnt=1,nCRflgh           ! radical
                i=CRflg(1,cnt)        ! radical
                j=CRflgh(1,cnt)       ! solvent
                Rctyp=CRflg(3,cnt)
                call Save831(tcnt,Rctyp,i,j,rdpos(1,i),h2pos(1,j))
                !location of reaction sites (Bolch et al. (1988) ORNL_TM-10851)
                cpos(1)=rdpos(1,i)!*posDD1(Rctyp)+h2pos(1,j)*posDD2(Rctyp)
                cpos(2)=rdpos(2,i)!*posDD1(Rctyp)+h2pos(2,j)*posDD2(Rctyp)
                cpos(3)=rdpos(3,i)!*posDD1(Rctyp)+h2pos(3,j)*posDD2(Rctyp)
                cgrp=rdgrp(i)
                cgen=rdgen(i)+1
				cregid=rdregid(i)  ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
				crdid=rdid(i)  ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
                !
                do cnt2=3,5
                    if(reaction(Rctyp,cnt2)>0)then
                        nn=nn+1
                        brdtyp(nn)=reaction(Rctyp,cnt2)
                        brdgrp(nn)=cgrp
                        brdgen(nn)=cgen
                        brdpos(1,nn)=cpos(1)
                        brdpos(2,nn)=cpos(2)
                        brdpos(3,nn)=cpos(3)
                        brdid(nn)=crdid      ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
						brdregid(nn)=cregid  ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
                    end if
                end do
            end do

            !del radical
            nn2=0    !nn2=nCRflg
            do cnt=1,nCRflgh
                nn2=nn2+1
                ij(nn2)=CRflg(1,cnt)
            end do

            flag=0
            do cnt=1,nn2
                flag(ij(cnt))=1
            end do

            !
            nn3=nn
            do cnt=1,rdnum
                if(flag(cnt)==1)cycle
                nn3=nn3+1
                brdtyp(nn3)=rdtyp(cnt)
                brdgrp(nn3)=rdgrp(cnt)
                brdgen(nn3)=rdgen(cnt)
                brdpos(1,nn3)=rdpos(1,cnt)
                brdpos(2,nn3)=rdpos(2,cnt)
                brdpos(3,nn3)=rdpos(3,cnt)
				brdregid(nn3)=rdregid(cnt) ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
				brdid(nn3)=rdid(cnt)       ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
            end do

            rdnum=nn3
            do cnt=1,rdnum
                rdtyp(cnt)=brdtyp(cnt)
                rdgrp(cnt)=brdgrp(cnt)
                rdgen(cnt)=brdgen(cnt)
                rdpos(1,cnt)=brdpos(1,cnt)
                rdpos(2,cnt)=brdpos(2,cnt)
                rdpos(3,cnt)=brdpos(3,cnt)
				rdregid(cnt)=brdregid(cnt) ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
				rdid(cnt)=brdid(nn3)        ! 2024-05-14 Yoshii
				!brdid(nn3)=rdid(cnt)       ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
            end do

            !del sol
            nn2=0    !nn2=nCRflgh
            do cnt=1,nCRflgh
                nn2=nn2+1
                ijh(nn2)=CRflgh(1,cnt)
            end do

            flag=0
            do cnt=1,nn2
                flagh(ij(cnt))=1
            end do

            !
            nn3=nn
            do cnt=1,h2num
                if(flagh(cnt)==1)cycle
                nn3=nn3+1
                brdtyph(nn3)=h2typ(cnt)
                brdposh(1,nn3)=h2pos(1,cnt)
                brdposh(2,nn3)=h2pos(2,cnt)
                brdposh(3,nn3)=h2pos(3,cnt)
            end do

            h2num=nn3
            do cnt=1,h2num
                h2typ(cnt)=brdtyph(cnt)
                h2pos(1,cnt)=brdposh(1,cnt)
                h2pos(2,cnt)=brdposh(2,cnt)
                h2pos(3,cnt)=brdposh(3,cnt)
            end do

        end subroutine

        subroutine ChemicalReaction_solvent2(tcnt)    ! sol
            use mtmod
            integer,intent(in) :: tcnt
            integer :: cnt,rdfg(rdnum00*2),nn
            integer :: brdtyp(rdnum00*2),brdgrp(rdnum00*2),brdgen(rdnum00*2),brdlifetime(rdnum00*2)
            real(8) :: brdpos(3,rdnum00*2)
			integer :: brdregid(rdnum00*2),brdid(rdnum00*2)  ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya

            !detection
            rdfg=0
            if(fg_solvent==2)then
                do cnt=1,rdnum
                    if(rdlifetime(cnt)==tcnt)then
                        rdfg(cnt)=1
                    endif
                end do
            endif

            if(fg_solvent==3)then
                do cnt=1,rdnum
                    if(rdtyp(cnt)==1)then
                        if(probws>=grnd())then
                            rdfg(cnt)=1
                        endif
                    endif
                end do
            endif

            brdtyp=0
            brdgrp=0
            brdgen=0
            brdpos=0.0
			brdregid=0 ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
			brdid=0    ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
            if(fg_solvent==2)brdlifetime=0

            nn=0
            do cnt=1,rdnum
                if(rdfg(cnt)==1)cycle        ! undo 0 -> 1
                nn=nn+1
                brdtyp(nn)=rdtyp(cnt)
                brdgrp(nn)=rdgrp(cnt)
                brdgen(nn)=rdgen(cnt)
                brdpos(1,nn)=rdpos(1,cnt)
                brdpos(2,nn)=rdpos(2,cnt)
                brdpos(3,nn)=rdpos(3,cnt)
                brdregid(nn)=rdregid(cnt)   ! 2024-05-14 Yoshii
                brdid(nn)=rdid(cnt)         ! 2024-05-14 Yoshii
				!rdregid(nn)=rdregid(cnt)   ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
				!rdid(nn)=rdid(cnt)         ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
                if(fg_solvent==2)brdlifetime(nn)=rdlifetime(cnt)
            end do

            rdnum=nn
            do cnt=1,rdnum
                rdtyp(cnt)=brdtyp(cnt)
                rdgrp(cnt)=brdgrp(cnt)
                rdgen(cnt)=brdgen(cnt)
                rdpos(1,cnt)=brdpos(1,cnt)
                rdpos(2,cnt)=brdpos(2,cnt)
                rdpos(3,cnt)=brdpos(3,cnt)
				rdregid(cnt)=brdregid(cnt)  ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
				rdid(cnt)=brdid(cnt)        ! 2024-04-12 Matsuya
                if(fg_solvent==2)rdlifetime(cnt)=brdlifetime(cnt)  ! Revised by Matsuya ??
            end do
        end subroutine

!***************************************************

        subroutine BrownMotion_solvent    ! sol
            use modWLTPhysicoChem
            integer :: cnt,i,ibf
            real(8) :: sd

            do i=1,h2num
                ibf=h2typ(i)
                sd=0.0
                call BrownMotion(h2pos(1,i),h2pos(2,i),h2pos(3,i),ramda(ibf),sd)
                if(0>=h2pos(1,i))h2pos(1,i)=h2pos(1,i)+h2length
                if(0>=h2pos(2,i))h2pos(2,i)=h2pos(2,i)+h2length
                if(0>=h2pos(3,i))h2pos(3,i)=h2pos(3,i)+h2length
                if(h2length<=h2pos(1,i))h2pos(1,i)=h2pos(1,i)-h2length
                if(h2length<=h2pos(2,i))h2pos(2,i)=h2pos(2,i)-h2length
                if(h2length<=h2pos(3,i))h2pos(3,i)=h2pos(3,i)-h2length
            end do
        end subroutine

!***************************************************
        real(8) function SCTM(wt,aeff,DC,cs)    ! t

            real(8),intent(in) ::wt,aeff,DC,cs
            real(8) :: A,B,C
            real(8) :: PI = 3.141592
            real(8) :: Av = 6.022d23
            B=2.0d0*aeff/sqrt(PI*DC)                            ! B: 2aeff/sqrt(pi*D)
            A=dlog(1.0d0-wt)/(-4.0d0*PI*DC*aeff*cs*Av*1.0d3)    ! A: log(1-U)/(-4pi*D*aeff*cs*Av)
            SCTM=(B*B-B*sqrt(B*B+4.0d0*A)+2.0d0*A)/2.0d0*1.0d12 ! [B^2-B*sqrt(B^2+4A)+2A]/2
        end function

        real(8) function FSTM(tt,aeff,DC,cs)    ! Wscav

            real(8),intent(in) ::tt,aeff,DC,cs
            real(8) :: A,B,C
            real(8) :: PI = 3.141592
            real(8) :: Av = 6.022d23
            !FSTM=1-exp((-4.0d0/PI*DC*aeff*cs*Av*10d3)*(tt+2.0d0*aeff*sqrt(tt/(PI*DC))))
            FSTM=1-exp((-4.0d0*PI*DC*aeff*cs*Av*1.0d3)*(tt+2.0d0*aeff*sqrt(tt/(PI*DC))))    !fix231121yy
        end function

!================================================================================================================================
    end module

      write(110,'(A)') ' >>> END >>>======================================================================'
   end subroutine
