    module modWLTPhysicoChem
        implicit none
        private
        public :: iniPhysicoChem, endPhysicoChem
        public :: prePhysicoChem, postPhysicoChem
        public :: PhysicoChem
        public :: PhysicoChemDataClear
        public :: Add_solvent

        integer,public :: rdnum0
        integer,public :: rdcnt
        integer,allocatable,public :: rdtyp0(:)
        real(8),allocatable,public :: rdpos0(:,:)
        integer,allocatable,public :: rdgrp0(:)
        integer,allocatable,public :: rdgen0(:)
        integer,allocatable,public :: rdregid0(:)  ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
        integer,allocatable,public :: rdid0(:)     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
		integer,public :: mxrdid0           ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
		integer :: brdregid                 ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
		integer :: brdid                    ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
        real(8) :: A1B1(10),B1A1(10),Rydbde(10),diffbands(10),DEA(10)

        !"BranchingRatio.csv"
        integer,public :: BRtyp
        integer :: nBR
        real(8) :: pBR(100,17)
        character(10) ::chaBR(100)

        integer,public :: nrd0(99)
        real(8) :: grd0(99)    ! note: g-value

        integer :: nrd98(100000,99),nrd99(100000,99)
        real(8) :: grd98(100000,99),grd99(100000,99)

        real(8) :: rc

        ! radical scavenger -- solv
        integer,public :: h2num0
        integer,allocatable,public :: h2typ0(:)
        integer,allocatable,public :: h2grp0(:)
        integer,allocatable,public :: h2gen0(:)
        real(8),allocatable,public :: h2pos0(:,:)

        integer,public :: nh20(99)

        integer,public :: h2num
        real(8),public :: h2length
        real(8),public :: h2Volume      ! unit: nm^3
        real(8),public :: molar         ! unit: M
        real(8),public :: ScCap         ! unit:s-1

    contains

    subroutine iniPhysicoChem(Otyp,fn)
        integer,intent(in) :: Otyp
        character(100),intent(in) :: fn(10)
        integer :: cnt,cnt2,cnt3
        real(8) :: ec,Celsius,Kelvin,pi,eps0,eps,Boltzmann

        !write(110,*)
        write(110,'(A)') '[ Echo physicochemical parameters ]'

        !read "BranchingRatio.csv"
        open (10,file=fn(3),status='old')
        read(10,*)
        read(10,*)
        pBR=0.0d0
        nBR=0
        do cnt=1,100
        read(10,*,end=110)chaBR(cnt),pBR(cnt,1),pBR(cnt,2),pBR(cnt,3),pBR(cnt,4),pBR(cnt,5)    &
             ,pBR(cnt,6),pBR(cnt,7),pBR(cnt,8),pBR(cnt,9),pBR(cnt,10)    &
             ,pBR(cnt,11),pBR(cnt,12),pBR(cnt,13),pBR(BRtyp,17),pBR(cnt,14),pBR(cnt,15),pBR(cnt,16)
        nBR=nBR+1
        end do

110     close(10)

        A1B1=0.0d0
        B1A1=0.0d0
        Rydbde=0.0d0
        diffbands=0.0d0

        A1B1(1)=pBR(BRtyp,1)                    !H + OH
        A1B1(2)=pBR(BRtyp,2)+A1B1(1)            !H2 + O
        A1B1(3)=pBR(BRtyp,3)+A1B1(2)            !H2O
        B1A1(1)=pBR(BRtyp,4)                    !H3O+ + OH + eaq
        B1A1(2)=pBR(BRtyp,5)+B1A1(1)            !H + OH
        B1A1(3)=pBR(BRtyp,6)+B1A1(2)            !2H + O
        B1A1(4)=pBR(BRtyp,7)+B1A1(3)            !H2 + O
        B1A1(5)=pBR(BRtyp,8)+B1A1(4)            !H2 + H2O2
        B1A1(6)=pBR(BRtyp,9)+B1A1(5)            !H2O
        Rydbde(1)=pBR(BRtyp,10)                 !H + OH
        Rydbde(2)=pBR(BRtyp,11)+Rydbde(1)       !H3O+ + OH + eaq
        Rydbde(3)=pBR(BRtyp,12)+Rydbde(2)       !H2O
        diffbands(1)=pBR(BRtyp,13)              !H + OH
        diffbands(2)=pBR(BRtyp,17)+diffbands(1) !H3O+ + OH + eaq
        DEA(1)=pBR(BRtyp,14)                    !H + OH-
        DEA(2)=pBR(BRtyp,15)+DEA(1)             !O- + H2
        DEA(3)=pBR(BRtyp,16)+DEA(2)             !OH + H2 (or 2H) + OH-

        !Initialzation
        nrd99=0

        !!The reconbination of subexcitation electron (ref model: Uehara et al. 2006)
        Celsius=25.0            !input parameter
        Kelvin=Celsius+273.15
        ec=1.60217653d-19
        pi=3.14159265359
        eps0=8.854187817d-12
        eps=88.15-0.414*Celsius+0.131*0.01*Celsius**2-0.046*0.0001*Celsius**3
        Boltzmann=1.3806505d-23
        rc=ec**2/(4.0*pi*eps0*eps*Boltzmann*Kelvin)*1.0d+9

        !write(110,*)"BranchingRatio.csv"
        write(110,'(1x,A,4x,I10,A)') ' BRtyp   =  ',BRtyp,'        # (D=1) 1:PHITS model; 2:User model'
        write(110,'(A)') ' _______________________________________________________________________________'
        write(110,*)
        write(110,'(1x,A)')       ' Ionization (1b1, 3a1, 1b2, 2a1, K)'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 H3O+ + OH + eaq- ',(100.0d0),'   %'
        write(110,*)
        write(110,'(1x,A)')       ' Excitation (A1B1, B1A1, Rydberg, diff bands, Collective)'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') ' A1B1          : H + OH           ',(pBR(BRtyp,1)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 H2 + O           ',(pBR(BRtyp,2)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 H2O              ',(pBR(BRtyp,3)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') ' B1A1          : H3O + +OH + eaq- ',(pBR(BRtyp,4)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 H + OH           ',(pBR(BRtyp,5)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 2H + O           ',(pBR(BRtyp,6)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 H2 + O           ',(pBR(BRtyp,7)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 H2 + H2O2        ',(pBR(BRtyp,8)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 H2O              ',(pBR(BRtyp,9)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') ' Rydberg       : H2O* -> H + OH   ',(pBR(BRtyp,10)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 H3O + +OH + eaq- ',(pBR(BRtyp,11)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 H2O              ',(pBR(BRtyp,12)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') ' diffbands     : H3O + +OH + eaq- ',((0.90d0+pBR(BRtyp,17)*0.10d0)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 H + OH           ',(pBR(BRtyp,13)*0.10d0*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') ' Collective    : H3O+ + OH + eaq- ',100.0d0,'   %'
        write(110,*)
        write(110,'(1x,A)')       ' Dissociative electron attachment'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') ' OH- production: H + OH-          ',(pBR(BRtyp,14)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') ' O- production : O- + H2          ',(pBR(BRtyp,15)*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') ' H- production : OH + H2 + OH-    ',(pBR(BRtyp,16)*0.1330d0*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(1x,A,f12.1,A)') '                 OH + 2H + OH-    ',(pBR(BRtyp,16)*0.867d0*100.d0),'   %'
        write(110,'(A)') ' _______________________________________________________________________________'
        write(110,*)

        if(mod(Otyp,10).ne.3)return ! check for developer
        !OPEN(730,FILE='730_mod_event_num.csv')
        !write(730,*)'-,OH,eaq-,H,H3O+,H2,H2O2,HO2,O2,OH-,O2-,HO2-'
        if(Otyp.ne.13)return
        !OPEN(710,FILE='710_mod_event_xyz.csv')
        !write(710,*)'-,i,inie,x,y,z,typ'!
    end subroutine

    subroutine endPhysicoChem(Otyp,nbch,Enum)
        integer,intent(in) :: Otyp,nbch,Enum
        integer :: cnt
        real(8) :: data(nbch*Enum),av(99),sd(99)

       ! g-value (initial yield)
        data=0.0d0
        av=0.0d0
        sd=0.0d0
        do cnt=1,99
        data(:)=grd99(:nbch*Enum,cnt)
            av(cnt)=average(nbch*Enum,data)
            sd(cnt)=stdev(nbch*Enum,data,av(cnt))
        end do

       ! CSV.close     check for developer
        if(mod(Otyp,10).ne.3)return
        !close(730)
        !close(740)
        if(Otyp.ne.13)return
        !close(710)
    end subroutine

    real(8) function average(n,data)
        integer,intent(in) :: n
        real(8),intent(in) :: data(n)
        integer :: cnt

        average=0.0d0
        do cnt=1,n
        average=average+data(cnt)
        end do
        average=average/n
    end function

    real(8) function stdev(n,data,av)
        integer,intent(in) :: n
        real(8),intent(in) :: data(n),av
        integer :: cnt

        stdev=0.0d0
        do cnt=1,n
        stdev=stdev+(av-data(cnt))**2
        end do
        stdev=sqrt(stdev/n)
    end function

    subroutine prePhysicoChem(Otyp)
        integer,intent(in) :: Otyp

        !initialization
        rdnum0=0
        nrd0=0
        h2num0=0
        nh20=0
        if(mod(Otyp,10).ne.3)return
    end subroutine

    subroutine postPhysicoChem(Otyp)
        integer,intent(in) :: Otyp
    end subroutine

    subroutine PhysicoChemDataClear    ! scavenger mode
        h2num0=0
        ! scavenger mode check for developer
        !write(999,*)"## modPhysicoChem.f90"
        !write(999,*)"### PhysicoChemDataClear"
    end subroutine

    subroutine Add_solvent(styp)    ! scavenger mode
        use mtmod
        integer,intent(in) :: styp
        integer :: cnt
        integer :: h2cnt
        integer :: typ
        integer :: grp
        real(8) :: DC,SD

        h2num0=h2num
        allocate(h2typ0(h2num))
        allocate(h2grp0(h2num))
        allocate(h2gen0(h2num))
        allocate(h2pos0(3,h2num))

        do cnt=1,h2num
        !typ=5         !H2
        !typ=14        !Tris
        !typ=15        !DMSO
        h2typ0(cnt)=styp
        h2pos0(1,cnt)=grnd()*h2length
        h2pos0(2,cnt)=grnd()*h2length
        h2pos0(3,cnt)=grnd()*h2length
        h2grp0(cnt)=99
        h2gen0(cnt)=99
        nh20(h2typ0(cnt))=nh20(h2typ0(cnt))+1

        ! scavenger mode check for developer
        !if(cnt<10)write(999,*)"|",h2num,"|",cnt,"|",h2typ0(cnt),"|",h2pos0(1,cnt),"|",h2pos0(2,cnt),"|",h2pos0(3,cnt),"|"
        end do
    end subroutine

    subroutine PhysicoChem(Otyp,inie,lpcnt,bhcnt,nxcnt,trackID,phycnt,phypos,phytyp,physube,regid,KE,phygrp0)
        use mtmod
        integer,intent(in) :: Otyp
        real(8),intent(in) :: inie
        integer,intent(in) :: trackID,lpcnt,bhcnt,nxcnt
        integer,intent(in) :: phycnt
        real(8),intent(in) :: phypos(3,phycnt),physube(phycnt)
        integer,intent(in) :: phytyp(phycnt)
        real(8),intent(in) :: KE              ! deposited energy (by Matsuya, 2021-11-01)
        integer,intent(in) :: regid(phycnt)   ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
        integer,intent(in),optional :: phygrp0(phycnt)

        real(8) :: rn,rn2,rn3,rn4
        integer :: cnt
        integer :: phytypb
        integer :: phygrp(phycnt)
        integer :: d0typ
        real(8) :: bphypos(3),bphysube
        integer :: bphygrp

        !print*,"PhysicoChem"
        if ( present(phygrp0 ) ) then
            phygrp=phygrp0
        else
            phygrp=1
        end if

        nrd0 = 0
        d0typ = 0

        allocate(rdtyp0(phycnt*3))
        allocate(rdpos0(3,phycnt*3))
        allocate(rdgrp0(phycnt*3))
        allocate(rdgen0(phycnt*3))
        allocate(rdregid0(phycnt*3)) ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
        allocate(rdid0(phycnt*3)   ) ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya

        do cnt=1,phycnt
        phytypb=phytyp(cnt)
       !write(250,*)phytyp(cnt)
        rn=grnd()
        rn2=grnd()
        rn3=grnd()
        rn4=grnd()
        bphypos(1) = phypos(1,cnt)
        bphypos(2) = phypos(2,cnt)
        bphypos(3) = phypos(3,cnt)
        bphysube = physube(cnt)
        bphygrp = phygrp(cnt)
        brdregid = regid(cnt)   ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
        select case(phytypb)

        ! ionization
        case(21)
           ! H3O+ + OH    100%
           call H3OppOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)

        ! excitation A1B1
        case(4)
        if (rn<=A1B1(1))then
           ! H + OH
           call HpOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
        else if (rn<=A1B1(2))then
           ! H2 + O
           call H2pO(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
        else
           ! H2O
        endif

        ! excitation B1A1
        case(5)
        if (rn<=B1A1(1))then
            ! H3O+ + OH + eaq-
            call H3OppOHpEaq(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
        else if (rn<=B1A1(2))then
            ! H + OH
            call HpOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
        else if (rn<=B1A1(3))then
            ! 2H + O
            call twoHpO(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
        else if (rn<=B1A1(4))then
            ! H2 + O
            call H2pO(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
        else if (rn<=B1A1(5))then
            ! H2 + H2O2
            call H2pH2O2(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
        else
            ! H2O
        endif

		! Rydberg
        case(6)
        if (rn<=Rydbde(1))then
            ! H + OH
            call HpOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
        else if (rn<=Rydbde(2))then
            ! H3O+ + OH + e-aq-
            call H3OppOHpEaq(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
        else
            ! H2O
        endif

		! diffuse bands
        case(7)
        if (rn<=diffbands(1))then
            ! H + OH
            call HpOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
        else if (rn<=diffbands(2)) then
            ! H3O+ + OH + eaq-
            call H3OppOHpEaq(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
        else
            ! H2O
        endif

	    ! excitation for PHITS-KURBUC mode
        case(18)
        ! A1B1 1.18% (Fr=0.0118)
        if (rn2<=0.0774d0)then
            if (rn<=A1B1(1))then
            ! H + OH
            call HpOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            else if (rn<=A1B1(2))then
            ! H2 + O
            call H2pO(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            else
            ! H2O
        endif
        ! B1A1 0.81% (Fr=0.0081)
        else if (rn2<=0.1305d0)then
            if (rn<=B1A1(1))then
            ! H3O+ + OH + eaq-
            call H3OppOHpEaq(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            else if (rn<=B1A1(2))then
            ! H + OH
            call HpOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            else if (rn<=B1A1(3))then
            ! 2H + O
            call twoHpO(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            else if (rn<=B1A1(4))then
            ! H2 + O
            call H2pO(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            else if (rn<=B1A1(5))then
            ! H2 + H2O2
            call H2pH2O2(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            else
            ! H2O
            endif
        ! Rydberg 2.24% (Fr=0.0224)
        else if (rn2<=0.2774d0)then
            if (rn<=Rydbde(1))then
            ! H + OH
            call HpOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            else if (rn<=Rydbde(2))then
            ! H3O+ + OH + e-aq-
            call H3OppOHpEaq(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            else
            ! H2O
            endif
        ! Diffuse bands 11.02% (Fr=0.1102)
        else if (rn2<=1.0000d0)then
            if (rn<=0.90d0)then   ! PHITS-ETS model: 90% electron release
            ! ionization: H3O+ + OH + eaq-
            call H3OppOHpEaq(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            else if (rn<=(0.90d0+diffbands(1)*0.1d0))then
            ! H + OH
            call HpOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            else if (rn<=(0.90d0+diffbands(2)*0.1d0))then
            ! H3O+ + OH + eaq-    ! auto-ionization
            call H3OppOHpEaq(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            else
			! H2O
            endif
        endif

        ! electron capture for ion
        case(19)
            call H3OppOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)

        ! electron loss for ion
        case(20)
            nrd0(99)=nrd0(99)+1
            call SubexcitationElectron(cnt,bphysube,bphypos,bphygrp)

        ! dissociative electron attachment
        case(31)
            ! H2O + e- -> H + OH-  (3%)
            if (rn<=DEA(1))then
                call OHmpH(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            ! H2O + e- -> O- + H2  (11.5%)
            else if (rn<=DEA(2))then
                call OmpH2(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            else if (rn<=DEA(3))then
            ! H2O + e- -> H- + OH  (85.5%)
            ! H- + H2O -> 2H + OH-
            ! H- + H2O -> H2 + OH-
            if (rn2<=0.1330d0)then
                call H2pOHpOHm(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            else if (rn2<=1.00d0)then
                call OHp2HpOHm(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            end if
            end if

        ! hydrated electron
        case(99)
            nrd0(99)=nrd0(99)+1
            call SubexcitationElectron(cnt,bphysube,bphypos,bphygrp)
            case default

        end select
        end do

        nrd98(trackID,:)=nrd0
        if(mod(Otyp,10)==3)then
            grd0=0.d0
            grd0=dble(nrd0)/(KE)*100
            grd98(trackID,:)=grd0
        endif

        nrd99(trackID,:)=nrd0

        if(mod(Otyp,10)==3)then
            do cnt=1,13
            if(nrd0(cnt)==0)then
               grd0(cnt)=0.0d0
            else
               grd0(cnt)=dble(nrd0(cnt))/(KE)*100
            end if
            end do

        grd99(trackID,:)=grd0
        ! for primary yield 0psec in phits_tsmode.out (by Matsuya 2022-08-21)--------
        !write(150,'(I7,2I12,15ES12.3)')lpcnt,bhcnt,nxcnt,inie,KE,grd0(1),grd0(99),grd0(3),grd0(4)  &
        !           ,grd0(5),grd0(6),grd0(7),grd0(8),grd0(9),grd0(10),grd0(11),grd0(12),grd0(13)
        !write(110,'(I7,2I12,15ES12.3)')lpcnt,bhcnt,nxcnt,inie,KE,grd0(1),grd0(99),grd0(3)&
        !           ,grd0(4),grd0(5),grd0(6),grd0(7),grd0(8),grd0(9),grd0(10),grd0(11),grd0(12),grd0(13)
        !-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        endif

        if(Otyp==13)then   ! check for developer
        do cnt=1,rdnum0
        !print*,"PhysicoChem",phycnt,cnt,rdtyp0(cnt),rdpos0(1,cnt),rdpos0(2,cnt),rdpos0(3,cnt)
        !write(710,*)trackID,',',cnt,',',inie,',',rdpos0(1,cnt),',',rdpos0(2,cnt),',',rdpos0(3,cnt),',',rdtyp0(cnt)
        end do
        endif

     end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   H2O* -> H2 + O generator
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine H2pO(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3
            integer :: typ1,typ2,typ3
            d1=0.51
            SD1=d1/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ1=4
            d2=0.06
            SD2=d2/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ2=12
            call RadicalGenerator2(cnt,bphypos,typ1,typ2,bphygrp,d1,d2,SD1,SD2)            !fix yoshii 20230612
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   H2O* -> 2H + O generator
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine twoHpO(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp) !2H + O
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3
            integer :: typ1,typ2,typ3
            d1=0.71
            SD1=d1/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ1=3
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ1,bphygrp,d1,SD1)
            d1=0.71
            SD1=d1/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ1=3
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ1,bphygrp,d1,SD1)
            d2=0.09
            SD2=d2/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ2=12
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ2,bphygrp,d2,SD2)
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   H2O+ -> H3O+ + OH generator  (model: DBreak system by Tomita et al. 1997)
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine H3OppOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3
            integer :: typ1,typ2,typ3
            d1=1.25d0
            SD1=d1/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ1=4
            d2 = 0.29d0
            SD2=d2/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ2=1
            call RadicalGenerator4(cnt,bphypos,typ1,typ2,bphygrp,d1,d2,SD1,SD2)
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   H2O* -> H + OH generator  (model: KURBUC by Uehara et al. 2006)
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine HpOH(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3
            integer :: typ1,typ2,typ3
            d1=0.04833d0   ! need to check in the future
            SD1=d1/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ1=1
            d2=0.821666d0  ! need to check in the future
            !SD2=0.75
            SD2=d2/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ2=3
            call RadicalGenerator2(cnt,bphypos,typ1,typ2,bphygrp,d1,d2,SD1,SD2)
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   H2O* -> H2 + H2O2 generator  (model: KURBUC by Uehara et al. 2006)
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine H2pH2O2(cnt,bphypos,bphygrp)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3
            integer :: typ1,typ2,typ3
            d1=0.36d0
            SD1=d1/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ1=5
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ1,bphygrp,d1,SD1)
            d2=0.0d0
            SD2=d2/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ2=6
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ2,bphygrp,d2,SD2)
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   H2O+ + sube -> !H3O+ + OH + eaq-  (auto ionization)
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine H3OppOHpEaq(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3),bphysube
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: e1,e2,e3,DC,d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3
            integer :: typ1,typ2,typ3
            d1=0.0d0
            SD1=0.0d0
            typ1=4
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ1,bphygrp,d1,SD1)
            d2=0.29d0
            SD2=d2/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ2=1
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ2,bphygrp,d2,SD2)
            e1=bphysube-10.9        !ref. JAERI-memo08-145 p46
            e2=e1*e1
            e3=e2*e1
            d3=3.151+e1*0.964+e2*1.362-e3*0.134
            SD3=d3
            typ3=2
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ3,bphygrp,d3,SD3)
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   2H2O + e- -> OH + H2 + OH- (DEA model in Geant4-DNA  (Bernal et al.2015))
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine H2pOHpOHm(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3),bphysube
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3
            integer :: typ1,typ2,typ3
            d1=0.03d0
            SD1=d1/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ1=5
            d2=0.29d0
            SD2=d2/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ2=1
            d3=0.29d0
            SD3=d3/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ3=9
            call RadicalGenerator3(cnt,bphypos,typ1,typ2,typ3,bphygrp,d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3)
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   2H2O + e- -> OH + 2H + OH- (DEA model in PHITS)
!******************************************************************************

    subroutine OHp2HpOHm(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3),bphysube
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: d1,d2,d3,d4,SD1,SD2,SD3,SD4
            integer :: typ1,typ2,typ3,typ4
            d1=0.71
            SD1=d1/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ1=3
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ1,bphygrp,d1,SD1)
            d2=0.29d0
            !SD2=0.75
            SD2=d2/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ2=1
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ2,bphygrp,d2,SD2)
            d3=0.71
            SD3=d3/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ3=3
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ3,bphygrp,d3,SD3)
            d4=0.29d0
            SD4=d4/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ4=9
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   H2O + e- -> O- + H2 (DEA model in PHITS)
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine OmpH2(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3),bphysube
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3
            integer :: typ1,typ2,typ3
            d1=0.03d0
            SD1=d1/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ1=5
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ1,bphygrp,d1,SD1)
            d2=0.09    ! need to check in the future study
            SD2=d2/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ2=13
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ2,bphygrp,d2,SD2)
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   H2O + e- -> OH- + H ̇ (DEA model in PHITS)
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine OHmpH(cnt,bphypos,bphysube,bphygrp)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3),bphysube
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3
            integer :: typ1,typ2,typ3
            d1=0.71
            SD1=d1/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ1=3
            call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ1,bphygrp,d1,SD1)
            d2=0.29d0
            SD2=d2/sqrt(3.0d0)
            typ2=9
            !call RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ2,bphygrp,d2,SD2)
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   Radical generator algorithms
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine RadicalGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ,bphygrp,d1,SD)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            integer,intent(in) :: typ
            real(8),intent(in) :: d1,SD
            rdnum0=rdnum0+1
            rdtyp0(rdnum0)=typ
            rdgrp0(rdnum0)=bphygrp
            rdgen0(rdnum0)=1
            rdpos0(:,rdnum0)=bphypos(:)
            rdregid0(rdnum0)=brdregid ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdid0(rdnum0)=rdnum0      ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			mxrdid0 = rdnum0          ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            call BrownMotion(rdpos0(1,rdnum0),rdpos0(2,rdnum0),rdpos0(3,rdnum0),d1,SD)
            nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))=nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))+1
        end subroutine

        subroutine RadicalGenerator2(cnt,bphypos,typ1,typ2,bphygrp,d1,d2,SD1,SD2)
            use mtmod
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            integer,intent(in) :: typ1,typ2
            real(8),intent(in) :: d1,d2
            real(8),intent(in) :: SD1,SD2
            real(8) :: swx,swy,swz
            real(8) :: da,db
            real(8) :: PAI2=6.28318531
            !001
            rdnum0=rdnum0+1
            rdtyp0(rdnum0)=typ1
            rdgrp0(rdnum0)=bphygrp
            rdgen0(rdnum0)=1
            rdregid0(rdnum0)=brdregid ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdid0(rdnum0)= rdnum0     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			mxrdid0 = rdnum0          ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            call BrownMotion0(swx,swy,swz)
            da=d1+SD1*(sqrt(-2.0*log(grnd()))*sin(PAI2*grnd()))
            rdpos0(1,rdnum0)=bphypos(1)+swx*da
            rdpos0(2,rdnum0)=bphypos(2)+swy*da
            rdpos0(3,rdnum0)=bphypos(3)+swz*da
            nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))=nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))+1
            !002
            rdnum0=rdnum0+1
            rdtyp0(rdnum0)=typ2
            rdgrp0(rdnum0)=bphygrp
            rdgen0(rdnum0)=1
            rdregid0(rdnum0)=brdregid ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdid0(rdnum0)= rdnum0     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			mxrdid0 = rdnum0          ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            db=d2+SD2*(sqrt(-2.0*log(grnd()))*sin(PAI2*grnd()))
            rdpos0(1,rdnum0)=bphypos(1)-swx*db
            rdpos0(2,rdnum0)=bphypos(2)-swy*db
            rdpos0(3,rdnum0)=bphypos(3)-swz*db
            nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))=nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))+1
        end subroutine

        subroutine RadicalGenerator3(cnt,bphypos,typ1,typ2,typ3,bphygrp,d1,d2,d3,SD1,SD2,SD3)
            use mtmod
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            integer,intent(in) :: typ1,typ2,typ3
            real(8),intent(in) :: d1,d2,d3
            real(8),intent(in) :: SD1,SD2,SD3
            real(8) :: swx,swy,swz
            real(8) :: swx2,swy2,swz2
            real(8) :: da,db
            real(8) :: PAI2=6.28318531
            !001
            rdnum0=rdnum0+1
            rdtyp0(rdnum0)=typ1
            rdgrp0(rdnum0)=bphygrp
            rdgen0(rdnum0)=1
            rdregid0(rdnum0)=brdregid ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdid0(rdnum0)= rdnum0     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			mxrdid0 = rdnum0          ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            call BrownMotion0(swx,swy,swz)
            da=d1+SD1*(sqrt(-2.0*log(grnd()))*sin(PAI2*grnd()))
            rdpos0(1,rdnum0)=bphypos(1)+swx*da
            rdpos0(2,rdnum0)=bphypos(2)+swy*da
            rdpos0(3,rdnum0)=bphypos(3)+swz*da
            nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))=nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))+1
            !002
            rdnum0=rdnum0+1
            rdtyp0(rdnum0)=typ2
            rdgrp0(rdnum0)=bphygrp
            rdgen0(rdnum0)=1
            rdregid0(rdnum0)=brdregid ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdid0(rdnum0)= rdnum0     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			mxrdid0 = rdnum0          ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            call BrownMotion0(swx2,swy2,swz2)
            db=d2+SD2*(sqrt(-2.0*log(grnd()))*sin(PAI2*grnd()))
            rdpos0(1,rdnum0)=bphypos(1)-swx*da-swx2*db
            rdpos0(2,rdnum0)=bphypos(2)-swy*da-swy2*db
            rdpos0(3,rdnum0)=bphypos(3)-swz*da-swz2*db
            nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))=nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))+1
            !003
            rdnum0=rdnum0+1
            rdtyp0(rdnum0)=typ3
            rdgrp0(rdnum0)=bphygrp
            rdgen0(rdnum0)=1
            rdregid0(rdnum0)=brdregid ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdid0(rdnum0)= rdnum0     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			mxrdid0 = rdnum0          ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            db=d3+SD3*(sqrt(-2.0*log(grnd()))*sin(PAI2*grnd()))
            rdpos0(1,rdnum0)=bphypos(1)-swx*da+swx2*db
            rdpos0(2,rdnum0)=bphypos(2)-swy*da+swy2*db
            rdpos0(3,rdnum0)=bphypos(3)-swz*da+swz2*db
            nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))=nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))+1
        end subroutine

        subroutine RadicalGenerator4(cnt,bphypos,typ1,typ2,bphygrp,d1,d2,SD1,SD2)
            use mtmod
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            integer,intent(in) :: typ1,typ2
            real(8),intent(in) :: d1,d2
            real(8),intent(in) :: SD1,SD2
            real(8) :: swx,swy,swz
            real(8) :: da,db
            real(8) :: PAI2=6.28318531
            !001
            rdnum0=rdnum0+1
            rdtyp0(rdnum0)=typ1
            rdgrp0(rdnum0)=bphygrp
            rdgen0(rdnum0)=1
            rdregid0(rdnum0)=brdregid ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdid0(rdnum0)= rdnum0     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			mxrdid0 = rdnum0          ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            call BrownMotion0(swx,swy,swz)
            da=d1+SD1*(sqrt(-2.0*log(grnd()))*sin(PAI2*grnd()))
            rdpos0(1,rdnum0)=bphypos(1)+swx*da
            rdpos0(2,rdnum0)=bphypos(2)+swy*da
            rdpos0(3,rdnum0)=bphypos(3)+swz*da
            nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))=nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))+1
            !002
            rdnum0=rdnum0+1
            rdtyp0(rdnum0)=typ2
            rdgrp0(rdnum0)=bphygrp
            rdgen0(rdnum0)=1
            rdregid0(rdnum0)=brdregid ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdid0(rdnum0)= rdnum0     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			mxrdid0 = rdnum0          ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            call BrownMotion0(swx,swy,swz)
            db=d2+SD2*(sqrt(-2.0*log(grnd()))*sin(PAI2*grnd()))
            rdpos0(1,rdnum0)=rdpos0(1,rdnum0-1)+swx*db
            rdpos0(2,rdnum0)=rdpos0(2,rdnum0-1)+swy*db
            rdpos0(3,rdnum0)=rdpos0(3,rdnum0-1)+swz*db
            nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))=nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))+1
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   sub e- -> eaq- (model: KURBUC code by Terrissol 1990 & Uehara 2006
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine SubexcitationElectron(cnt,e,bphypos,bphygrp)
            use mtmod
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: e
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            real(8) :: e0,e1,e2,e3,rr,pesc,DC,SD
            real(8) :: d1,d2,SD1,SD2
            integer :: typ1,typ2

            !Terrissol et al. 1990, Uehara et al. 2006
            if(e>7.4)then
                print*,"Ecut>7.4 ",e
                e0=7.4
            else
                e0=e
            end if
            e1=e0
            e2=e1*e1
            e3=e2*e1
            rr=3.151+e1*0.964+e2*1.362-e3*0.134
            pesc=exp(-rc/rr)
            !print*,e,rc,rr,pesc,"pesc"
            d1 = rr
            SD1=d1/2.0
            typ1=2
            call HydratedElectronGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ1,bphygrp,d1,SD1)
            if(pesc>=grnd())then
            else
                !recombination (A1B1 !H + OH) considered in PHITS physical processes
                d1=0.04833d0
                SD1=0.75
                typ1=1
                d2=0.821666d0
                SD2=0.75
                typ2=3
                !call RadicalGenerator2(cnt,phypos,typ1,typ2,phygrp,d1,d2,SD1,SD2) !Matsuya 230615
            end if
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   Hydrated electron generator algorithms
!******************************************************************************

        subroutine HydratedElectronGenerator(cnt,bphypos,typ,bphygrp,DC,SD)
            integer,intent(in) :: cnt
            real(8),intent(in) :: bphypos(3)
            integer,intent(in) :: bphygrp
            integer,intent(in) :: typ
            real(8),intent(in) :: DC,SD
            rdnum0=rdnum0+1
            rdtyp0(rdnum0)=typ
            rdgrp0(rdnum0)=bphygrp
            rdgen0(rdnum0)=1
            rdregid0(rdnum0)=brdregid ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            rdid0(rdnum0)= rdnum0     ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
			mxrdid0 = rdnum0          ! 2024-04-10 Matsuya
            nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))=nrd0(rdtyp0(rdnum0))+1
            rdpos0(:,rdnum0)=bphypos(:)
            call BrownMotion(rdpos0(1,rdnum0),rdpos0(2,rdnum0),rdpos0(3,rdnum0),DC,SD)
        end subroutine

!******************************************************************************
!   Brown motion algorithms
!******************************************************************************

        SUBROUTINE BrownMotion(x1,y1,z1,d1,sd)
            use mtmod
            real(8),intent(inout) :: x1,y1,z1
            real(8),intent(in) :: d1,sd
            real(8) :: swx,swy,swz
            real(8) :: d
            real(8) :: PAI2=6.28318531

            call BrownMotion0(swx,swy,swz)
            !Box?Muller's method !https://mathtrain.jp/boxmuller
            d=d1+sd*(sqrt(-2.0*log(grnd()))*sin(PAI2*grnd()))

            x1=x1+swx*d1
            y1=y1+swy*d1
            z1=z1+swz*d1
        END SUBROUTINE BrownMotion

        SUBROUTINE BrownMotion0(swx,swy,swz)
            use mtmod
            real(8),intent(out) :: swx,swy,swz
            real(8) :: sinthe,pi2rn,d
            real(8) :: PAI=3.14159265
            real(8) :: PAI2=6.28318531

            swz=grnd()*2.0-1.0
            sinthe=sqrt(1.0-swz*swz)
            pi2rn=pai2*grnd()
            swx=sinthe*cos(pi2rn)
            swy=sinthe*sin(pi2rn)
        END SUBROUTINE BrownMotion0

    end module
!******************************************************************************
END_FILE

FILE: ChemCode/mod/modrandom.f90
BEGIN_FILE
module mtmod
        private
        public :: sgrnd,grnd
        integer :: seed
        integer :: iran
        real(8) :: rnfb,rnfs,rngb,rngs,rnmult,ranj
        integer :: rani,nstrid,inif
        real(8) :: rijk,rans,ranb

        integer*8 :: iranji64
        integer*8 :: iransb64
   contains
   !initialization
        subroutine sgrnd(seed0)
            implicit none
            integer, intent(in) :: seed0

            iran=5
            seed=seed0
            if(seed>1234567891)stop "seed>1234567891"
            call setrnd(seed)
        end subroutine sgrnd

        real(8) function grnd()
            implicit none
            real(8) :: p6
            integer :: rtyp=1

            if(rtyp==1)then
                p6=rang_LCG()            !PHITS-LCG
            elseif(rtyp==2)then
                p6=rang_xorshift64()     !PHITS-xorshift64
            elseif(rtyp==3)then
                p6=rangd(seed)           !DMCC
            else
                call rangw(seed,iran,p6) !WLT
            endif
            grnd=p6
        end function grnd

!************************************************************************
!************************************************************************
        subroutine setrnd(seed)
!************************************************************************
            implicit none
            integer,intent(in) :: seed

            if( inif .eq. 0 ) call advijk
            inif = 0
            rans = seed

            iranji64 = transfer(seed,iranji64)
            iransb64 = iranji64
            call setrnd_LCG()
            call setrnd_xorshift()
        end subroutine

!************************************************************************
        subroutine setrnd_LCG()
!************************************************************************
!   controls for the pseudo-random number sequence
!   when nrandgen=0; Linear Congruential Generator is used.
!
!   andkk: rseed(>0) specified in [parameters]
! ----------------------------------------------------------------------
            implicit none
   !        include 'err.inc'
            real(8),parameter:: fb=13008944d0,fs=170125d0,gb=1136868d0, &
                        gs=6328637d0,p=2d0**24,q=2d0**(-24),rm=5d0**19
            real(8) :: a,b
            integer :: dbcn(14)
            integer :: i,ii

            data dbcn/14*0.d0/
            rans=seed
            nstrid=152917
            rnfb=fb
            rnfs=fs
            rngb=gb
            rngs=gs
            rnmult=rm
            inif=0
!   set new random number multiplier, rnmult, if required.
!   rngb and rngs are the upper and lower 24 bits of rnmult.
            if(dbcn(13)+dbcn(14).le.0.)then
            else
                    if(dbcn(14).gt.0.)rnmult=dbcn(14)
                    if(aint((rnmult+.5)*.5).eq.aint((rnmult+1.5)*.5)) then
                    end if
                    rngb=aint(rnmult*q)
                    rngs=rnmult-rngb*p
                    if(rngb+rngs.ge.p) then
                    end if
!!   get rnfb (upper 24 bits) and rnfs (lower 24 bits) of
!   rnmult**nstrid which is used in advijk to advance the random
!   number by nstrid random numbers for each history.
                    if(dbcn(13).gt.0.)nstrid=dbcn(13)
                    rnfb=rngb
                    rnfs=rngs
                    ii=nstrid-1
                    if(ii<1)ii=1
                    do i=1,ii
                       a=rngs*rnfs
                       b=(rngb*rnfs-aint(rngb*rnfs*q)*p)   &
                            +(rngs*rnfb-aint(rngs*rnfb*q)*p)+aint(a*q)
                       rnfs=a-aint(a*q)*p
                    end do
                    rnfb=b-aint(b*q)*p
            end if
!   set the first random number, rijk, composed of
!   ranj (top 24 bits) and rani (bottom 24 bits).
            rijk=rnmult
            if(dbcn(1).gt.0.)rijk=dbcn(1)
            if(dbcn(1)+dbcn(8).ne.0.)inif=1

            rani=aint(rijk*q)
            ranj=rijk-rani*p
            if( inif .eq. 0 ) call advijk ! when rseed was not specified
            call advijk
            dbcn(1)=0.
            dbcn(8)=0.
            return
        end subroutine

!************************************************************************
        subroutine setrnd_xorshift()
!************************************************************************
            implicit none
            real*8 :: rijk,rans,ranb,randkk
            real*8 :: rnfb,rnfs,rngb,rngs,rnmult,ranj,rani,rnrtc
            integer :: nstrid,inif
            real*8 :: bitrseed

            bitrseed = 6647299061401.d0
            rijk = bitrseed
            iranji64 = transfer(rijk,iranji64)
        end subroutine

!************************************************************************
        subroutine advijk
!************************************************************************
            implicit double precision (a-h,o-z)
            call advijk_LCG
            call advijk_xorshift64
        end subroutine

!************************************************************************
        subroutine advijk_LCG
!************************************************************************
!   advijk_LCG and rang_LCG (below) are pseudo-random number generator
!   based on algorithm of Linear Congruential Generator.
!   Reference: R. Picard and T. Booth [LA-UR-08-06204]
!   period length is 2**46
!
!   ranj is the lower 24 bits of rijk, rani is the upper 24 bits.
! ----------------------------------------------------------------------
            implicit double precision (a-h,o-z)
            parameter (p=2d0**24,q=2d0**(-24))

            a=rnfs*ranj
            b=(rnfb*ranj-aint(rnfb*ranj*q)*p) &
             +(rnfs*rani-aint(rnfs*rani*q)*p)+aint(a*q)
            ranj=a-aint(a*q)*p
            rani=b-aint(b*q)*p
            rijk=rani*p+ranj
            return
        end subroutine

!************************************************************************
        subroutine advijk_xorshift64
!************************************************************************
!   advijk_xorshift64 and rang_xorshift64 (below) are pseudo-random
!   number generator based on algorithm of xorshift.
!   These period lengths of xorshift64 and xorshift32 are 2**64-1.
!   Binary matrixes T=(I+L^a)(I+R^b)(I+L^c) with two sets
!   [a,b,c] =[13,7,17] and [29,27,37] are used for advijk and rang, respectively.
!
!   References:
!    G. Marsaglia, 2003. Xorshift RNGs. Journal of Statistical Software. 8, 14, 1-6,
!   and webpage for introduction and verification of this paper
!   [https://admiswalker.blogspot.com/2018/06/marsaglia-g-2003-xorshift-rngs.html
!   (in Japanese, 2020.1.29 accessed)]
! ----------------------------------------------------------------------
            implicit none
            real*8 :: rijk,rans,ranb
            integer*8 :: it
            real*8 :: rnfb,rnfs,rngb,rngs,rnmult,ranj,rani,rnrtc
            integer :: nstrid,inif

            it = xor(iranji64,ishft(iranji64,13))
            it = xor(it,ishft(it,-7))
            iranji64 = xor(it,ishft(it,17))
            rijk = transfer(iranji64,rijk)
        end subroutine

!************************************************************************
!************************************************************************
        real(8) function rang_LCG()           !PHITS
!************************************************************************
            implicit double precision (a-h,o-z)
            parameter (p=2d0**24,q=2d0**(-24),r=2d0**(-48))
! -----------------------------------!
!   rang()=mod(2**48*rang()*rnmult,2**48)
!   split rang() and rnmult into upper and lower 24-bit halves,
!   ranb,rans,rngb,rngs, respectively, to achieve 96-bit precision.
!   this expression for b is invalid unless rngb+rngs < 2**24
!   or unless the more elaborate expression of advijk is used.
!
            a=rngs*rans
            b=rngb*rans+rngs*ranb+aint(a*q)
            rans=a-aint(a*q)*p
            ranb=b-aint(b*q)*p
            rang_LCG=(ranb*p+rans)*r
            return
        end function

!************************************************************************
!************************************************************************
        real(8) function rang_xorshift64()     !PHITS
!************************************************************************
            implicit none
            real*8 :: r01
            real*8 :: rijk,rans,ranb
            integer*8 :: it
            integer*4 :: i32
            real*8 :: bit32, period
            parameter (bit32=2d0**32, period=2d0**32-1)

            it = xor(iransb64,ishft(iransb64,29))
            it = xor(it,ishft(it,-27))
            iransb64 = xor(it,ishft(it,37))
            i32 = ibits(iransb64,32,32)
            if ( i32.eq.0 ) i32 = ibits(iransb64,0,32)
            r01 = dble(i32)
            if ( i32.lt.0 ) r01 = r01+bit32
            rang_xorshift64 = r01/period
        end function

!************************************************************************
!************************************************************************
        function rangd(idum)                   !DMCC
!************************************************************************
            INTEGER,intent(inout) :: idum
            integer :: IM1,IM2,IMM1,IA1,IA2,IQ1,IQ2,IR1,IR2,NTAB,NDIV

            REAL :: AM,EPS,RNMX
            INTEGER,save ::idum2,iv(32),iy
            integer ::j,k

            PARAMETER (IM1=2147483563,IM2=2147483399,AM=1./IM1,IMM1=IM1-1,&
                IA1=40014,IA2=40692,IQ1=53668,IQ2=52774,IR1=12211,IR2=3791,&
                NTAB=32,NDIV=1+IMM1/NTAB,EPS=1.2e-7,RNMX=1.-EPS)
            DATA idum2/123456789/, iv/NTAB*0/, iy/0/

            if (idum.le.0) then
                    idum=max(-idum,1)
                    idum2=idum
                    do j=NTAB+8,1,-1
                       k=idum/IQ1
                       idum=IA1*(idum-k*IQ1)-k*IR1
                       if (idum.lt.0) idum=idum+IM1
                       if (j.le.NTAB) iv(j)=idum
                    end do
                    iy=iv(1)
                    print*,"idum<0"
            endif
            k=idum/IQ1
            idum=IA1*(idum-k*IQ1)-k*IR1
            if (idum.lt.0) idum=idum+IM1
            k=idum2/IQ2
            idum2=IA2*(idum2-k*IQ2)-k*IR2
            if (idum2.lt.0) idum2=idum2+IM2
            j=1+iy/NDIV
            iy=iv(j)-idum
            iv(j)=idum
            if(iy.lt.1)iy=iy+IMM1
            rangd=min(AM*iy,RNMX)
            return
        end function

!************************************************************************
!************************************************************************
        subroutine rangw(ix,n,ax)              !WLT
!************************************************************************
            integer,intent(inout) :: ix   !seed
            integer,intent(in) :: n        !
            real(8),intent(out) :: ax
            real(8) :: a(30)
            real(8) :: aa=32771.d0 ,b=1234567891.d0, x
            real(8) :: c=2147483648.d0, ci=4.6566128730773925d-10

            x=dble(ix)
            do i=1,n
                    x=dmod(aa*x+b,c)
                    a(i)=x*ci
            end do
            ax=a(n)
            ix=idint(x)
        end subroutine
!************************************************************************
   end module mtmod
END_FILE

FILE: ChemCode/readme-eng.txt
