!////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

   include'mod/moddamageSDD.f90'
   include'mod/modclesions.f90'

   program main
      use moddamageyield
      use modcDamage
      implicit none

      integer:: cas,bat,itype,kf,cell
      real(8):: eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt,miene,miene2,sume
      integer:: ndata,ncas,nbat,nprl,nprl2,totprl
      integer:: ievent(1000000),cevent
      integer:: cnt,cnt2,cnt3,cnt4,cnt5,cntp,cntpp,neve,moni,bchcnt
      real   :: t1,t2
      integer:: PTSF,SDD,EOH,seed,DNAunit,ccptyp,CLUS
      integer:: access, status
      character(16):: f, linebuf

      real(8):: cpos(3,1000000),csube(1000000),KE,ckine,mckine
      integer:: ctype(1000000),tID,PDG
      integer:: nion,nexc,ndea,nvib,npho,nrot,natint,nmol

      integer:: cntlesion                    ! total damage (for SDD format)
      real(8):: Eps,SSBind,DSBind,BDind,Rsb  ! DNA damage parameters
      integer:: class,tSB1,tSB2,tSB3,cause   ! SDD format parameters
      real(8):: depe,totanum,totAI,totKE,totSSBind,totDSBind
      real(8):: fracDSB(4)                   ! fraction of clustered damage

!<<<<<<<<< User setting parameters >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>
     ! [Biological factor]
        DNAunit = 1       ! Unit of strand break yield: 1:/Gy/Da, 2:/Gy/bp
        ccptyp = 2        ! cell cycle: 0:G0/G1, 1:Plateau, 2:Logarithmic phase
        CLUS = 1          ! complex damage (D=1): 0:off, 1:on
     ! [Seed for random number]
        seed = 4537       ! seed for random number
     ! [Output file]
        PTSF = 1          ! PHITStsmode original output: 0:off, 1:on
        SDD = 1           ! SDD format: 0:off, 1:on
        EOH = 1           ! SDD data Section: 0:no data, 1:all, 2:minimal
     ! [Monitor]
        moni = 1          ! Number of particles users want to monitor in concole
!<<<<<<<<< END user setting >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

      !---Open file------------------------------------------
          open(100,file='event.d',status='old')
          f = 'log.out'
          Eps = 3.4d0       ! 10 base pair (bp) (fixed value)
          status = access(f, ' ')
          if( status .ne. 0 )then
          open(120,file='log.out')
          if(PTSF==1)then
          open(110,file='phits_tsmode.out')
          open(150,file='tsmode_temp.out')
          call iniCluster(Eps,seed,DNAunit,CLUS)
          end if
          if(SDD==1)then
          open(130,file='SDDv1_phits.out')
          open(140,file='SDDv1_temp.out')
          end if
          bchcnt = 1
		  nprl = 0
		  miene = 0.0d0
          write(120,*) bchcnt
		  write(120,*) nprl
		  write(120,'(es12.3)') miene
          write(120,*)'>>>> Loop; particle; mean in-energy'
		  close(120)
          end if
          if( status .eq. 0 )then
          if(PTSF==1)then
          open(150,file='tsmode_temp.out',status='old')
          open(110,file='phits_tsmode.out',status='old')
          call iniCluster(Eps,seed,DNAunit,CLUS)
          do
          ! ** if you want to change output data, please modify below ******
		      if(CLUS==1)then
              read (150,*,end=3500) cnt3,cnt2,cnt,ckine,KE,SSBind,DSBind,&
                                fracDSB(1),fracDSB(2),fracDSB(3),fracDSB(4)
		      write(110,'(i8,i9,i9,6es12.3)') cnt3,cnt2,cnt,ckine,KE,SSBind,DSBind,fracDSB(1)
		      else
		      read (150,*,end=3500) cnt3,cnt2,cnt,ckine,KE,SSBind,DSBind
              write(110,'(i8,i9,i9,2es12.3,3es12.3)') cnt3,cnt2,cnt,ckine,KE,SSBind,DSBind
		      end if
          ! ****************************************************************
          end do
          3500 continue
          close(150)
          end if
          open(120,file='log.out',status='old')
          read(120,*) cnt
		  read(120,*) cnt2
		  read(120,'(es12.3)') eold
          bchcnt = cnt + 1
		  nprl2 = cnt2
		  miene = eold
          close(120)
          open(120,file='log.out',status='replace')
          write(120,*) bchcnt
		  write(120,*) nprl2
		  write(120,'(es12.3)') miene
          write(120,*)'>>>> Loop; particle; mean in-energy'
          close(120)
          if(PTSF==1)then
          open(150,file='tsmode_temp.out',status='old',position='append')
          end if
          if(SDD==1)then
          open(130,file='SDDv1_phits.out',status='old')
          open(140,file='SDDv1_temp.out',status='old',position='append')
          end if
          end if
          ! bchcnt = 1: new calculation, bchcnt > 1: restart

      !======================================================

      !---Initialization of counter--------------------------
         cnt=0     ! counter #1
         cnt2=0    ! counter #2
         cnt3=0    ! counter #3
         ndata=0   ! all interactions per track
         natint=0  ! ion and e-exc per track
		 nprl=0
      !------------------------------------------------------
         call TRACE(nbat,ncas,ndata,nprl)
         call EVENT(nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent)
      !------------------------------------------------------

         call cpu_time(t1)

!<<<< Please modify the below description if you want >>>>
!<<<<<<<<< Main loop for analysing track >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

      do cnt=1,nbat           ! analysis for each bat
      do cnt2=1,ncas          ! analysis for each cas
         cnt3 = cnt3 + 1
         cevent=ievent(cnt3)  ! number of event (bat=cnt, cas=cnt2)

     !<---- Call analytical subroutine ------------------------------------------
       call PRED(cevent,cpos,ctype,csube,ckine,KE,PDG,nion,nexc,ndea,nmol)
       if(PTSF==1)then    ! PHITS tsmode original output (call subroutine)
       call LINKAGE(KE,cnt,cnt3,cevent,ctype,cpos,Eps,DNAunit,SSBind,DSBind)
       call cLINKAGE(KE,cevent,cpos,ctype,cnt4,Eps,fracDSB)
       end if
       if(SDD==1)then     ! SDD format (call subroutine)
       call POSSB(KE,cnt,cnt2,bchcnt,cevent,ctype,cpos,ckine,PDG,ccptyp,Eps,csube,cntlesion,cause)
       end if
     !---------------------------------------------------------------------------

     natint = nion + nexc ! Number of events (ionizations and e-excitations)

     if(PTSF==1)then
     if(natint > 0)then  ! phits_tsmode.out
     ! ** if you want to change output data, please modify below ******
	 if(CLUS==1)then
     write(110,'(i8,i9,i9,6es12.3)') bchcnt,cnt2,cnt,ckine,KE,SSBind,DSBind,fracDSB(1)
     else
     write(110,'(i8,i9,i9,2es12.3,3es12.3)') bchcnt,cnt2,cnt,ckine,KE,SSBind,DSBind
	 end if
     ! ****************************************************************
     end if
     if(KE > 0)then       ! tsmode_temp.out
     ! ** if you want to change output data, please modify below ******
	 if(CLUS==1)then
     write(150,'(i8,i9,i9,9es12.3)') bchcnt,cnt2,cnt,ckine,KE,SSBind,DSBind,&
                                     fracDSB(1),fracDSB(2),fracDSB(3),fracDSB(4)
     else
     write(150,'(i8,i9,i9,2es12.3,3es12.3)') bchcnt,cnt2,cnt,ckine,KE,SSBind,DSBind
	 end if
     ! ****************************************************************
     end if
     end if

     if(mod(cnt3,moni)==0)then
     call cpu_time(t2)
     print '(1x,A,i8,1x,A,1x,i8,1x,A,1x,f5.3,3x,A)',&
          '  track[ ',cnt3,'/',nprl,' ]    cpu time:',t2-t1,'sec'
     call cpu_time(t1)
     end if

     end do
     end do

     if(PTSF==1)then
     call sumLINKAGE(DNAunit,PDG)
     if(CLUS==1)then
     call sumCLUS(DNAunit)
     end if
     end if

!<<<<<<<<< END main loop for analysing track >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

!=== Note of parameters =========================================================
! cevent : number of interactions per track
! ctype  : event ID (10: ion, 11: e-exc, 12:dea, 13: vib, 14: phonon,)
! cpos   : interaction position (x,y,z) (nm)
! csub   : deposited energy (eV)
! KE     : incident particle energy
! nion   : number of ionization per track
! nexc   : number of eletronic excitation per track
! ndea   : number of desociative electron attachment per track
! nvib   : number of vibrational excitation per track
! npho   : number of photon excitation per track
! nrot   : number of rotational excitation per track
! nmol   : number of molecular excitation per track
! SSBind : yield of DNA single-strand breaks (DNA SSB)
! DSBind : yield of DNA single-strand breaks (DNA DSB)
!================================================================================

!<<<<<<<<< Update log file >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

      call meanpartene(nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent,totprl,sume)

      open(120,file='log.out',status='old')
      read(120,*) cnt
	  read(120,*) cnt2
	  read(120,'(es12.3)') eold
      bchcnt = cnt
	  nprl2 = cnt2 + totprl
      miene = ( eold*real(cnt2) + sume*real(totprl) ) / real(nprl2)
      close(120)
      open(120,file='log.out',status='replace')
      write(120,*) bchcnt
	  write(120,*) nprl2
	  write(120,'(es12.3)') miene
      write(120,*)'>>>> Loop; particle; mean in-energy'
      close(120)

!<<<<<<<<< SDD format output >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

      if(SDD==1)then

      print*, ">>> Outputing the SDD format...."
      call SDDformat1(nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent,EOH,ccptyp,miene,nprl2)

      rewind(140)
      do
      read(140,*,end=4000) class,x,y,z,cause,tSB1,tSB2,tSB3,PDG,KE
      x = x / 1000.d0        ! unit: nm -> um
      y = y / 1000.d0        ! unit: nm -> um
      z = z / 1000.d0        ! unit: nm -> um
      KE = KE / 1.d6         ! unit: keV -> MeV
      if(EOH==0)then
      end if
      if(EOH==1)then
      write(130,'(1x,i0,A,3(es12.3,A),i4,A,3(i4,A),2x,i0,A,es12.3,A)') &
           class,';',x,',',y,',',z,';',cause,';',tSB1,',',tSB2,',',tSB3 &
           ,';',PDG,';',KE,';'
      end if
      if(EOH==2)then
      write(130,'(1x,i0,A,3(es12.3,A),3(i4,A),A)') &
      class,';',x,',',y,',',z,';',tSB1,',',tSB2,',',tSB3,';'
      end if
      end do

      4000 continue

      end if

!<<<<<<<<< END SDD output >>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>>

      print*, ">>> DNA damage estimation completed"

      close(100)
      if(PTSF==1)then
      if(CLUS==1)then
      call END2
      else
      call END1
      end if
      close(110)
      close(150)
      end if
      if(SDD==1)then
      close(130)
      end if

   end program main

! <<<The below algorithms for reading output data by the PHITS calculation >>>
!================================================================================
!    CHECK OUTPUT DATA BY PHITS (nbat,ncas,ndata,nprl)
!================================================================================

   subroutine TRACE(nbat,ncas,ndata,nprl)

      integer:: cas,bat,itype,kf,cell
      real(8):: eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
      real(8):: sexc,sold,snew,sx,sy,sz
      integer:: cnt,cnt2,cnt3
      integer,intent(out):: ncas,nbat,nprl,ndata

      ndata=0
      ncas=0
      nbat=0

      print *, ">>> Reading the physical data...."

      do
         ndata=ndata+1
         read (100,*,end=1000) cas,bat,itype,kf,cell,eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
         sexc=eexc*1.d6
         sold=eold*1.d6
         snew=enew*1.d6
         sx=x*1.d7
         sy=y*1.d7
         sz=z*1.d7
         ncas=cas                           ! maxcas in the PHITS calculation
         nbat=bat                           ! batch in the PHITS calculation
         nprl=ncas*nbat                     ! Number of total particles
      end do

   1000 continue
      print '(1x,A,i7)', ">>> total incident particle = ",nprl
      rewind(100)

   end subroutine

   subroutine EVENT(nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent)

      integer:: cas,bat,itype,kf,cell
      real(8):: eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
      integer:: cnt,cnt2,cnt3
      integer,intent(in):: nprl,ncas,nbat
      integer:: nevent(nbat,ncas)
      integer,intent(out):: ievent(nprl)

      nevent=0

      do
         read (100,*,end=998) cas,bat,itype,kf,cell,eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
         nevent(bat,cas)=nevent(bat,cas)+1  ! Record the number of event per track
      end do

   998 continue
      rewind(100)

      cnt3=0

      do cnt=1,nbat
         do cnt2=1,ncas
            cnt3 = cnt3+1
            ievent(cnt3) = nevent(cnt,cnt2) ! Record the number of event per track
         end do
      end do

   end subroutine

   subroutine meanpartene(nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent,totprl,sume)
      integer,intent(in):: nprl,nbat,ncas,ievent(nprl)
	  integer,intent(out):: totprl
	  real(8),intent(out):: sume
      integer:: cnt,cnt2,cnt3,cnt4,cnt5,cas,bat,itype,kf,cell
      real(8):: eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt,KE

      sume=0.d0
      cnt4=0
      cnt5=0
	  totprl=0

      rewind(100)
      do cnt=1,nbat       ! number of batch
      do cnt2=1,ncas      ! number of cas
         cnt4=cnt4+1      ! counter for analyzed particle
         if(ievent(cnt4)>0)then
         cnt5=cnt5+1
         do cnt3=1,ievent(cnt4)
            read (100,*,end=996) cas,bat,itype,kf,cell,eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
            if(cnt3==1)then
               KE=eold
               sume=sume+KE
            end if
         end do
         end if
      end do
      end do

   996 continue
      rewind(100)
      totprl = cnt4
	  sume = sume / dble(totprl)

   end subroutine

!================================================================================
!    PARTIAL READ OF PHITS DATA ccas,cbat,ncas,tID,cpos,ctype,csube,KE)
!================================================================================

   subroutine PRED(cevent,cpos,ctype,csube,ckine,KE,PDG,nion,nexc,ndea,nmol)

      integer:: cas,bat,itype,kf,cell,cnt4,lcnt
      real(8):: eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt

      integer,intent(in):: cevent
      real(8),intent(out):: cpos(3,cevent),csube(cevent),KE,ckine
      integer,intent(out):: ctype(cevent),PDG
      integer,intent(out):: nion,nexc,ndea,nmol

      integer:: nvib,npho,nrot
      real(8):: dvib,dpho,drot,dion,dexc,ddea

      !*** initialization *************************************
      cnt4=0
      nion=0        ! ionization (number)
      nexc=0        ! electronic excitaion (number)
      ndea=0        ! desociative electron attachment (number)
      nvib=0        ! vibrational excitaion (number)
      npho=0        ! phonon excitaion (number)
      nrot=0        ! rotational excitaion (number)
      nmol=0        ! molecular excitaion (number)
      dion=0.d0     ! ionization (energy)
      dexc=0.d0     ! electronic excitaion (energy)
      ddea=0.d0     ! desociative electron attachment (energy)
      dvib=0.d0     ! vibrational excitaion (energy)
      dpho=0.d0     ! phonon excitaion (energy)
      drot=0.d0     ! rotational excitaion (energy)
      sumE=0.d0
      KE=0.d0       ! energy deposited in cell ts-activated
      ckine=0.d0    ! incident particle energy
      !********************************************************

      if(cevent>0)then
         do cnt4=1,cevent
            read (100,*,end=2000) cas,bat,itype,kf,cell,eexc,eold,enew,x,y,z,wgt
            cpos(1,cnt4) = x*1.0d7
            cpos(2,cnt4) = y*1.0d7
            cpos(3,cnt4) = z*1.0d7
            ctype(cnt4)  = itype
            csube(cnt4)  = eexc*1.0d6
            KE = KE + csube(cnt4)  ! calculation of deposited energy target reg
            if(wgt.lt.1.0)then
               KE = KE + enew * 1.0d6
            end if
            if(cnt4==1)then        ! detection of kf-code
               PDG=kf
            end if
            if(itype.ne.0)then
               if(eold>ckine)then
                  ckine = eold * 1.0d6
               end if
            end if
            if(itype==10.0.or.itype==17.0)then
               nion=nion+1         ! counter of ionization
               dion=dion+csube(cnt4)
            end if
            if(itype==11.0.or.itype==18.0)then
               nexc=nexc+1         ! counter of electronic excitaion
               dexc=dexc+csube(cnt4)
            end if
            if(itype==12.0)then    ! counter of desociative electron attachment
               ndea=ndea+1
               ddea=ddea+csube(cnt4)
            end if
            if(itype==13.0)then    ! counter of vibrational excitation
               nvib=nvib+1
               dvib=dvib+csube(cnt4)
            end if
            if(itype==14.0)then    ! counter of photon excitation
               npho=npho+1
               dpho=dpho+csube(cnt4)
            end if
            if(itype==15.0)then    ! counter of rotational excitation
               nrot=nrot+1
               drot=drot+csube(cnt4)
            end if

            if(kf .ne. 11 .or. kf .ne. 2212)then
            !print*, ' WARMING: this analytical code can be used only for electron and proton'
            end if
         end do
      end if

   2000 continue

   end subroutine

!////END/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
END_FILE

FILE: DNAdamage/usrtally.f90
BEGIN_FILE
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
subroutine usrtally(ncol)
!                                                                      *
!      sample subroutine for user defined tally.                       *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!       ncol = 1 : start of calculation                                *
!              2 : end of calculation                                  *
!              3 : end of a batch                                      *
!              4 : source                                              *
!              5 : detection of geometry error                         *
!              6 : recovery of geometry error                          *
!              7 : termination by geometry error                       *
!              8 : termination by weight cut-off                       *
!              9 : termination by time cut-off                         *
!             10 : geometry boundary crossing                          *
!             11 : termination by energy cut-off                       *
!             12 : termination by escape or leakage                    *
!             13 : (n,x) reaction                                      *
!             14 : (n,n'x) reaction                                    *
!             15 : sequential transport only for tally                 *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        In the distributed-memory parallel computing,                 *
!          npe : total number of used Processor Elements               *
!          me : ID number of each processor                            *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        In the shared memory parallel computing,                      *
!          ipomp : ID number of each core                              *
!          npomp : total number of used cores                          *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nocas : current event number in this batch                    :
!        nobch : current batch number                                  *
!        rcasc : real number of NOCAS+maxcas*(NOBCH-1)                 *
!        rsouin : sum of the weight of source particle                 *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        no : cascade id in this event                                 *
!        idmn(mat) : material id                                       *
!        ityp : particle type                                          *
!        ktyp : particle kf-code                                       *
!        jtyp : charge number of the particle                          *
!        mtyp : baryon number of the particle                          *
!        rtyp : rest mass of the particle (MeV)                        *
!        oldwt : weight of the particle at (x,y,z)                     *
!        qs : dE/dx of electron at (x,y,z)                             *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        iblz1 : cell id at (x,y,z)                                    *
!        iblz2 : cell id after crossing                                *
!        ilev1 : level structure id of the cell at (x,y,z)             *
!          ilat1(i,j)                                                  *
!        ilev2 : level structure id of the cell after crossing         *
!          ilat2(i,j)                                                  *
!        costha : cosine of theta on surface crossing                  *
!        uang(1) : x of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        uang(2) : y of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        uang(3) : z of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        nsurf : surface number                                        *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        name(no) : collision number of the particle                   *
!        ncnt(1,no) : values of counter 1                              *
!        ncnt(2,no) : values of counter 2                              *
!        ncnt(3,no) : values of counter 3                              *
!        wt(no) : weight of the particle at (xc,yc,zc)                 *
!        u(no) : x, y, z-components of unit vector of                  *
!        v(no) :momentum of the particle                               *
!        w(no) :                                                       *
!        e(no) : energy of the particle at (x,y,z) (MeV)               *
!        t(no) : time of the particle at (x,y,z) (nsec)                *
!        x(no) : x, y, z-position coordinates of                       *
!        y(no) :the preceding event point (cm)                         *
!        z(no) :                                                       *
!        ec(no) : energy of the particle at (xc,yc,zc) (MeV)           *
!        tc(no) : time of the particle at (xc,yc,zc) (nsec)            *
!        xc(no) : x, y, z-position coordinates of                      *
!        yc(no) :the particle (cm)                                     *
!        zc(no) :                                                      *
!        spx(no) : x, y, z-components of unit vector of                *
!        spy(no) :spin direction of the particle                       *
!        spz(no) :                                                     *
!        nzst(no)                                                      *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nclsts : the number of produced particle and nucleus          *
!        mathz : Z number of the mother nucleus                        *
!        mathn : N number of the mother nucleus                        *
!        jcoll : reaction type id1                                     *
!        kcoll : reaction type id2                                     *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!        jcoll reaction type identifier                                *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        jcoll : =  0, nothing happen                                  *
!                =  1, Hydrogen collisions                             *
!                =  2, Particle Decays                                 *
!                =  3, Elastic collisions                              *
!                =  4, High Energy Nuclear collisions                  *
!                =  5, Heavy Ion reactions                             *
!                =  6, Neutron reactions by data                       *
!                =  7, Photon reactions by data                        *
!                =  8, Electron reactions by data                      *
!                =  9, Proton reactions by data                        *
!                = 10, Neutron event mode                              *
!                = 11, Delta Ray production                            *
!                = 12, Muon interaction                                *
!                = 13, Photon by EGS5                                  *
!                = 14, Electron by EGS5                                *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!        kcoll reaction type identifier                                *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        kcoll : =  0, normal                                          *
!                =  1, high energy fission                             *
!                =  2, high energy absorption                          *
!                =  3, low energy n elastic                            *
!                =  4, low energy n non-elastic                        *
!                =  5, low energy n fission                            *
!                =  6, low energy n absorption                         *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nclsts   : total number of out going particles and nuclei     *
!                                                                      *
!        iclusts(nclsts)                                               *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, nucleus                                        *
!                  = 1, proton                                         *
!                  = 2, neutron                                        *
!                  = 3, pion                                           *
!                  = 4, photon                                         *
!                  = 5, kaon                                           *
!                  = 6, muon                                           *
!                  = 7, others                                         *
!                                                                      *
!        jclusts(i,nclsts)                                             *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, angular momentum                               *
!                  = 1, proton number                                  *
!                  = 2, neutron number                                 *
!                  = 3, ip, see below                                  *
!                  = 4, status of the particle 0: real, <0 : dead      *
!                  = 5, charge                                         *
!                  = 6, baryon number                                  *
!                  = 7, kf code                                        *
!                  = 8, isomer level (0: Ground, 1,2: 1st, 2nd isomer) *
!                                                                      *
!        qclusts(i,nclsts)                                             *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, impact parameter                               *
!                  = 1, px (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 2, py (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 3, pz (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 4, etot = sqrt( p**2 + rm**2 ) (GeV)              *
!                  = 5, rest mass (GeV)                                *
!                  = 6, excitation energy (MeV)                        *
!                  = 7, kinetic energy (MeV)                           *
!                  = 8, weight                                         *
!                  = 9, time                                           *
!                  = 10, x                                             *
!                  = 11, y                                             *
!                  = 12, z                                             *
!                                                                      *
!        jcount(i,nclsts)                                              *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
!        kf code table                                                 *
!                                                                      *
!           kf-code: ityp :  description                               *
!                                                                      *
!             2212 :   1  :  proton                                    *
!             2112 :   2  :  neutron                                   *
!              211 :   3  :  pion (+)                                  *
!              111 :   4  :  pion (0)                                  *
!             -211 :   5  :  pion (-)                                  *
!              -13 :   6  :  muon (+)                                  *
!               13 :   7  :  muon (-)                                  *
!              321 :   8  :  kaon (+)                                  *
!              311 :   9  :  kaon (0)                                  *
!             -321 :  10  :  kaon (-)                                  *
!                                                                      *
!               11 :  12  :  electron                                  *
!              -11 :  13  :  positron                                  *
!               22 :  14  :  photon                                    *
!          1000002 :  15  :  deuteron                                  *
!          1000003 :  16  :  triton                                    *
!          2000003 :  17  :  3he                                       *
!          2000004 :  18  :  alpha                                     *
!      Z*1000000+A :  19  :  nucleus                                   *
!                                                                      *
!           kf-code of the other transport particles (ityp=11)         *
!               12 :         nu_e                                      *
!               14 :         nu_mu                                     *
!              221 :         eta                                       *
!              331 :         eta'                                      *
!             -311 :         k0bar                                     *
!            -2112 :         nbar                                      *
!            -2212 :         pbar                                      *
!             3122 :         Lanbda0                                   *
!             3222 :         Sigma+                                    *
!             3212 :         Sigma0                                    *
!             3112 :         Sigma-                                    *
!             3322 :         Xi0                                       *
!             3312 :         Xi-                                       *
!             3334 :         Omega-                                    *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
use MMBANKMOD
use usrtalmod
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
include 'param00.inc'
include 'param.inc'
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /mpi00/ npe, me
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /cusrtally/ iusrtally, iudtf(50)
common /cudtpara/ udtpara(0:9)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /jcomon/ nabov,nobch,nocas,nomax
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/jcomon/)
common /rcomon/ rcasc
common /icomon/ no,mat,ityp,ktyp,jtyp,mtyp,rtyp
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/icomon/)
common /wtsave/ oldwt
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/wtsave/)
common /tlgeom/ iblz1,iblz2
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlgeom/)
common /tlglat/ ilev1,ilev2,ilat1(5,10),ilat2(5,10)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlglat/)
common /tlcost/ costha, uang(3), nsurf
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlcost/)
common /celdb/  idsn(kvlmax), idtn(kvlmax)
!KN 2012/10/31
common /elect/  uint(3), qs, qo, eint, delc, am, qsex, &
&                nq, ns, n1, noz, mtel
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/elect/)
common /mathzn/ mathz, mathn, jcoll, kcoll
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/mathzn/)
common /clustt/ nclsts, iclusts(nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/clustt/)
common /clustw/ jclusts(0:8,nnn),  qclusts(0:12,nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/clustw/)
common /cntcls/ jcount(3,nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/cntcls/)
common /randtp/ rijk,rans,ranb
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/randtp/)
common /taliin/ rsouin, nzztin, nrgnin
common /kmat1d/ idmn(0:kvlmax), idnm(kvmmax)
integer nudtvar
common /cnudtvar/ nudtvar
common /tstara/ atmrc(10,8)
common / etsminmax / etsmin, etsmax
common / ptsminmax / ptsmin, ptsmax
common / ctsminmax / ctsmin, ctsmax
common / etsexe  / dexc_ene
common / ptsexe  / dep_ene_p
common / ctsexe  / dep_ene_c
real tradyna
io = iudtf(1)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     similar to [t-interact] or [t-star] tally
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ncol .ne. 13 .and. ncol .ne. 14 ) return
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if(atmrc(2,4)+atmrc(3,4).gt.0.0) then                             ! delta-ray
  iatmrc=1
elseif(atmrc(1,1)+atmrc(2,1)+atmrc(3,1)+atmrc(4,1).gt.0.0) then   ! atmflu
  iatmrc=2
elseif(atmrc(1,2)+atmrc(2,2)+atmrc(3,2).gt.0.0) then              ! auger
  iatmrc=3
elseif(atmrc(2,3)+atmrc(3,3)+atmrc(4,3)+atmrc(5,3) &
  &+atmrc(2,5).gt.0.0) then                                          ! brems
  iatmrc=4
elseif(atmrc(1,3).gt.0.0) then                                    ! photoelec
  iatmrc=5
elseif(atmrc(1,4).gt.0.0) then                                    ! compton
  iatmrc=6
elseif(atmrc(1,5)+atmrc(4,5)+atmrc(5,5).gt.0.0) then              ! pairprod
  iatmrc=7
elseif(atmrc(3,5).gt.0.0) then                                    ! annih
  iatmrc=8
elseif(atmrc(6,1)+atmrc(7,1).gt.0.0) then                         ! ets_elas
  iatmrc=9
elseif(atmrc(6,2)+atmrc(7,2).gt.0.0) then                         ! ets_ioniz
  iatmrc=10
elseif(atmrc(6,3)+atmrc(7,3).gt.0.0) then                         ! ets_e-exc
  iatmrc=11
elseif(atmrc(6,4)+atmrc(7,4).gt.0.0) then                         ! ets_dea
  iatmrc=12
elseif(atmrc(6,5)+atmrc(7,5).gt.0.0) then                         ! ets_v-exc
  iatmrc=13
elseif(atmrc(6,6)+atmrc(7,6).gt.0.0) then                         ! ets_p-exc
  iatmrc=14
elseif(atmrc(6,7)+atmrc(7,7).gt.0.0) then                         ! ets_r-exc
  iatmrc=15
elseif(atmrc(8,1)+atmrc(9,1).gt.0.0) then                         ! its_elas
  iatmrc=16
elseif(atmrc(8,2)+atmrc(9,2).gt.0.0) then                         ! its_ioniz
  iatmrc=17
elseif(atmrc(8,3)+atmrc(9,3).gt.0.0) then                         ! its_e-exc
  iatmrc=18
elseif(atmrc(8,4)+atmrc(9,4).gt.0.0) then                         ! its_e-cap
  iatmrc=19
elseif(atmrc(8,5)+atmrc(9,5).gt.0.0) then                         ! its_e-stp
  iatmrc=20
else
  iatmrc=0
endif
qclsum7 = 0.d0
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     electron for latter than version 3.27
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
do ir=1,nudtvar
  if(iatmrc.eq.idnint(udtvar(ir))) then
    if(ktyp.eq.11) then
      tradyna = 1.000E00
      write(io,'(5i10,20es15.6)') nocas,nobch,iatmrc,ktyp,iblz1&
      &  ,dexc_ene,e(no,ipomp+1),ec(no,ipomp+1),x(no,ipomp+1)&
      &  ,y(no,ipomp+1),z(no,ipomp+1),tradyna
      if(nclsts.ge.2) then
        do i = 2, nclsts
          if(qclusts(7,i).lt.etsmin) then
            qclsum7 = qclsum7 + qclusts(7,i)
          end if
        enddo
      endif
      if(qclsum7.gt.0.d0) then
        tradyna = 0.000d0
        write(io,'(5i10,20es15.6)') nocas,nobch,99,ktyp,iblz1&
        &  ,qclsum7,0.0d0,0.0d0,x(no,ipomp+1)&
        &  ,y(no,ipomp+1),z(no,ipomp+1),tradyna
      end if
      if(ec(no,ipomp+1).le.etsmin) then
        tradyna = 0.000d0
        write(io,'(5i10,20es15.6)') nocas,nobch,99,ktyp,iblz1&
        &  ,etsmin,0.0d0,0.0d0,x(no,ipomp+1)&
        &  ,y(no,ipomp+1),z(no,ipomp+1),tradyna
      endif
    endif
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     proton ion for latter than version 3.27
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
    if(ktyp.eq.2212) then
      tradyna = 1.000E00
      write(io,'(5i10,20es15.6)') nocas,nobch,iatmrc,ktyp,iblz1&
      &  ,dexc_ene,e(no,ipomp+1),ec(no,ipomp+1),x(no,ipomp+1)&
      &  ,y(no,ipomp+1),z(no,ipomp+1),tradyna
      if(ec(no,ipomp+1).le.ptsmin) then
        tradyna = 0.000d0
        write(io,'(5i10,20es15.6)') nocas,nobch,99,ktyp,iblz1&
        &  ,ptsmin,0.0d0,0.0d0,x(no,ipomp+1)&
        &  ,y(no,ipomp+1),z(no,ipomp+1),tradyna
      endif
    endif
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     carbon ion for latter than version 3.27
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
    if(ktyp.eq.6000012) then
      tradyna = 1.000E00
      write(io,'(5i10,20es15.6)') nocas,nobch,iatmrc,ktyp,iblz1&
      &  ,dexc_ene,e(no,ipomp+1),ec(no,ipomp+1),x(no,ipomp+1)&
      &  ,y(no,ipomp+1),z(no,ipomp+1),tradyna
      if(ec(no,ipomp+1).le.ctsmin) then
        tradyna = 0.000d0
        write(io,'(5i10,20es15.6)') nocas,nobch,99,ktyp,iblz1&
        &  ,ctsmin,0.0d0,0.0d0,x(no,ipomp+1)&
        &  ,y(no,ipomp+1),z(no,ipomp+1),tradyna
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
      endif
    endif
  endif
enddo
return
end
END_FILE

FILE: scinful-qmd/usrtally.f90
BEGIN_FILE
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
subroutine usrtally(ncol)
!                                                                      *
!        sample subroutine for user defined tally.                     *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!       ncol = 1 : start of calculation                                *
!              2 : end of calculation                                  *
!              3 : end of a batch                                      *
!              4 : source                                              *
!              5 : detection of geometry error                         *
!              6 : recovery of geometry error                          *
!              7 : termination by geometry error                       *
!              8 : termination by weight cut-off                       *
!              9 : termination by time cut-off                         *
!             10 : geometry boundary crossing                          *
!             11 : termination by energy cut-off                       *
!             12 : termination by escape or leakage                    *
!             13 : (n,x) reaction                                      *
!             14 : (n,n'x) reaction                                    *
!             15 : sequential transport only for tally                 *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        In the distributed-memory parallel computing,                 *
!          npe : total number of used Processor Elements               *
!          me : ID number of each processor                            *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        In the shared memory parallel computing,                      *
!          ipomp : ID number of each core                              *
!          npomp : total number of used cores                          *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nocas : current event number in this batch                    :
!        nobch : current batch number                                  *
!        rcasc : real number of NOCAS+maxcas*(NOBCH-1)                 *
!        rsouin : sum of the weight of source particle                 *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        no : cascade id in this event                                 *
!        idmn(mat) : material id                                       *
!        ityp : particle type                                          *
!        ktyp : particle kf-code                                       *
!        jtyp : charge number of the particle                          *
!        mtyp : baryon number of the particle                          *
!        rtyp : rest mass of the particle (MeV)                        *
!        oldwt : weight of the particle at (x,y,z)                     *
!        qs : dE/dx of electron at (x,y,z)                             *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        iblz1 : cell id at (x,y,z)                                    *
!        iblz2 : cell id after crossing                                *
!        ilev1 : level structure id of the cell at (x,y,z)             *
!          ilat1(i,j)                                                  *
!        ilev2 : level structure id of the cell after crossing         *
!          ilat2(i,j)                                                  *
!        costha : cosine of theta on surface crossing                  *
!        uang(1) : x of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        uang(2) : y of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        uang(3) : z of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        nsurf : surface number                                        *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        name(no,ipomp+1) : collision number of the particle           *
!        ncnt(1,no,ipomp+1) : values of counter 1                      *
!        ncnt(2,no,ipomp+1) : values of counter 2                      *
!        ncnt(3,no,ipomp+1) : values of counter 3                      *
!        wt(no,ipomp+1) : weight of the particle at (xc,yc,zc)         *
!        u(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-components of unit vector of          *
!        v(no,ipomp+1) :momentum of the particle                       *
!        w(no,ipomp+1) :                                               *
!        e(no,ipomp+1) : energy of the particle at (x,y,z) (MeV)       *
!        t(no,ipomp+1) : time of the particle at (x,y,z) (nsec)        *
!        x(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-position coordinates of               *
!        y(no,ipomp+1) :the preceding event point (cm)                 *
!        z(no,ipomp+1) :                                               *
!        ec(no,ipomp+1) : energy of the particle at (xc,yc,zc) (MeV)   *
!        tc(no,ipomp+1) : time of the particle at (xc,yc,zc) (nsec)    *
!        xc(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-position coordinates of              *
!        yc(no,ipomp+1) :the particle (cm)                             *
!        zc(no,ipomp+1) :                                              *
!        spx(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-components of unit vector of        *
!        spy(no,ipomp+1) :spin direction of the particle               *
!        spz(no,ipomp+1) :                                             *
!        nzst(no,ipomp+1)                                              *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nclsts : the number of produced particle and nucleus          *
!        mathz : Z number of the mother nucleus                        *
!        mathn : N number of the mother nucleus                        *
!        jcoll : reaction type id1                                     *
!        kcoll : reaction type id2                                     *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!        jcoll reaction type identifier                                *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        jcoll : =  0, nothing happen                                  *
!                =  1, Hydrogen collisions                             *
!                =  2, Particle Decays                                 *
!                =  3, Elastic collisions                              *
!                =  4, High Energy Nuclear collisions                  *
!                =  5, Heavy Ion reactions                             *
!                =  6, Neutron reactions by data                       *
!                =  7, Photon reactions by data                        *
!                =  8, Electron reactions by data                      *
!                =  9, Proton reactions by data                        *
!                = 10, Neutron event mode                              *
!                = 11, Delta Ray production                            *
!                = 12, Muon atomic interaction                         *
!                = 13, Photon by EGS5                                  *
!                = 14, Electron by EGS5                                *
!                = 15, Photon photonuclear interaction                 *
!                = 16, Negative muon captured by nucleon               *
!                = 17, Muon photonuclear interaction                   *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!        kcoll reaction type identifier                                *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        kcoll : =  0, normal                                          *
!                =  1, high energy fission                             *
!                =  2, high energy absorption                          *
!                =  3, low energy n elastic                            *
!                =  4, low energy n non-elastic                        *
!                =  5, low energy n fission                            *
!                =  6, low energy n absorption                         *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nclsts   : total number of out going particles and nuclei     *
!                                                                      *
!        iclusts(nclsts)                                               *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, nucleus                                        *
!                  = 1, proton                                         *
!                  = 2, neutron                                        *
!                  = 3, pion                                           *
!                  = 4, photon                                         *
!                  = 5, kaon                                           *
!                  = 6, muon                                           *
!                  = 7, others                                         *
!                                                                      *
!        jclusts(i,nclsts)                                             *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, angular momentum                               *
!                  = 1, proton number                                  *
!                  = 2, neutron number                                 *
!                  = 3, ip, see below                                  *
!                  = 4, status of the particle 0: real, <0 : dead      *
!                  = 5, charge                                         *
!                  = 6, baryon number                                  *
!                  = 7, kf code                                        *
!                  = 8, isomer level (0: Ground, 1,2: 1st, 2nd isomer) *
!                                                                      *
!        qclusts(i,nclsts)                                             *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, impact parameter                               *
!                  = 1, px (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 2, py (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 3, pz (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 4, etot = sqrt( p**2 + rm**2 ) (GeV)              *
!                  = 5, rest mass (GeV)                                *
!                  = 6, excitation energy (MeV)                        *
!                  = 7, kinetic energy (MeV)                           *
!                  = 8, weight                                         *
!                  = 9, time                                           *
!                  = 10, x                                             *
!                  = 11, y                                             *
!                  = 12, z                                             *
!                                                                      *
!        jcount(i,nclsts)                                              *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
!        kf code table                                                 *
!                                                                      *
!           kf-code: ityp :  description                               *
!                                                                      *
!             2212 :   1  :  proton                                    *
!             2112 :   2  :  neutron                                   *
!              211 :   3  :  pion (+)                                  *
!              111 :   4  :  pion (0)                                  *
!             -211 :   5  :  pion (-)                                  *
!              -13 :   6  :  muon (+)                                  *
!               13 :   7  :  muon (-)                                  *
!              321 :   8  :  kaon (+)                                  *
!              311 :   9  :  kaon (0)                                  *
!             -321 :  10  :  kaon (-)                                  *
!                                                                      *
!               11 :  12  :  electron                                  *
!              -11 :  13  :  positron                                  *
!               22 :  14  :  photon                                    *
!          1000002 :  15  :  deuteron                                  *
!          1000003 :  16  :  triton                                    *
!          2000003 :  17  :  3he                                       *
!          2000004 :  18  :  alpha                                     *
!      Z*1000000+A :  19  :  nucleus                                   *
!                                                                      *
!           kf-code of the other transport particles (ityp=11)         *
!               12 :         nu_e                                      *
!               14 :         nu_mu                                     *
!              221 :         eta                                       *
!              331 :         eta'                                      *
!             -311 :         k0bar                                     *
!            -2112 :         nbar                                      *
!            -2212 :         pbar                                      *
!             3122 :         Lanbda0                                   *
!             3222 :         Sigma+                                    *
!             3212 :         Sigma0                                    *
!             3112 :         Sigma-                                    *
!             3322 :         Xi0                                       *
!             3312 :         Xi-                                       *
!             3334 :         Omega-                                    *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
use MMBANKMOD !FURUTA
use usrtalmod
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
include 'param00.inc'
include 'param.inc'
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /mpi00/ npe, me
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /cusrtally/ iusrtally, iudtf(50)
common /cudtpara/ udtpara(0:9)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /jcomon/ nabov,nobch,nocas,nomax
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/jcomon/)
common /rcomon/ rcasc
common /icomon/ no,mat,ityp,ktyp,jtyp,mtyp,rtyp
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/icomon/)
common /wtsave/ oldwt
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/wtsave/)
common /wtsav2/ oldwt2
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/wtsav2/)
common /tlgeom/ iblz1,iblz2
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlgeom/)
common /tlglat/ ilev1,ilev2,ilat1(5,10),ilat2(5,10)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlglat/)
common /tlcost/ costha, uang(3), nsurf
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlcost/)
common /celdb/  idsn(kvlmax), idtn(kvlmax)
!KN 2012/10/31
common /elect/  uint(3), qs, qo, eint, delc, am, qsex, &
&                nq, ns, n1, noz, mtel
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/elect/)
common /mathzn/ mathz, mathn, jcoll, kcoll
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/mathzn/)
common /clustt/ nclsts, iclusts(nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/clustt/)
common /clustw/ jclusts(0:8,nnn),  qclusts(0:12,nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/clustw/)
common /cntcls/ jcount(3,nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/cntcls/)
integer*8 :: iransb64 ! S.H. xorshift (2020.2.6)
common /randtp/ rijk,rans,ranb,iransb64
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/randtp/)
common /taliin/ rsouin, nzztin, nrgnin
common /kmat1d/ idmn(0:kvlmax), idnm(kvmmax)
integer nudtvar
common /cnudtvar/ nudtvar
common /dedxfac/ dedxfd
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/dedxfac/)
integer iegsemi, iegsout
common /egsemi/ iegsemi, iegsout
real*8 edep
common/EPCONTedep/ edep
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/EPCONTedep/)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
! This is a subroutine program for user-defined tally to calculate
! response function and detection efficiencies of a liquid or plastic
! organic scintillator (NE213, EJ301, BC501A, NE110, EJ208, and BC412).
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
! udtvar(1)   # optin for scintillator type and software PSD
! udtvar(2)   # cell id of a scintillator
! udtvar(3)   # lower value of the minimum light-output bin (MeVee)
! udtvar(4)   # upper value of the maximum light-output bin (MeVee)
! udtvar(5)   # number of the light-output bins
! udtvar(6)   # position of photocathode of PMT on z-axis
! udtvar(7)   # light attenuation factor (/cm)
! udtvar(8)   # one standard deviation of the normal distribution (MeVee)
! udtvar(9)  # parameter for light-output dependent resolution. Dev.=sqrt(dsigma**2 + dfano*dlight)
! udtvar(10:nudtvar)   # bias settings for the neutron-detection efficiency (MeVee)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
! version 1
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
! Programed by d.satoh (2017.10.31)
! Modified  by d.satoh (2020.07.13)  # light-attenuation process
! Modified  by d.satoh (2020.07.16)  # normal distribution for light resolution
! Modified  by d.satoh (2020.08.25)  # change the algorithm of counting up and normalization
! Modified  by d.satoh (2020.09.02)  # light-output resolution
! Modified  by d.satoh (2020.09.03)  # option for discarding the escaping proton events
! Modified  by d.satoh (2020.09.04)  # change the order of the user-defined valuables
! Modified  by d.satoh (2020.09.10)  # OpenMP version
! Modified  by d.satoh (2020.09.14)  # multi-particle incidences
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
! version 2
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.06.25)  # bugfix for the treatment of escaping particles
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.06.26)  # software PSD
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.06.28)  # change the algorithm for nhits, nhist
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.06.29)  # change the algorithm for ipsd, iesc
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.06.30)  # update the function ETOL
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.07.12)  # coutners for PS and EP discrimination
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.07.20)  # change the order of paramters
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.07.20)  # remove the nhits & nihist counter
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.08.04)  # change the option for PSD
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.08.17)  # change again the option for PSD
! Modified  by d.satoh (2021.08.25)  # change the PSD algorithm
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
! version 3
! Modified  by d.satoh (2025.01.31)  # suport for plastic scintillators
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
integer,parameter :: ifvar = 9
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
real(8) :: emin, emax
real(8) :: dres, derr, dl, dl0, dd
real(8) :: zeroeff
character(len=2) :: cnum
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
integer,save :: icp
integer,save :: idet
integer,save :: ne
integer,save :: npsd, nepd
integer,save :: ipsd
integer,save :: istyp
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
real(8),save :: dbin(1:1000)=0.d0, dcnt(1:1000)=0.d0
real(8),save :: bias(1:10), eff(1:10)
real(8),save :: zpos_pmt
real(8),save :: grho
real(8),save :: dsigma
real(8),save :: dfano
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
real(8),save:: dlight(0:999)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(dlight)
real(8),save :: curwt(0:999)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(curwt)
real(8),save :: dweight(0:999)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(dweight)
integer,save :: iflag_psd_ele(0:999)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(iflag_psd_ele)
integer,save :: iflag_psd_oth(0:999)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(iflag_psd_oth)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
io = iudtf(1)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     Source
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ncol == 4 ) then
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
!       ================================================================
  if( icp == 0 ) then
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
!         --------------------------------------------------------------
    emin = udtvar(3)
    emax = udtvar(4)
    ne   = udtvar(5)
!         --------------------------------------------------------------
!         Error trap ---------------------------------------------------
    if( emin >= emax ) then
      write(*,'(a,2es13.4)') "ERROR@usrtally: emin >= emax",&
      &      emin, emax
      stop
    end if
    if( ne > 999 ) then
      write(*,'(a,2es13.4)') "ERROR@usrtally: ne >= 1000",&
      &      ne
      stop
    end if
!         --------------------------------------------------------------
!         Binning ------------------------------------------------------
    if( ne <= 0 ) then
      emin = 0.d0
      emax = ec(no,ipomp+1)*1.25
      ne   = 100
    end if
    de = ( emax - emin ) /dble(ne)
    dbin(1) = emin
    do i = 2, ne+1
      dbin(i) = dbin(i-1) + de
    end do
!         --------------------------------------------------------------
    icp = 1
    return
  end if
!       ================================================================
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  if( dlight(ipomp) /= 0.d0 ) then
!         Software PSD -------------------------------------------------
    if( ipsd == 1 .and. iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) == 1 ) then
      iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) = 0
      iflag_psd_oth(ipomp) = 0
      npsd = npsd + dweight(ipomp)
      goto 111
    else if( ipsd == 2 .and. iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) == 1 ) then
      iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) = 0
      iflag_psd_oth(ipomp) = 0
      npsd = npsd + dweight(ipomp)
      goto 111
    end if
!         --------------------------------------------------------------
!         Assume the normal distribution -------------------------------
    dev = dsqrt(dsigma**2 + dfano*dlight(ipomp))
    dlight(ipomp) = dlight(ipomp) + dev*gaurn(dummy)
!         --------------------------------------------------------------
    if( dlight(ipomp) <= 0.d0 ) goto 111
    if( dlight(ipomp) >= dbin(ne+1) ) then
      dcnt(ne+1) = dcnt(ne+1) + dweight(ipomp)
      goto 222
    end if
    do i = 1, ne
      if( dlight(ipomp) >= dbin(i) .and. &
      &          dlight(ipomp) < dbin(i+1) ) then
        dcnt(i) = dcnt(i) + dweight(ipomp)
        goto 222
      end if
    end do
  222     continue
    do i = 1, nudtvar-ifvar
      if( dlight(ipomp) >= bias(i) ) then
        eff(i) = eff(i) + dweight(ipomp)
      end if
    end do
  111     continue
    dlight(ipomp) = 0.d0
    dweight(ipomp)= 0.d0
  end if
!       ================================================================
!       2021.08.17
  iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) = 0
  iflag_psd_oth(ipomp) = 0
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  return
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     Start of calculation
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ncol == 1 ) then
!       Initializing ---------------------------------------------------
  dlight(:) = 0.d0
  curwt(:)  = 0.d0
  dweight(:)= 0.d0
  eff(:) = 0.d0
  icp = 0
  npsd = 0
  nepd = 0
  iflag_psd_ele(:) = 0
  iflag_psd_oth(:) = 0
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
!       Reading input data ---------------------------------------------
  ipsd = udtvar(1)
  if( ipsd >= 0 .and. ipsd <= 3 ) then
    istyp = 1  ! Liquid organic scintillator
  else if( ipsd >= -3 .and. ipsd < 0 ) then
    istyp = 2  ! Plastic scintillator
  else
    write(*,'(a,i2)') 'Warning: ipsd is strange!',ipsd
    stop
  end if
!ver.3
  ipsd = iabs(ipsd)
  idet = udtvar(2)
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  if( nudtvar-ifvar > 10 ) then
    write(*,&
    &    '(''ERROR: the number of bias&
    & setting is greater than 10. (nudtvar-ifvar)='',i10)')&
    & nudtvar-ifvar
    stop
  end if
  do i = ifvar+1, nudtvar
    bias(i-ifvar) = udtvar(i)
  end do
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  zpos_pmt = udtvar(6)
  grho     = udtvar(7)
  dsigma   = udtvar(8)
  dfano    = udtvar(9)
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  return
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     End of calculation
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ncol == 2 ) then
  write(cnum,'(i2)') nudtvar-ifvar
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  if( ipsd == 1 ) then
    write(io,'(a)')'#--------------------------------------------'
    write(io,'(a,i10)') 'No. of discarded gamma events   = ', npsd
    write(io,'(a)')'#--------------------------------------------'
  else if( ipsd == 2 ) then
    write(io,'(a)')'#--------------------------------------------'
    write(io,'(a,i10)') 'No. of discarded gamma events   = ', npsd
    write(io,'(a,i10)') 'No. of discarded escaping proton events&
    & = ', nepd
    write(io,'(a)')'#--------------------------------------------'
  end if
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  write(io,'(a,'//trim(cnum)//'f10.3)')&
  &            'Bias:      ', bias(1:nudtvar-ifvar)
  write(io,'(a,'//trim(cnum)//'es10.3)')&
  &            'Efficiency:', eff(1:nudtvar-ifvar)/rsouin
  write(io,'(a)') '#--------------------------------------------'
  write(io,'(3a13,a8)') 'L-lower', 'L-upper', 'response', 'r.err'
  write(io,'(3a13)')    '(MeVee)', '(MeVee)', '(/MeVee/n)'
  write(io,'(a)') '#--------------------------------------------'
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  do i = 1, ne
    dres = dcnt(i)/(dbin(i+1)-dbin(i))/rsouin
    if( dres == 0.d0 ) then
      derr = 0.d0
    else
      derr = dsqrt(dcnt(i))/dcnt(i)
    end if
    write(io,'(3es13.4,f8.4)') dbin(i), dbin(i+1),&
    &    dres, derr
  end do
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  return
endif
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     End of batch
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ncol == 3 ) then
!       Software PSD ---------------------------------------------------
  if( ipsd == 1 .and. iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) == 1 ) then
    iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) = 0
    iflag_psd_oth(ipomp) = 0
    npsd = npsd + dweight(ipomp)
    goto 110
  else if( ipsd == 2 .and. iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) == 1 ) then
    iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) = 0
    iflag_psd_oth(ipomp) = 0
    npsd = npsd + dweight(ipomp)
    goto 110
  end if
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
!       Assume the normal distribution----------------------------------
  dev = dsqrt(dsigma**2 + dfano*dlight(ipomp))
  dlight(ipomp) = dlight(ipomp) + dev*gaurn(dummy)
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  if( dlight(ipomp) <= 0.d0 ) goto 110
  if( dlight(ipomp) >= dbin(ne+1) ) then
    dcnt(ne+1) = dcnt(ne+1) + dweight(ipomp)
    goto 220
  end if
  do i = 1, ne
    if( dlight(ipomp) >= dbin(i) .and. &
    &        dlight(ipomp) < dbin(i+1) ) then
      dcnt(i) = dcnt(i) + dweight(ipomp)
      goto 220
    end if
  end do
  220   continue
  do i = 1, nudtvar-ifvar
    if( dlight(ipomp) >= bias(i) ) then
      eff(i) = eff(i) + dweight(ipomp)
    end if
  end do
  110   continue
  dlight(ipomp) = 0.d0
  dweight(ipomp)= 0.d0
!       2021.08.17
  iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) = 0
  iflag_psd_oth(ipomp) = 0
  return
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     Geometry boundary corssing
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ncol == 10 ) then
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
!       A particle enters into a scintillator cell
  if( iblz1 /= idet .and. iblz2 == idet ) then
    curwt(ipomp) = oldwt
  end if
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
!       ================================================================
!       A particle escapes from a scintillator cell
  if( iblz1 == idet .and. iblz2 /= idet) then
    ein = e(no,ipomp+1)   ! particle energy of preceding event (MeV)
    ecc = ec(no,ipomp+1)  ! current particle energy (MeV)
    zd  = z(no,ipomp+1)   ! z-position of preceding particle (cm)
!         Special treatment for electrons ------------------------------
    if( ityp==12 .and. iegsemi /= 0 ) then ! EGS mode
      tlngth = dsqrt( ( xc(no,ipomp+1) - x(no,ipomp+1) )**2 &
      &                  + ( yc(no,ipomp+1) - y(no,ipomp+1) )**2 &
      &                  + ( zc(no,ipomp+1) - z(no,ipomp+1) )**2 )
      call egs5edxde(ecc,tlngth,ein,mat,ityp)
      if( ncol == 9 .or. ncol == 11 ) then
        ecc = 0d0
        ein = ein + edep
      endif
    else ! original PHITS mode
      ecc = ein - dedxfd * ( ein - ecc ) ! modification factor
    end if
!         --------------------------------------------------------------
!         --------------------------------------------------------------
!         Distance from the interaction point to the photocathode
    dd = dabs(zd - zpos_pmt)
!         --------------------------------------------------------------
    if( ein /= ecc ) then
      if( ipsd == 2 .and. ityp == 1 .and. &
      &             dlight(ipomp) <= 0.d0 ) then
        dlight(ipomp) = 0.d0
        dweight(ipomp)= 0.d0
        nepd = nepd + curwt(ipomp)
      else
        dl0= ETOL(ktyp,ein) - ETOL(ktyp,ecc) ! light output (MeVee)
        dl = dl0 * dexp(-1.d0*grho*dd)
        dlight(ipomp) = dlight(ipomp) + dl
        dweight(ipomp)= curwt(ipomp)
      end if
    end if
!         --------------------------------------------------------------
  end if
!       ================================================================
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  return
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     Start of Monte Carlo history
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( iblz1 /= idet ) return
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ncol >= 5 ) then
  ein = e(no,ipomp+1)   ! particle energy of preceding event (MeV)
  ecc = ec(no,ipomp+1)  ! current particle energy (MeV)
  zd  = z(no,ipomp+1)   ! z-position of preceding particle (cm)
!       Special treatment for electrons --------------------------------
  if( ityp==12 .and. iegsemi /= 0 ) then ! EGS mode
    tlngth = dsqrt( ( xc(no,ipomp+1) - x(no,ipomp+1) )**2 &
    &                + ( yc(no,ipomp+1) - y(no,ipomp+1) )**2 &
    &                + ( zc(no,ipomp+1) - z(no,ipomp+1) )**2 )
    call egs5edxde(ecc,tlngth,ein,mat,ityp)
    if( ncol == 9 .or. ncol == 11 ) then
      ecc = 0d0
      ein = ein + edep
    endif
  else ! original PHITS mode
    ecc = ein - dedxfd * ( ein - ecc ) ! modification factor for electron
  end if
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
!       Distance from the interaction point to the photocathode
  dd = dabs(zd - zpos_pmt)
!       ----------------------------------------------------------------
  if( ein /= ecc ) then
    dl0= ETOL(ktyp,ein) - ETOL(ktyp,ecc) ! light output (MeVee)
    dl = dl0 * dexp(-1.d0*grho*dd)
    dlight(ipomp) = dlight(ipomp) + dl
    dweight(ipomp)= curwt(ipomp)
  end if
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( (ncol == 13 .or. ncol == 14) .and. &
&    mat > 0 .and. nclsts > 0 ) then
  do j = 1, nclsts
    if( jclusts(4,j) < 0 .and. jclusts(5,j) /= 0 ) then
      ein = qclusts(7,j)
      ecc = 0.0d0
      kfd = jclusts(7,j)
      xd  = qclusts(10,j)
      yd  = qclusts(11,j)
      zd  = qclusts(12,j)
      dd = dabs(zd - zpos_pmt)
      dl0= ETOL(kfd,ein)
      dl = dl0 * dexp(-1.d0*grho*dd)
      dlight(ipomp) = dlight(ipomp) + dl
      dweight(ipomp)= curwt(ipomp)
    end if
  end do
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
return
!***********************************************************************
contains
!***********************************************************************
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
function ETOL(ktyp,en)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
implicit none
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
real(8) :: ETOL
integer :: ktyp
real(8) :: en
real(8) :: a1, a2, a3
integer :: i, n, iflag
real(8) :: ENE(1:127)
real(8) :: HYDL(1:127), CARL(1:127), ALPL(1:127), DEUL(1:127)
real(8) :: X(1:127), Y(1:127)
!ver.3
real(8) :: fac
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
iflag=0
ETOL=0.d0
fac=1.d0
if( en <= 0.d0 ) return
if( &
&  ( ktyp == 2212 )    .or.                        &! Proton &
&  ( ktyp == 1000002 ) .or.                        &! Deuteron &
&  ( ktyp == 1000003 ) .or.                        &! Triton &
&  ( ktyp == 2000003 ) .or.                        &! 3He &
&  ( ktyp == 2000004 ) .or.                        &! Alpha &
&  ( ktyp >= 3000000 .and. ktyp <= 3000100 ) .or.  &! Lithium &
&  ( ktyp >= 4000000 .and. ktyp <= 4000100 ) .or.  &! Beryllium &
&  ( ktyp >= 5000000 .and. ktyp <= 5000100 ) .or.  &! Boron &
&  ( ktyp >= 6000000 .and. ktyp <= 6000100 ) .or.  &! Carbon &
&  ( ktyp == 11 ) .or.                             &! Electron &
&  ( ktyp == 2000005 ) .or.                        &! 5He (NEW) &
&  ( ktyp == 2000006 ) .or.                        &! 6He (NEW) &
&  ( ktyp >= 7000000 .and. ktyp <= 7000100 ) .or.  &! Nitrogen (NEW) &
&  ( ktyp >= 8000000 .and. ktyp <= 8000100 )       &! Oxygen (NEW) &
&  ) then
  iflag = 1
end if
!     For checking -----------------------------------------------------
if( iflag == 0 ) then
  return
end if
!     ------------------------------------------------------------------
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     FLAG FOR PULSE SHAPE DISCRIMINATION
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ktyp == 11 ) then
  iflag_psd_ele(ipomp) = 1
else if( ktyp == 2212 .or. ktyp == 1000002 .or. &
  &         ktyp == 1000003 .or. ktyp == 1000004 ) then
  iflag_psd_oth(ipomp) = 1
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     ELECTRON
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ktyp == 11 ) then
  ETOL = en ! ( MeVee)
  return
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     EQUATION
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     proton
if( ktyp == 2212 .and. en > 25.0 ) then
  a1 = 8.100d-1
  a2 = 2.430d-0
  a3 = 2.900d-1
  fac= 1.000d+0
!     deuteron
else if( ktyp == 1000002 .and. en > 10.0 ) then
  a1 = 7.400d-1
  a2 = 3.450d-0
  a3 = 2.000d-1
  fac= 1.520d+0
!     triton
else if( ktyp == 1000003 .and. en > 10.0 ) then
  a1 = 7.200d-1
  a2 = 7.190d-0
  a3 = 7.000d-2
  fac= 1.520d+0
!     He-3
else if( ktyp == 2000003 .and. en > 5.0 ) then
  a1 = 5.400d-1
  a2 = 3.970d-0
  a3 = 2.000d-1
  fac= 1.750d+0
!     alpha
else if( ktyp == 2000004 .and. en > 5.0 ) then
  a1 = 5.100d-1
  a2 = 6.420d-0
  a3 = 8.000d-2
  fac= 1.750d+0
else
  goto 987
end if
ETOL = a1*en - a2*( 1.d0 - dexp(-1.d0*a3*en) ) ! (MeVee)
!ver.3
if( istyp == 2 ) then
  ETOL = ETOL*fac
end if
return
  987 continue
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     DATABASE
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA (HYDL(i),i=1,127)/0.0,2.150E-4,1.030E-3,1.150E-3,1.270E-3,&
&1.400E-3,1.460E-3,1.520E-3,1.580E-3,1.640E-3,1.760E-3,1.880E-3,&
&2.000E-3,2.120E-3,2.240E-3,2.360E-3,2.480E-3,2.600E-3,2.720E-3,&
&2.850E-3,3.090E-3,3.340E-3,3.570E-3,3.820E-3,4.070E-3,4.460E-3,&
&4.840E-3,5.220E-3,5.620E-3,6.150E-3,6.710E-3,7.400E-3,8.120E-3,&
&8.860E-3,9.620E-3,1.040E-2,1.122E-2,1.207E-2,1.292E-2,1.377E-2,&
&1.465E-2,1.645E-2,1.838E-2,2.035E-2,2.245E-2,2.460E-2,2.680E-2,&
&2.900E-2,3.130E-2,3.380E-2,3.650E-2,4.220E-2,4.830E-2,5.450E-2,&
&6.090E-2,6.780E-2,7.860E-2,9.100E-2,1.040E-1,1.175E-1,1.367E-1,&
&1.562E-1,1.825E-1,2.095E-1,2.385E-1,2.690E-1,2.995E-1,3.320E-1,&
&3.660E-1,4.000E-1,4.360E-1,4.725E-1,5.480E-1,6.250E-1,7.030E-1,&
&7.830E-1,8.660E-1,9.520E-1,1.042E+0,1.135E+0,1.230E+0,1.327E+0,&
&1.521E+0,1.718E+0,1.915E+0,2.112E+0,2.310E+0,2.630E+0,2.950E+0,&
&3.280E+0,3.620E+0,4.080E+0,4.550E+0,5.140E+0,5.750E+0,6.360E+0,&
&6.970E+0,7.580E+0,8.200E+0,8.830E+0,9.480E+0,1.014E+1,1.080E+1,&
& 12.15,   13.5,    14.9,    16.3,    17.7,    19.1,    20.5,&
& 21.9,    23.35,   24.8,    27.7,    30.75,   33.8,    36.9,&
& 40.0,    44.65,   49.4,    54.3,    59.2,    65.8,    72.4,&
&         397.03,          802.98,           965.36/
DATA (CARL(i),i=1,127)/.0,6.0E-5,.000228,.00025,.000272,.000294,&

&.018713,.019762,.020810,.021859,.023957,.026054,.028152,.030250,&
&.032347,.035549,.038750,.041952,.045154,.049570,.053986,.059616,&
&.065412,.071346,.077694,.084594,.091632,.098808,.105984,.113712,&
&.121440,.136896,.153456,.170016,.187680,.206448,.225216,.246192,&
&.268272,.290352,.312432,.357696,.406272,.460368,.516672,.575184,&
&.670128,.775008,.888720,1.00464,1.18680,1.36896,&
&        1.36869,1.36869,1.36896/
DATA (ALPL(i),i=1,127)/0.0,6.500E-5,2.850E-4,3.210E-4,3.550E-4,&
