!        kf code table                                                 *
!                                                                      *
!           kf-code: ityp :  description                               *
!                                                                      *
!             2212 :   1  :  proton                                    *
!             2112 :   2  :  neutron                                   *
!              211 :   3  :  pion (+)                                  *
!              111 :   4  :  pion (0)                                  *
!             -211 :   5  :  pion (-)                                  *
!              -13 :   6  :  muon (+)                                  *
!               13 :   7  :  muon (-)                                  *
!              321 :   8  :  kaon (+)                                  *
!              311 :   9  :  kaon (0)                                  *
!             -321 :  10  :  kaon (-)                                  *
!                                                                      *
!               11 :  12  :  electron                                  *
!              -11 :  13  :  positron                                  *
!               22 :  14  :  photon                                    *
!          1000002 :  15  :  deuteron                                  *
!          1000003 :  16  :  triton                                    *
!          2000003 :  17  :  3he                                       *
!          2000004 :  18  :  alpha                                     *
!      Z*1000000+A :  19  :  nucleus                                   *
!                                                                      *
!           kf-code of the other transport particles (ityp=11)         *
!               12 :         nu_e                                      *
!               14 :         nu_mu                                     *
!              221 :         eta                                       *
!              331 :         eta'                                      *
!             -311 :         k0bar                                     *
!            -2112 :         nbar                                      *
!            -2212 :         pbar                                      *
!             3122 :         Lanbda0                                   *
!             3222 :         Sigma+                                    *
!             3212 :         Sigma0                                    *
!             3112 :         Sigma-                                    *
!             3322 :         Xi0                                       *
!             3312 :         Xi-                                       *
!             3334 :         Omega-                                    *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
use MMBANKMOD !FURUTA
use usrtalmod
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
include 'param00.inc'
include 'param.inc'
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /mpi00/ npe, me
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /cusrtally/ iusrtally, iudtf(50)
common /cudtpara/ udtpara(0:9)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /jcomon/ nabov,nobch,nocas,nomax
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/jcomon/)
common /rcomon/ rcasc
common /icomon/ no,mat,ityp,ktyp,jtyp,mtyp,rtyp
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/icomon/)
common /wtsave/ oldwt
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/wtsave/)
common /tlgeom/ iblz1,iblz2
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlgeom/)
common /tlglat/ ilev1,ilev2,ilat1(5,10),ilat2(5,10)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlglat/)
common /tlcost/ costha, uang(3), nsurf
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlcost/)
common /celdb/  idsn(kvlmax), idtn(kvlmax)
!KN 2012/10/31
common /elect/  uint(3), qs, qo, eint, delc, am, qsex, &
&                nq, ns, n1, noz, mtel
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/elect/)
common /mathzn/ mathz, mathn, jcoll, kcoll
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/mathzn/)
common /clustt/ nclsts, iclusts(nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/clustt/)
common /clustw/ jclusts(0:8,nnn),  qclusts(0:12,nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/clustw/)
common /cntcls/ jcount(3,nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/cntcls/)
integer*8 :: iransb64 ! S.H. xorshift (2020.2.6)
common /randtp/ rijk,rans,ranb,iransb64
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/randtp/)
common /taliin/ rsouin, nzztin, nrgnin
common /kmat1d/ idmn(0:kvlmax), idnm(kvmmax)
integer nudtvar
common /cnudtvar/ nudtvar
common /tstara/ atmrc(10,7)      ! S.Abe 2018/02/07, (5,6) -> (7,7)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tstara/)
io = iudtf(1)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     similar to [t-interact] or [t-star] tally
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ncol .eq. 1 ) then ! Start of calculation
  write(io,'("  #history    #batch  React-ID   kf-code   cell-ID"&
  & ,"  E_exc(MeV)  E_old(MeV)  E_new(MeV)",&
  & "       X(cm)       Y(cm)       Z(cm)      Weight")')
  return
end if
if( ncol .ne. 13 .and. ncol .ne. 14 ) return
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
iRID=igetcolltype(ncol)
if(nudtvar.eq.0) then ! no udtvar is specified
  ioutidx=1 ! 0: ignore, 1: output data
else
  ioutidx=0 ! 0: ignore, 1: output data
  do ir=1,nudtvar
    if(udtvar(ir).eq.0) then ! udtvar = 0 indicates including all reactions
      ioutidx=1
      exit
    elseif(mod(nint(udtvar(ir)),1000).eq.0) then ! Category match
      if(nint(udtvar(ir))/1000.eq.iRID/1000) then
        ioutidx=1
        exit
      endif
    elseif(nint(udtvar(ir)).eq.iRID) then ! Sub-category match
      ioutidx=1
      exit
    endif
  enddo
endif

if(ioutidx.eq.1) then
!$OMP critical(text_write_lock)
  write(io,'(5i10,20es12.4)') nocas,nobch,iRID,ktyp,iblz1&
  &  ,qclusts(6,1),e(no,ipomp+1),ec(no,ipomp+1),x(no,ipomp+1)&
  &  ,y(no,ipomp+1),z(no,ipomp+1),oldwt
!$OMP end critical(text_write_lock)
endif

return
end
END_FILE

FILE: t-product/usrtally.f90
BEGIN_FILE
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
subroutine usrtally(ncol)
!                                                                      *
!        sample subroutine for user defined tally.                     *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!       ncol = 1 : start of calculation                                *
!              2 : end of calculation                                  *
!              3 : end of a batch                                      *
!              4 : source                                              *
!              5 : detection of geometry error                         *
!              6 : recovery of geometry error                          *
!              7 : termination by geometry error                       *
!              8 : termination by weight cut-off                       *
!              9 : termination by time cut-off                         *
!             10 : geometry boundary crossing                          *
!             11 : termination by energy cut-off                       *
!             12 : termination by escape or leakage                    *
!             13 : (n,x) reaction                                      *
!             14 : (n,n'x) reaction                                    *
!             15 : sequential transport only for tally                 *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        In the distributed-memory parallel computing,                 *
!          npe : total number of used Processor Elements               *
!          me : ID number of each processor                            *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        In the shared memory parallel computing,                      *
!          ipomp : ID number of each core                              *
!          npomp : total number of used cores                          *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nocas : current event number in this batch                    :
!        nobch : current batch number                                  *
!        rcasc : real number of NOCAS+maxcas*(NOBCH-1)                 *
!        rsouin : sum of the weight of source particle                 *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        no : cascade id in this event                                 *
!        idmn(mat) : material id                                       *
!        ityp : particle type                                          *
!        ktyp : particle kf-code                                       *
!        jtyp : charge number of the particle                          *
!        mtyp : baryon number of the particle                          *
!        rtyp : rest mass of the particle (MeV)                        *
!        oldwt : weight of the particle at (x,y,z)                     *
!        qs : dE/dx of electron at (x,y,z)                             *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        iblz1 : cell id at (x,y,z)                                    *
!        iblz2 : cell id after crossing                                *
!        ilev1 : level structure id of the cell at (x,y,z)             *
!          ilat1(i,j)                                                  *
!        ilev2 : level structure id of the cell after crossing         *
!          ilat2(i,j)                                                  *
!        costha : cosine of theta on surface crossing                  *
!        uang(1) : x of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        uang(2) : y of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        uang(3) : z of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        nsurf : surface number                                        *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        name(no,ipomp+1) : collision number of the particle                   *
!        ncnt(1,no,ipomp+1) : values of counter 1                              *
!        ncnt(2,no,ipomp+1) : values of counter 2                              *
!        ncnt(3,no,ipomp+1) : values of counter 3                              *
!        wt(no,ipomp+1) : weight of the particle at (xc,yc,zc)                 *
!        u(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-components of unit vector of                  *
!        v(no,ipomp+1) :momentum of the particle                               *
!        w(no,ipomp+1) :                                                       *
!        e(no,ipomp+1) : energy of the particle at (x,y,z) (MeV)               *
!        t(no,ipomp+1) : time of the particle at (x,y,z) (nsec)                *
!        x(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-position coordinates of                       *
!        y(no,ipomp+1) :the preceding event point (cm)                         *
!        z(no,ipomp+1) :                                                       *
!        ec(no,ipomp+1) : energy of the particle at (xc,yc,zc) (MeV)           *
!        tc(no,ipomp+1) : time of the particle at (xc,yc,zc) (nsec)            *
!        xc(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-position coordinates of                      *
!        yc(no,ipomp+1) :the particle (cm)                                     *
!        zc(no,ipomp+1) :                                                      *
!        spx(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-components of unit vector of                *
!        spy(no,ipomp+1) :spin direction of the particle                       *
!        spz(no,ipomp+1) :                                                     *
!        nzst(no,ipomp+1)                                                      *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nclsts : the number of produced particle and nucleus          *
!        mathz : Z number of the mother nucleus                        *
!        mathn : N number of the mother nucleus                        *
!        jcoll : reaction type id1                                     *
!        kcoll : reaction type id2                                     *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!        jcoll reaction type identifier                                *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        jcoll : =  0, nothing happen                                  *
!                =  1, Hydrogen collisions                             *
!                =  2, Particle Decays                                 *
!                =  3, Elastic collisions                              *
!                =  4, High Energy Nuclear collisions                  *
!                =  5, Heavy Ion reactions                             *
!                =  6, Neutron reactions by data                       *
!                =  7, Photon reactions by data                        *
!                =  8, Electron reactions by data                      *
!                =  9, Proton reactions by data                        *
!                = 10, Neutron event mode                              *
!                = 11, Delta Ray production                            *
!                = 12, Muon interaction                                *
!                = 13, Photon by EGS5                                  *
!                = 14, Electron by EGS5                                *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!        kcoll reaction type identifier                                *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        kcoll : =  0, normal                                          *
!                =  1, high energy fission                             *
!                =  2, high energy absorption                          *
!                =  3, low energy n elastic                            *
!                =  4, low energy n non-elastic                        *
!                =  5, low energy n fission                            *
!                =  6, low energy n absorption                         *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nclsts   : total number of out going particles and nuclei     *
!                                                                      *
!        iclusts(nclsts)                                               *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, nucleus                                        *
!                  = 1, proton                                         *
!                  = 2, neutron                                        *
!                  = 3, pion                                           *
!                  = 4, photon                                         *
!                  = 5, kaon                                           *
!                  = 6, muon                                           *
!                  = 7, others                                         *
!                                                                      *
!        jclusts(i,nclsts)                                             *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, angular momentum                               *
!                  = 1, proton number                                  *
!                  = 2, neutron number                                 *
!                  = 3, ip, see below                                  *
!                  = 4, status of the particle 0: real, <0 : dead      *
!                  = 5, charge                                         *
!                  = 6, baryon number                                  *
!                  = 7, kf code                                        *
!                  = 8, isomer level (0: Ground, 1,2: 1st, 2nd isomer) *
!                                                                      *
!        qclusts(i,nclsts)                                             *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, impact parameter                               *
!                  = 1, px (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 2, py (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 3, pz (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 4, etot = sqrt( p**2 + rm**2 ) (GeV)              *
!                  = 5, rest mass (GeV)                                *
!                  = 6, excitation energy (MeV)                        *
!                  = 7, kinetic energy (MeV)                           *
!                  = 8, weight                                         *
!                  = 9, time                                           *
!                  = 10, x                                             *
!                  = 11, y                                             *
!                  = 12, z                                             *
!                                                                      *
!        jcount(i,nclsts)                                              *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
!        kf code table                                                 *
!                                                                      *
!           kf-code: ityp :  description                               *
!                                                                      *
!             2212 :   1  :  proton                                    *
!             2112 :   2  :  neutron                                   *
!              211 :   3  :  pion (+)                                  *
!              111 :   4  :  pion (0)                                  *
!             -211 :   5  :  pion (-)                                  *
!              -13 :   6  :  muon (+)                                  *
!               13 :   7  :  muon (-)                                  *
!              321 :   8  :  kaon (+)                                  *
!              311 :   9  :  kaon (0)                                  *
!             -321 :  10  :  kaon (-)                                  *
!                                                                      *
!               11 :  12  :  electron                                  *
!              -11 :  13  :  positron                                  *
!               22 :  14  :  photon                                    *
!          1000002 :  15  :  deuteron                                  *
!          1000003 :  16  :  triton                                    *
!          2000003 :  17  :  3he                                       *
!          2000004 :  18  :  alpha                                     *
!      Z*1000000+A :  19  :  nucleus                                   *
!                                                                      *
!           kf-code of the other transport particles (ityp=11)         *
!               12 :         nu_e                                      *
!               14 :         nu_mu                                     *
!              221 :         eta                                       *
!              331 :         eta'                                      *
!             -311 :         k0bar                                     *
!            -2112 :         nbar                                      *
!            -2212 :         pbar                                      *
!             3122 :         Lanbda0                                   *
!             3222 :         Sigma+                                    *
!             3212 :         Sigma0                                    *
!             3112 :         Sigma-                                    *
!             3322 :         Xi0                                       *
!             3312 :         Xi-                                       *
!             3334 :         Omega-                                    *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
use MMBANKMOD !FURUTA
use usrtalmod
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
include 'param00.inc'
include 'param.inc'
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /mpi00/ npe, me
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /cusrtally/ iusrtally, iudtf(50)
common /cudtpara/ udtpara(0:9)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /jcomon/ nabov,nobch,nocas,nomax
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/jcomon/)
common /rcomon/ rcasc
common /icomon/ no,mat,ityp,ktyp,jtyp,mtyp,rtyp
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/icomon/)
common /wtsave/ oldwt
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/wtsave/)
common /tlgeom/ iblz1,iblz2
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlgeom/)
common /tlglat/ ilev1,ilev2,ilat1(5,10),ilat2(5,10)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlglat/)
common /tlcost/ costha, uang(3), nsurf
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlcost/)
common /celdb/  idsn(kvlmax), idtn(kvlmax)
!KN 2012/10/31
common /elect/  uint(3), qs, qo, eint, delc, am, qsex, &
&                nq, ns, n1, noz, mtel
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/elect/)
common /mathzn/ mathz, mathn, jcoll, kcoll
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/mathzn/)
common /clustt/ nclsts, iclusts(nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/clustt/)
common /clustw/ jclusts(0:8,nnn),  qclusts(0:12,nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/clustw/)
common /cntcls/ jcount(3,nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/cntcls/)
integer*8 :: iransb64 ! S.H. xorshift (2020.2.6)
common /randtp/ rijk,rans,ranb,iransb64
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/randtp/)
common /taliin/ rsouin, nzztin, nrgnin
common /kmat1d/ idmn(0:kvlmax), idnm(kvmmax)
common /dedxfac/ dedxfd
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/dedxfac/)
common /pnint/  ipnint
integer nudtvar
common /cnudtvar/ nudtvar
save totalproduct ! total product
io = iudtf(1)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     similar to [t-product] tally
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ncol .eq. 1 ) then ! Start of calculation
  totalproduct=0.0
  return
end if
if( ncol .eq. 2 ) then ! End of calculation
  write(io,'(''Total Product (/source)='',es12.4)')&
  & totalproduct/rsouin
  return
endif
if(ncol.eq.13.or.ncol.eq.14) then ! reaction timing
  if(jcoll.eq.6.or.jcoll.eq.8.or.jcoll.eq.9) return ! neutron, electron, proton reaction by nuclear or atomic data
  if(jcoll.eq.7.and.ipnint.eq.0) return ! photon reaction by atomic data
!  Output reaction information
!$OMP critical(text_write_lock)
  write(io,'(''  #history    #batch R_ID   cell-ID'',&
  & '' Z_mother N_mother jcoll kcoll nclsts'',&
  & ''       x(cm)       y(cm)       z(cm)'')')
  write(io,'(2i10,i5,i10,2i9,2i6,i7,3es12.4)') nocas,nobch,igetcolltype(ncol),&
  & iblz1,mathz,mathn,jcoll,kcoll,nclsts,xc(no,ipomp+1),&
  & yc(no,ipomp+1),zc(no,ipomp+1)
!  Output Primary particle information
  write(io,'(''   Pri/Sec   kf-code      E(MeV)'',&
  & ''           U           V           W      weight'')')
  write(io,'(''   Primary'',i10,20es12.4)') ktyp,&
  & ec(no,ipomp+1),u(no,ipomp+1),v(no,ipomp+1),w(no,ipomp+1),oldwt
!  Output Secondary particle information
  do j=1,nclsts
    px=qclusts(1,j)
    py=qclusts(2,j)
    pz=qclusts(3,j)
    pt=sqrt(px**2+py**2+pz**2)
    write(io,'('' Secondary'',i10,20es12.4)') jclusts(7,j),&
    &  qclusts(7,j),px/pt,py/pt,pz/pt,qclusts(8,j)
    totalproduct=totalproduct+qclusts(8,j)
  enddo
!$OMP end critical(text_write_lock)
endif
return
end
END_FILE

!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
subroutine usrtally(ncol)
!                                                                      *
!       user defined tally for ParaView output of particle tracks      *
!       ONLY FOR USE in single mode calculation                        *
!       made by N.MATSUDA on 2016/12/16                                *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!       ncol = 1 : start of calculation                                *
!              2 : end of calculation                                  *
!              3 : end of a batch                                      *
!              4 : source                                              *
!              5 : detection of geometry error                         *
!              6 : recovery of geometry error                          *
!              7 : termination by geometry error                       *
!              8 : termination by weight cut-off                       *
!              9 : termination by time cut-off                         *
!             10 : geometry boundary crossing                          *
!             11 : termination by energy cut-off                       *
!             12 : termination by escape or leakage                    *
!             13 : (n,x) reaction                                      *
!             14 : (n,n'x) reaction                                    *
!             15 : sequential transport only for tally                 *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        In the distributed-memory parallel computing,                 *
!          npe : total number of used Processor Elements               *
!          me : ID number of each processor                            *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        In the shared memory parallel computing,                      *
!          ipomp : ID number of each core                              *
!          npomp : total number of used cores                          *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nocas : current event number in this batch                    :
!        nobch : current batch number                                  *
!        rcasc : real number of NOCAS+maxcas*(NOBCH-1)                 *
!        rsouin : sum of the weight of source particle                 *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        no : cascade id in this event                                 *
!        idmn(mat) : material id                                       *
!        ityp : particle type                                          *
!        ktyp : particle kf-code                                       *
!        jtyp : charge number of the particle                          *
!        mtyp : baryon number of the particle                          *
!        rtyp : rest mass of the particle (MeV)                        *
!        oldwt : weight of the particle at (x,y,z)                     *
!        qs : dE/dx of electron at (x,y,z)                             *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        iblz1 : cell id at (x,y,z)                                    *
!        iblz2 : cell id after crossing                                *
!        ilev1 : level structure id of the cell at (x,y,z)             *
!          ilat1(i,j)                                                  *
!        ilev2 : level structure id of the cell after crossing         *
!          ilat2(i,j)                                                  *
!        costha : cosine of theta on surface crossing                  *
!        uang(1) : x of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        uang(2) : y of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        uang(3) : z of position(?) at surface crossing                *
!        nsurf : surface number                                        *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        name(no,ipomp+1) : collision number of the particle                   *
!        ncnt(1,no,ipomp+1) : values of counter 1                              *
!        ncnt(2,no,ipomp+1) : values of counter 2                              *
!        ncnt(3,no,ipomp+1) : values of counter 3                              *
!        wt(no,ipomp+1) : weight of the particle at (xc,yc,zc)                 *
!        u(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-components of unit vector of                  *
!        v(no,ipomp+1) :momentum of the particle                               *
!        w(no,ipomp+1) :                                                       *
!        e(no,ipomp+1) : energy of the particle at (x,y,z) (MeV)               *
!        t(no,ipomp+1) : time of the particle at (x,y,z) (nsec)                *
!        x(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-position coordinates of                       *
!        y(no,ipomp+1) :the preceding event point (cm)                         *
!        z(no,ipomp+1) :                                                       *
!        ec(no,ipomp+1) : energy of the particle at (xc,yc,zc) (MeV)           *
!        tc(no,ipomp+1) : time of the particle at (xc,yc,zc) (nsec)            *
!        xc(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-position coordinates of                      *
!        yc(no,ipomp+1) :the particle (cm)                                     *
!        zc(no,ipomp+1) :                                                      *
!        spx(no,ipomp+1) : x, y, z-components of unit vector of                *
!        spy(no,ipomp+1) :spin direction of the particle                       *
!        spz(no,ipomp+1) :                                                     *
!        nzst(no,ipomp+1)                                                      *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nclsts : the number of produced particle and nucleus          *
!        mathz : Z number of the mother nucleus                        *
!        mathn : N number of the mother nucleus                        *
!        jcoll : reaction type id1                                     *
!        kcoll : reaction type id2                                     *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!        jcoll reaction type identifier                                *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        jcoll : =  0, nothing happen                                  *
!                =  1, Hydrogen collisions                             *
!                =  2, Particle Decays                                 *
!                =  3, Elastic collisions                              *
!                =  4, High Energy Nuclear collisions                  *
!                =  5, Heavy Ion reactions                             *
!                =  6, Neutron reactions by data                       *
!                =  7, Photon reactions by data                        *
!                =  8, Electron reactions by data                      *
!                =  9, Proton reactions by data                        *
!                = 10, Neutron event mode                              *
!                = 11, Delta Ray production                            *
!                = 12, Muon interaction                                *
!                = 13, Photon by EGS5                                  *
!                = 14, Electron by EGS5                                *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!        kcoll reaction type identifier                                *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        kcoll : =  0, normal                                          *
!                =  1, high energy fission                             *
!                =  2, high energy absorption                          *
!                =  3, low energy n elastic                            *
!                =  4, low energy n non-elastic                        *
!                =  5, low energy n fission                            *
!                =  6, low energy n absorption                         *
!                                                                      *
!----------------------------------------------------------------------*
!                                                                      *
!        nclsts   : total number of out going particles and nuclei     *
!                                                                      *
!        iclusts(nclsts)                                               *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, nucleus                                        *
!                  = 1, proton                                         *
!                  = 2, neutron                                        *
!                  = 3, pion                                           *
!                  = 4, photon                                         *
!                  = 5, kaon                                           *
!                  = 6, muon                                           *
!                  = 7, others                                         *
!                                                                      *
!        jclusts(i,nclsts)                                             *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, angular momentum                               *
!                  = 1, proton number                                  *
!                  = 2, neutron number                                 *
!                  = 3, ip, see below                                  *
!                  = 4, status of the particle 0: real, <0 : dead      *
!                  = 5, charge                                         *
!                  = 6, baryon number                                  *
!                  = 7, kf code                                        *
!                  = 8, isomer level (0: Ground, 1,2: 1st, 2nd isomer) *
!                                                                      *
!        qclusts(i,nclsts)                                             *
!                                                                      *
!                i = 0, impact parameter                               *
!                  = 1, px (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 2, py (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 3, pz (GeV/c)                                     *
!                  = 4, etot = sqrt( p**2 + rm**2 ) (GeV)              *
!                  = 5, rest mass (GeV)                                *
!                  = 6, excitation energy (MeV)                        *
!                  = 7, kinetic energy (MeV)                           *
!                  = 8, weight                                         *
!                  = 9, time                                           *
!                  = 10, x                                             *
!                  = 11, y                                             *
!                  = 12, z                                             *
!                                                                      *
!        jcount(i,nclsts)                                              *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
!        kf code table                                                 *
!                                                                      *
!           kf-code: ityp :  description                               *
!                                                                      *
!             2212 :   1  :  proton                                    *
!             2112 :   2  :  neutron                                   *
!              211 :   3  :  pion (+)                                  *
!              111 :   4  :  pion (0)                                  *
!             -211 :   5  :  pion (-)                                  *
!              -13 :   6  :  muon (+)                                  *
!               13 :   7  :  muon (-)                                  *
!              321 :   8  :  kaon (+)                                  *
!              311 :   9  :  kaon (0)                                  *
!             -321 :  10  :  kaon (-)                                  *
!                                                                      *
!               11 :  12  :  electron                                  *
!              -11 :  13  :  positron                                  *
!               22 :  14  :  photon                                    *
!          1000002 :  15  :  deuteron                                  *
!          1000003 :  16  :  triton                                    *
!          2000003 :  17  :  3he                                       *
!          2000004 :  18  :  alpha                                     *
!      Z*1000000+A :  19  :  nucleus                                   *
!                                                                      *
!           kf-code of the other transport particles (ityp=11)         *
!               12 :         nu_e                                      *
!               14 :         nu_mu                                     *
!              221 :         eta                                       *
!              331 :         eta'                                      *
!             -311 :         k0bar                                     *
!            -2112 :         nbar                                      *
!            -2212 :         pbar                                      *
!             3122 :         Lanbda0                                   *
!             3222 :         Sigma+                                    *
!             3212 :         Sigma0                                    *
!             3112 :         Sigma-                                    *
!             3322 :         Xi0                                       *
!             3312 :         Xi-                                       *
!             3334 :         Omega-                                    *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
use MMBANKMOD !FURUTA
use usrtalmod
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
include 'param00.inc'
include 'param.inc'
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /mpi00/ npe, me
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /cusrtally/ iusrtally, iudtf(50)
common /cudtpara/ udtpara(0:9)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /jcomon/ nabov,nobch,nocas,nomax
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/jcomon/)
common /rcomon/ rcasc
common /icomon/ no,mat,ityp,ktyp,jtyp,mtyp,rtyp
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/icomon/)
common /wtsave/ oldwt
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/wtsave/)
common /wtsav2/ oldwt2
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/wtsav2/)
common /tlgeom/ iblz1,iblz2
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlgeom/)
common /tlglat/ ilev1,ilev2,ilat1(5,10),ilat2(5,10)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlglat/)
common /tlcost/ costha, uang(3), nsurf
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/tlcost/)
common /celdb/  idsn(kvlmax), idtn(kvlmax)
!KN 2012/10/31
common /elect/  uint(3), qs, qo, eint, delc, am, qsex, &
&                nq, ns, n1, noz, mtel
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/elect/)
common /mathzn/ mathz, mathn, jcoll, kcoll
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/mathzn/)
common /clustt/ nclsts, iclusts(nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/clustt/)
common /clustw/ jclusts(0:8,nnn),  qclusts(0:12,nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/clustw/)
common /cntcls/ jcount(3,nnn)
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/cntcls/)
integer*8 :: iransb64 ! S.H. xorshift (2020.2.6)
common /randtp/ rijk,rans,ranb,iransb64
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/randtp/)
common /taliin/ rsouin, nzztin, nrgnin
common /kmat1d/ idmn(0:kvlmax), idnm(kvmmax)
integer nudtvar
common /cnudtvar/ nudtvar
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     NEW characters and variables for this user defined tally
!     ( Partcle tracks )
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     Maximum number of tracks: iudtal_maxlimt
parameter ( iudtal_maxlimt = 10000 )
!     Control key (ON/OFF) for this user defined tally
integer iudtal_onoff
common /udtal_00/ iudtal_onoff
!     for 1 event (OMP)
integer iudtal_cas, iudtal_bch, &
&        iudtal_evnt, iudtal_ktyp(iudtal_maxlimt)
common /udtal_01/ iudtal_cas, iudtal_bch, iudtal_evnt, iudtal_ktyp
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/udtal_01/)
double precision udtal_coord00(6,iudtal_maxlimt)
common /udtal_02/ udtal_coord00
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/udtal_02/)
!     Total event
integer iudtal_NUM, iudtal_counter(0:9), &
&        iudtal_kf01(iudtal_maxlimt*2)
common /udtal_03/ iudtal_NUM, iudtal_counter, iudtal_kf01
double precision udtal_c01(6,iudtal_maxlimt*2)
common /udtal_04/ udtal_c01
integer iudtal_iot
save    iudtal_iot
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     START
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( ncol .eq. 1 ) then  ! start of calculation
!     ncol=1: for initialization and setting of variables
  iudtal_onoff =  1
  iudtal_NUM   =  0
  iudtal_counter(0) =  0
  do i = 1, 10
    if( int(udtpara(i)) .ne.  0 .and. i .le. 9) then
      iudtal_counter(i) =  0          ! counter reset
    else
      iudtal_counter(0) =  i          ! summary file No.
      iudtal_iot = iudtal_counter(0)
      iudtal_counter(i) =  0
      exit
    end if
  end do
  write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),&
  &        '(''SUMMARY OF USER DEFINED TALLY (particle tracks)'')')
  if( int(udtpara(0)) .gt. iudtal_maxlimt ) then
    write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),111)&
    &                int(udtpara(0)), iudtal_maxlimt
    udtpara(0) = dble(iudtal_maxlimt)
    write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),113) int(udtpara(0))
  else if( int(udtpara(0)) .eq. 0 ) then
    write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),112) iudtal_maxlimt
    udtpara(0) = dble(iudtal_maxlimt)
    write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),113) int(udtpara(0))
  else if( int(udtpara(0)) .gt. 0 ) then
    write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),113) int(udtpara(0))
  else
    write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),114) int(udtpara(0))
    iudtal_onoff = 0  ! negative number (error)
    return
  end if
  111   format('# Input value (udtpara0:',i9,') is exceeded the maximum',&
  &       ' number of tracks (default:',i9,' @iudtal_maxlimt).'/&
  &       '  -> Value of udtpara0 was changed to iudtal_maxlimt.')
  112   format('# Input value (udtpara0) is not defined.'/&
  &       '  -> Value of udtpara0 was defined to default:',i9,'.')
  113   format('Maximum number of tracks is ',i9,' (udtpara0).')
  114   format('# Input value (udtpara0) is negative (',i9,'). -- STOP')
  write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),'(''Kf-code (ktyp):'')')
  do i = 1, (iudtal_counter(0)-1)
    if( (iudtal_counter(0)-1) .eq.  1 ) then
      write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),fmt='(a,i9,a)')&
      &           'No. ', int(udtpara(i)), ',OMP,    NOCAS,    NOBCH'
    else if( i .eq.  1 ) then
      write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),fmt='(a,i9)',advance='no')&
      &           'No. ', int(udtpara(i))
    else if( i .eq. (iudtal_counter(0)-1) ) then
      write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),fmt='(a,i9,a)')&
      &           ',', int(udtpara(i)), ',OMP,    NOCAS,    NOBCH'
    else
      write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),fmt='(a,i9)',advance='no')&
      &           ',', int(udtpara(i))
    end if
  end do
  iudtal_evnt = 0
  return
else if( ncol .eq. 3 .and. iudtal_onoff .eq. 0 ) then
!     ncol=3: for sub-summary (end of a batch)
!       if( iudtal_counter(iudtal_counter(0)) .gt. 1 )
!    &      call usrtalwrite(iudtal_iot)
  call usrtalwrite(iudtal_iot)
  return
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( iudtal_onoff .eq. 0 ) then  ! OFF
  return
else  ! ON( iudtal_onoff .eq. 1 )
  if( ncol .eq. 2 ) then  ! end of calculation
!     ncol=2: for summary of this calculation
    return
  else if( ncol .eq. 3 ) then  ! end of a batch
!     ncol=3: for sub-summary (end of a batch)
    if( iudtal_evnt .gt.  1 ) &
    &        call usrtalrecord(iudtal_iot,(iudtal_evnt-1))
    call usrtalwrite(iudtal_iot)
    iudtal_evnt = 0
    return
  else if( ncol .gt. 3 ) then  ! ncol = 4 - 15
    if( ncol .eq. 4 ) then  ! source ( start of new event, or
!          end of previous event )
!     ncol=4: for sub-summary (end of previous event)
      if( iudtal_evnt .gt.  1 ) &
      &          call usrtalrecord(iudtal_iot,(iudtal_evnt-1))
!     ncol=4: for sub-summary (start of new event)
      iudtal_evnt = 1
      iudtal_cas  = nocas
      iudtal_bch  = nobch
      return
    else if( ncol .ge.  5 .and. ncol .le.  7 ) then  ! error
!     ncol=5,6,7: error (off-record event)
      iudtal_evnt = -1
      return
    else if( ncol .ge.  8 .and. ncol .le. 15 ) then
!     ncol=8,9,11,12: terminations (record event)
!     ncol=10: geometry boundary crossing (record event)
!     ncol=13,14: reactions (record event)
!     ncol=15: sequential transport only for tally (record event)
!           IF( iblz1 .eq. XXXX ) then
! If you would like to select the tracks in certain cells,
!    please insert above "IF" statement using cell-ID "iblz1".
      if( iudtal_evnt .ge. 1 .and. &
      &            iudtal_evnt .le. iudtal_maxlimt ) then
        iudtal_ktyp(iudtal_evnt) = ktyp
        udtal_coord00(1,iudtal_evnt) = x(no,ipomp+1)
        udtal_coord00(2,iudtal_evnt) = y(no,ipomp+1)
        udtal_coord00(3,iudtal_evnt) = z(no,ipomp+1)
        udtal_coord00(4,iudtal_evnt) = xc(no,ipomp+1)
        udtal_coord00(5,iudtal_evnt) = yc(no,ipomp+1)
        udtal_coord00(6,iudtal_evnt) = zc(no,ipomp+1)
        iudtal_evnt = iudtal_evnt + 1
      else if( iudtal_evnt .gt. iudtal_maxlimt ) then
        write(iudtf(iudtal_iot),115) iudtal_maxlimt
        iudtal_evnt = -1
  115         format('# Error: Number of particle tracks / event was exceeded',&
        &       ' the maximum number of tracks (default:',i9,&
        &       ' @iudtal_maxlimt).')
      else if( iudtal_evnt .lt. 0 ) then
      end if
!           END IF
      return
    else
    end if
  end if
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
return
end
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
subroutine usrtalrecord(iot,nk)
!                                                                      *
!       user defined tally for ParaView output of particle tracks      *
!       ONLY FOR USE in single mode calculation                        *
!       check and record the event                                     *
!       made by N.MATSUDA on 2016/12/16                                *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /ipomp0/ipomp,npomp
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/ipomp0/)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /cusrtally/ iusrtally, iudtf(50)
common /cudtpara/ udtpara(0:9)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     Maximum number of tracks: iudtal_maxlimt
parameter ( iudtal_maxlimt = 10000 )
!     Control key (ON/OFF) for this user defined tally
integer iudtal_onoff
common /udtal_00/ iudtal_onoff
!     for 1 event (OMP)
integer iudtal_cas, iudtal_bch, &
&        iudtal_evnt, iudtal_ktyp(iudtal_maxlimt)
common /udtal_01/ iudtal_cas, iudtal_bch, iudtal_evnt, iudtal_ktyp
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/udtal_01/)
double precision udtal_coord00(6,iudtal_maxlimt)
common /udtal_02/ udtal_coord00
!$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/udtal_02/)
!     Total event
integer iudtal_NUM, iudtal_counter(0:9), &
&        iudtal_kf01(iudtal_maxlimt*2)
common /udtal_03/ iudtal_NUM, iudtal_counter, iudtal_kf01
double precision udtal_c01(6,iudtal_maxlimt*2)
common /udtal_04/ udtal_c01
integer iot, nk, count, ll1(1:9)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
do i = 1, (iot-1)
  ll1(i) = 0
end do
iudtal_NUM = iudtal_NUM + 1
count = 0
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     COUNT
do n = 1, nk
  do  i = 1, (iot-1)
    if( iudtal_ktyp(n) .eq. int(udtpara(i)) ) then
      ll1(i) = ll1(i) + 1
      count = count + 1
      exit
    end if
  end do
end do
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
if( iudtal_NUM .eq.  1 ) then
  write(iudtf(iot),121)
  121   format('Cumulative track number:')
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     CHECK
if( (iudtal_counter(iot)+count) .gt. int(udtpara(0)) ) then
  if( iudtal_NUM .eq.  1 ) then
    write(iudtf(iot),'(2x,''You should change the input value'',&
    &                     '' (udtpara0) which is too small.'')')
  else
    write(iudtf(iot),'(2x,''OFF ( Total tracks > udtpara0 )'')')
  end if
  iudtal_onoff =  0
  return
end if
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     OUT (for summary file)
do i = 1, (iot-1)
  if( (iot-1) .eq. 1 ) then
    write(iudtf(iot),fmt='(i4,i9,x,i9,x,i3,x,i9,x,i9)')&
    &          iudtal_NUM, (iudtal_counter(i)+ll1(i)),&
    &          ipomp, iudtal_cas, iudtal_bch
  else if( i .eq. 1 ) then
    write(iudtf(iot),fmt='(i4,i9,x)',advance='no')&
    &          iudtal_NUM, (iudtal_counter(i)+ll1(i))
  else if( i .eq. (iot-1) ) then
    write(iudtf(iot),fmt='(i9,x,i3,x,i9,x,i9)')&
    &         (iudtal_counter(i)+ll1(i)),&
    &          ipomp, iudtal_cas, iudtal_bch
  else
    write(iudtf(iot),fmt='(i9,x)',advance='no')&
    &         (iudtal_counter(i)+ll1(i))
  end if
end do
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     RECORD ( iudtal_kf01 and udtal_c01 )
do n = 1, nk
  do  i = 1, (iot-1)
    if( iudtal_ktyp(n) .eq. int(udtpara(i)) ) then
      iudtal_counter(iot) = iudtal_counter(iot) + 1
      iudtal_counter(i) = iudtal_counter(i) + 1
      iudtal_kf01(iudtal_counter(iot)) = iudtal_ktyp(n)
      do nn = 1, 6
        udtal_c01(nn,iudtal_counter(iot)) = udtal_coord00(nn,n)
      end do
      exit
    end if
  end do
end do
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
return
end
!***********************************************************************
!                                                                      *
subroutine usrtalwrite(iot)
!                                                                      *
!       user defined tally for ParaView output of particle tracks      *
!       This output subroutine is based on VTK file format (ver. 4.2). *
!       http://www.vtk.org/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/file-formats.pdf *
!       made by N.MATSUDA on 2016/12/16                                *
!                                                                      *
!***********************************************************************
implicit real*8 (a-h,o-z)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
common /cusrtally/ iusrtally, iudtf(50)
common /cudtpara/ udtpara(0:9)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
!     Maximum number of tracks: iudtal_maxlimt
parameter ( iudtal_maxlimt = 10000 )
!     Control key (ON/OFF) for this user defined tally
!     integer iudtal_onoff
!     common /udtal_00/ iudtal_onoff
!     for 1 event (OMP)
!     integer iudtal_cas, iudtal_bch,
!    &        iudtal_evnt, iudtal_ktyp(iudtal_maxlimt)
!     common /udtal_01/ iudtal_cas, iudtal_bch, iudtal_evnt, iudtal_ktyp
! !$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/udtal_01/)
!     double precision udtal_coord00(6,iudtal_maxlimt)
!     common /udtal_02/ udtal_coord00
! !$OMP THREADPRIVATE(/udtal_02/)
!     Total event
integer iudtal_NUM, iudtal_counter(0:9), &
&        iudtal_kf01(iudtal_maxlimt*2)
common /udtal_03/ iudtal_NUM, iudtal_counter, iudtal_kf01
double precision udtal_c01(6,iudtal_maxlimt*2)
common /udtal_04/ udtal_c01
integer iot, nk, ll1
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
nk = iudtal_counter(iot)
do i = 1, (iot-1)
  ll1 = iudtal_counter(i)
  rewind(iudtf(i))
  if( ll1 .gt. 0 ) then
    write(iudtf(i),131) ll1*2
    do n = 1, nk
      if( iudtal_kf01(n) .eq. int(udtpara(i)) ) then
        write(iudtf(i),'(2x,6(1pe13.5))')&
        &                udtal_c01(1,n), udtal_c01(2,n), udtal_c01(3,n),&
        &                udtal_c01(4,n), udtal_c01(5,n), udtal_c01(6,n)
      end if
    end do
    write(iudtf(i),135)
    write(iudtf(i),132) ll1, ll1*3
    do n = 1, ll1
      write(iudtf(i),'(''2  '',i6,x,i6)') (2*n-2), (2*n-1)
    end do
    write(iudtf(i),135)
    write(iudtf(i),133) ll1
    do n = 1, ll1
!             VTK_LINE (=3)
      write(iudtf(i),'(''3'')')
    end do
    write(iudtf(i),135)
  else
    write(iudtf(i),'(''  NO TRACKS'')')
  end if
end do
  131 format('# vtk DataFile Version 3.0',/'Comments',/'ASCII',&
&      /'DATASET UNSTRUCTURED_GRID',/'POINTS',x,i6,x,'float')
  132 format('CELLS',x,i6,x,i6)
  133 format('CELL_TYPES',x,i6)
  135 format(/)
!-----------------------------------------------------------------------
return
end
END_FILE
